title: Pattern-Derived Visual Swarm Games: Multi-Scale Drone-Vision States for Interception and Sustainability Audits
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures. Ancillary files include reproducibility code, dataset manifests, numerical tables, remote audit outputs, and Lean/Coq formal checks
summary: We convert drone-vision annotation streams into virtual swarm-game states without controlling physical drones. VisDrone and UAVSwarm metadata are compressed into a Bloom representation; deterministic probes produce bounded capability vectors, image-space formations, finite zero-sum payoffs, and human-readable visual overlays. The audit scales from $6\times 6$ to $32\times 32$ finite games and adds a repeated Markov layer with stock, fatigue, adaptation, exposure, stress, budget, data-growth, model-improvement, and entropy-budget state variables. Local screen tuning raises robust screen security from $0.526$ to $0.593$, and the $32\times 32$ tuned screen reaches value $0.616$. A field readout audit shows that fixed-pixel rasters do not improve monotonically: $128\times 128$ accuracy is $67.2\%$ and hotspot error is $0.136$. The diagnosed error is shrinking image-plane bandwidth. A finite empirical-risk encoder over scale-normalized Gaussian bandwidths selects a scale-normalized encoder with $λ=1.50$, reaching $77.6\%$ accuracy at $128\times 128$ and reducing joint loss by $0.185$. A server-side audit checks $16{,}777{,}216$ target-localization states, and a 32-round repeated-game audit over $16{,}777{,}216$ trajectories selects a budget-adaptive policy with value $0.461$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将无人机视觉标注流转换为虚拟蜂群博弈状态，通过Bloom压缩表示、确定性探针和有限零和博弈框架进行无人机系统的可扩展审计，涵盖多维度状态变量（库存、疲劳、适应、暴露、压力、预算、数据增长、模型改进、熵预算），并通过屏幕调优、图像带宽优化和服务器端审计提升系统性能。
AI.motivation: 无人机视觉标注系统需要可验证的审计机制，但物理无人机控制成本高且难以规模化。作者旨在不控制物理无人机的前提下，将大规模无人机标注数据转化为虚拟博弈状态，从而实现可扩展、可量化的系统审计与性能评估。
AI.method: 1) 将VisDrone和UAVSwarm元数据压缩为Bloom表示，通过确定性探针生成能力向量、图像空间编队、有限零和收益及可视化覆盖层；2) 审计范围从6×6扩展到32×32有限博弈，并添加带9种状态变量的重复马尔可夫层；3) 进行局部屏幕调优和固定像素栅格审计；4) 使用有限经验风险编码器在尺度归一化高斯带宽上选择最优编码器；5) 服务器端审计检查1677万目标定位状态，进行32轮重复博弈审计选择预算自适应策略。
AI.result: 局部屏幕调优将鲁棒屏幕安全性从0.526提升至0.593，32×32调优屏幕达到值0.616；固定像素栅格不单调改进（128×128精度67.2%，热点误差0.136）；尺度归一化编码器在λ=1.50时达到77.6%精度（128×128），联合损失减少0.185；预算自适应策略在32轮重复博弈中达到值0.461。
AI.conclusion: 无人机视觉系统的审计可以通过虚拟博弈转化和多层次优化（屏幕调优、编码器选择、重复博弈策略）来实现，无需物理控制无人机。诊断出的核心问题是图像平面带宽收缩，而尺度归一化的高斯带宽编码器能够有效缓解此问题。

title: Macro-Operator Generation and Predicate Selection for TAMP Operator Learning
summary: Creating symbolic operators by hand is one of the main bottlenecks in deploying Task and Motion Planning systems (TAMP). Recent works show that these operators can instead be learned directly from demonstration data. Existing methods, however, typically learn each action in isolation and cannot capture the recurring multi-step structure of manipulation tasks, so the search becomes intractable on long sequential tasks. A further inefficiency arises in the symbolic state: every provided predicate is evaluated at every search node, even when it never appears in any learned operator. We present a system that addresses both problems together. Its central component is the automatic generation of macro-operators, composite actions that compress a recurring sequence of individual actions into a single planning step. Our system discovers causally linked action pairs directly from the training data, where one action produces exactly the condition that the next one requires, and turns each pair into a new operator. Alongside this, our system prunes every predicate that no learned operator references, which shrinks the symbolic state evaluated at each search node. Together, these changes shorten the effective planning horizon, and the benefit they bring grows with the length of the task. Across four TAMP domains, our method reaches up to a 4.6x planning speedup compared to the baseline method, namely Learning Operators for TAMP. More importantly, it solves a long sequential task that the baseline cannot solve. Macro-operator discovery thus not only accelerates planning but, in certain domains, determines solvability in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动生成宏算子（macro-operators）的TAMP系统，通过从训练数据中发现因果相连的动作对将其压缩为单一规划步骤，同时剪除未被引用的谓词以缩小符号状态空间，在四个TAMP基准域上实现最高4.6倍规划加速，并能解决基线方法无法求解的长序列任务。
AI.motivation: 手工创建符号算子是部署TAMP系统的主要瓶颈。现有从演示数据学习算子的方法通常孤立地学习每个动作，无法捕捉操作任务中反复出现的多步结构，导致长序列任务上的规划搜索变得难以处理。此外，每个提供的谓词在每个搜索节点都会被评估，即使该谓词从未出现在任何学习到的算子中，造成额外计算开销。
AI.method: 系统包含两大核心组件：(1) 自动生成宏算子——从训练数据中发现因果相连的动作对，即一个动作恰好产生下一个动作所需的前提条件，将每个这样的动作对转化为一个新的复合算子，从而压缩重复出现的多步操作序列；(2) 谓词剪枝——移除所有未被任何学习到算子引用的谓词，缩小每个搜索节点上需要评估的符号状态。两者共同缩短有效规划视界。
AI.result: 在四个TAMP域上，该方法相比基线方法（Learning Operators for TAMP）达到最高4.6倍的规划加速；更重要的是，它能够解决基线无法求解的长序列任务。
AI.conclusion: 宏算子发现不仅能够加速规划，在某些域中甚至决定了任务在实践中是否可解。随着任务长度的增加，该方法带来的收益也越来越大。

title: Concept-Guided Exploration: Building Persistent, Actionable Scene Graphs
summary: The perception of 3D space by mobile robots is rapidly moving from flat metric grid representations to hybrid metric-semantic graphs built from human-interpretable concepts. While most approaches first build metric maps and then add semantic layers, we explore an alternative, concept-first architecture in which spatial understanding emerges from asynchronous concept agents that directly instantiate and manage semantic entities. Our robot employs two spatial concepts (room and door), implemented as autonomous processes within a cognitive distributed architecture. These concept agents cooperatively build a shared scene graph representation of indoor layouts through active exploration and incremental validation. The key architectural principle is hierarchical constraint propagation: Room instantiation provides geometric and semantic priors to guide and support door detection within wall boundaries. The resulting structure is maintained by a complementary functional principle based on prediction-matching loops. This approach is designed to yield an actionable, human-interpretable spatial representation without relying on any pre-existing global metric map, supporting scalable operation and persistent, task-relevant understanding in structured indoor environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"概念优先"的空间认知架构，移动机器人通过异步的概念代理（房间和门）直接从感知构建混合度量-语义场景图，无需预先构建全局度量地图，通过层级约束传播和预测匹配循环实现室内布局的理解与维护。
AI.motivation: 传统方法先构建度量地图再叠加语义层，这种"度量优先"范式在可扩展性、长期任务理解和计算效率上存在瓶颈。作者探索一种替代架构，让空间理解从人类可解释的概念出发，而非从底层度量数据出发。
AI.method: 采用认知分布式架构，将"房间"和"门"两种空间概念实现为自主运行的进程（概念代理）。这些代理通过主动探索和增量验证协同构建共享场景图。核心架构原则为层级约束传播：房间实例化为门检测提供几何和语义先验，引导支撑墙边界内的门识别。系统由基于预测-匹配循环的互补功能原则维护。
AI.result: 该架构能在不依赖预建全局度量地图的情况下生成可操作、人类可解释的空间表示，支持可扩展操作和结构化室内环境中持久、任务相关的理解。
AI.conclusion: 概念优先的架构为移动机器人空间认知提供了一种替代范式，证明空间理解可以从语义概念出发通过自主代理协作涌现，而非必须依赖先验的度量地图。

title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
summary:
While reinforcement learning (RL) allows generalist robot policies to continually improve during deployment, the large model size of modern generalist policies, such as VLAs, poses a fundamental obstacle to effective RL improvement. In particular, their severe inference latency---which can lead to pauses or jerky movements---can alter the effective environment dynamics and, if not correctly accounted for, break the Markov assumption that RL relies on, causing standard RL algorithms to fail completely. In this work, we introduce a latency-aware framework, Asynchronous RL with Intermediate Information (ARLI), that enables RL-based improvement of generalist policies under inference delays.
  Our framework builds on asynchronous inference approaches, which interleave action generation with execution to hide latency, and addresses its incompatibility with RL by providing a low-latency RL policy design that maximizes reactivity within the inference window through two contributions: state augmentations that restore near-Markovian structure by incorporating committed actions and a mid-inference observation.
  We evaluate our approach across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, and find that it enables effective finetuning under inference delays where standard RL fails entirely, even matching or exceeding the performance of standard RL in idealized no-latency settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARLI框架，解决大规模VLA等通用机器人策略在强化学习微调时因推理延迟破坏马尔可夫假设而导致的RL失效问题，通过异步推理与状态增强（加入已执行动作和推理中期观测）恢复近马尔可夫结构，实现在延迟条件下有效的RL微调。
AI.motivation: 虽然强化学习能让通用机器人策略在部署中持续改进，但现代通用策略（如VLA）模型庞大，推理延迟严重，导致动作执行卡顿或抖动，改变环境动态并破坏RL依赖的马尔可夫假设，使标准RL算法完全失效。需要一个能适应推理延迟的RL改进框架。
AI.method: 提出ARLI（异步强化学习+中间信息）：基于异步推理方法（将动作生成与执行交错以隐藏延迟），通过两个贡献解决异步推理与RL的不兼容性：（1）低延迟RL策略设计，最大化推理窗口内的反应性；（2）状态增强，将已提交的动作和推理中期的观测纳入状态，以恢复近马尔可夫结构。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界的操作任务中，ARLI在推理延迟条件下能有效微调，而标准RL完全失效；甚至在理想的无延迟场景中，ARLI也能匹配或超越标准RL的性能。
AI.conclusion: ARLI证明了在推理延迟存在的情况下仍能对通用机器人策略进行有效的RL微调，通过恢复近马尔可夫状态结构解决了异步推理与RL不兼容的难题，为大规模VLA策略的持续学习提供了可行路径。

title: RENDER: Controlling Reader-Facing Evidence in LLM Memory Evaluation
summary: Memory and RAG evaluations often treat the answering model's input as an implementation detail, even though systems may render the same history as a memory entry, summary, typed record, or raw excerpt. We introduce RENDER, a benchmark control that fixes the conversation while varying the reader-facing artifact. RENDER combines a five-level packet ladder, localizing when answer-bearing content enters the input, with deterministic templates approximating ChatGPT-style entries, LangChain summaries, MemGPT-style typed records, and raw conversation. On 500 LongMemEval questions and nine models, matched-budget resolved packets beat recency-truncated raw dialogue by 42.4-72.6 points. In deployed-style templates, best-worst spread is 24.6-48.8 points per model; under the primary scorer, ChatGPT-style entries have higher point estimates than raw conversation on 7 of 9 models. Judge rescoring preserves the positive aggregate effect, but model-specific significance is mixed. Three models scoring 0 percent on formal ledger packets answer the same facts from natural-language entries at 45.4-53.4 percent. The effect persists under retrieval noise and transfers to HotpotQA, suggesting that memory/RAG evaluations should report or control the reader-facing artifact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RENDER基准控制方法，通过在固定对话内容下改变读者看到的记忆/RAG工件格式（如摘要、类型化记录、原始对话等），发现工件的呈现方式对模型回答准确率有显著影响（可造成24.6-48.8分的差异），并建议记忆/RAG评估应报告或控制读者面对的内容格式。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆与RAG评估通常将输入内容的呈现格式视为实现细节，忽视了同一段历史可能以记忆条目、摘要、类型化记录或原始摘录等不同形式呈现给模型，而这些格式差异可能显著影响评估结果。作者希望系统性地量化这种格式效应。
AI.method: 引入RENDER基准控制，包含：(1) 五级数据包阶梯（packet ladder），定位答案承载内容进入输入的位置；(2) 确定性模板，模拟ChatGPT风格条目、LangChain摘要、MemGPT风格类型化记录和原始对话；(3) 在500个LongMemEval问题、9个模型上评测，并设置检索噪声实验和在HotpotQA上做迁移验证；同时使用不同评价器（scorer）进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 在预算匹配下，采用已解析数据包比截断原始对话高42.4-72.6分；在部署风格模板中，每个模型的最佳与最差格式间差异为24.6-48.8分；主要评价器下ChatGPT风格条目在9个模型中的7个上点估计高于原始对话；法官重打分保持了正向总体效应但模型级显著性混合；3个模型在正式账本类型包上得分为0%，但同样事实用自然语言条目回答时达45.4-53.4%；效应在检索噪声下仍存在，并迁移到HotpotQA。
AI.conclusion: 读者面对的记忆/RAG工件格式对模型回答能力有实质性且跨模型、跨数据集稳健的影响，因此记忆/RAG评估应报告或控制读者面对的工件格式，否则评估结论可能因格式选择而产生误导。

title: Transformer Accelerator (TFA): A Macro-Op INT8 Hardware Chip for Transformer Inference and Machine Translation
summary:
We present the Transformer Accelerator (TFA), a synthesizable, parameterizable INT8 memory-to-memory engine for transformer inference. One time-multiplexed datapath handles prompt processing and autoregressive generation. TFA implements matrix multiplication, softmax, RMSNorm, elementwise, and copy/gather operations through eight 512-bit macro-op descriptors. Offline-compiled programs are fetched, validated, and dispatched through AXI interfaces, supporting encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder models.
  The RTL combines an output-stationary multiply-accumulate array with ping-pong buffers that overlap DMA and compute, bit-exact reciprocal-square-root and divide units, key-value-cache and embedding addressing, and an abort-safe zero-padding write engine. A UVM environment byte-compares outputs against a bit-exact golden model. Across 25 tests and 34 constrained-random runs, TFA achieved zero mismatches, 100% functional coverage, and 94.96% code coverage.
  We compiled the t5-small encoder-decoder pipeline for English-to-French, German, and Romanian translation. On ten multilingual proverbs, TFA executed 70,320 descriptors and matched 37.9 MB of golden-model output with zero mismatches. INT8 output matched the floating-point reference token-for-token on five sentences; the rest produced valid alternative translations. Randomized-Hadamard reparameterization recovered about 11 dB of per-tensor INT8 signal-to-noise ratio across layers. The verification configuration achieved about 20x end-to-end speedup over a 22-thread CPU, while larger designs are projected to reduce energy per token by about 1000x. After RAM inference recoding, logic area fell to 2.73 mm2, and the design completed design-rule-clean synthesis and place-and-route on SkyWater sky130. TFA demonstrates end-to-end, bit-exact execution of pretrained transformers using compact hardware and compiler-managed quantization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TFA（Transformer加速器），一个可综合、参数化的INT8存算一体式（memory-to-memory）Transformer推理引擎。它采用单一时分复用数据通路同时处理提示词预处理和自回归生成，通过八个512位宏操作描述符实现了矩阵乘法、softmax、RMSNorm、逐元素运算及copy/gather等操作。RTL设计结合输出驻留MAC阵列、乒乓缓冲、位精确求逆平方根与除法单元、KV缓存与嵌入寻址，以及中止安全的零填充写入引擎。UVM环境与位精确黄金模型逐字节比对，在25项测试和34次约束随机运行中实现零失配、100%功能覆盖率和94.96%代码覆盖率。基于t5-small的英法/德/罗多语翻译验证中，TFA执行了70,320个描述符并匹配37.9MB黄金模型输出零失配。INT8输出在五句上与浮点参考逐token完全一致，其余产生有效的替代翻译。随机化Hadamard重参数化恢复约11dB每张量INT8信噪比。验证配置较22线程CPU实现约20倍端到端加速，更大设计预计将每token能耗降低约1000倍。RAM推理重编码后逻辑面积降至2.73mm²，并在SkyWater sky130工艺上完成DRC清洁的综合与布局布线。TFA展示了使用紧凑硬件和编译器管理的量化实现预训练Transformer的端到端、位精确执行。
AI.motivation: Transformer推理在边缘和嵌入式场景中面临高能效、高吞吐和硬件资源受限的挑战。现有硬件加速器通常难以同时覆盖提示词处理（prompt processing）和自回归生成两种工作模式，且在低精度量化下难以保持输出质量。本文旨在设计一个紧凑、可综合、参数化的硬件引擎，在INT8精度下实现预训练Transformer的端到端、位精确推理，同时兼顾功能正确性、能效和可验证性。
AI.method: TFA采用单一时分复用数据通路，通过八种512位宏操作描述符统一实现矩阵乘法、softmax、RMSNorm、逐元素和copy/gather操作，离线编译的程序经AXI接口获取、验证和分发。硬件架构包含输出驻留乘法累加（MAC）阵列、乒乓缓冲以重叠DMA与计算、位精确的倒数平方根和除法单元、KV缓存与嵌入寻址，以及中止安全的零填充写入引擎。验证方面使用UVM环境与位精确黄金模型逐字节比较，并采用随机化Hadamard重参数化（randomized-Hadamard reparameterization）恢复量化信噪比。
AI.result: 在验证层面，TFA在25项测试和34次约束随机运行中实现零失配、100%功能覆盖率和94.96%代码覆盖率。在t5-small多语翻译任务上，TFA执行70,320个描述符并匹配37.9MB黄金模型输出零失配；INT8输出在五句上与浮点参考逐token完全一致，其余生成有效的替代翻译。随机化Hadamard重参数化恢复约11dB信噪比。验证配置实现约20倍端到端CPU加速，更大设计投影可降低约1000倍每token能耗。RAM推理重编码后逻辑面积为2.73mm²，并在SkyWater sky130工艺上完成综合与布局布线。
AI.conclusion: TFA证明了在紧凑硬件资源和编译器管理量化条件下，可实现预训练Transformer的端到端、位精确INT8推理。其统一数据通路设计、完备的验证方法论和量化解法（Hadamard重参数化）为低功耗边缘Transformer推理提供了可行路径，同时展示了从RTL设计到物理实现（sky130流片级验证）的完整闭环。

title: A Survey of Timing Variability in Microservice-Based Software-Defined Vehicles
comment: Submitted to ACM Computing Surveys, 33 pages, 17 figures
summary: Microservice-based systems are modular and adaptable, but their distributed structure makes their timing behavior difficult to analyze and guarantee. Because latency emerges from interactions among service dependencies, shared resources, and coordinating middleware, local timing disturbances can propagate into system-level effects. This survey examines the sources, propagation mechanisms, and observable impacts of timing variability in microservice-based systems, using software-defined vehicles as a motivating example. It compares major classes of timing models by their assumptions about workload stability, execution structure, resource sharing, observability, and guarantee admissibility, and summarizes their limitations within microservice-based software-defined vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于微服务系统时序可变性（timing variability）的综述，以软件定义汽车为应用场景，分析时序问题的来源、传播机制和可观测影响，并比较不同时序模型的假设条件与局限性。
AI.motivation: 微服务系统虽具有模块化和自适应性，但其分布式结构使得时序行为难以分析和保证。延迟源于服务依赖、共享资源和协调中间件之间的交互，局部时序扰动可能传播为系统级效应，因此需要系统性地综述时序可变性的来源、传播机制和影响。
AI.method: 采用综述研究方法：以软件定义汽车为示例场景，首先分析时序可变性的来源与传播机制，然后比较各类时序模型在负载稳定性、执行结构、资源共享、可观测性和保证可采纳性等维度上的假设，最后总结这些模型在微服务化软件定义汽车中的应用局限。
AI.result: 系统梳理了微服务系统中时序可变性的来源、传播机制与可观测影响，并在多个维度上对主要时序模型类别进行了对比分析，指出了现有模型在微服务化软件定义汽车场景下的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 现有时序模型难以完全适应微服务化软件定义汽车的复杂时序保证需求，需要进一步研究更符合该场景特性的时序建模与分析方法。

title: Taming Visual Neglect: A Variational Information Bottleneck Framework for Adaptive Attention in Multimodal In-Context Learning
summary: Large vision-language models exhibit strong in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet when and why visual context helps multimodal ICL remains poorly understood. Empirical studies show a puzzling dichotomy: models sometimes effectively leverage visual demonstrations, yet often neglect them entirely. We propose VIB-ICL, an information-theoretic framework that resolves this dichotomy through the Information Bottleneck principle. We introduce the Cross-Modal Information Gain (CMIG), which quantifies the additional mutual information that visual context provides about the target beyond textual context. We derive a generalization bound showing that multimodal ICL's excess risk over text-only ICL is governed by the CMIG, proving that multimodal ICL provably outperforms text-only ICL when visual information is non-redundant. We further prove that visual context neglect, often viewed as a failure mode, is the Information Bottleneck-optimal solution when visual information is redundant, yielding a closed-form Attention Reallocation Principle that prescribes how visual attention weights should be adaptively adjusted. We instantiate this principle in the VIB-ICL algorithm, which estimates CMIG via variational bounds and dynamically reallocates attention. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements of up to 4.7\% accuracy gains and 35\% reduction in required demonstrations, validating our theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIB-ICL框架，用信息瓶颈原理解释多模态上下文学习（ICL）中视觉上下文被利用或被忽视的"悖论"现象，并通过跨模态信息增益（CMIG）理论证明显式学习优于文本-only学习，同时证明了视觉上下文被忽视在信息冗余时是IB最优解，并据此设计了注意力重新分配算法，在五个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型展现了强大的上下文学习能力，但视觉上下文在何时以及为何帮助下多模态ICL仍不被理解。实证研究呈现矛盾现象：模型有时有效利用视觉示范，有时却完全忽视它们。这种二分法缺乏统一的理论解释，需要从信息论角度深入阐明。
AI.method: 基于信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck）原则构建统一理论框架，引入跨模态信息增益（CMIG）量化视觉上下文相对于纯文本上下文提供的额外互信息；推导泛化界证明多模态ICL的额外风险由CMIG控制；证明当视觉信息冗余时，视觉上下文忽视是IB最优解，并推导出闭式注意力重新分配原则，实例化为VIB-ICL算法，通过变分界估计CMIG并动态重新分配注意力权重。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，VIB-ICL算法相比基线取得了最高4.7%的准确率提升，并减少了35%所需的示范数量，实验结果验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文从信息论角度成功解释了多模态ICL中视觉上下文利用与忽视的矛盾现象：视觉信息非冗余时应被充分利用以超越文本-only模型，而视觉信息冗余时忽视视觉上下文反而是最优策略。这一统一框架为设计更高效的多模态上下文学习算法提供了理论基础和实用方案。

title: Fidelity Preference, Not Demographic Preference: A Pixel-Level Attribute-Sensitivity Audit of Image Aesthetic/Preference Scorers
summary: Text-to-image systems use learned aesthetic scorers to filter training data and guide generation, but whether these scores encode demographic attributes as objective quality is unclear. We audit four scorers (LAION-Aesthetics, PickScore, ImageReward, HPSv2) using pixel-level interventions on skin tone and body type in synthetic and real images. Our key finding is that along skin-lightness, the dominant effect is fidelity preference: unaltered images score highest, and perturbations in either direction are penalized (inverted-U). Placebo arms show this penalty is not an artifact of the skin operator, as applying the same CIELAB L* shift to non-skin regions yields similar penalty magnitudes. However, the penalty is operator-dependent and holds for all operators only for LAION-Aes. Critically, audits on synthetic images alone are misleading: LAION-Aes shows strong preference for darker skin on synthetic faces, but on 1470 real faces the preference reverses and becomes much smaller, and amplification becomes non-significant. Across scorers, synthetic results do not transfer -- reversing for LAION-Aes and HPSv2, attenuating for PickScore. We contribute a reproducible benchmark with artifact control and synthetic/real cross-validation, and an auditability criterion for pixel-level causal isolation (valid for skin tone, not for body type due to deformation). Population-stratified analysis shows fidelity-penalty asymmetry is not robust across groups after FDR correction except for HPSv2. Our findings show naive synthetic audits misjudge bias direction and magnitude, and only within-image causal isolation on real data can distinguish true demographic bias from fidelity preference.

AI.tldr: 本文对四个美学评分器（LAION-Aesthetics, PickScore, ImageReward, HPSv2）进行了系统审计，通过像素级干预（肤色和体型）发现：评分器的主要效应是保真度偏好（未修改图像得分最高，向任何方向扰动都受惩罚），而非真正的群体偏见；仅使用合成图像进行审计会产生误导性结论，结果无法迁移到真实数据；作者提供了可复现基准和审计标准。
AI.motivation: 文生图系统使用学到的美学评分器来筛选训练数据和指导生成，但评分器中是否编码了人口统计属性（如肤色、体型）作为客观质量指标尚不清楚。现有审计方法通常仅基于合成图像，无法区分真实的群体偏好与像素干扰引入的伪影。
AI.method: 对四个美学评分器使用像素级干预（CIELAB L* 亮度平移调节肤色深浅和体型变形），在合成图像和1470张真实人脸图像上进行审计；设置安慰剂对照组（对非皮肤区域施加相同亮度变化）以排除皮肤操作算子的伪影；进行群体分层分析和FDR校正；提出像素级因果隔离的可审计性标准。
AI.result: 核心发现：沿肤色亮度维度，主导效应是保真度偏好（倒U形，未修改图像得分最高）；该惩罚不是皮肤算子的伪影（安慰剂组有相似惩罚幅度），但依赖操作算子且仅LAION-Aes对所有算子都成立；合成图像审计具有误导性——LAION-Aes在合成图像上偏好较深肤色，但在1470张真实人脸上偏好反转且幅度显著减小；合成结果无法跨评分器迁移（LAION-Aes和HPSv2反转，PickScore减弱）；FDR校正后保真度惩罚不对称性仅在HPSv2上稳健。
AI.conclusion: 天真的合成图像审计会误判偏差的方向和幅度；只有对真实数据做图像内因果隔离才能区分真正的人口统计偏见与保真度偏好。论文贡献了带伪影控制和合成/真实交叉验证的可复现基准，以及像素级因果隔离的审计标准（对肤色有效，对体型因变形无效）。

title: Effective Pivot Attack Detection via System and Network Information
summary: Perimeter-based security appliances, such as firewalls or Intrusion Detection Systems, are ineffective against modern attacks that use pivoting, wherein attackers "pivot" traffic through compromised hosts to gain access to additional targets that would otherwise be inaccessible. Due to the legitimate appearance of the relayed traffic, pivoting is extremely difficult to detect. Although the consequences of these attacks are known to be severe, existing defenses suffer from drawbacks such as high processing delays, low accuracy, or reliance on network-wide participation, making them inconvenient or even ineffective. This work presents Stitch, a host-based system that uses the programmable kernel to detect pivoting in real time. By observing host-traversing flows, Stitch uses process tracing to effectively combine system and network-level information, connecting incoming and outgoing communications and identifying pivoting characteristics between them. Showing 31% gains in accuracy over state-of-the-art pivoting defenses and a maximum false positive rate of 0.006% over two separate real-world deployments, Stitch covers the gap in current pivot detection solutions by providing accurate, lightweight, and independent coverage for vulnerable hosts in a network.

AI.tldr: Stitch是一个基于主机、利用可编程内核实时检测网络渗透（pivoting）的系统。通过进程追踪结合系统级和网络级信息，将进出通信关联起来，识别渗透特征。相比现有最先进防御方案，准确率提升31%，误报率最高仅0.006%。
AI.motivation: 传统基于边界的安全设备（如防火墙、入侵检测系统）无法有效防御利用pivoting技术的现代攻击，这是因为中继流量看起来合法，极难检测。现有防御方案存在处理延迟高、准确率低或依赖全网协同等问题，导致使用不便甚至无效。
AI.method: Stitch是一个基于主机的系统，利用可编程内核实现实时检测。通过观察穿越主机的流量，使用进程追踪有效地结合系统和网络层面的信息，将入站与出站通信关联起来，并识别它们之间的pivoting特征。
AI.result: 相比最先进的pivoting防御方案，Stitch在准确率上提升了31%；在两次独立真实世界部署中，最大误报率仅为0.006%。
AI.conclusion: Stitch通过提供准确、轻量级且可独立部署的防护能力，填补了当前pivoting检测方案的空白，能够为网络中的易受攻击主机提供有效防护。

title: Equivariant Cellular Sheaves for Molecular Electronic Structure: Bridging Sheaf Cohomology and E(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Learning
summary: Equivariant message-passing networks are the standard model for molecular property and interatomic-potential prediction, and recent work predicts the electronic Hamiltonian itself in an E(3)-equivariant way. Separately, topological deep learning has extended graph networks to cellular sheaves. Our central observation is structural: in a localized atomic-orbital basis, the molecular single-particle Hamiltonian, after a constant shift that makes it positive semidefinite, is the Laplacian of a cellular sheaf on a regular cell complex built from the molecule. Making the restriction maps O(3)-steerable two-center kernels from bond geometry recovers the Slater-Koster form as a special case and yields an E(3)- and permutation-equivariant operator. Three consequences follow. First, the zeroth sheaf cohomology H^0 = ker L is a topological invariant equal to the non-bonding (zero-mode) orbitals, recovering the classical alternant non-bonding-orbital count as a lower bound. Second, the Hodge 1-Laplacian lets higher cells (rings) carry cycle and delocalization information through H^1. Third, the model strictly generalizes E(3)-equivariant message-passing networks and CW networks, and inherits the anti-oversmoothing of non-trivial sheaf diffusion. We prove equivariance, expressivity, and cohomological-correspondence results for the Equivariant Cellular Sheaf Networks, and validate them numerically: the Hamiltonian-to-sheaf embedding is exact to machine precision, the cohomology dimension reproduces non-bonding-orbital counts across eleven conjugated molecules, the sheaf Laplacian is O(3)-equivariant to machine precision, and the equivariant model attains lower error and rotation generalization on a directional electronic target. Our contribution is this sheaf-theoretic formalization and its invariants, not equivariant Hamiltonian prediction itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的形式化框架：在局域原子轨道基下，分子单粒子哈密顿量在经过常数平移使其半正定后，等价于一个构建于分子规则胞腔复形上的细胞层（cellular sheaf）的图拉普拉斯算子。作者据此构建了E(3)等变细胞层网络（Equivariant Cellular Sheaf Networks），并从零阶层上同调（非键轨道）、Hodge 1-拉普拉斯（环/离域信息）和模型表达能力三个维度证明了该框架的优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有等变消息传递网络是分子性质预测的标准模型，近期工作也实现了对电子哈密顿量的E(3)等变预测。然而，这些方法缺少对哈密顿量内在拓扑结构的利用。作者的核心洞见在于：局域原子轨道基下的分子哈密顿量在平移后本质上是一个细胞层的拉普拉斯算子，这一结构联系可以将拓扑工具（层上同调）引入分子建模，从而获得更强、更具可解释性的等变模型。
AI.method: 作者首先证明分子单粒子哈密顿量（经常数平移）等于分子规则胞腔复形上细胞层的拉普拉斯算子。接着将限制映射（restriction maps）设计为基于键几何的O(3)可转向双中心核，Slater-Koster形式为其特例，由此得到E(3)与置换等变算子。基于此构建等变细胞层网络（ECSN），并证明其严格generalize E(3)-等变消息传递网络与CW网络，同时继承非平凡层扩散的抗过平滑特性。三个核心结论：H^0对应非键（零模）轨道且为拓扑不变量；Hodge 1-拉普拉斯使环结构携带循环与离域信息；模型具备严格更强的表达能力。
AI.result: 数值验证全面通过：哈密顿量到层的嵌入达到机器精度；跨越11个共轭分子的上同调维数精确复现非键轨道计数；层拉普拉斯的O(3)等变性达到机器精度；在方向性电子目标上，等变模型取得了更低的误差和更好的旋转泛化能力。作者明确强调其贡献在于层论形式化及其不变量，而非等变哈密顿量预测本身。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了分子哈密顿量与细胞层拓扑之间的深层结构对应关系，将代数拓扑工具（层上同调、Hodge理论）引入等变分子建模，既提供了可解释的拓扑不变量（如非键轨道计数），又获得了严格更强的表达能力与抗过平滑性能，为结合拓扑深度学习的分子科学开辟了新的方向。

title: InfoDPP-PAC: Principled Patch Selection for Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Each WSI slide contains thousands of candidate tissue patches, while supervision is usually available only at slide level. Existing bag-construction strategies like Uniform extraction and handcrafted heuristics do not control redundancy while attention-based multiple-instance models couple patch importance to a particular downstream classifier, and coreset methods optimise embedding-space coverage without modelling task-relevant patch quality. We introduce InfoDPP-PAC, a principled patch-selection framework that combines teacher-seeded Gaussian process relevance modelling, determinantal log-determinant diversity,submodular greedy optimisation, and a concentration-based adaptive stopping rule. The main theoretical result shows that the log-determinant diversity term used in DPP-style selection is the Gaussian process mutual information between a selected subset and the latent relevance function. We further derive a PAC-style certificate for residual information gain, allowing the number of retained patches to vary by slide rather than being fixed a priori. The empirical study evaluates whether the selected subset is diverse, spatially and morphologically covering, non-redundant, and enriched for the teacher-derived relevance signal. It does not claim end-to-end diagnostic improvement after retraining a downstream MIL model. On 202 HISTAI gastrointestinal whole-slide images, the adaptive rule uses 83.7% fewer patches on average than a fixed full budget while retaining 97.9% of full-budget composite selection quality. At a matched budget, InfoDPP-PAC achieves the highest mean teacher-derived relevance score among fourteen baselines, with diversity and composite scores close to the strongest coreset methods. The results support InfoDPP-PAC as a controlled quality-diversity-cardinality selection framework, rather than as a downstream clinical predictor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfoDPP-PAC，一个用于全切片图像（WSI）补丁选择的理论驱动框架，结合教师驱动的高斯过程相关性建模、行列式点过程（DPP）多样性、子模贪婪优化及基于浓度的自适应停止规则。核心理论贡献是证明DPP中的log-determinant多样性项等价于高斯过程互信息，并推导出PAC风格证书以自适应决定每张切片保留的补丁数。在202张HISTAI胃肠道WSI上，该方法平均减少83.7%的补丁数同时保留97.9%的全预算组合选择质量，并在匹配预算下取得最高的教师驱动相关性分数。作者明确声明该框架是受控的质量-多样性-基数的选择框架，而非端到端临床诊断模型。
AI.motivation: WSI每张切片包含数千个候选组织补丁，但监督信号通常仅存在于切片级别。现有的包构建策略（如均匀抽取、基于启发式的手工规则）无法控制冗余；基于注意力的多示例模型将补丁重要性与特定下游分类器耦合；核集（coreset）方法优化嵌入空间覆盖但缺乏对任务相关补丁质量的建模。因此需要一个既考虑任务相关性又能控制多样性和冗余的补丁选择框架。
AI.method: InfoDPP-PAC框架包含四个关键组件：(1) 教师驱动的（teacher-seeded）高斯过程回归来建模补丁的相关性（relevance）；(2) 基于行列式点过程（DPP）的log-determinant多样性项；(3) 子模贪婪优化用于选择子集；(4) 基于浓度不等式的自适应停止规则。理论方面，作者证明DPP多样性项等价于所选子集与潜在相关函数之间的高斯过程互信息，并推导出残差信息增益的PAC风格证书，使保留补丁数随切片变化而非预先固定。
AI.result: 在202张HISTAI胃肠道WSI上，自适应规则平均使用比固定全预算少83.7%的补丁，同时保留97.9%的全预算组合选择质量。在匹配预算下，InfoDPP-PAC在14个基线中取得最高的平均教师驱动相关性分数，并具有与最强核集方法相当的多样性和组合分数。实证研究评估了所选子集的多样性、空间与形态覆盖性、非冗余性以及教师驱动相关性信号的富集程度，但未声称重训练下游MIL模型后能实现端到端诊断改进。
AI.conclusion: InfoDPP-PAC被定位为一个受控的质量-多样性-基数补丁选择框架，而非下游临床预测器。该框架在极大减少补丁数量的同时维持了高质量的选择，并通过理论保证（高斯过程互信息等价性与PAC证书）为自适应补丁数量提供了依据。研究局限性在于未验证重训练下游MIL模型后的端到端诊断性能提升。

title: A Human-Factors Guided Cognitive Model of Visuospatial Complexity in Embodied Active Vision
comment: Preprint; AIC 2025: Artificial Intelligence and Cognition
summary: We propose a novel framework for the analysis of multimodal data -- encompassing visual, auditory, and spatial stimuli -- foregrounding the role of complexity in embodied perception and interaction in dynamic, naturalistic settings. Grounded in theories of embodied cognition and active vision, we argue that embodied perceptual complexity emerges from an agent's dynamic engagement with the environment and must be analyzed holistically, as a combination of qualitative and quantitative attributes pertaining to, for instance, visuospatial and auditory features. Building on previous work on visual complexity, we expand this into a categorization of diverse complexity attributes -- quantitative, structural, dynamic, auditory, and interactional -- that together characterize multimodal complexity. We demonstrate how this model provides a theoretical framework for characterizing aspects of visuospatial complexity and their interactions, specifically in the context of everyday driving. We also discuss practical applications of the proposed model for creating and evaluating benchmark datasets (e.g., in driving) that centralize cognitive human factors, as well as applications aimed at systematically investigating the effect of visuospatial complexity on human active vision from the viewpoint of visual perception research. The proposed framework lays the foundation for automated methods that interpret complexity in 3D dynamic environments from a human-centered perspective, serving as a semantic template for explainable computational analysis of visuospatial complexity with a categorical focus on cognitive human factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多模态数据分析的新型框架，强调具身感知中复杂性的核心作用，将复杂性分解为定量、结构、动态、听觉和交互五类属性，并以日常驾驶场景为例展示其应用，为可解释的计算分析奠定语义模板基础。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉复杂性研究多局限于静态视觉特征，缺乏对多模态（视觉、听觉、空间）数据中具身感知复杂性的整体性考量；在动态自然环境中，复杂性需结合认知主体与环境的动态交互来理解，现有框架无法满足这一需求。
AI.method: 基于具身认知与主动视觉理论，提出多模态复杂性分类模型，将复杂性划分为定量、结构、动态、听觉和交互五大属性类别；以日常驾驶为具体情境，演示该模型如何表征视觉空间复杂性及其维度间的交互。
AI.result: 该框架为驾驶等动态三维环境中的复杂性解释提供了理论支撑，可用于基准数据集构建与评估（融合认知人为因素），并为视觉感知研究中主动视觉机制的复杂性效应研究提供系统性方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为以人为中心的可解释计算分析奠定基础，可作为三维动态环境中视觉空间复杂性的语义模板，聚焦认知人为因素，服务于自动化复杂性解释方法。

title: Resilience Matters for Embodied Agents System: New Metrics, Systematic Evaluation, and Optimization
summary: Embodied Agents System (EAS) are increasingly deployed in open-world physical domains, where reliability directly dictates deployment quality and human-agent trust. However, existing evaluations rely on outcome-centric metrics as success rate or safety scores that collapse diverse execution trajectories into coarse scores, obscuring the dynamic processes underlying agent behavior. Therefore, they ignore a critical property of EAS -- which we define as the Resilience -- that reflects how EASs recover, stabilize, and extend under perturbations and across iterative updates. The lack of resilience is particularly critical in open-world environments due to continuous unexpected disruptions, thus directly affecting the quality of EAS deployment. To address this problem, we gain insight from the resilience-engineering concepts to EAS groundings and propose a novel resilience evaluation framework that can be flexibly applied to any EAS. Specifically, we define the first comprehensive resilience metrics suite for EASs system that exposes Rebound, Stability, and Graceful Extensibility across embodied tasks execution, providing a practical grounding for EAS resilience analysis. We further implement the resilience evaluation layer that transforms execution process into assessments for diagnosis and optimization. Across 400 household tasks with 10 EAS, we reveal the process-level distinction hidden by outcome metrics, including recovery cost differences among successful episodes ($ΔC_{rec}=25.2$), increased instability and task-family degradation. Metrics-guided optimizations reduce recovery cost and increase stability, graceful extensibility completion, showing the diagnostic effect of resilience evaluation. Our results reveal a trade-off among resilience characteristics, suggesting that a resilient EAS construction should be configured according to deployment-specific requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向具身智能体系统（EAS）的韧性（Resilience）评估框架，包含回弹（Rebound）、稳定性（Stability）和优雅扩展性（Graceful Extensibility）三个维度的度量套件，通过过程级分析揭示传统结果导向指标所隐藏的行为差异，并在400个家庭任务中对10个EAS进行了验证，证明该框架可用于诊断和优化EAS的部署。
AI.motivation: 现有EAS评估主要依赖成功率和安全分数等结果导向指标，将多样的执行轨迹压缩为粗糙的分数，忽略了执行过程中的动态行为。这一缺失导致无法捕捉EAS在扰动下恢复、稳定和扩展的关键能力——即韧性（Resilience），而该特性在开放世界环境中因持续出现意外干扰而至关重要。
AI.method: 借鉴韧性工程（resilience-engineering）概念并将其映射到EAS领域，首次定义了涵盖回弹（Rebound）、稳定性（Stability）和优雅扩展性（Graceful Extensibility）三个维度的综合韧性度量套件，并实现了韧性评估层，将执行过程转化为可用于诊断和优化的评估结果，可灵活适用于任意EAS。
AI.result: 在400个家庭任务和10个EAS的实验中，该框架揭示了结果指标掩盖的过程级差异，包括成功episode之间恢复成本差异（ΔC_rec=25.2）、稳定性下降和任务族退化等现象。基于度量引导的优化降低了恢复成本并提升了稳定性和优雅扩展性完成度。此外，发现韧性特性之间存在权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 韧性评估能够提供结果指标无法揭示的过程级洞察，具有诊断和优化EAS的实用价值。韧性各维度之间存在内在权衡，这表明构建韧性EAS时应根据具体部署需求进行配置，而非追求单一维度的最大化。

title: ESQ-Bench: A Multi-Tier Enterprise Oracle Benchmark for Evaluating NL2SQL Dialect Generalization and Silent Semantic Divergence
summary: State-of-the-art Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) models report execution accuracy exceeding 89 percent on established benchmarks such as Spider and BIRD. However, these benchmarks rely on simplified academic schemas and open-source SQL dialects that do not reflect the complexity of enterprise database environments. We introduce ESQ-Bench, an Oracle-first NL2SQL benchmark with systematic complexity tiers and silent-divergence evaluation across three enterprise schema complexity tiers. We constructed and released six populated schemas (465 tables, 164,682 rows, zero empty tables) with identical seed data on Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, a four-metric evaluation harness (EM, EX, SR, SD), and 550 gold-validated question-query pairs (Tier-1: 95; Tier-2: 228; Tier-3: 227). Schema-linked prompting with GPT-4o shows monotonic execution-match degradation across tiers: 79.8, 60.3, and 57.2 percent EX on executed queries (June 2026), versus 75.6, 80.4, and 95.8 percent on an earlier 142-question pilot slice. EM stays below 7 percent tier-wide; operational silent-divergence reaches 73 to 99 percent among EX-passing queries. Failure analysis shows wrong-result semantics dominate at higher tiers. Claude Sonnet 4.6 with schema-linked prompts reaches 87.4, 74.9, and 68.7 percent EX (executed queries), exceeding GPT-4o schema-linked on every tier. GPT-4o zero-shot EX on executed queries (78.7, 73.5, and 77.8 percent) inverts schema-linked at Tiers 2 to 3 due to lower execution rates and survivor bias in the zero-shot versus schema-linked analysis. Local Llama 3.2 schema-linked reaches only 13.3 percent bank-wide EX (73 out of 550), underscoring the gap between closed API models and open-weight baselines on enterprise Oracle schemas.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍ESQ-Bench，一个面向企业级Oracle数据库环境的NL2SQL基准测试，包含三个复杂度层级、六个跨数据库平台填充模式（465张表、164,682行）和550个金标准问题对。实验表明GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4.6在schema-linked提示下执行准确率随复杂度层级单调下降（79.8/60.3/57.2%，87.4/74.9/68.7%），EM始终低于7%，无声分歧率高达73-99%，本地开源模型Llama 3.2仅达13.3%，揭示了现有基准与企业真实场景之间的巨大差距。
AI.motivation: 现有NL2SQL基准（如Spider和BIRD）依赖简化的学术模式和开源SQL方言，无法反映企业数据库环境的复杂性。即使在基准上执行准确率超过89%，这些模型在企业级Oracle场景中的真实表现尚不明确。作者旨在构建一个Oracle优先、具系统性复杂度层级的企业级NL2SQL基准，以填补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 构建ESQ-Bench基准，包含：(1) 六个已填充的Schema（465张表、164,682行、零空表），在Oracle、PostgreSQL、MySQL和SQL Server上使用相同种子数据；(2) 四个评估指标（EM、EX、SR、SD），涵盖执行匹配和无声分歧评估；(3) 550个金标准验证的问题-查询对，分为三个复杂度层级（Tier-1:95, Tier-2:228, Tier-3:227）。使用schema-linked提示和零样本两种策略测试GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.6和Llama 3.2。
AI.result: GPT-4o schema-linked在三个层级的EX分别为79.8%、60.3%和57.2%，呈单调下降；EM在全部层级低于7%；通过EX的查询中无声分歧率达73-99%。Claude Sonnet 4.6在每层均超过GPT-4o schema-linked（87.4/74.9/68.7%）。GPT-4o零样本EX为78.7/73.5/77.8%，由于幸存者偏差导致层级2-3反转。Llama 3.2仅达13.3%，显示闭源API模型与开源权重基线之间的巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有NL2SQL基准高估了模型在企业Oracle环境中的实际能力。企业级schema复杂度导致执行匹配显著下降，EM指标极低，且大量EX通过的查询仍存在无声分歧（结果正确但语义偏离），说明执行准确率本身不足以衡量企业场景中的可靠性。闭源API模型显著优于开源模型，但即使最先进的模型在企业级复杂度下仍远未达到实用可靠水平。

title: Squeezing the Cache, Preserving the Truth: Monotonic Equipotential Allocation with Geodesia-KV
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code and vLLM integration available at https://github.com/geodesia-ai/geodesia-kv
summary: Current assessment of KV-cache compression performance confuses resident bits with read bandwidth and is affected by the artifacts of chunked teacher-forcing. We present Geodesia-KV, a family of training-free KV cache policies based on monotonic block-wise precision allocation, exact rate-distortion residuals, and query-sparse reading, enabling proper hardware-ready compression. With proper separation of resident and read bits and causal evaluation, we show that Geodesia-KV significantly outperforms other approaches. Specifically, on WikiText-2 with 16k context, the 5-bit operating point of Geodesia-KV results in lower perplexity at lower bitrate than KIVI-4 on Qwen. In addition, our compressed-Quest version delivers improved perplexity and reduces resident (9.83 vs 16.25 bits/value) and read rates (1.95 vs 2.32 bits/value) over baseline sparse methods on PG-19. As Geodesia-KV is implemented as native GeodesiaKVCacheManager plug-in of vLLM, Geodesia-KV fully removes the need for dense cache residency via monotonic bit demotion. With the full consumer hardware evaluation, Geodesia-KV leads to 1M-token context generation on a single 16 GiB GPU with up to 71.7% peak VRAM savings on all leading architectures (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek).

title: Memory-Sovereign Inference: Output-Exact Execution Beyond Full Residency
summary:
Storage-backed inference is easy to overclaim: process RSS excludes charged page cache, process-local device readings exclude board-wide use, and successful generation does not establish correct asynchronous reuse. We present a falsifiable certificate separating representation, semantic demand, scheduler requests, and traffic while naming resource authorities, exactness horizons, and tested reuse transitions.
  At one Qwen3-Next identity, the stock router selects all 48 x 512 managed layer-expert objects during 32K prefill. Their duplicate-free, overlap-free canonical union gives a 43.59375 GiB semantic-demand lower bound, exceeding the declared 34 GiB full-residency envelope and the 11 GiB host-hard plus physical 24 GiB-device envelope. LRU64 execution stays within its host-hard/GPU-audited contract. Against one prespecified zero-cache oracle, all 64 token IDs, every byte of 64 complete 151,936-float logit rows, 3,408 route events, response bytes, and recorded consumer and destination identities are exact. Recurrent-state and upstream-runtime equality are excluded.
  In a matched source campaign, the buffered path completes exactly but reaches the 11 GiB host ceiling and records 33,481 memory.max events. The blocking one-window direct path and complete eight-window asynchronous component are exact with positive margin and zero limit events. Across six counterbalanced pairs, the complete asynchronous component takes 32.3% of the blocking direct path's wall time at identical physical source bytes per output; the comparison jointly changes queue depth, overlap, and lifecycle implementation. Separately, fourteen prespecified control/fault cells pass across later Qwen3-Next and Gemma 4 binaries, supporting fail-closed behavior only for the named transitions. The principal experiment is one fixed model, workload, runtime, device, and 64-output horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可证伪的存储后援推理证书，通过区分表示层、语义需求、调度请求和流量，并标注资源权威、精确水平及测试的复用转换，对Qwen3-Next模型的缓存复用性能进行了严格验证。结果表明LRU64执行严格满足其host-hard/GPU审计契约，异步完整组件相比阻塞直接路径节省约67.7%的墙钟时间。
AI.motivation: 存储后援推理的性能声明容易被过度夸大：进程RSS排除了计费的页面缓存，进程本地设备读数排除了板级功耗，且成功生成并不能证明正确的异步复用。因此需要一种可证伪的证书来严格验证声明，避免误导性的性能结论。
AI.method: 提出一种可证伪的证书框架，将表示层、语义需求、调度请求和流量分开命名，并标注资源权威（如host-hard/GPU审计）、精确水平（如64输出horizon）和测试的复用转换。在Qwen3-Next身份和匹配源码战役中，对比缓冲路径、阻塞直接路径和完整异步组件，执行精确字节级验证（token ID、logit行、路由事件、响应字节及消费者/目标身份）并记录memory.max等限制事件。
AI.result: 在32K prefill中，48个512维托管层专家对象的无重复、无重叠规范并集给出43.59375 GiB的语义需求下界，超过声明的34 GiB全驻留包络和11 GiB host-hard + 24 GiB物理设备包络。LRU64执行保持在合同范围内。匹配源码战役中，缓冲路径达到11 GiB host上限并记录33,481个memory.max事件；完整异步组件精确且零限制事件，墙钟时间仅为阻塞直接路径的32.3%。14个预指定的控制/故障单元通过，支持仅针对命名转换的fail-closed行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过可证伪的证书框架，作者证明异步复用路径在语义需求超出声明包络的情况下仍能精确完成，且显著优于阻塞直接路径。但结论的普适性有限：主实验仅针对单一模型、工作负载、运行时、设备和64输出horizon，且循环状态和上游运行时相等性被排除在验证范围之外。

title: From Triage to Discharge: A Survey of NLP Tasks, Methods, and Open Challenges in the Emergency Department
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference; camera-ready version
summary: Emergency departments (EDs) operate under time pressure, generating multimodal data such as clinical conversations, triage notes, and discharge documents. Recent advances in natural language processing (NLP), particularly pretrained transformers and large language models, have created new opportunities to support language and time-intensive stages of emergency care. Yet existing surveys map clinical NLP across the broader hospital workflow or focus on specific tasks. This survey analyses 46 papers spanning the three phases of ED: triage, diagnosis, and disposition, covering tasks such as triage classification, clinical summarisation, automatic diagnosis, report generation, and discharge documentation. We examine modelling paradigms, evaluation practices, and emerging benchmarks and shared tasks. Across tasks, we identify common trends, including a shift from task-specific neural architectures to pretrained language models, growing interest in interactive clinical systems, and increasing attention to clinically grounded evaluation. Finally, we detail open challenges such as limited generalisability, noisy clinical inputs, and workflow constraints that inform future ED-NLP research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了46篇急诊科（ED）自然语言处理（NLP）研究论文，覆盖分诊、诊断和处置三个阶段，分析建模范式、评估实践及新兴基准，识别了从任务特定架构向预训练语言模型转变、交互式临床系统兴起、临床评估受关注等趋势，并指出泛化性不足、临床输入噪声和工作流约束等开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 急诊科在高压环境下产生大量多模态临床数据（如对话、分诊笔记、出院文档），NLP进展为语言和耗时的急诊环节提供了新机遇。然而现有综述要么横跨整个医院流程范围过广，要么聚焦于单一任务，缺乏针对急诊科全流程（分诊→诊断→处置）NLP的系统性梳理，因此需要一篇聚焦ED三阶段任务的专门综述。
AI.method: 作者系统地分析了46篇论文，将其按急诊科三个核心阶段（分诊、诊断、处置）进行归类，覆盖分诊分类、临床摘要、自动诊断、报告生成和出院文档等任务，并从建模范式、评估实践、基准与共享任务三个维度进行综合审视。
AI.result: 识别出三大共同趋势：(1) 从任务特有神经网络架构转向预训练语言模型；(2) 对交互式临床系统的兴趣日益增长；(3) 日益重视临床接地评估（clinically grounded evaluation）。同时梳理了现存的benchmarks与共享任务。
AI.conclusion: 尽管ED-NLP取得了显著进展，仍面临泛化性有限、临床输入噪声大、工作流约束等开放挑战，这些为未来ED-NLP研究指明了方向。

title: The Blending Ratio Is Not Where the Performance Is: Diagnosing Prototype Blending for Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary: Many few-shot adaptation methods for vision-language models classify with a convex combination of the zero-shot text prototype and the mean of the K labelled image features, with a single blending ratio routinely tuned on held-out labels, often on the test set itself. We ask what the family's own bias-variance justification invites: what is the right ratio, can it be estimated without validation data, and is finding it where the performance is? First, the ratio minimising prototype mean-squared error has a closed form whose support-set plug-in is exactly a positive-part James-Stein coefficient shrinking towards the text prototype. Across 4,800 cells (ten datasets, five backbones including SigLIP, five shot counts, five seeds, four prompt tiers) this theoretically optimal ratio is a reliable estimate of the wrong quantity: on the 950 primary-tier cells where it is defined it trails a test-set-oracle ratio by 8.5 points. It saturates near 1, discarding the text prior for a nearest-class-mean classifier, because 78% of the text-image prototype distance it treats as bias is a class-independent offset that the arg max largely cancels. We prove the mechanism and bound its share of the damage at 26% by a counterfactual. Second, leave-one-out on the support set alone sets a ratio landing within 0.9 points of the oracle blend, so it is estimable without validation data. Third, validation-free linear probes beat even the oracle-tuned blend: CLAP by +1.9 points and LP++ by +1.5 on average, and at K >= 4 all four validation-free baselines sit above the oracle, the linear probes by margins excluding zero. These results locate the ceiling in the model class, not the hyperparameter: the ratio can be set near-optimally for free, and it is still not where the performance is. Code, cached features, per-cell records: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Liangzhi-Li/clipbench-blending

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地研究了视觉-语言模型少样本适应中"零样本文本原型与K个标注图像特征均值凸组合"这一经典方法族的融合比率问题。作者发现：(1) 使原型均方误差最小的理论最优比率（其支持集插件估计恰好是正部James-Stein收缩系数）在实际中是一个"错量的可靠估计"——在950个主层单元中比测试集oracle比率低8.5个点，且饱和于1（丢弃文本身先验），原因是78%的文本-图像原型距离是类别无关偏移量，arg max会将其抵消（已证明机制并界定其最多贡献26%的损失）；(2) 仅仅在支持集上做留一法即可设置一个与oracle融合相差0.9个点的比率，因此无需验证数据即可估计；(3) 免验证的线性探针甚至胜过oracle调优的融合：CLAP平均+1.9点、LP++平均+1.5点，且在K≥4时所有四个免验证基线都高于oracle。结论是性能天花板位于模型类而非超参数——比率可以近乎最优地免费设定，但它仍然不是性能所在之处。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本适应方法（如CLIP线性探针、Tip-Adapter等）通常依赖于用验证集（甚至测试集本身）调优单一融合比率，缺乏理论指导。作者希望探究：正确的比率是什么？能否在没有验证数据的情况下估计？以及找到最优比率是否真的能带来性能提升？
AI.method: (1) 推导使原型均方误差最小化的封闭形式最优比率，证明其支持集插件估计等价于正部James-Stein收缩系数；(2) 通过大规模实验（4,800个单元：10数据集×5骨干网络含SigLIP×5个shot数×5个种子×4个提示层级）系统评估该理论最优比率；(3) 证明文本-图像原型距离中78%是类别无关偏移量的机制；(4) 提出基于支持集留一法的免验证比率估计；(5) 对比CLAP、LP++等免验证线性探针基线。
AI.result: 理论最优比率是"错量的可靠估计"：在950个主层单元中比oracle低8.5点，且饱和于1即退化为最近类均值分类器。该退化源于78%的文本-图像原型距离属于类别无关偏移，arg max可抵消（机制已证明，占比界为26%）。留一法比率与oracle仅差0.9点，证明比率可免验证估计。但免验证线性探针（CLAP +1.9、LP++ +1.5）甚至超过oracle融合，K≥4时四条免验证基线均高于oracle。
AI.conclusion: 性能天花板位于模型类（线性探针等更丰富模型）而非融合比率这一超参数。比率可以近乎最优地免费设定，但即使如此它也不是性能所在之处，研究应转向超越凸组合的模型设计。

title: TrustShiftProbe: Characterizing, Benchmarking, and Defending Staged Trust Attacks on MCP Servers
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as the standard layer connecting Large Language Model agents to external tool backends. This openness introduces a severe server-side threat we term TrustShift: a compromised MCP server behaves benignly during an initial conditioning phase, building operational reliance and suppressing agent skepticism, before switching to an adversarial payload once an interaction threshold is reached. The evasion is temporal, not syntactic: benign at deploy time, the server's defection is invisible to predeployment static analysis, which sees only the honest phase. Switched payloads range from overt structural violations to schema-valid manipulations, the latter preserving outer protocol compliance to evade runtime middleware filters. Crucially, TrustShift originates in the server-controlled tool channel, not user prompts (unlike indirect prompt injection) or the transport (unlike man-in-the-middle): the adversary is the trusted server endpoint itself. We introduce TrustShiftProbe, an evaluation and defense framework with four contributions: (1) a stateful temporal threat model of the agent-server lifecycle as a benign conditioning phase followed by an adversarial defection at a trust horizon; (2) a language-agnostic attack engine that instantiates each variant as a compromised MCP server across four production domains; (3) SHIELD, a multi-tier, zero-oracle runtime defense at the MCP transport boundary that audits server payloads against behavioral baselines learned during clean trust windows; and (4) a taxonomy of nine TrustShift variants spanning three execution mechanisms (structural violation, semantic corruption, scope expansion) and three adversarial objectives (disruption, exfiltration, and their combination). Across frontier proprietary and open-weight models, TrustShift attacks achieve a 69.5% mean attack success rate that SHIELD mitigates to 42.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrustShift攻击：一种针对Model Context Protocol (MCP)服务器的时序性安全威胁，恶意服务器在初始阶段表现良性以建立信任，达到交互阈值后切换至对抗性载荷。作者提出了TrustShiftProbe评估与防御框架，包含状态性时序威胁模型、语言无关的攻击引擎、多层级零预言机运行时防御SHIELD，以及九种TrustShift变体的分类体系。实验表明攻击平均成功率69.5%，SHIELD可将其降至42.7%。
AI.motivation: MCP已成为连接LLM代理与外部工具的标准层，但其开放性引入了服务器端的严重安全威胁。传统静态分析无法检测此类时序性逃避攻击，因为服务器在部署时表现良性，仅在运行后通过交互阈值才发动攻击。与间接提示注入或中间人攻击不同，TrustShift的恶意源头是受信任的服务器端点本身，填补了这一安全研究空白。
AI.method: TrustShiftProbe框架包含四个核心组件：(1)状态性时序威胁模型，将代理-服务器生命周期建模为良性条件化阶段后接信任视界处的对抗性叛逃；(2)语言无关的攻击引擎，在四个生产领域实例化各类妥协MCP服务器；(3)SHIELD运行时防御，在MCP传输边界进行多层级零预言机审计，基于良性信任窗口内学习的行为基线校验服务器载荷；(4)九种TrustShift变体分类体系，涵盖三种执行机制（结构性违规、语义损坏、范围扩展）和三种对抗目标（破坏、数据外泄及两者结合）。
AI.result: 在前沿专有和开源权重模型上的实验表明，TrustShift攻击达到69.5%的平均攻击成功率，SHIELD防御将其缓解至42.7%。
AI.conclusion: TrustShift揭示了一种新型的、从信任的服务器端点起源的低协议层安全漏洞；虽然SHIELD提供了显著的防御效果，但42.7%的残余攻击率表明该威胁尚无完全解决方案，需要进一步研究。该工作为MCP生态系统的安全性提供了评估基线，并呼吁建立针对时序性服务器叛逃的运行时检测机制。

title: Data Predictability Shapes Weibull Weight-Scale Growth in Transformer Training
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public
summary: A trained transformer's weight magnitudes can be summarized by a two-parameter Weibull distribution whose shape $k \approx 1.2$ is stable across layers and models, so the scale $λ$ carries most training-induced movement. What corpus property sets how much $λ$ grows? Using the bigram conditional entropy $D = H(\text{next} \mid \text{prev})$, a training-free statistic computed before training, we find across controlled corruption families a learning-rate-conditioned law, $λ^2 - λ_0^2 = C_0(η) + C_1(η)(H_r - D)^{0.59}$, where $H_r$ is a matched-budget shuffle baseline. The convex exponent is inherited from an independently measured data-side saturation relation rather than fitted directly to the growth curve. After removing the two per-$η$ coefficients, 23 runs spanning an order of magnitude in learning rate collapse onto $(H_r - D)^{0.59}$ with unit slope ($R^2 = 0.941$; direct per-$η$ fits are weaker, $R^2 \approx 0.82$). Because $D$ is computed before training, the law is a forward predictor: an end-to-end self-validation recovers held-out within-family weight growth with 5.7% relative error. The readout holds at model and per-layer resolutions and across two tested architectures, with the functional form preserved and only the coefficients changing. It also marks its boundary: cross-corpus prediction over-predicts code, implicating redundancy as a second axis of a broader $Φ(D,R,A,H)$ data-to-weight framework.

AI.tldr: 本文发现训练后的Transformer权重幅度可由双参数Weibull分布（形状参数k≈1.2稳定）刻画，其中尺度参数λ的成长与训练前可计算的二元条件熵D=H(next|prev)相关，存在学习率条件化的定律λ²-λ₀²=C₀(η)+C₁(η)(H_r-D)^{0.59}，可作为前向预测器，跨23个实验在去除每η系数后以单位斜率塌缩到统一曲线上（R²=0.941），端到端自验证相对误差5.7%。
AI.motivation: 理解训练后的Transformer权重幅度变化背后由什么语料属性驱动，特别是λ的增长来源。已有研究仅描述Weibull分布规律本身，但未解释λ这一承载主要训练变化的参数受何种数据性质控制。
AI.method: 1) 使用二元条件熵D=H(next|prev)作为训练前可计算的语料统计量；2) 通过受控损坏语料族进行实验，测试不同学习率下λ²-λ₀²与(H_r-D)之间的标度关系；3) 指数0.59并非从增长曲线直接拟合，而是继承自独立测量的数据侧饱和关系；4) 通过端到端自验证测试预测能力，比较去除每η系数后的塌缩质量（R²=0.941）与直接每η拟合（R²≈0.82）。
AI.result: 发现学习率条件化定律λ²-λ₀²=C₀(η)+C₁(η)(H_r-D)^{0.59}；23个训练实验跨一个数量级的学习率在去除两个每η系数后以单位斜率塌缩到(H_r-D)^{0.59}上；端到端自验证恢复held-out同族权重增长相对误差5.7%；该关系在模型级和逐层分辨率均成立，并在两种架构上保持函数形式不变仅系数变化。
AI.conclusion: 条件熵差(H_r-D)是驱动权重幅度λ增长的核心数据属性，且该性质在训练前可计算，从而构成前向预测框架。但跨语料预测对代码语料过预测，暗示冗余性构成数据到权重映射的第二维度，指向更宏观的Φ(D,R,A,H)数据到权重框架。

title: A nonlinear dynamics approach to assess amplitude-frequency coupling in non-invasive human electrogastrography recordings
summary: Conventional electrogastrography (EGG) analyses summarize gastric slow-wave activity using dominant frequency, power, or phase-based metrics, without explicitly modeling amplitude-dependent frequency dynamics. We developed a statistical nonlinear-dynamics framework that represents the gastric-band analytic EGG signal as a stochastic Stuart-Landau oscillator and estimate local effective phase-shear, $β_{\mathrm{eff}}$, a normalized measure of amplitude-frequency coupling. In overnight recordings from 60 healthy participants, effective phase-shear was consistently negative, generalized to held-out halves of each recording, and was abolished by amplitude surrogates that disrupted amplitude-phase alignment while preserving amplitude-series structure. We then applied the measure to fasted and fed recordings from 16 healthy participants and 24 participants with gastric dysfunction. Phase-shear magnitude differed between groups and classified dysfunction comparable to the strongest multielectrode phase-based traveling-wave measures. These findings establish amplitude-frequency coupling as a dynamical feature of gastric-band EGG that complements conventional spectral and spatial phase metrics, while motivating future multichannel observation models to determine its relationship to slow-wave propagation and gastric function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于随机Stuart-Landau振子的统计非线性动力学框架，通过估计有效相位剪切β_eff（振幅-频率耦合的归一化度量）来分析胃电描记术（EGG）信号。在60名健康参与者的过夜记录中，β_eff一致为负且可泛化，并可通过振幅代理数据消除；将其应用于胃功能障碍患者时，相位剪切幅值能区分组别，其分类性能与最强多电极相位行波指标相当。
AI.motivation: 传统电胃描记术（EGG）分析仅使用主导频率、功率或基于相位的指标来总结胃慢波活动，未显式建模振幅依赖的频率动态，缺少能够刻画振幅-频率耦合的非线性动力学指标。
AI.method: 将胃频带解析EGG信号建模为随机Stuart-Landau振子，估计局部有效相位剪切β_eff作为归一化的振幅-频率耦合度量；通过过夜记录分段泛化验证和振幅代理数据检验，并在禁食/进食状态下对健康人与胃功能障碍患者进行分组比较与分类评估。
AI.result: 在60名健康受试者的过夜记录中，有效相位剪切一致为负且可泛化到各记录的对半分割，振幅代理数据（破坏振幅-相位对齐但保留振幅序列结构）可消除该效应。在16名健康与24名胃功能障碍受试者的禁食/进食记录中，相位剪切幅值在不同组间存在差异，其分类性能与最强多电极基于相位的行波指标相当。
AI.conclusion: 振幅-频率耦合是胃频带EGG的一种动力学特征，能补充传统光谱与空间相位指标；未来需发展多通道观测模型以探究其与慢波传播及胃功能的关系。

title: Primate vision reveals a missing principle for robust dynamic AI
summary: How does an intelligent visual system combine what objects look like with how they move while remaining robust as appearance changes? We addressed this question by comparing human perception and neural activity in macaque inferior temporal cortex with representations from image- and video-based neural networks spanning recognition, segmentation, optic-flow processing and predictive world modeling. Temporal integration improved object representations, but most video recognition models generalized poorly when appearance was disrupted while motion structure was preserved. Humans and macaque IT remained robust. Notably, predictive world models combined strong cross-appearance generalization with the closest correspondence to IT, outperforming other video-modeling approaches in neural fidelity. Yet no model reproduced the cortical transformation from early appearance-dominated responses toward later appearance-invariant motion coding. These results identify progressive integration of motion into object representations as a principle of robust dynamic vision and implicate predictive learning as a promising route toward realizing this computation in artificial systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比人类感知、猕猴下颞叶皮层神经活动与多种图像/视频神经网络表示，发现视频识别模型在运动结构保留但外观破坏时泛化能力差，而预测性世界模型在跨外观泛化能力和神经保真度上均最优，但所有模型均未复现皮层从外观主导到外观不变运动编码的渐进转换。
AI.motivation: 智能视觉系统如何整合物体的外观信息与运动信息，并在外观变化时仍保持鲁棒性，这是视觉科学和人工智能领域的核心问题。作者旨在通过对比生物视觉系统（人类感知和猕猴IT区）与各类神经网络的表示，揭示这一整合机制的神经计算原理。
AI.method: 将人类感知行为和猕猴下颞叶皮层神经活动与多类神经网络表示进行比较，涵盖识别、分割、光流处理及预测性世界建模等模型类别；通过时间整合操作评估运动信息的加入对物体表示的影响，并在破坏外观但保留运动结构的条件下测试跨外观泛化能力，同时评估各模型与IT神经活动的一致性（神经保真度）。
AI.result: 时间整合改进了物体表示；大部分视频识别模型在外观被破坏而运动结构保留时泛化能力差，而人类和猕猴IT保持鲁棒；预测性世界模型在跨外观泛化与IT神经保真度方面均最优，超越其他视频建模方法；然而没有任何模型能复现皮层从早期外观主导响应到后期外观不变运动编码的转换过程。
AI.conclusion: 将运动信息渐进整合进物体表示是稳健动态视觉的关键原则，预测性学习是人工系统实现该计算最有前景的途径，但现有模型与皮层在鲁棒动态视觉机制上仍存在本质差距，提示预测性学习是未来发展方向。

title: DreamLedger: Execution-Settled Credit Files for World-Model Imagination in Robot Decision Loops
summary: Robots are beginning to act on world-model predictions, yet reliability is still expressed through instantaneous, model-internal signals. DreamLedger instead treats reliability as a persistent deployment object: an execution-settled credit file recording how often consumed predictions are borne out, indexed by operating condition, region, and prediction horizon, and consulted before each use. Each consumed prediction is registered as a claim; attributable outcomes are settled against arriving reality at zero labeling cost, an attribution stage excludes measurement-contaminated outcomes, and a settlement-supervised head complements sparse bins. The resulting credit gates consumption: low-credit predictions shorten the dependent horizon or trigger additional observation; every reliance event remains auditable via dependency tickets and replayable logs. We evaluate DreamLedger in three simulated domains (indoor flight, tabletop manipulation, 2D navigation), via mounts on unmodified DreamerV3, TD-MPC2, and V-JEPA 2-AC, and on a real Franka manipulator. Claim failure is dose-monotone in all 12 held-out condition-horizon cells. Credit-gated planning reduces burned imagination (consumed claims that later fail to redeem) by 62% (95% CI 43-81%) versus blind consumption, with equal success and comparable collision rates. At matched risk targets, persistent books cut verification probes from 1.00 to 0.36/episode in manipulation, at success 0.94 versus 0.98; settlement-grounded calibration retains moderate, seed-consistent operating points unlike raw instantaneous gates. The same trust layer operates across decoder-, latent-, and token-space interfaces, including V-JEPA 2-AC settled on real robot frames. On hardware, settlement remains operational under real sensing and contact noise, a deployment failure loop is re-priced online, and all 1,062 registered spends replay from the audit logs.

AI.tldr: DreamLedger提出将机器人世界模型预测的可靠性从"瞬时内部信号"转为"持久化部署对象"——一份执行结算的信用档案，按运行条件、区域和预测时域记录预测兑现情况，并在每次使用前查询。消费的预测被登记为claims，由归因阶段排除含测量污染的结果，以零标注成本对账现实，稀疏桶由结算监督头补全。低信用预测会缩短依赖时域或触发额外观测，所有依赖事件通过依赖票和可回放日志可审计。在三个模拟域和真实Franka机械臂上验证，信用门控规划使"烧掉的想象"减少62%，在匹配风险目标下将验证探针从1.00降到0.36/回合，且跨解码器/隐空间/词元空间接口通用。
AI.motivation: 机器人开始基于世界模型预测行动，但当前可靠性仍以瞬时、模型内部的信号表达，缺乏跨时间、跨条件的持久可信度量，导致预测消费（imagination）缺乏问责与追溯机制。
AI.method: 将可靠性建模为持久部署对象（执行结算信用档案）：1) 每个被消费的预测注册为claim；2) 归因阶段排除测量污染的outcomes；3) 以零标注成本对现实结算；4) 结算监督头为稀疏桶补全；5) 信用门控消费（低信用缩短时域或触发额外观测）；6) 依赖票+可回放日志实现全链路审计。
AI.result: 在12个留出条件-时域单元中claim失败呈剂量单调；信用门控规划减少62%的烧掉想象（95%CI 43-81%），成功率持平、碰撞率相当；在匹配风险目标下，验证探针从1.00降至0.36/回合（成功率0.94 vs 0.98）；结算校准在不同头下保持种子一致的稳定工作点；跨三种接口（解码器/隐空间/词元空间）泛化；在真实Franka硬件上结算在噪声下依然有效，1,062笔消费均可审计回放。
AI.conclusion: DreamLedger表明可靠性应被视作一种随部署持续沉积、按条件索引、可审计的持久信用对象，而非模型内部的瞬时信号；它在多个基座模型和域上以更低验证成本换取相当的任务性能，为世界模型预测的安全、负责任消费提供了新的架构范式。

title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models
comment: Accepted at the 31st IEEE International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation ETFA 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool use, but many scientific and engineering tasks require more than plausible text and code generation. They require understanding how a system responds to intervention, which in practice depends on controlled experimentation. In this work, we propose a multi-agent framework that enables LLM agents to conduct controlled experiments with scientific simulation models for pharmaceutical process design. Given a user query and a baseline configuration, the system constructs a structured task representation, designs experiments, executes comparative simulation, interprets the resulting outcomes, and synthesizes evidence-based recommendations for process parameter optimization. By coupling language models with high-fidelity simulation models in an interactive agent framework, the proposed system supports reasoning through intervention, comparison, and observation. As a result, it produces more specific and actionable outputs than language-only reasoning. In an industrial application setting, this advantage is reflected in higher output specificity as well as improved user-rated correctness and helpfulness. Ablation studies and visualized case analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness and practical utility of simulation-integrated experimental reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多智能体框架，使LLM能够通过与科学仿真模型耦合进行受控实验，用于药物工艺设计中的过程参数优化，相比纯语言推理能产生更具体和可操作的结果。
AI.motivation: 许多科学和工程任务需要的不仅是合理的文本和代码生成，而是理解系统对干预的响应，这依赖于受控实验。现有的LLM主要擅长语言推理，但缺乏与高保真仿真模型交互进行实验推理的能力。
AI.method: 提出一个多智能体框架，包含以下流程：根据用户查询和基线配置构建结构化任务表示，设计实验方案，执行对比仿真，解释实验结果，并综合基于证据的工艺参数优化建议。系统将LLM与高保真仿真模型耦合在交互式智能体框架中，支持通过干预、比较和观察进行推理。
AI.result: 在工业应用场景中，该框架相比纯语言推理表现出更高的输出特异性，以及更优的用户评分正确性和有用性。消融研究和可视化案例分析进一步证明了仿真集成的实验推理方法的有效性和实际效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语言模型与高保真仿真模型耦合，LLM智能体能够进行受控实验推理，从而在药物工艺设计等科学任务中产生比纯语言推理更具体、更可操作的推荐，具有实际工业应用价值。

title: StateTune: Transforming LLM-Assisted EDA Flow Tuning into a Stateful, Closed-Loop Process
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
summary: EDA flow parameter tuning is critical for quality-of-results~(QoR), yet the parameter space is large, tightly coupled, and full evaluations are prohibitively expensive. Prior LLM-assisted tuners mainly use the LLM as an external proposer with transient working context; we instead present \textbf{StateTune}, which reformulates LLM-assisted EDA tuning as a closed-loop, state-carrying process. Its optimizer state is a typed, evidence-gated \emph{persistent optimization memory} that is updated by every evaluation and shared between candidate generation and budget allocation. On top of this optimizer state, an expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI)-guided, runtime-aware promotion policy ranks quick-stage candidates by expected Pareto frontier gain per unit of runtime cost. Evaluated on a Cadence industrial flow across six benchmark blocks (two technology nodes \(\times\) three designs), against five baselines including LLM+retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and preference-based Bayesian optimization (BO) tuners, StateTune achieves the strongest final hypervolume on all six benchmark blocks, showing a stable improvement in frontier quality across the full matrix; it also matches or surpasses the strongest baselines on worst negative slack (WNS), area, and power across the same set. Ablation shows persistent memory is the largest contributor: removing it costs 58.5\% of the hypervolume. Dedicated analyses of evidence-gating sensitivity, memory poisoning, cross-design transfer, and three-seed reproducibility (CV\,\(<\)\,7\% on five of six blocks) further validate the memory design.

AI.tldr: StateTune是一种将LLM辅助EDA参数调优重构为闭环、状态携带过程的新方法，通过持续优化记忆和经验超体积改进（EHVI）引导的运行时感知提升策略，在Cadence工业流程六个基准块上全面超越五种基线，实现最强最终超体积，并匹配或超越最强基线在WNS、面积和功耗上的表现。
AI.motivation: EDA流程参数调优对最终结果质量（QoR）至关重要，但参数空间大、耦合紧密且完整评估代价高昂。先前的LLM辅助调优器主要将LLM作为具有瞬时工作上下文的外部提议者，缺乏持续记忆和学习能力，导致调优效率低下。
AI.method: StateTune将LLM辅助EDA调优重构为闭环状态携带过程。其优化器状态是基于类型化的、证据门控的持久优化记忆，每次评估都会更新该记忆，并在候选生成与预算分配之间共享。在此优化器状态之上，采用EHVI引导的运行时感知提升策略，根据每单位运行成本下的期望Pareto前沿增益来对快速阶段候选进行排序。
AI.result: 在Cadence工业流程上，跨两个技术节点×三个设计的六个基准块，对比包括LLM+RAG和基于偏好的贝叶斯优化调优器在内的五种基线，StateTune在所有六个基准块上取得最强最终超体积，并在WNS、面积和功耗上与最强基线持平或超越。消融实验表明持久记忆贡献最大，移除后超体积损失58.5%。三种子可复现性验证（六个块中五个CV<7%）进一步验证了记忆设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: StateTune通过持久优化记忆与运行时感知提升策略，显著提升了LLM辅助EDA参数调优的性能与稳定性，其中持久记忆是最大的贡献因素，证据门控、跨设计迁移及可复现性分析均验证了记忆设计的稳健性。

title: ShardMeter: Sharded and Geo-Distributed Training Without the Guesswork
summary: Training large-scale AI models often outgrows a single data center, demanding sharded, multi-cluster, and decentralized training. However, the huge space of resource allocations makes exhaustive benchmarking and manual tuning impractical, while performance depends on tightly coupled factors like model size, GPU memory, batch size, bandwidth, and sharding strategy. We introduce ShardMeter, a lightweight analytical performance model that predicts the end-to-end runtime of transformer-based workloads across arbitrary sharded, distributed, and even decentralized training. Given a model's characteristics and a target hardware topology, ShardMeter estimates per-GPU and per-island throughput, training cost, total wall-clock time, and identifies performance bottlenecks. Our analysis reveals diminishing-return regimes as island size increases, quantifies transitions between compute- and communication-bound scaling, evaluates hyperparameter trade-offs, and models cost-throughput for large-scale decentralized training. ShardMeter exposes these insights to quickly explore the configuration space, choose near-optimal deployment plans, and avoid costly trial and error.

AI.tldr: ShardMeter是一个轻量级分析性能模型，用于预测Transformer工作负载在任意分片、分布式甚至去中心化训练中的端到端运行时间，帮助用户在无需穷举基准测试和手动调优的情况下快速探索配置空间并选择接近最优的部署方案。
AI.motivation: 大规模AI模型训练常超出单一数据中心容量，需要分片、多集群和去中心化训练。但资源分配的搜索空间巨大，穷举基准测试和手动调优不切实际，且性能高度依赖模型大小、GPU内存、批次大小、带宽和分片策略等多个紧耦合因素。
AI.method: ShardMeter提出一个轻量级分析性能模型，输入模型特征和目标硬件拓扑，即可估算每GPU和每岛吞吐量、训练成本、总墙钟时间，并识别性能瓶颈。模型能够分析收益递减区域、计算与通信受限缩放之间的转换、超参数权衡以及大规模去中心化训练的成本-吞吐量。
AI.result: ShardMeter揭示了岛屿规模增大时收益递减的规律，量化了计算受限与通信受限缩放之间的转换，评估了超参数权衡，并为大规模去中心化训练建模了成本与吞吐量的关系。
AI.conclusion: ShardMeter能够快速探索配置空间、选择近似最优的部署计划并避免代价高昂的试错过程。

title: Contextual Embedding Evidence for Main--Light Verb Distinctions in Urdu
summary: Urdu light verbs contribute schematic event-structural meaning while remaining lexically related to corresponding main verbs. This study tests representational predictions derived from Butt's analysis using contextual embeddings from UrduBERT, DunbaaBERT, and multilingual BERT across 1,126 naturally occurring sentences containing seven Urdu verbs. Main and light uses show significant representational separation in all 21 verb--model comparisons. At the same time, same-lemma main and light centroids are consistently closer than mismatched main--light lemma pairs, supporting continued lexical relatedness. In a seven-way prediction task restricted to light uses, verb identity remains recoverable after the target is masked, with UrduBERT achieving 0.866 accuracy and 0.852 macro-F1. UrduBERT also retains 0.782 accuracy under a preceding-form-disjoint evaluation, indicating generalization beyond repeated local verb combinations. These findings provide computational evidence consistent with Butt's account that Urdu light verbs differ systematically from their main uses while retaining lemma-specific and verb-specific representational structure.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用UrduBERT、DunbaaBERT和多语言BERT三种上下文嵌入模型，在1,126个自然句子中检验乌尔都语轻动词的语义表示。结果显示，主要动词用法与轻动词用法在所有21个动词-模型对比中均表现出显著的表示分离，但同一词元（lemma）的主-轻用法表示仍比跨词元更接近，支持词汇关联延续性。在掩码预测任务中，UrduBERT达到0.866准确率与0.852宏-F1，且在前置形式不重叠的评估中仍保留0.782准确率，为Butt的轻动词理论提供了计算证据。
AI.motivation: 检验Butt关于乌尔都语轻动词的理论预测：轻动词贡献图式化的事件结构语义，同时与其对应的主要动词保持词汇关联。该研究旨在通过上下文嵌入模型验证这一双重特性的表征性假说。
AI.method: 使用三种预训练上下文语言模型（UrduBERT、DunbaaBERT、mBERT）对1,126个包含七个乌尔都语动词的自然句子进行嵌入提取。设计了21组动词-模型对比测试主/轻用法表示分离；通过同词元与跨词元质心距离比较检验词汇关联；在轻动词子集中执行七类掩码预测任务评估动词身份的可恢复性，并引入前置形式不重叠的评估验证泛化能力。
AI.result: 所有21个动词-模型配对均呈现主/轻用法的显著表示分离；同词元主-轻质心距离显著小于跨词元配对；掩码条件下七类轻动词预测中UrduBERT达到0.866准确率和0.852宏-F1；前置不重叠评估下仍保持0.782准确率。
AI.conclusion: 上下文嵌入的计算证据与Butt的理论一致：乌尔都语轻动词在表示上与主要动词用法存在系统性差异，同时保留了词元特异性和动词特异性的表示结构，验证了轻动词"图式化语义+词汇关联"的双重属性。

title: Cross-Generation Optimization of YOLOv26, YOLOv11, and YOLOv8 for Fine-Grained Small-Object Detection and Instance Segmentation in Complex Orchards
summary: Small-object detection and instance segmentation remain challenging in orchard environments because of green-on-green similarity, occlusion, and limited pixel representation of fine fruit anatomy. This study presents a cross-generation benchmark of Ultralytics YOLOv8, YOLOv11, and YOLOv26 for detecting and segmenting apple fruitlet, calyx, and peduncle structures for robotic orchard perception. Five model scales (n, s, m, l, and x) were evaluated under conventional 640 x 640 and small-object focused 960 x 960 training configurations, yielding 30 experiments. Increasing model capacity did not consistently improve accuracy. YOLOv11s-960 achieved the highest observed mask mAP@50:95 (0.402) and box mAP@50:95 (0.426), while YOLOv26s-960 achieved comparable values of 0.397 and 0.425 with only 10.37 M parameters and 34.1 GFLOPs. Peduncle remained the most challenging class. Overall, compact-to-moderate YOLO models with small-object-focused training provided favorable accuracy efficiency trade-offs, establishing a practical benchmark for fine-grained agricultural robotics and orchard perception. Github Link: https://github.com/rnjnspkt/Optimizing-and-Comparing-Ultralytics-YOLOv26-YOLOv11-and-YOLOv8-for-Small-Object-Detection-and-Seg

AI.tldr: 该研究对Ultralytics YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26三个跨代模型在果园环境中检测和分割苹果果实幼果、花萼和果柄结构进行了系统性基准测试，在640×640和960×960两种分辨率配置下评估了五个模型尺度共30组实验，发现紧凑至中等规模的YOLO模型配合小目标训练能提供更优的精度-效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 果园环境中的小目标检测和实例分割面临绿色-绿色相似性、遮挡以及细粒度果实解剖结构像素表征有限等挑战，需要系统的跨代基准来评估不同YOLO模型在细粒度果园感知任务中的表现。
AI.method: 对Ultralytics YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26三个模型代际，分别以五种模型尺度（n、s、m、l、x）在传统640×640和小目标聚焦式960×960训练配置下进行检测与分割实验，共30组对比实验，评估mask mAP@50:95和box mAP@50:95等指标。
AI.result: YOLOv11s-960达到最高的mask mAP@50:95（0.402）和box mAP@50:95（0.426）；YOLOv26s-960以仅10.37M参数和34.1 GFLOPs的计算量达到相近的0.397和0.425。果柄（peduncle）是最难检测的类别，且增加模型容量并未持续提升精度。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑至中等规模的YOLO模型配合小目标聚焦训练在精度与效率之间展现出更优的权衡，为细粒度农业机器人和果园感知建立了实用基准。

title: ROBBIN: Rowhammer-Based Backdoor Injection during Inference
summary: Existing Rowhammer-based inference-time backdoor attacks design their bit-flip strategies purely at the algorithmic level, without accounting for the bit-flips that the underlying DRAM hardware will actually produce. This disconnection between the algorithmic backdoor construction and its hardware realization leads to unreliable attack performance, as collateral bit-flips at unintended locations degrade both the attack success rate (ASR) on triggered inputs and the test accuracy (TA) for normal inputs. Consequently, the performance of such attacks varies significantly across different DRAM devices, as each device presents a unique set of exploitable bit-flip locations. This work presents ROBBIN, a hardware-aware Rowhammer-based backdoor injection attack that integrates the device-specific vulnerability into the backdoor construction process. ROBBIN first characterizes the bit-flip patterns of a target DRAM and uses this information to iteratively select DRAM \textit{page} mappings for the model weights that would maximize ASR while preserving TA under Rowhammering. By treating every hammering-induced bit-flip as an integral part of the attack design rather than first constructing a hardware-agnostic backdoor and dismissing collateral flips as side effects, ROBBIN produces backdoors that remain robust across devices. Evaluated on ResNet-20 and VGG-16 with CIFAR-10 across three commodity DDR4 chips, ROBBIN consistently achieves close to 90\% ASR while maintaining TA above 83\%, demonstrating reliable backdoor efficacy across diverse DRAM devices.

AI.tldr: ROBBIN是一种硬件感知的Rowhammer后门注入攻击方法，通过将特定DRAM设备的位翻转特征纳入后门构建过程，而非像现有方法那样在算法层面构建后门再忽略硬件实际产生的位翻转，从而在不同DRAM设备上实现可靠的后门攻击性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Rowhammer的推理时后门攻击在算法层面设计位翻转策略，未考虑底层DRAM硬件实际产生的位翻转。这种算法-硬件脱节导致意外位置的附加位翻转降低攻击成功率（ASR）和正常输入测试准确率（TA），且不同DRAM设备的可利用位翻转位置各不相同，导致攻击性能在不同设备间差异显著。
AI.method: ROBBIN首先刻画目标DRAM的位翻转特征，然后利用该信息迭代地为模型权重选择DRAM页面映射，在Rowhammer攻击下最大化ASR同时保持TA。其核心思想是将每次锤击诱导的位翻转视为攻击设计的组成部分，而非先构建与硬件无关的后门再把附加翻转当作副作用处理。
AI.result: 在ResNet-20和VGG-16模型配合CIFAR-10数据集、三种商用DDR4芯片上的评估中，ROBBIN始终达到接近90%的ASR，同时TA保持在83%以上，展示了跨不同DRAM设备的可靠后门效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将设备特定的DRAM漏洞信息整合到后门构建过程中，ROBBIN解决了Rowhammer后门从算法设计到硬件实现之间的断连问题，实现了跨设备的鲁棒后门攻击，为Rowhammer后门攻击领域提供了硬件感知的设计范式。

title: From Causal Plausibility to Causal Reliability: Evaluating LLMs as Calibrated Direct Causal-Edge Classifiers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide prior causal knowledge for structural causal discovery, yet whether their direct-edge judgments and confidence can be trusted remains unclear. We systematically evaluate 12 instruction-tuned open-weight models across six benchmark causal graphs, five prompting strategies, and four confidence sources: verbalized, logit-based, cross-prompt agreement, and cross-model agreement. Under our language-only pairwise protocol, our evaluation yields three key findings. (i) LLM-based causal judgments are strongly recall-dominant: models predict overly dense graphs with many false-positive edges, while prompting mainly shifts the precision-recall trade-off rather than resolving overprediction. Gains from model scale diminish on the largest graphs and do not eliminate miscalibration. (ii) LLMs often capture causal relatedness without reliably identifying directness or orientation. Relative to published reference graphs, models misclassify 40.0% of indirect and 36.0% of reversed non-edges as direct edges, versus 28.2% of other non-edges. Moreover, 80.8% and 84.6% of these false positives receive verbalized confidence of at least 80%, revealing substantial overconfidence in structurally incorrect predictions. (iii) Conventional confidence estimates are unreliable, whereas agreement offers a more promising signal. Logit-based confidence frequently collapses near 1.0 regardless of correctness, while cross-prompt and cross-model agreement achieve better mean calibration and discrimination, though their advantages are not statistically significant after Holm correction. A benchmark-familiarity audit further identifies potential familiarity in five model-dataset pairs, all involving AsiaM. Overall, our results suggest LLMs are better viewed as sources of externally validated soft causal priors than as direct evidence of causal structure.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了12个指令微调开源LLM在结构因果发现中提供先验知识的可靠性，发现LLM的因果判断高度偏向召回（预测过密图），无法可靠区分直接关系和间接/反向关系，且置信度严重过度校准；相比之下，跨提示和跨模型一致性是更可靠的置信度信号。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于为结构因果发现提供先验因果知识，但其直接边判断和置信度的可信度尚不清楚，缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 在仅语言的成对协议下，对12个指令微调开源模型、6个基准因果图、5种提示策略和4类置信度来源（语言化、基于logit、跨提示一致性、跨模型一致性）进行系统评估，并进行基准熟悉度审计。
AI.result: (i) LLM因果判断强烈偏向召回，预测过密图，提示只能改变精度-召回权衡而非解决过度预测；模型规模收益在大图上减弱且不消除校准误差。(ii) LLM常捕捉因果相关性但难以识别直接性/方向性，分别有40.0%的间接边和36.0%的反向非边被误判为直接边，且80.8%和84.6%的此类误判获得至少80%的语言化置信度。(iii) 基于logit的置信度常坍缩到1.0附近，而跨提示和跨模型一致性校准和判别更好，但优势在Holm校正后不显著。审计发现5个可能涉及AsiaM的模型-数据集组合存在基准熟悉度。
AI.conclusion: LLM更适合被视为外部验证的软因果先验来源，而非因果结构的直接证据。

title: Finch: Toxicity Dose Response Curve Prediction of Chemical Compounds and Mixtures
summary: A holistic approach to chemical mixtures is reshaping risk assessment emphasizing mixture testing over single compounds eliminating animal testing and advancing modeling methods. Most computational models still focus on individual chemicals and conventional mixture models like concentration addition and independent action are limited they struggle with multiple Modes of Action and often miss synergistic or antagonistic effects. Regulatory agencies need faster more efficient models that go beyond these constraints. Finch addresses these challenges with a novel workflow. It integrates molecular descriptor based frameworks and deep learning embeddings in multi task quantitative structure activity relationship models for improved chemical exposure prediction. DL embeddings preserve information from diverse inputs molecular descriptors physicochemical properties and large language model embeddings from SMILES by distilling key features into a latent space enhancing machine learning predictions. Finch multi task learning optimizes multiple loss functions simultaneously leveraging all available data to learn generalized representations. This enables effective modeling of complex ingredient interactions within mixtures offering a significant advancement for regulatory safety assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Finch工作流，一种面向化学混合物风险评估的新型多任务QSAR建模方法，整合分子描述符和深度学习嵌入（含SMILES的大语言模型嵌入），突破传统浓度加和与独立作用模型的局限，实现对复杂成分交互效应的有效建模，为监管安全评估提供更高效的预测工具。
AI.motivation: 传统风险评估主要关注单一化合物，而浓度加和（CA）和独立作用（IA）等传统混合物模型在处理多种作用模式时存在局限，且难以捕捉协同或拮抗效应。监管机构需要更快更高效的模型来应对化学混合物评估的挑战。
AI.method: Finch采用整合工作流：1）将分子描述符框架与深度学习嵌入相结合；2）利用深度学习嵌入从多种输入（分子描述符、理化性质、SMILES的大语言模型嵌入）中提取关键特征到潜在空间；3）采用多任务QSAR模型，通过同时优化多个损失函数充分利用所有可用数据，学习广义表征。
AI.result: Finch实现了对混合物中复杂成分交互关系的有效建模，相比传统模型在预测化学暴露和混合物效应方面有显著提升，为监管安全评估提供重要进展。具体的定量结果未在摘要中给出。
AI.conclusion: Finch代表了一种整体性化学混合物风险评估的新方向，通过多任务学习和深度学习嵌入的结合，克服了传统模型的局限性，为监管机构提供了更先进的混合物评估工具。

title: Beauty is in the ELBO of the Beholder: A Variational Account of Processing Fluency in Face Perception
summary: Facial attractiveness has been linked to statistical regularities such as symmetry and averageness, suggesting that beauty may depend on the ease with which a face is perceived. We empirically test this hypothesis by training variational autoencoders on four face datasets without attractiveness supervision and evaluating their representations on the 597 faces from the Chicago Face Database. Across models, human attractiveness ratings closely aligns with the direction defined by the VAE evidence lower bound (ELBO) in rate-distortion space. Independently learned latent spaces contain an attractiveness direction that transfers strongly across random initializations and training data. We also find that attractive faces are more prototypical in both shape and latent space. Our results connect classic accounts of aesthetics with learned generative models and provide empirical support for a variational interpretation of the processing fluency theory of aesthetic pleasure.

AI.tldr: 本文实证检验了审美愉悦的处理流畅性理论：通过在四个面部数据集上训练变分自编码器（无吸引力标注），发现人类吸引力评分与VAE的ELBO在率失真空间中定义的方向高度一致，且学习到的潜在空间包含可跨初始化与数据迁移的吸引力方向，吸引力高的面孔在形状和潜在空间中更具原型性。
AI.motivation: 面部吸引力一直与对称性、平均性等统计规律相关联，暗示美可能取决于面部被感知的难易程度。作者希望用生成式学习模型实证检验这一假设，将处理流畅性理论以变分推断的形式形式化并验证。
AI.method: 在四个面部数据集上训练无监督变分自编码器（VAE），不对吸引力做任何监督；用芝加哥面孔数据库（CFD）的597张面孔进行评测；检验人类吸引力评分与VAE的ELBO（证据下界）在率失真空间中方向的对应关系，并分析跨随机初始化与训练数据的迁移性，以及吸引力与原型性（形状和潜在空间）的关系。
AI.result: 人类吸引力评分与VAE的ELBO方向在率失真空间中高度一致；独立学习的潜在空间包含吸引力方向，且该方向在随机初始化和训练数据之间具有很强的迁移性；吸引力高的面孔在形状空间和潜在空间中更具原型性（prototypical）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果将经典美学理论与学习式生成模型联系起来，为处理流畅性理论的美学愉悦提供了基于变分推断的实证支持，表明美感可能源于面孔在生成模型框架下的编码简洁性或重构容易程度。

title: Interpreting Control Latents for System Identification via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Latent-conditioned adaptive policies can control robots across changing dynamics, but their learned latents remain internal representations of the policy rather than physical models that can be inspected, rolled out, or used by other control modules. This limits closed-loop analysis, diagnosis, and further improvement of a fixed policy. A direct mapping from latent to physical parameters is also under-specified, because multiple systems can induce similar closed-loop behavior. We therefore decode each operational latent into a distribution of quadrotor models using conditional flow matching. The decoded distribution enables two downstream uses without modifying the policy: online predictive tuning of a high-level controller around the fixed low-level policy, and robustness analysis under specified disturbances. Under perturbed actuator dynamics, decoded-model predictive tuning reduces position tracking RMSE by $23\%$ and heading RMSE by $45\%$ relative to fixed gains. Under Gaussian force disturbances, decoded-model ensembles closely predict the lateral tracking-error evolution. Together, these results show that control latents can be converted into physical model ensembles for tuning, robustness analysis, and diagnosis of frozen adaptive policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将潜变量条件自适应策略的内部潜变量解码为四旋翼物理模型分布（使用条件流匹配），使得冻结策略的潜变量可被检查、滚动预测和用于其他控制模块，实现高层控制器的在线预测调参和鲁棒性分析。
AI.motivation: 潜变量条件自适应策略可以控制机器人在变化的动力学下工作，但其学习到的隐变量只是策略的内部表征，不是可检查、可滚动预测或可被其他控制模块使用的物理模型。这限制了闭环分析、诊断和对固定策略的进一步改进。直接从隐变量映射到物理参数是欠约束的，因为多个系统可能产生类似的闭环行为。
AI.method: 使用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）将每个操作潜变量解码为四旋翼模型的分布。解码得到的分布支持两种下游应用：在不修改策略的情况下，进行高层控制器的在线预测调参，以及在指定扰动下进行鲁棒性分析。
AI.result: 在扰动执行器动力学下，解码模型预测调参相比固定增益将位置跟踪RMSE降低23%，航向RMSE降低45%。在高斯力扰动下，解码模型集成能够紧密预测横向跟踪误差的演变。
AI.conclusion: 控制潜变量可以转换为物理模型集成，用于冻结自适应策略的调参、鲁棒性分析和诊断，弥补了潜变量从内部表征到可解释物理模型之间的鸿沟。

title: A survey detection channel overrides the pixels in an astronomical foundation model, and biases tomographic mean redshifts
summary:
