Foundation models for astronomy are trained on survey pixels together with the catalogue products derived from those pixels. Those catalogues are incomplete at a measurable rate, and a model trained on both inherits that incompleteness as a systematic. We audit AION-1, a 39-modality transformer trained on more than 200 million objects, using causal interventions on its inputs.
  Holding the image tokens byte-identical and editing only the survey segmentation map changes every quantity the model reports -- flux, size, ellipticity, redshift -- by 110-4400 times a matched placebo. The mechanism is detection gating, presence at the field centre (r = 0.47), not the light the mask encloses (r = 0.30); across 322 real blends the model ignores how the pipeline partitioned the light (R = -0.006). Nor is the preference specific to that channel: contradicted catalogue photometry leaves the model nine times worse than supplying no metadata at all.
  The Legacy Survey pipeline leaves 3.68% of targets with no segment covering their position. Propagating that rate, with a miss represented by the fields the pipeline actually returns, shifts tomographic mean redshifts by a median 0.71 times the LSST DESC requirement over 40 assignments and exceeds it in 12; observed positional errors take the worst bin to 8.3 times. Drawing the misses by their measured magnitude dependence rather than uniformly does not change it. Spectroscopy removes the effect, withholding the detection channel removes it at no measurable cost, and the effect grows with model scale.
  Two further limits lie in the tokeniser: its image codec resolves 28 effective states on source patches against 934 for the spectrum codec, and the redshift readout is quantisation-limited. Sparse dictionaries are unreliable causal handles: across 15, recovery spans 26-75% and moves up to 18 points on the seed alone.

AI.tldr: 本文对39模态天文基础模型AION-1进行因果干预审计，发现该模型继承了调查管线在目标检测上的不完整性系统偏差：仅编辑分割图（不修改图像token）即可使模型输出的流量、大小、椭圆率、红移等全部量发生110-4400倍于安慰剂的变化，机制是检测门控（场中心存在性）而非掩模包含的光。管线缺失率3.68%传播后，断层扫描平均红移偏移中位数达到LSST DESC要求的0.71倍，最差情形超出8.3倍；去除检测通道或使用光谱可消除该效应，且效应随模型规模增大而增强。此外，图像tokeniser仅解析28个有效状态（光谱为934），红移读出受量化限制，稀疏字典作为因果手柄不可靠（恢复率26-75%）。
AI.motivation: 天文基础模型同时在巡天像素和由这些像素导出的星表上训练，而星表以可测量的速率存在不完整性（部分目标未被检测/分割）。模型若在两者上训练，会继承这种不完整性作为系统性偏差。本文旨在审计AION-1模型是否以及如何继承这种检测不完整性，并量化其对科学产出（如红移、形态参数）的影响。
AI.method: 对AION-1（39模态Transformer，2亿+天体训练）进行因果干预实验：1) 保持图像token逐字节不变，仅编辑巡天分割图，观察所有输出量的变化；2) 对比检测门控（场中心存在性r=0.47）与掩模包含的光（r=0.30）的因果作用，并在322个真实混合体上检验管线光分配是否被忽略（R=-0.006）；3) 通过向模型提供矛盾星表测光或完全不提供元数据对比性能；4) 将Legacy Survey管线3.68%的缺失率传播到红移估计，评估对tomographic红移的影响（对照LSST DESC精度要求）；5) 通过消融实验（移除检测通道、使用光谱、不同模型规模）验证机制的因果方向和规模依赖性。
AI.result: 1) 仅编辑分割图使模型全部输出量变化110-4400倍于安慰剂，机制是检测门控（r=0.47）而非掩模内的光（r=0.30）；模型完全忽略管线如何分配混合体中的光（R=-0.006）。2) 矛盾的星表测光使模型比不提供任何元数据差9倍。3) 3.68%缺失率传播导致tomographic平均红移偏移中位数达LSST DESC要求的0.71倍，在40次分配中12次超标；观测位置误差使最差bin达到8.3倍。4) 光谱可消除效应，移除检测通道无成本地消除效应，效应随模型规模增大而增强。5) 图像codec仅28个有效状态（光谱934个），红移读出受量化限制；稀疏字典恢复率仅26-75%，且仅凭种子变化可移动18个点。
AI.conclusion: AION-1这样的天文基础模型严重继承了巡天管线的检测不完整性作为系统性偏差，其影响可远超LSST DESC的科学精度要求。检测门控而非光内容主导了模型行为，表明模型学会了"检测存在性"而非"像素内容"的捷径。缓解方案包括提供光谱、移除检测通道（无成本）以及改进tokeniser（提高图像codec有效状态数、解决红移量化限制）。稀疏字典作为可解释性工具不可靠。

title: PACT: Post-route Agentic Checkpoint Tuning for FPGA Timing Closure
comment: Accepted to the 2026 International Conference on Field-Programmable Technology (FPT 2026)
summary: Late-stage FPGA timing closure often starts from an implemented design whose remaining violations are visible in timing reports. Engineering change order (ECO) optimization is a standard mechanism for applying localized changes to such designs without restarting the full implementation flow. Automating post-route ECO optimization remains challenging. A post-route change must improve timing without violating routing legality, hold or pulse-width timing constraints, checkpoint replayability or functional equivalence. This paper presents PACT, a Post-route Agentic Checkpoint Tuning framework for Vivado design checkpoints (DCP). PACT represents post-route tuning as validation-gated transitions between accepted and candidate checkpoints. From checkpoint-derived evidence, an agent selects localized backend actions through a profile-driven recipe planner over typed Vivado and RapidWright skills, and probes tool behavior in isolated workspaces. PACT records each trial as an evidence-gated case to guide candidate generation and suppress unsafe, unsupported or ineffective actions. Across 35 UltraScale+ post-route checkpoints, PACT improves validation-clean $F_{\max}$ (maximum operating frequency) by a geometric mean of $+22.30\%$ over the original implementations, compared with $+15.14\%$ for DATuner and $+9.78\%$ for the Codex Agent. On shared designs, PACT achieves these gains $6.4\times$ faster than the uncapped DATuner and at an average token cost of only \$0.16 per DCP ($24.5\times$ lower than the free-form Codex Agent). The source code is available in an anonymous repository

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACT，一个面向Vivado FPGA后布线（post-route）工程变更单（ECO）优化的智能体框架。PACT将后布线时序收敛建模为验证门控的检查点（DCP）状态转换过程，通过基于档案驱动的配方规划器选择局部后端动作，并在隔离工作区中探测工具行为。在35个UltraScale+后布线检查点上，PACT将验证干净的Fmax几何平均提升22.30%，优于DATuner（+15.14%）和Codex Agent（+9.78%），同时速度提升6.4倍，平均token成本仅$0.16/DCP。
AI.motivation: FPGA后布线阶段的时序收敛（timing closure）是设计流程中最耗时且高度依赖经验的环节。工程变更单（ECO）优化是修复剩余时序违例的标准化手段，但自动化后布线ECO优化极具挑战：任何修改必须同时满足布线合法性、保持时间/脉冲宽度约束、检查点可重放性和功能等价性。现有的自动化方法在效率、成本和有效性上均存在不足，因此需要一种能够系统性地探索安全ECO动作空间并学习经验的新型框架。
AI.method: PACT将后布线调优建模为验证门控的检查点状态转换：在接受的检查点与候选检查点之间通过验证进行门控。核心组件包括：(1) 证据驱动的配方规划器，基于检查点导出的证据选择局部后端动作，这些动作编排为类型化的Vivado和RapidWright技能；(2) 隔离工作区中的工具行为探测；(3) 证据门控的案例库，记录每次试验以指导候选生成并抑制不安全、不受支持或无效的动作。该框架结合了智能体决策、经验积累和形式化验证检查。
AI.result: 在35个UltraScale+后布线检查点上，PACT将验证干净的Fmax（最大工作频率）几何平均提升22.30%，优于DATuner的15.14%和Codex Agent的9.78%。在共享设计上，PACT以6.4倍的速度优于未封顶的DATuner，平均token成本仅为每个DCP $0.16，比自由形式的Codex Agent低24.5倍。源代码已在匿名仓库中公开。
AI.conclusion: PACT证明了一种将智能体决策与验证门控机制相结合的自动化ECO优化框架，能够在保持设计合法性和功能等价性的前提下显著提升时序性能，同时大幅降低计算时间与token成本。其证据门控的案例积累机制有效抑制了不安全的动作，为FPGA后布线自动化调优提供了一种高效且经济可行的解决方案。

title: A Few Shared Random Bits Suffice for Constant-Round Almost Stable Matching
summary:
We show that almost stable matching can be solved in constant distributed rounds on general bipartite graphs $G=(V,E)$ using only a few shared random bits. Specifically, in the $\congest$ model, we compute a matching whose expected number of blocking pairs is at most $\varepsilon |E|$ in $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$ rounds using $O\left(\log(1/\varepsilon)\right)$ shared random bits. Thus, for every constant $\varepsilon>0$, the round complexity is $O(1)$, independent of the number of vertices and the maximum degree.
  Previous algorithms achieve constant round complexity only for bounded-degree or almost-regular graphs; on general graphs, their round complexity depends polylogarithmically on $n$. Our main technical idea is a degree-guarded freezing rule that allows widely varying degrees to be handled by a single global charging argument, avoiding the $Θ(\log n)$ successive degree thresholds used in previous work. The shared random bits are used only to select a common random output iteration.
  As consequences, we obtain an $O\left(
  \frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}
  +
  \frac{\log n}{\varepsilon} \right)$-round $\congest$ algorithm without pre-shared randomness, via a low-diameter decomposition, and an $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$-round algorithm in the fully-scalable Massively Parallel Computation ($\mpc$) model with linear total memory.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在一般二分图上，几乎稳定匹配可以在常数轮分布式计算中求解。在congest模型中，使用O(log(1/ε))个共享随机比特，仅需O(log(1/ε)/ε^4)轮即可计算出期望阻塞对数不超过ε|E|的匹配。核心思想是"度保护冻结规则"，避免了以往算法中Θ(log n)个连续度阈值。
AI.motivation: 以往的分布式近似稳定匹配算法在一般图上只能达到关于n的polylogarithmic轮复杂度，仅在有限度或近似正则图上才能实现常数轮。作者希望打破这一限制，在一般二分图上实现独立于顶点数和最大度的常数轮复杂度。
AI.method: 提出一种"度保护冻结规则"(degree-guarded freezing rule)，使高度变化的度分布能够通过单一全局charging论证来处理，避免了以往需要Θ(log n)个连续度阈值的方法。共享随机比特仅用于选择一个共同的随机输出迭代。此外，通过低直径分解(low-diameter decomposition)去随机化，以及在MPC模型中利用线性总内存实现。
AI.result: 在congest模型中，使用O(log(1/ε))个共享随机比特，以O(log(1/ε)/ε^4)轮计算期望阻塞对数不超过ε|E|的匹配。对于任意常数ε>0，轮复杂度为O(1)。还获得了无预共享随机性时的O(log(1/ε)/ε^4 + log n/ε)轮算法，以及MPC模型中的O(log(1/ε)/ε^4)轮算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在一般二分图上实现了几乎稳定匹配的常数轮分布式求解，显著改善了此前对bounded-degree或almost-regular图假定的依赖，并通过共享随机比特的巧妙使用和度数防护冻结规则解决了度分布的异质性挑战。

title: The Limits of Automatic Evaluation of Creativity in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of generating text that challenges human performance in domains requiring creativity, yet evaluating creativity in LLM-generated content remains a significant challenge. Here, we investigate whether current automatic evaluation methods can reliably capture human judgments of creativity. We collect human evaluations of human- and AI-generated short stories from the WritingPrompts dataset across 11 dimensions of creativity, and compare these judgments with automated objective metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations. Our experiments reveal substantial misalignment between automatic evaluations and human assessments. In particular, LLM-based judges exhibit a systematic preference for AI-generated stories, consistently favoring their stylistic characteristics over the unpredictability and other qualities of human-authored texts. Furthermore, correlation analyses show that widely used automatic metrics exhibit near-zero alignment with human judgments across both human- and AI-generated stories, suggesting that they fail to capture important dimensions of creativity. These findings highlight fundamental limitations in current approaches to the automatic evaluation of creative text and underscore the difficulty of reducing the multidimensional and subjective nature of creativity to computational metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型生成文本的创造力自动评估方法是否能够可靠地反映人类的创造力判断。通过在WritingPrompts数据集上收集人类对人和AI生成的短篇故事在11个创造力维度上的评估，并与自动客观指标和LLM-as-a-Judge评估进行对比，发现当前的自动评估与人类判断存在严重偏差：LLM评判者系统性地偏好AI生成的故事，而广泛使用的自动指标与人类判断几乎零对齐，揭示了创造力评估中计算方法的基本局限性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成文本在创造性领域中已能挑战人类水平，但如何有效评估其创造力仍是一个关键难题。现有的自动评估方法是否能够真实反映人类对创造力的判断尚不明确，这限制了我们对LLM创造性能力的可靠度量。
AI.method: 在WritingPrompts数据集上，收集人类评估者对人和AI生成的短篇故事在11个创造力维度上的主观评价，然后将这些人类判断与两类自动评估方式进行比较：（1）自动化的客观指标；（2）LLM-as-a-Judge（即将LLM作为评判者）的评估结果，通过对齐度和相关性分析检验它们的可靠性。
AI.result: 实验发现自动评估与人类判断之间存在显著偏差。LLM-based评判者表现出对AI生成故事的系统性偏好，持续偏爱其风格特征而非人类文本的不可预测性等品质。同时，广泛使用的自动指标与人类判断几乎为零相关，表明它们无法捕捉创造力的关键维度。
AI.conclusion: 当前创造文本的自动评估方法存在根本性局限，创造力的多维性和主观本质难以被简化为计算度量。这凸显了开发更可靠的创造力评估方法的必要性。

title: Scaling Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models via Velocity Matching
summary: Reward fine-tuning is becoming an important tool for adapting diffusion models to human preferences and task-specific objectives, but existing methods largely inherit policy-gradient machinery from large language models. Unlike autoregressive models, diffusion models do not provide tractable likelihoods for generated samples. As a result, current approaches either construct trajectory likelihoods from stochastic denoising transitions or approximate endpoint likelihoods with evidence lower bound, introducing additional computation and algorithmic complexity. We demonstrate that this likelihood-based machinery is not necessary for effective diffusion reward fine-tuning. We propose reward-based velocity matching (RVM), a simple trajectory-free update that acts directly on the velocity field. RVM reinforces directions associated with high-reward generations, suppresses those with low reward, and involves an optional anchor term controlling drift from a reference velocity. Notably, it provides a general framework that recovers recent fine-tuning methods, including RAM and DiffusionNFT, as special cases. Across various large-scale diffusion models reward fine-tuning tasks, RVM is competitive with or outperforms trajectory-based policy-gradient methods under substantially reduced training cost. We further find that, once the velocity update is simplified, the particular loss variant matters less than reward and anchor design. For video generation, standard preference rewards can favor visually clean but nearly static outputs; introducing a new dynamic-tracking reward that substantially improve motions while improving overall VBench performance. These results suggest that scalable reward fine-tuning for diffusion models is better posed in the native velocity representation than as likelihood-based policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于奖励的动量匹配（RVM），一种无需轨迹的扩散模型奖励微调方法，直接在速度场上作用而非使用似然机制，以更低的计算成本在多项任务中达到或超越现有轨迹策略梯度方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型奖励微调方法过度借鉴大语言模型的策略梯度机制，但由于扩散模型不像自回归模型那样具有可处理的似然，现有方法需构造轨迹似然或用ELBO近似端点似然，引入了额外的计算和算法复杂性。
AI.method: RVM直接在速度场上进行更新：奖励高的生成方向被强化，奖励低的方向被抑制，并可选锚定项控制与参考速度的漂移。该框架可统一恢复RAM和DiffusionNFT等现有方法作为特例。
AI.result: 在大规模扩散模型奖励微调任务中，RVM以显著降低的训练成本与轨迹策略梯度方法竞争或超越。作者还发现速度更新简化后损失变体的影响小于奖励与锚定设计；对于视频生成，引入动态追踪奖励可大幅改善运动同时提升VBench表现。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的奖励微调更适合在原生速度表示中定义，而非作为基于似然的策略优化问题，这为扩散模型的可扩展奖励微调提供了更简洁有效的范式。

title: A Scenario-Based Evaluation of CRQC+AI Vulnerability Spectrum for TLS 1.3 Cryptographic Dependencies
summary: This paper evaluates quantum and AI-accelerated risks to TLS 1.3 cryptographic dependencies under an evidence-tiered model, distinguishing mechanism-backed threats (Shor algorithm against RSA and ECC) from contingency-backed risks to lattice-based post-quantum cryptography (PQC) and hypothesis-only risks to hash-based and symmetric primitives. We do not identify any known breaks of ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, or AES-256. Instead, we use explicit scenario assumptions, organized as a four-scenario capability model with parameters and pseudocode for reproducibility, to stress-test migration timelines accompanied by parameter sensitivity analysis and explicit falsification analysis. The primary methodological contribution is a reproducible scenario-estimation instrument together with its explicit update mechanics: every parameter is a named, anchored quantity that can be varied and the model rerun; a stated protocol maps observed conformance to, or deviation from, the modeled curves onto revisions of specific parameters, so progressive refinements can be tested against accumulating historical data. The paper is a methodological companion to quantum resource-estimation studies and to expert-elicitation timeline surveys such as the Global Risk Institute quantum threat reports, with its revision rules stated explicitly. As of mid-2026, the model does not show any NIST-approved algorithms as broken. Instead, the vulnerability spectrum under different scenarios shows RSA risk crossing the 50% threshold between 2030-2032 and the PQC risk becoming a non-zero risk after 2032-2035 under contingency scenarios conditional on the unproven dimension-collapse. We urge PQC migration as mandatory per the 2030 and 2031 federal deadlines and by Mosca HNDL reasoning, and that crypto-agility and hybrid cryptographic deployment be considered necessary complements to any PQC migration efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个可复现的、基于证据分级的场景估计模型，用于评估TLS 1.3密码依赖面临的量子与AI加速风险。模型将威胁分为机制支撑型（Shor算法对RSA/ECC）、情境支撑型（对格基PQC）和仅假设型（哈希与对称原语），通过四场景参数化框架进行压力测试。至2026年中，模型未发现任何NIST批准算法被攻破，但预测RSA风险在2030-2032年跨过50%阈值，PQC风险在2032-2035年后在维度塌缩假设下成为非零风险。论文的主要贡献是可复现的场景估计工具及显式更新机制，并敦促按联邦期限推进PQC迁移，同时将密码敏捷性与混合加密部署视为必要补充。
AI.motivation: 随着量子计算与AI加速技术的快速发展，TLS 1.3所依赖的密码体制面临不确定性威胁。现有量子风险评估多依赖专家意见或资源估算，缺乏可复现、可迭代更新的量化方法。作者旨在提供一个证据分级、参数显式、可随历史数据不断修正的场景估计工具，以弥补方法论空白。
AI.method: 采用四层证据模型区分威胁类型（机制支撑、情境支撑、仅假设），并构建四场景能力模型作为参数化框架，包含显式参数、伪代码和灵敏度分析。每个参数均为命名且锚定的量化量，可单独变动并重新运行模型；同时规定了一套更新协议，将观测数据与模型曲线的符合或偏离映射到特定参数修订，支持渐进式精化。
AI.result: 截至2026年中，模型未显示任何NIST批准算法（ML-KEM、ML-DSA、SLH-DSA、AES-256）被攻破。场景分析显示：RSA风险在2030-2032年跨过50%阈值；PQC风险在2032-2035年后于维度塌缩情境假设下成为非零风险。论文还提供了参数灵敏度分析和显式证伪分析。
AI.conclusion: 论文敦促将PQC迁移视为强制性措施以符合2030和2031年联邦期限，并依据Mosca HNDL推理支持该立场。同时强调密码敏捷性（crypto-agility）和混合密码部署是任何PQC迁移工作的必要补充，而非可选项。该模型作为量子资源估算研究和专家启发时间线调查的方法论伴侣，提供显式修订规则以持续校准。

title: Renormalization Group Flow Matching for Scalable Local Generative Modeling
summary: Despite their remarkable success in modeling complex data, generative models face a fundamental tradeoff. Global approaches can capture full structural coherence but suffer from high computational costs, while local models are efficient but often fail to reproduce long-range correlations and global coherence. The renormalization group (RG) bridges this gap by seamlessly connecting spatial structures across different length scales, retaining quasi-local descriptions at each step while preserving long-range correlations. We introduce renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework that systematically structures data generation across different spatial scales. By using an exact RG flow as the probability path, RGFM progressively generates data from long- to short-wavelength structures. To reconcile scalability with global structure, we exploit two key properties of the RG: quasi-locality and scale separation. We rigorously show that the RGFM probability flow can be accurately approximated by local velocity fields acting over a spatial range $O(Λ^{-1}[\ln L+\ln(1/\varepsilon)])$ for RG wavenumber scale $Λ$, linear system size $L$, and prescribed error tolerance $\varepsilon$. This property enables local generative modeling with patches of size $O(\ln L)$ and a computational cost that scales nearly linearly with the system volume. We numerically demonstrate that local RGFM reproduces long-range correlations far beyond its receptive field in representative one-dimensional distributions, while conventional local flow matching exhibits substantial errors at long distances. On FFHQ images, RGFM yields far more coherent and higher-quality samples than local flow matching at 64x64 and 256x256. Our results establish RG-guided probability flows as a promising route toward scalable generative modeling that captures long-range structure using only local computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出重正化群流匹配（RGFM），一种利用重正化群（RG）流动作为概率路径的生成框架，通过尺度分离和准局域性实现局部计算即可捕捉长程相关性的高效生成建模。
AI.motivation: 生成模型面临根本性权衡：全局方法能捕捉完整结构一致性但计算成本高，局部模型高效但无法再现长程相关性和全局一致性。RG桥接了不同尺度间的空间结构，保留准局域描述的同时维持长程相关性。
AI.method: RGFM使用精确RG流动作为概率路径，从长波长结构逐步生成到短波长结构。利用RG的两个关键性质——准局域性和尺度分离，严格证明RGFM概率流可被空间范围O(Λ^{-1}[ln L + ln(1/ε)])的局部速度场精确近似，从而支持O(ln L)大小的分块局部生成建模。
AI.result: 数值实验表明：在一维分布上，局部RGFM能再现远超其感受野的长程相关性，而传统局部流匹配在长距离上存在显著误差；在FFHQ图像上，RGFM在64x64和256x256分辨率下生成的样本比局部流匹配更连贯、质量更高。
AI.conclusion: RG引导的概率流为可扩展生成建模提供了有前景的路径，仅使用局部计算即可捕捉长程结构。

title: Safety-aware Model Predictive Path Integral Control with Signal Temporal Logic
summary: Safety-aware motion planning remains a challenge in robotics, especially when missions are time-critical and are under complex specifications. In this paper, we propose safety-aware-stl-mppi, a computationally efficient sampling-based receding-horizon planning framework designed to promote satisfaction of constraints expressed in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). Our approach encodes discrete-time STL formulas into candidate time-varying control barrier functions (CBF), which are integrated into a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller. Our method inherits the benefits of low computational cost from an efficiently parallelizable sampling based planner and utilizes CBF for constraints expressed in STL. We compare against several MPPI baselines using four artificial Mars Rover planning case studies with a diverse environment and cost setups, where we show our method consistently achieving high safety and efficiency. We show a quadcopter planning experiment with NVIDIA Isaac Lab.

AI.tldr: 本文提出safety-aware-stl-mppi，一种将信号时序逻辑（STL）约束编码为时变控制障碍函数（CBF）并集成到模型预测路径积分（MPPI）框架中的采样型滚动时域规划方法，在保证计算效率的同时提升复杂时序规范下的安全性。在火星车和四旋翼（Isaac Lab）实验中验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 在时间紧迫且规范复杂的机器人安全感知运动规划任务中，现有方法难以同时兼顾计算效率和复杂规格约束的满足。需要一种既能高效并行采样又能在STL约束下保证安全性的规划框架。
AI.method: 将离散时间STL公式编码为候选的时变控制障碍函数（CBF），并将其集成到模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器中，利用MPPI的并行采样特性降低计算成本，同时借助CBF实现STL约束的安全满足。
AI.result: 在四个不同环境和成本设置的Mars Rover规划案例中，与多个MPPI基线方法相比，所提方法一致地实现了高安全性和高效率；并在NVIDIA Isaac Lab中完成了四旋翼规划实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法融合了MPPI的低计算成本优势与CBF对STL约束的严格满足能力，为复杂时序规格下的安全感知运动规划提供了高效的解决方案。

title: TRACE: Transition-Aware Residual Control for Multi-Objective Materials Discovery
summary: Multi-objective materials discovery with LLM agents is often limited not only by how many candidates can be proposed, but by how effectively each costly property evaluation informs the next search step. Existing agents mainly store evaluated candidates and their scores, so they know which materials succeeded but not which executable edits caused useful property changes. This makes local refinement difficult when objectives compete and an edit that improves one property may damage another. We propose TRACE, a transition-aware residual control framework that treats evaluated edits as the basic unit of feedback. TRACE records each local refinement as a parent-edit-child transition with observed property deltas, aggregates transition evidence to estimate reusable edit effects, and ranks future edits by their predicted ability to reduce the current candidate's remaining constraint violations while avoiding damage to already satisfied objectives. In a controlled same-backbone comparison, TRACE improves over LLEMA, the state-of-the-art LLM-agent baseline, raising macro-average hit rate from 18.13\% to 25.96\%.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE框架，将编辑操作（而非仅评价候选材料）作为LLM智能体反馈的基本单元，通过记录父编辑-子编辑转移及属性增量来估计可复用的编辑效果，从而在材料多目标发现中更有效地指导局部优化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体仅存储已评价的候选材料及其得分，知道哪些材料成功但不知道哪些具体编辑导致了有用的属性变化，导致多目标冲突（改善一个属性可能损害另一个）时局部精细化困难，限制了材料发现的效率。
AI.method: TRACE框架将每次局部细化记录为父编辑-子编辑-子代的转移结构，附带观察到的属性增量；通过汇总转移证据估算可复用的编辑效果；按预测能减少当前候选剩余约束违反同时避免破坏已满足目标的能力对后续编辑进行排序。
AI.result: 在受控的同骨架（same-backbone）对比中，TRACE优于最先进的LLM智能体基线LLEMA，宏平均命中率从18.13%提升至25.96%。
AI.conclusion: 将编辑转移作为反馈单元能显著提升LLM智能体在多目标材料发现中的性能，为低成本高效利用评价结果提供了新思路。

title: Elastic KV Cache for LLM Serving:A Working Reclamation Mechanism, and Why Chunked Prefill Already Closes the Gap
summary:
An LLM serving engine sizes its key-value (KV) cache once, at startup, permanently setting aside a reserve for the worst-case prefill activation. During decode-dominant phases that reserve sits idle, yet it cannot be handed to the KV pool because it is exactly the memory a large prefill needs. We ask whether this reserve is reclaimable, and build a mechanism to test it. Our elastic KV cache lends the reserve to the KV pool during decode and returns it before prefill, driven by the scheduler's one-step-ahead view of the next batch. It is pure userspace on the CUDA virtual-memory path: two physical handles mapped into one contiguous virtual range per layer, so the attention kernel is unchanged and no driver patch is required. It decommits in a few milliseconds and recommits in tens of milliseconds, works with CUDA graphs and prefix caching, and never triggers an out-of-memory event. A static commit of the same memory is unsafe, crashing on prefill bursts, which makes the dynamic toggle necessary.
  Having built the mechanism, we test the premise it rests on and report an honest negative result. It only pays off if a small prefill chunk size badly hurts prefill latency. In a controlled experiment injecting long prompts into a live decode load, that penalty is small (median time-to-first-token differs by about 1% between chunk sizes of 8192 and 32768 tokens), because prefill is compute bound and decode consumes only about one token per sequence per step. Simply lowering max_num_batched_tokens recovers more KV than the controller does, at nearly equal latency. The reserve also dilutes under tensor parallelism, from 16% of KV at TP1 to 2.7% at TP4. We state precisely when reclaiming the reserve could still help, and release the mechanism as a reusable userspace elastic-VMM allocator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种弹性KV缓存机制，通过CUDA虚拟内存路径在用户态动态借出/归还KV缓存预留内存，但实验结果显示该机制在实践中收益甚微（时间到首token差异仅约1%），属于诚实的负面结果。
AI.motivation: LLM推理引擎在启动时一次性分配KV缓存，并在启动时永久保留一部分内存以应对最坏情况的prefill激活。然而在decode占主导的阶段，这部分预留内存闲置无用，却无法分配给KV池使用，造成内存浪费。作者想探究这部分预留内存是否可以被回收利用。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个弹性KV缓存机制：利用调度器对下一批次的前瞻视图，在decode阶段将预留内存借给KV池，在prefill之前归还。该机制在CUDA虚拟内存路径上实现，每层将两个物理句柄映射到一个连续虚拟地址范围，因此不需要修改attention内核或驱动。内存去提交只需几毫秒，重新提交需几十毫秒，兼容CUDA graphs和prefix caching，且不会触发OOM。
AI.result: 实验结果表明这是一个负面结果：该机制仅在prefill分块大小严重损害prefill延迟时才值得使用，但对照实验显示该惩罚很小（chunk size 8192与32768的time-to-first-token中位数仅差约1%），因为prefill是计算密集型而decode每步每序列仅消耗约一个token。降低max_num_batched_tokens能回收比该控制器更多的KV内存且延迟几乎相同。此外，预留内存在张量并行下会被稀释（TP1时为KV的16%，TP4时降至2.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 作者精确阐述了回收预留内存仍有帮助的条件，并发布了该机制作为可复用的用户态弹性VMM分配器。核心结论是：尽管机制本身可行且高效，但其依赖的前提（小prefill分块会严重损害延迟）在实践中不成立，因此该技术的实用价值有限。

title: pigzpp: Fast, Parallel, Portable Compression for the Whole Stack
summary: pigz is a widely deployed parallel gzip utility, but its process-global mutable state means that it was not designed as a reentrant, directly embeddable library. pigzpp is a from-scratch C++23 rewrite that turns the design into a thread-safe library with one accelerated DEFLATE core exposed to C++, Python, WebAssembly, Go, and Rust. As application-level conveniences built on that same core, it also provides multi-entry ZIP archives and a fast PNG codec. Its portable zlib-ng backend preserves gzip/zlib's ratio; its Intel ISA-L backend is an x86-64-only fast path that produces about 10% larger output at level 6 on our text corpus. In that configuration, zlib-ng reaches 2.1 times the CLI throughput of pigz and 16 times that of Python's in-memory gzip; ISA-L reaches 8.5 times and 50 times, respectively. Outputs remain standards-compliant and cross-decode with gzip, pigz, and unzip. The result is a self-contained, multi-platform compression stack and a case study in AI-assisted modernization under automated compatibility tests.

AI.tldr: pigzpp是一个从零开始的C++23重写项目，将pigz（一个广泛部署但不可重入的并行gzip工具）改造成线程安全的库，通过一个加速的DEFLATE核心暴露给C++、Python、WebAssembly、Go和Rust等多种语言。它提供多条目ZIP归档和快速PNG编解码器，支持zlib-ng（保持压缩比）和Intel ISA-L（x86-64快速路径，压缩比略大）两种后端，性能提升显著。
AI.motivation: pigz虽然是广泛部署的并行gzip工具，但其进程级可变状态使其无法作为可重入、可直接嵌入的库使用，限制了其在不同语言和应用场景中的复用。
AI.method: 以C++23从零重写pigz，设计为线程安全的库，将单一加速DEFLATE核心暴露给C++、Python、WebAssembly、Go和Rust；在同一核心上构建多条目ZIP归档和快速PNG编解码器；采用可移植的zlib-ng后端保持压缩比，以及x86-64专属的Intel ISA-L快速路径；在自动化兼容性测试下进行AI辅助现代化开发。
AI.result: zlib-ng后端达到pigz CLI吞吐量的2.1倍，是Python内存gzip的16倍；ISA-L后端分别达到8.5倍和50倍。ISA-L在level 6下输出比zlib-ng大约10%体积。输出保持标准兼容，可与gzip、pigz和unzip交叉解压。
AI.conclusion: pigzpp提供了一个自包含、跨平台的压缩技术栈，同时作为在自动化兼容测试下进行AI辅助代码现代化改造的案例研究，展示了旧有工具向现代多语言可嵌入库转型的可行路径。

title: ADE: Agentic Data Evolution Framework for Human-Centered Objectives
summary: Aligning large language models to human-centered objectives is difficult when targets are non-executable and context-dependent, limiting reliable verification and scalable supervision. Although synthetic data expands coverage, weak verification shifts the bottleneck from generation to selection. Noisy signals destabilize iterative refinement and can cause silent regressions. We propose Agentic Data Evolution (ADE), a data-centric framework that organizes synthetic supervision as evolving data snapshots. ADE improves data snapshots through a closed-loop Observation-Variation-Selection (OVS) procedure, where a steady-state admission mechanism acts as a quality ratchet that conservatively gates updates for sustained cross-round improvement. We validate these improvements through complementary intrinsic trend tracking and extrinsic post-training evaluation. On DEV300, ADE raises the intrinsic win rate from 50% to 75.81% and the extrinsic win rate from 55.20% to 68.86%, consistent performance gains across diverse benchmarks. Blind expert evaluation further confirms this, with a 66.11% preference for evolved answers. These gains extend across post-training methods, model scales, and tasks beyond the target weakly verifiable educational objectives. Resources are available at https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/Agentic-Data-Evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic Data Evolution (ADE)框架，通过Observation-Variation-Selection闭环流程和稳态准入机制，将合成数据监督组织为演化的数据快照，在弱可验证目标下实现持续跨轮改进，DEV300内在胜率从50%提升至75.81%，外在胜率从55.20%提升至68.86%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型与以人为中心的目标对齐存在困难：目标不可执行且依赖上下文，导致验证不可靠、监督难以扩展。虽然合成数据扩充了覆盖范围，但弱验证机制使瓶颈从生成转向选择。噪声信号会破坏迭代优化稳定性并导致静默回退，亟需一种数据层面的演进框架来应对这一挑战。
AI.method: ADE是一个以数据为中心的框架，将合成监督组织为持续演化的数据快照。核心包含三部分：(1) 闭环的Observation-Variation-Selection (OVS)流程用于改进数据快照；(2) 稳态准入机制作为质量棘轮，通过保守地门控更新实现持续跨轮改进；(3) 通过内在趋势追踪和外在后训练评估互补性地验证改进效果。
AI.result: 在DEV300基准上，ADE将内在胜率从50%提升至75.81%，外在胜率从55.20%提升至68.86%，在多个基准上表现一致。盲审专家评估确认66.11%偏好于进化后的答案。收益可扩展到不同后训练方法、模型规模和超出目标弱可验证教育目标的任务。
AI.conclusion: ADE通过数据快照的受控演化有效解决了弱可验证目标下合成数据选择与迭代优化的瓶颈问题，验证了数据演进作为对齐策略的有效性，并展现出良好的跨方法、跨规模和跨任务泛化能力。

title: Platonic Representation Hypothesis on World Models
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Wenhow Li and Chengwei MA contributed equally. Project page: https://sellerbubble.github.io/platonic-representation-hypothesis-on-world-models/
summary: World models have demonstrated significant potential for perceiving and simulating complex environments. Despite their strong performance, the fundamental nature of their learned representations remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the Platonic Representation Hypothesis within this domain by proposing the Predictive Consistency Assumption: we posit that the optimization of a shared state transition objective acts as a selective pressure that encourages heterogeneous models to converge toward a shared latent structure. Through systematic experiments with the DINO World Model (DINO-WM), in which we vary visual encoders to create heterogeneous models, we find that capable world models evolve toward geometrically similar internal structures. Moreover, via model stitching, we show that the internal features of one world model can be mapped to another with limited performance degradation, providing evidence of functional compatibility. Our findings suggest that the pursuit of predictive consistency can promote shared, transition-compatible latent structure across world models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提出"预测一致性假设"，研究世界模型中的柏拉图表示假说，发现不同视觉编码器的DINO-WM世界模型在优化共享状态转移目标时，会趋向于几何上相似的内部潜在结构，且通过模型拼接可实现功能兼容。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在复杂环境感知与模拟方面表现出色，但其学习到的内部表征的本质特性仍不明确。作者希望探究不同世界模型是否在优化过程中收敛到共享的潜在结构，从而验证柏拉图表示假说在世界模型领域的适用性。
AI.method: 提出预测一致性假设，即共享状态转移目标函数的优化会产生选择性压力，促使异构模型收敛到共享潜在结构。通过改变视觉编码器构建异构DINO-WM模型，进行系统实验，并利用模型拼接技术验证不同世界模型内部特征之间的可映射性与功能兼容性。
AI.result: 研究发现，能力较强的世界模型在优化过程中会演化出几何上相似的内部结构；模型拼接实验表明，一个世界模型的内部特征可以映射到另一个世界模型且性能退化有限，证明了功能兼容性的存在。
AI.conclusion: 追求预测一致性可以促进不同世界模型之间形成共享的、转移兼容的潜在结构，为理解世界模型表征收敛性提供了理论依据和实证支持。

title: Beyond the Mandate: A Systematic Security Analysis of the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
summary: The Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), introduced by Google, enables large language model (LLM)-driven shopping agents to authorize and execute payments on behalf of users. Its signed Checkout and Payment Mandates protect the integrity of transaction data after signing. Agent interactions and external inputs that shape a transaction before authorization remain outside that protection, including Agent-to-Agent Protocol (A2A) messages and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls. Prior work identified replay and prompt-injection attacks in AP2 v0.1. AP2 v0.2 addresses some of these issues but adds capabilities and deployment assumptions that require renewed analysis. We present a systematic security analysis of AP2 v0.2 based on its roles, transaction lifecycle, deployment architectures, and trust boundaries. We divide the lifecycle into five phases and identify five deployment architectures. Using MAESTRO (Multi-Agent Environment, Security, Threat, Risk, Outcome), we model four threat actors, eleven attack surfaces, eighteen adversary capabilities, and six attacker goals. The resulting catalog contains 48 threats spanning five attack families. We score these threats with the Artificial Intelligence Vulnerability Scoring System (AIVSS), identifying eight that reach the High band in at least one architecture. Because no complete public AP2 deployment was available, we build a testbed spanning all five architectures and develop five proof-of-concept demonstrations covering all eight High-risk threats and their mitigations. We also develop a deployment-aware scanner that maps applicable threats to static, cross-role consistency, and adversarial checks. Our analysis shows that valid mandate signatures alone do not ensure that an agent-mediated transaction reflects the user's intent when its pre-authorization context is manipulated.

AI.tldr: 本文对Google推出的Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) v0.2进行了系统性安全分析，识别出48个威胁（覆盖5个攻击家族），其中8个达到高风险等级，并通过构建覆盖5种部署架构的测试平台和5个概念验证演示证实了这些威胁。核心发现：即使具有合法的授权签名，在预授权阶段被操纵的代理交易上下文也可能无法反映用户的真实意图。
AI.motivation: AP2 v0.1已被识别出重放攻击和提示注入攻击，而v0.2虽然修复了部分问题，但新增了功能和部署假设，需要进行新的安全分析。此外，AP2的签名保护仅覆盖交易数据签署后的完整性，而签署前代理交互和外部输入（如A2A消息和MCP工具调用）形成的交易背景不受保护，这构成了潜在的安全缺口。
AI.method: 本文采用MAESTRO（Multi-Agent Environment, Security, Threat, Risk, Outcome）框架进行系统化安全分析：将交易生命周期划分为5个阶段，识别5种部署架构，建模4个威胁行为者、11个攻击面、18个攻击者能力和6个攻击者目标。使用AIVSS对威胁进行评分，构建覆盖全部5种架构的测试平台，并开发了部署感知的安全扫描器用于映射威胁到静态检查、跨角色一致性检查和对抗性检查。
AI.result: 分析产生了包含48个威胁的分类目录，跨越5个攻击家族。通过AIVSS评分，识别出8个在至少一种架构中达到高风险等级的威胁。构建了覆盖所有5种架构的测试平台，开发了5个概念验证演示涵盖全部8个高风险威胁及其缓解措施，并开发了部署感知的扫描器。
AI.conclusion: AP2 v0.2中合法的授权签名并不足以保证代理中介交易反映用户的意图，因为交易前的授权上下文可能被操纵。该研究表明，对于智能体驱动的支付系统，仅保护签名后的数据完整性是不够的，还必须保护授权前的上下文完整性。

authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
title: Response Renormalization for Critical Deep Equilibrium Models
summary: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) compute predictions from a hidden representation unchanged by the model update. Training through this equilibrium uses implicit differentiation and requires solving an adjoint system built from the residual Jacobian. If this Jacobian is nearly singular along loss-sensitive directions, small perturbations can be strongly amplified in the adjoint response, producing large, highly sensitive gradients that can make optimization unreliable. We introduce Response Renormalization, a backward-pass framework that lifts selected near-pole denominators while leaving unlifted response channels unchanged. Collective Mode Response Renormalization (CMR) applies this correction in a low-dimensional critical subspace, while Phi-adaptive CMR computes a bounded response mass from a positive susceptibility rule. We derive dense and matrix-free collective formulations, distinguish exact gradients of a modified frozen-anchor residual from backward-response surrogates, and extend the construction to Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors (SILVA). Across 23 multiphysics families spanning partial differential equations, three-dimensional fields, operator maps, complex geometries, and particle systems, CMR and Phi-CMR yield test errors no more than five percent higher than those from models trained with exact implicit differentiation in more than 98% of static and 95% of transient family-seed comparisons. Solver-index experiments show convergence toward the static adjoint, while physical-time rollouts retain predictive fidelity under the evaluated conditions. These results demonstrate that selective response renormalization can control near-critical adjoint amplification without globally damping well-conditioned sensitivity. Therefore, the method can make parameter updates more reliable while preserving the useful gradient information needed for learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出响应重正化（Response Renormalization）框架，通过在反向传播中对近奇异残差Jacobian的临界子空间进行选择性修正，控制伴随系统梯度放大问题，同时保留良好条件敏感性。基于此框架的CMR和Phi-CMR方法在23个多物理场任务族中，超过98%的静态和95%的瞬态实验中测试误差不超过精确隐式微分的5%。
AI.motivation: 深度平衡模型（DEQ）通过隐式微分训练时，需要求解基于残差Jacobian的伴随系统。当Jacobian沿损失敏感方向接近奇异时，微小扰动会被强烈放大，导致梯度极大且高度敏感，使优化变得不可靠。现有方法缺乏对这类近临界伴随放大的选择性控制手段。
AI.method: 提出Response Renormalization反向传播框架：选择性提升近极点分母（lifting near-pole denominators），保持未提升响应通道不变。具体包括：(1) Collective Mode Response Renormalization (CMR)——在低维临界子空间中施加修正；(2) Phi-adaptive CMR——通过正磁化率规则计算有界响应质量。推导了稠密与无矩阵（matrix-free）集体公式，区分了修正冻结锚点的精确梯度与反向响应替代梯度，并扩展到结构化隐式层与向量吸引子（SILVA）。
AI.result: 在23个多物理场家族（涵盖偏微分方程、三维场、算子映射、复杂几何和粒子系统）中，CMR和Phi-CMR在超过98%的静态和95%的瞬态族种子比较中，测试误差不超过精确隐式微分训练模型的5%。Solver-index实验显示向静态伴随收敛，物理时间展开在评估条件下保持预测保真度。
AI.conclusion: 选择性响应重正化能够在不全局削弱良态灵敏度的情况下控制近临界伴随放大，使参数更新更可靠，同时保留学习所需的有用梯度信息。

title: Sensorless damage-safe grasping
summary: Robotic fruit harvesting must hold produce securely without bruising it, yet compression stiffness varies several-fold with ripeness within a single species, so no fixed grip force spans the range. Rather than tune force, we bound deformation: a controller closes the gripper until the object's estimated compression strain reaches a user-specified limit $\varepsilon$, using only the encoder position and motor-effort signal on every servo gripper---no tactile or force-torque sensor. Dividing an effort-based contact force by a lower bound on object stiffness makes the stop provably conservative---true compression stays at or below $\varepsilon$---for any $\varepsilon$ above a contact-detection strain floor we identify and quantify: robust detection itself spends compression, linearly in closing speed, making speed an explicit throughput--gentleness knob. Unlike a hand-tuned force threshold, $\varepsilon$ is a certified, size-scaling, operator-interpretable damage limit, and a ready safe-action parameter for learned grasping policies. In MuJoCo simulation over a realistic fruit-stiffness range, under a sensor-noise model calibrated to the real servo, the controller holds $\ge 98\,\%$ grasp at $0\,\%$ damage across all medium-to-firm stiffnesses for the entire certified $\varepsilon$ range, which neither fixed-force baseline attains; on stiffness-graded 3D-printed TPU cubes it matches baseline grasp success at roughly half the grip force and cuts soft-object damage from $100\,\%$ to $40\,\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需力传感器、仅依赖编码器位置与电机力矩信号、通过估算压缩应变来控制夹持器停止点的果品采摘抓取控制方法，可保证真实压缩不超过设定应变阈值。
AI.motivation: 机器人水果采摘必须无损且牢固地抓取果实，但同一物种内果实随成熟度变化其压缩刚度可相差数倍，固定夹持力无法覆盖整个范围，因此需要一种能自适应刚度、可保证不造成损伤的抓取控制策略。
AI.method: 控制器持续闭合夹持器，直到基于编码器位置和电机力矩信号估算的物体压缩应变达到用户设定的阈值ε。通过将基于力矩估算的接触力除以物体刚度的下界，使控制停止点具有可证明的保守性，即真实压缩应变始终保持在ε以下。该方法无需触觉或力/力矩传感器，并识别出接触检测所需的应变下限与闭合速度的线性关系。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo仿真（覆盖实际水果刚度范围、校准至真实舵机的传感器噪声模型）中，对中到硬刚度范围内的全部认证ε区间，控制器达到≥98%抓取成功率且0%损伤，而两个固定力基线均无法达到；在刚度分级的3D打印TPU立方体实验中，抓取成功率与基线相当，但夹持力约为一半，且软物体损伤从100%降至40%。
AI.conclusion: 基于应变边界的夹持控制比固定力阈值更优，ε作为可认证、可随尺寸缩放、操作人员可理解的损伤指标，同时可作为学习型抓取策略的安全动作参数，在保证无损伤抓取的同时兼顾抓取成功率与吞吐效率。

title: Function-Level Execution Feedback for Code Preference Optimization
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Process supervision has improved mathematical reasoning, where intermediate steps are naturally expressed as chains of thought. In code generation, however, process supervision remains underexplored because there is no standard notion of a step. Supervision can target lines, reasoning traces, or program states, making it unclear what to label and optimize. We propose STEP-KTODER, a framework for code preference optimization that defines steps as module-level functions in decomposed multi-function programs and assigns binary correctness labels via automatically generated unit tests. Our method provides a code-specific instantiation of stepwise KTO, combining function-level process supervision with outcome-level feedback on the full program. We evaluate on HumanEval(+), MBPP(+), BigCodeBench, and LiveCodeBench, showing that STEP-KTODER improves over outcome-only KTO and DPO. Further analysis shows that execution-based labels are essential: LLM-as-a-judge annotations systematically over-predict function failures, corrupt positive step labels, and degrade downstream preference optimization. Code is available at: https://github.com/inechnech/STEP-KTODER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEP-KTODER，一个代码偏好优化框架，将过程监督定义为多函数程序中的模块级函数步骤，并通过自动生成的单元测试分配二元正确性标签，结合函数级过程监督与结果级反馈，在多个基准上优于仅用结果监督的KTO和DPO。
AI.motivation: 过程监督在数学推理中已被证明能改善推理能力，但在代码生成中因缺乏自然定义的"步骤"而未被充分探索。现有监督可针对代码行、推理轨迹或程序状态，导致标注目标和优化目标不明确。需要一个代码特化的、可自动标注的过程监督方法。
AI.method: STEP-KTODER将代码生成中的"步骤"定义为分解后多函数程序中的模块级函数，通过自动生成的单元测试为每个函数步骤分配二元正确性标签（执行层面的过程监督），并基于逐步KTO（stepwise KTO）实现函数级过程监督与整体程序结果级反馈的结合。
AI.result: 在HumanEval(+)、MBPP(+)、BigCodeBench和LiveCodeBench上，STEP-KTODER优于仅使用结果监督的KTO和DPO。进一步分析表明，基于执行结果的标签至关重要：使用LLM-as-a-judge的标注会系统性地高估函数失败，污染正向步骤标签，并降低下游偏好优化的性能。
AI.conclusion: STEP-KTODER证明了在代码生成中引入基于执行单元测试的函数级过程监督，可以有效提升代码偏好优化的性能。执行基标签优于LLM判官标注，为代码生成领域的过程监督研究提供了可行的范式。

title: Pipeline-Native Transformers: Co-Designing Model Architecture and CPU Inference for Bandwidth-Efficient Autoregressive Decode
comment: 77 pages, 2 figures. Model weights and binaries: https://huggingface.co/tompoper/cflow
summary:
Single-token autoregressive decode on CPUs is bound by memory bandwidth, not arithmetic: a modern CPU sustains roughly 1 TFLOP/s of compute but only about 50 GB/s from main memory, and each generated token must stream every active weight once. This report argues that the most effective response is to co-design the model architecture and the inference runtime together. It presents cflow, a CPU-first streaming engine, alongside a family of pipeline-native transformer architectures whose inter-layer dependency graphs are constructed to permit a vertical, stage-major execution schedule.
  cflow stores weights as L2-sized tiles in compute-consumption order, reads only the top-k experts of each mixture-of-experts layer, fuses projections, and executes a delay-aware schedule from per-model dependency parameters. Across five architectures trained on TinyStories, one (arch2_4_combined) achieves a 2.00x reduction in critical-path weight bandwidth (9.00 to 4.50 MB/token) within 0.24 perplexity of the best candidate, and the tile layout incurs 7.29x fewer L1-data read misses than a row-major baseline. On a 30.9-billion-parameter pipeline-native MoE, cflow decodes at 5.94 tokens/s (tok/s) on a 32-vCPU Ice Lake server, ahead of llama.cpp (4.75) and the vLLM CPU backend (1.65) on comparably sized dense models. Realizing the expert-delay window as asynchronous I/O overlap on a disk-resident expert tier yields a further net win of up to 1.68x, matching the overlap model within 1%. Measurement refutes one of the eight design claims and leaves a second inconclusive; both are reported in full, with the conditions under which they would hold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出cflow——一个CPU优先的流式推理引擎，以及一组管道原生（pipeline-native）Transformer架构族，通过架构与运行时协同设计来缓解CPU单token自回归解码的内存带宽瓶颈。在TinyStories训练的五个架构中，最佳架构将关键路径权重带宽从9.00降至4.50 MB/token（2.00x），在30.9B参数MoE模型上达到5.94 tok/s，优于llama.cpp和vLLM CPU后端。
AI.motivation: CPU上的单token自回归解码受限于内存带宽而非算力（约1 TFLOP/s算力 vs 50 GB/s内存带宽），每个生成的token都必须流过所有激活权重。作者认为最有效的应对策略是同时协同设计模型架构与推理运行时。
AI.method: 提出cflow引擎，采用L2大小的tile以计算消费顺序存储权重，仅读取MoE层top-k专家，融合投影操作，并根据每模型依赖参数执行延迟感知调度。同时构建管道原生Transformer架构族，其层间依赖图设计为允许纵向、按stage为主的执行调度。在磁盘驻留专家层上实现专家延迟窗口的异步I/O重叠。
AI.result: 在TinyStories上训练的五个架构中，arch2_4_combined实现关键路径权重带宽2.00x的降低（9.00到4.50 MB/token），且与最优候选的困惑度差距仅0.24；tile布局的L1数据读取未命中比行主序基线少7.29x。在30.9B参数管道原生MoE上，cflow在32 vCPU Ice Lake服务器上达到5.94 tok/s，优于llama.cpp（4.75）和vLLM CPU后端（1.65）的相似规模密集模型。磁盘专家层的异步I/O重叠带来最高1.68x的净收益。测量推翻了八个设计声明中的一个，另一个尚无定论。
AI.conclusion: 架构-运行时协同设计是应对CPU内存带宽瓶颈的有效路径，cflow展示了显著优于现有推理系统的性能。论文诚实报告了负面结果：八个设计声明中有一个被测量推翻，一个不确定，并给出了它们成立的条件。

title: An HPC Approach to Accelerate Tensor Decompositions
summary: Quantum systems grow in complexity so rapidly that even modest models become difficult to simulate, creating a strong need for methods that can handle high-dimensional data, also known as tensors. In this work, we investigate a novel Jacobi-type tensor algorithm for tensor decomposition and develop a CUDA-based algorithm that supports tensors of arbitrary order on a single GPU. We test the implementation on NVIDIA H100 GPUs and show that the algorithm converges correctly for diagonalizable tensors up to nine dimensions, with runtime scaling in a predictable way as tensor order grows. Finally, our general algorithm outperforms the original MATLAB reference by more than two orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于CUDA的Jacobi型张量分解算法，支持任意阶张量在单个GPU上运行，在NVIDIA H100上可正确收敛至九维对角化张量，运行时间随张量阶数增长具有可预测的扩展性，且比原始MATLAB参考实现快两个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 量子系统复杂度增长极快，即便是中等规模的模型也难以模拟，因此迫切需要能够处理高维数据（即张量）的方法。现有的张量分解方法在处理高维数据时存在性能瓶颈，需要更高效的算法和实现。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的Jacobi型张量分解算法，并基于CUDA开发了支持任意阶张量的单GPU实现算法，在NVIDIA H100 GPU上进行测试验证。
AI.result: 算法对高达九维的可对角化张量能正确收敛，运行时间随张量阶数增长具有可预测的扩展模式，且整体性能比原始MATLAB参考实现快两个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的CUDA加速Jacobi型张量分解算法在高维张量分解问题上展现出显著的性能优势，能够有效应对量子系统模拟中对高维数据处理的需求。

title: What Reaches Expert Review? Representation, Structural Screening, and Candidate-Form Dependence in AI-Assisted Item Development
comment: 42 pages, 1 figure, 19 tables. Data and reproducibility materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21968239
summary: Between AI-assisted item generation and expert review sits a computational evaluator whose decisions are usually treated as technical preliminaries. Yet representation, structural reduction, and selection policy determine which items and evidence psychometricians ever receive. Across two linked in-silico studies of 32,000 selected Big Five items, we followed fixed source populations from semantic representation through structural evaluation and candidate-form construction. Broad agreement in semantic geometry concealed consequential local differences: identical wording acquired different construct evidence, different items survived, and intended attributes could disappear even as community correspondence improved. These sensitivities also differed across generated source populations. At the final review boundary, both eligibility policies filled every content cell in every evaluable form, yet they presented different wording. Across embedding configurations, inclusive primary forms shared a median of only 6 of 40 items, reflecting the total downstream consequence of changing representation across structural evidence and ranking. The apparent stability of global summaries and complete forms therefore concealed instability in the content reaching psychometricians. The computational evaluator is not neutral infrastructure between generation and expertise; it is an inspectable and revisable part of measurement design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项关联的计算机模拟研究（32,000个Big Five条目），探讨AI辅助条目生成与专家评审之间的计算评估器（computational evaluator）如何通过表征、结构简化和选择策略影响心理测量学家最终收到的条目内容。研究发现全局语义几何的一致性掩盖了局部重大差异：相同措辞获得不同构念证据、不同条目存留、预期属性可能消失。不同嵌入配置下，包容性主表单40个条目中位数仅共享6个，表明计算评估器并非中性基础设施，而是可检查、可修订的测量设计组成部分。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将计算评估器（如表征、结构简化、选择策略）视为AI辅助条目生成与专家评审之间的技术性预备环节，忽视了它对最终条目内容的关键性影响。本文旨在揭示这些看似中立的计算决策如何从根本上决定了心理测量学家所能接收到的条目和证据，从而挑战计算评估器作为"中性基础设施"的传统假设。
AI.method: 作者设计了两项相关联的计算机模拟（in-silico）研究，从固定源总体出发追踪完整流程：从语义表征（semantic representation）→ 结构评估（structural evaluation）→ 候选构念构建（candidate-form construction）。研究采用32,000个精选的Big Five条目，比较不同嵌入配置和两种资格/选择策略在最终评审边界上的条目产出差异。
AI.result: 研究发现：全局层面的语义几何相似性掩盖了局部层面的关键差异——相同措辞在不同配置下获得不同的构念证据，不同条目得以存留，预期属性甚至可能消失。不同生成的源总体在敏感性上也存在系统性差异。在最终评审边界，两种资格策略都能填满所有可评估表单的内容单元，但呈现的措辞不同。在不同嵌入配置下，包容性主表单中位数只有6个共享条目（共40个），凸显了表征变化在结构证据和排序层面的全部下游后果。
AI.conclusion: 全局摘要的稳定性和表单的完整性掩盖了到达心理测量学家手中的内容的实质不稳定性。计算评估器并非生成与专家判断之间的中性管道，而是可检视、可修订的测量设计核心组成部分。研究呼吁对计算评估器的表征选择、结构决策和选择策略进行审慎考量与透明化报告。

title: DriftAD: Visually-Guided Text Drift for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) has recently benefited from vision-language models such as CLIP, which enable anomaly de?tection by aligning visual features with text descriptions of normal and abnormal states. However, existing methods typically rely on static text prompts that are applied uniformly across the entire feature hierarchy and spatial dimensions. This rigid global-to-local matching fails to capture the highly localized and scale-dependent physical variations of industrial defects. To address this, we propose DriftAD, a FSAD framework built on three key modules. First, an Anomaly Signal Amplification (ASA) module enhances subtle defect signals through spatial and frequency branches before text-visual matching. Second, Visually-Guided Text Drift (VGTD) dynamically transforms frozen CLIP text embeddings, steering them into layer?wise, spatially-adaptive anomaly descriptors conditioned on local visual context at each encoder depth. Third, Drift-Guided Spatial Gating (DGSG) uses the drifted abnormal descriptor as a spatial probe to selectively enhance anomaly-relevant visual features. Addi?tionally, a drift separation loss prevents representational collapse of the drifted descriptors, and a gate supervision loss enforces spatially discriminative gating in DGSG. Extensive experiments on MVTec?AD and VisA demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across all 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings on both image-level and pixel-level metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/wenyang001/DriftAD.

AI.tldr: DriftAD是一个基于CLIP的少样本异常检测框架，通过动态文本漂移机制将冻结的CLIP文本嵌入转换为逐层、空间自适应的异常描述符，结合异常信号放大和空间门控模块，在MVTec-AD和VisA数据集上取得了1/2/4-shot设置下的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉-语言模型的少样本异常检测方法采用静态文本提示，统一应用于整个特征层级和空间维度，这种僵化的全局到局部匹配无法捕捉工业缺陷高度局部化且尺度依赖的物理变化特征。
AI.method: 提出DriftAD框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) Anomaly Signal Amplification (ASA)模块通过空间和频域分支在文本-视觉匹配前增强微弱缺陷信号；(2) Visually-Guided Text Drift (VGTD)模块根据每个编码器深度的局部视觉上下文，动态变换冻结的CLIP文本嵌入为逐层、空间自适应的异常描述符；(3) Drift-Guided Spatial Gating (DGSG)模块利用漂移后的异常描述符作为空间探针，选择性增强异常相关视觉特征。此外设计漂移分离损失防止描述符表征坍缩，门控监督损失强化DGSG的空间判别能力。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD和VisA数据集上的广泛实验表明，DriftAD在1-shot、2-shot和4-shot设置下均取得了图像级和像素级指标的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: DriftAD通过动态、视觉引导的文本漂移机制有效克服了静态文本提示在少样本异常检测中的局限性，实现了对工业缺陷更精准的局部化和尺度自适应检测。

title: SoK: ARCUS: On the Efficiency and Efficacy of Hardware Fuzzing
summary: This work presents a comprehensive analysis of contemporary hardware fuzzing techniques applied across three major abstraction layers: Instruction Set Architecture (ISA), microarchitecture, and Register-Transfer Level (RTL). Our study examines key factors including input stimulus quality, mutation strategies, feedback mechanisms, target platforms, reference models, and achieved coverage. We find challenges, goals, and design trade-offs vary significantly across abstraction layers. We further identify several unmet needs in current hardware fuzzing practices, such as intelligent input generation, reliable and scalable golden reference models, expressive feedback channels, and cross-layer integration. Building on these insights, we outline future research directions, including hybrid fuzzing frameworks, AI-assisted test generation, scalable reference models, standardized evaluation metrics and benchmarks, and human-in-the-loop automation for guided exploration and analysis. Together, they aim to unlock efficient, reliable, and comprehensive hardware verification solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文对硬件模糊测试技术进行了全面分析，涵盖指令集架构、微架构和寄存器传输级三个抽象层，系统比较了输入刺激质量、变异策略、反馈机制、目标平台、参考模型和覆盖率等关键因素，识别了当前实践中的不足，并提出了未来的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 硬件模糊测试在不同抽象层（ISA、微架构、RTL）面临不同的挑战、目标和设计权衡，但缺乏系统性的跨层分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，全面审视各抽象层硬件模糊测试的现状，识别未满足的需求，为未来研究指明方向。
AI.method: 采用综合分析方法，从输入刺激质量、变异策略、反馈机制、目标平台、参考模型和覆盖率等维度，对三个抽象层（ISA、微架构、RTL）的硬件模糊测试技术进行系统比较与归纳，识别跨层共性挑战与差异，并据此提出未来研究方向。
AI.result: 研究发现各抽象层的挑战、目标和设计权衡存在显著差异；识别出当前硬件模糊测试的若干未满足需求，包括智能输入生成、可靠可扩展的金标准参考模型、表达性强的反馈通道以及跨层集成。
AI.conclusion: 未来硬件模糊测试应向混合模糊测试框架、AI辅助测试生成、可扩展参考模型、标准化评估指标与基准、以及人机协同自动化等方向发展，以实现高效、可靠且全面的硬件验证。

title: Calibration-Preserving Pruning: Compression as a Reliability Contract
summary: Split conformal prediction, not the pruning rule, supplies finite-sample marginal coverage once a pruned model is fixed independently of the conformal calibration split. We study the separate efficiency problem: can pruning preserve score geometry well enough to obtain smaller valid prediction sets? Calibration-Preserving Pruning (CPP) augments a base pruning score with nonconformity-gradient saliency and uses disjoint pruning, validation-selection, conformal-calibration, and test splits. Bounded score perturbations imply bounded conformal-quantile shifts and controlled set inflation, but do not make the generic coverage theorem CPP-specific. Final five-seed Qwen2.5-1.5B results at 50\% sparsity show the largest gains on large-label tasks. On DBpedia-14, CPP-SparseGPT reduces mean set size from \(10.1\) to \(8.6\) while changing accuracy from \(0.347\) to \(0.366\); CPP-Wanda reduces \(11.2\) to \(9.0\) with an accuracy trade-off from \(0.310\) to \(0.295\). Across 15 dataset--sparsity cells, CPP-SparseGPT produces smaller sets in 13 and higher accuracy in 11. Matched controls show that generic supervised gradients explain much of the gain: true-label CPP is not statistically resolved from matched Wanda+SNIP, whereas threshold-aware candidate-label CPP reaches \(7.8\) mean set size at explicit accuracy and offline-compute costs. RoBERTa-base and Llama-3-8B diagnostics support transfer, but our claims remain limited to reliability-sensitive classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出标定保持剪枝（CPP）方法，通过将非一致性梯度显著性融入基础剪枝分数，在模型剪枝后仍保持有限样本边际覆盖，同时优化预测集效率。实验表明CPP在多数数据集-稀疏度组合下产生更小且更准确的预测集。
AI.motivation: 分裂共形预测保证有限样本边际覆盖的前提是剪枝模型独立于共形标定分裂固定。然而，剪枝是否会破坏分数几何结构、导致预测集膨胀，是一个此前未被充分研究的效率问题。本文旨在回答：剪枝能否在保持有效覆盖的同时，产生更小的有效预测集？
AI.method: CPP方法在基础剪枝分数上增加非一致性梯度显著性项，并使用四个不相交分裂：剪枝、验证选择、共形标定和测试。理论上证明有界分数扰动意味着有界共形分位数偏移和受控的集合膨胀。实验在Qwen2.5-1.5B等模型上结合SparseGPT和Wanda两种剪枝方法进行验证。
AI.result: 在50%稀疏度下，DBpedia-14数据集上CPP-SparseGPT将平均集合大小从10.1降至8.6（准确率0.347→0.366），CPP-Wanda从11.2降至9.0（准确率0.310→0.295）。在15个数据集-稀疏度单元中，CPP-SparseGPT在13个中产生更小集合、11个中准确率更高。对照实验显示通用监督梯度贡献显著，阈值感知的候选标签CPP达到7.8的平均集合大小。RoBERTa-base和Llama-3-8B的补充实验支持迁移性。
AI.conclusion: CPP方法能够有效解决剪枝后的共形预测效率问题，在保持有限样本覆盖保证的同时产生更小的预测集。但真实标签CPP与匹配的Wanda+SNIP对照在统计上无法区分，表明增益主要来自通用监督梯度；方法的可靠性声明仅限于对可靠性敏感的分类任务。

title: Bridging Teacher Expectations and Robot Learning via Coupling Dynamics
summary: Human-robot teaching focuses on enabling nontechnical experts to customize robots according to their needs after deployment. With recent advances in machine learning, human-robot teaching is no longer confined to offline learning where the data gathering step from a human teacher is separated from when the robot learns. Instead, more recent approaches for human-robot teaching focus on coupling human teaching with robot learning. This coupling impacts the structure, timing, and content of the teaching and learning interaction. However, it is currently unclear how such coupling dynamics affect humanrobot teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process. Informed by human learning theories, in this paper we propose a new scale for classifying human-robot teaching interactions according to coupling dynamics present between the human teacher and robot learner. We apply this scale to a subset of the human-robot teaching literature to identify how coupling dynamics and human teacher mental model mismatches with the ground truth robot learning system affect teaching effectiveness and human perceptions towards the teaching process

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的量表，用于根据人与机器人之间耦合动态（coupling dynamics）对人-机器人教学交互进行分类，并应用于现有文献以研究耦合动态和教师心理模型不匹配如何影响教学效果和人类感知。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习的发展，人-机器人教学已从离线学习转向将人类教学与机器人学习相结合的在线方式，这种耦合影响了教学交互的结构、时机和内容。但目前尚不清楚这种耦合动态如何影响人-机器人教学效果以及人类对教学过程的主观感知。因此需要一种系统化的分类框架来理解这些耦合动力学的影响。
AI.method: 本文基于人类学习理论，提出了一种新的分类量表，用于根据人类教师与机器人学习者之间存在的耦合动态对人-机器人教学交互进行分类。随后将该量表应用于人-机器人教学文献的一个子集，用以分析耦合动态以及人类教师心理模型与机器人真实学习系统之间的不匹配如何影响教学效果和人类对教学过程的感知。
AI.result: 通过将所提出的分类量表应用到人-机器人教学文献子集，论文识别出耦合动态和人类教师心理模型与真实机器人学习系统之间的不匹配对教学效果及人类对教学过程感知的影响机制。
AI.conclusion: 该量表为理解和评估人-机器人教学中的耦合动态提供了一个系统性框架，有助于揭示教学交互设计中影响教学效果和用户体验的关键因素，为未来人-机器人教学系统的设计提供理论依据。

title: Auditing the Synthetic Memoir: Measuring Scene-Level Confabulation in LLM-Generated Autobiography Against the Documented Record of the Life It Describes
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code and derived data available at https://github.com/heathriel/synthetic-memoir-audit
summary: When a large language model (LLM) is asked to write a person's life, how much of what it writes actually happened? We present a scene-level case-study audit - the first quantified audit of LLM-generated autobiography against a subject-specific ground-truth corpus that we are aware of, based on an unsystematic literature search. The subject and the author of this paper are the same person: a 366-day "page-a-day" book of first-person anecdotal entries was drafted with a conversational LLM whose documented inputs were a template, two exemplar days, and each day's quote - not her corpus - and every day was subsequently audited at the anecdote-scene level against an independent verification corpus using a four-level rubric fixed before analysis. We define the verification-failure rate as the share of days not rated VERIFIED (scene positively corroborated): 354 of 366 days fail, 96.7% (Wilson 95% CI 94.4-98.1%). Only 12 days contain a corroborated scene; 19 days (5.2%) assert claims actively contradicted by the record; the dominant failure mode is grounded drift - real people, employers, and settings inside invented scenes - though its measured share varies across raters. Independent re-rating replicates the headline (no evidence the original rate was inflated) while showing that the four-way taxonomy has only fair-to-moderate reliability. Regenerating the same days with current named models reproduces 100% verification failure under the same inputs; grounding generation in the subject's corpus significantly improves the verification rate while leaving substantial residual failure (83.3%). We contribute the measurement, a reusable audit instrument whose WEAK/UNVERIFIED boundary we show to be unreliable, and a grounding remedy with quantified effect.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM生成的自传进行了首次场景级量化审计，发现96.7%的日子未能通过事实验证，主要失败模式为"接地漂移"（真实人物/雇主/场景被嵌入虚构情节），并验证了将语料接地可显著提升验证率但仍存在残余失败。
AI.motivation: LLM生成个人传记时其内容的真实性问题缺乏量化评估，作者基于自身366天"每日一页"的真实日记，对LLM生成的自传进行场景级审计，以填补该领域缺乏对"以具体主体为对象的地面真值"进行对照验证的研究空白。
AI.method: 以作者本人为研究对象，使用对话式LLM基于模板、两个示例日及每日引言生成366天自传条目，随后使用预先固定的四级评分体系（VERIFIED等），以独立验证语料库在轶事场景层面逐日审计；同时进行独立复评验证可重复性，并对比不同LLM及接地生成的验证效果。
AI.result: 366天中有354天（96.7%，Wilson 95% CI 94.4-98.1%）未达VERIFIED评级；仅12天包含被证实的场景；19天包含与记录直接矛盾的主张；主导失败模式为接地漂移。独立复评确认了主要结论但显示四级分类可靠性仅为一般至中等；用当前主流模型重新生成同样保持100%失败率；将生成接地于主体语料库后失败率显著降至83.3%。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成自传的现实印证率极低，接地漂移是主要系统性缺陷，且该缺陷在多个主流模型中普遍存在；将生成过程接地于主体语料库能实质改善但不消除该问题；同时作者指出其审计工具中的WEAK/UNVERIFIED边界不可靠，为后续自动化传记审核工具的设计提供了度量方法和可复用的审计工具。

title: Thermal Tuning Overhead in Wafer-Scale Optical Interconnects for LLM MoE Training: A Cross-Layer Analysis and Ferroelectric-Based Mitigation
summary: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs), particularly mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, has intensified interconnect demands because expert-parallel execution is communication-intensive. Wafer-scale optical interconnects based on dense wavelength-division multiplexing (DWDM) offer a promising path to higher bandwidth; however, conventional microring-resonator (MRR)-based links rely on thermo-optic tuning and are therefore vulnerable to workload-induced thermal fluctuations. In this work, we present a cross-layer analysis of wafer-scale optical interconnects for MoE workloads that combines workload profiling, packet-level network simulation, and transient thermal analysis. We implement a wafer-scale topology in the ht-sim simulator and construct an Ansys thermal model of a 3D-integrated GPU/EIC/PIC stack. Our results show that transient temperature variations can exceed the tracking capability of conventional thermo-optic control loops and thereby introduce repeated tuning stalls during communication phases. The stall durations injected into the network simulation are derived directly from the thermal model rather than assumed. We further evaluate a ferroelectric-based electro-optic tuning mechanism that removes the continuous thermal-tuning requirement. In a four-layer proxy simulation across three MoE models, eliminating the tuning stalls yields speedups of 2.7x for Mixtral 8x7B, 3.8x for Qwen-MoE 14.3B, and 3.3x for LLaMA-MoE 6.7B relative to the thermo-optic case. These results indicate that minimizing photonic tuning latency is important for realizing the performance potential of optical interconnects in large-scale AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MoE大语言模型工作负载下晶圆级光互连的热效应问题，提出跨层分析方法，结合工作负载画像、数据包级网络模拟和瞬态热分析，揭示了热光调谐机制在通信阶段会出现重复调谐停顿，并验证了基于铁电材料的电光调谐机制可消除这些停顿，带来最高3.8倍的加速。
AI.motivation: MoE架构的LLM扩展导致专家并行执行对互连带宽要求极高，晶圆级光互连（基于DWDM）是提高带宽的有前景方案。然而传统基于微环谐振器（MRR）的光链路依赖热光调谐，容易受到工作负载引起的热波动影响，可能导致调谐环路无法跟踪瞬态温度变化，从而造成性能瓶颈。当前缺乏对这一问题在真实MoE工作负载下的跨层量化分析。
AI.method: 采用跨层分析方法：1）工作负载画像以了解MoE通信模式；2）在ht-sim模拟器中实现晶圆级拓扑并进行数据包级网络仿真；3）构建3D集成GPU/EIC/PIC堆栈的Ansys热模型，进行瞬态热分析。热模型中导出的停顿持续时间直接注入网络仿真（而非假设值）。进一步评估基于铁电材料的电光调谐机制以替代连续热调谐。
AI.result: 瞬态温度变化可超过传统热光控制回路的跟踪能力，导致通信阶段出现重复调谐停顿。在四层代理模拟中，消除调谐停顿后，Mixtral 8x7B加速2.7倍、Qwen-MoE 14.3B加速3.8倍、LLaMA-MoE 6.7B加速3.3倍（相对于热光方案）。
AI.conclusion: 最小化光子调谐延迟对于充分发挥光互连在大规模AI系统中的性能潜力至关重要。基于铁电材料的电光调谐机制能够消除热调谐停顿，显著提升MoE工作负载下的端到端性能。

title: Mixed-Precision SEM-Based CFD Simulations on GPUs: A Taylor-Green Vortex case
summary: Mixed precision is a promising approach for reducing the computational cost and energy consumption of Computation Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations, but its effectiveness depends strongly on where precision is reduced within the full simulation pipeline. In this work, we study Taylor-Green vortex case using Neko, a matrix-free CFD solver based on the spectral element method (SEM). Profiling shows that the fluid time step is not dominated by Krylov convergence alone: the velocity and pressure solvers require only a small number of iterations per step, while a substantial fraction of runtime is spent in other SEM operators and solver components. Motivated by this structure, we propose a three-level hierarchical mixed-precision control model. Two groups of configurations are evaluated in environments bounded by 64-bit floating-point (fp64) and 32-bit floating-point (fp32) precision, respectively. The fp64-bounded group identifies accuracy sensitive components and shows that SEM-focused fp32 computation is a promising direction for future optimization. The fp32-bounded group provides the main practical benefit. For the high Reynolds number case studied, selected configurations reduce both time- and energy-to-solution by about 34% relative to the fp64 baseline, while improving robustness compared with global fp32. Targeted fp16 kernel overrides are also explored, showing potential for selected operations but increased sensitivity in gradient-based quantities such as enstrophy. Overall, these results indicate that mixed-precision for matrix-free SEM-based CFD should be treated as a simulation-level control problem rather than solely as a Krylov-solver optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于谱元法（SEM）的矩阵自由CFD求解器Neko中的混合精度策略，提出三级层次化混合精度控制模型，在fp64和fp32两个精度界内评估不同配置，发现fp32界内的特定配置可将时间和能耗降低约34%，并指出混合精度应作为仿真级控制问题而非单纯的Krylov求解器优化。
AI.motivation: 混合精度是降低CFD仿真计算成本和能耗的有效手段，但其效果强烈依赖于精度在仿真流水线中的具体降级位置。以往研究多聚焦于Krylov求解器的精度优化，但对SEM算子及其他求解器组件的精度分配缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 使用基于谱元法的矩阵自由CFD求解器Neko，以Taylor-Green涡为测试案例。首先通过性能剖析发现流体时间步并非仅由Krylov收敛主导，速度和压力求解器每步迭代次数少，而大量运行时间消耗在SEM算子和其他求解器组件上。基于此结构提出三级层次化混合精度控制模型，在fp64和fp32两个精度界内分别评估两组配置，并探索针对特定操作的fp16内核覆盖。
AI.result: fp64界内的配置识别出了精度敏感组件，表明SEM聚焦的fp32计算是未来优化的有前景方向。fp32界内的配置带来了主要实际收益：对高雷诺数案例，选定的配置相对fp64基线将时间和能耗均减少约34%，同时相比全局fp32改善了鲁棒性。fp16内核覆盖对选定操作有潜力，但在梯度相关量（如涡度拟能）上增加了敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 对于基于矩阵自由SEM的CFD，混合精度应被视为仿真级的控制问题，而非仅作为Krylov求解器的优化手段。

title: When Youth Enter The Chat: An Epistemic Shift in the Validation of LLM-Based Measures of Student Talk
summary: LLMs are being used increasingly to measure aspects of student discourse (e.g. talk moves, collaboration, equity of voice) at scale. Typically, LLM-based measures of student talk use transcriptions of classroom conversations that only include verbal contributions, which de-contextualize student language. Common practices for validating these measures include comparing outputs against expert annotations by adults, using held out evaluation sets and F1 scores. We argue that these approaches are insufficient to ensure that such measures are meaningful and equitable for teaching and learning, particularly for racially and linguistically marginalized youth. In order to center the youth whose talk is being analyzed, re-contextualizing these classroom conversations and engaging youth in the research process is necessary. Sharing epistemic authority with youth, ultimately, centers their point of view and adds crucial nuance to the analysis of their talk that adult experts, researchers, and LLMs cannot provide. In a case study of multilingual youth in one 8th-grade math classroom, we address the epistemic exclusion of youth by employing multiple ethnographically-oriented methods to re-contextualize student conversations and center youth as epistemic authorities in conversation with researchers and LLMs. We conducted participant observations, interviews, focus groups, and member checks with four focal students. Findings reveal that there were misalignments between students' interpretations of their own math talk experiences and the LLM-based measures of their talk. Students contested both the LLM classifications and the coding scheme used to measure their talk, highlighting the need for youth to be involved in the epistemic process of producing knowledge about their experiences.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了当前用LLM分析学生课堂话语的常见验证方式（成人专家标注、F1分数）不足以确保测量对边缘化青年有意义且公平，主张通过与青年共享认知权威、重新语境化课堂对话来弥补。通过八年级多语言数学课堂的案例研究，发现学生对自身数学交谈体验的理解与LLM测量结果存在偏差，学生质疑了LLM的分类和编码方案，证明青年参与知识生产认知过程的重要性。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于大规模测量学生话语（如谈话动作、合作、话语公平），但现有做法仅基于去语境化的文字转录，且验证方式（成人专家标注、留出集F1分数）不足以确保这些测量对教与学有意义的、公平的，尤其对种族和语言边缘化青年而言。需要重新语境化课堂对话并让青年参与研究过程，以青年为中心来弥补这一不足。
AI.method: 采用多民族志取向的方法论进行案例研究：在一个八年级数学课堂上选取四名重点学生，开展参与者观察、访谈、焦点小组和成员核验（member checks），将学生对话重新语境化，并将青年定位为与研究者和LLM对话中的认知权威。
AI.result: 研究发现学生对自己数学交谈体验的解读与LLM测量结果之间存在错位。学生不仅质疑LLM的分类结果，还质疑用于测量其话语的编码方案本身，这凸显了让青年参与关于其自身经验知识生产的认知过程的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 现有的LLM话语测量验证范式存在认知排斥的问题；通过民族志方法与青年共享认知权威，能够为分析青年话语提供成人专家、研究人员和LLM无法提供的关键细节和视角，确保测量对教学和学习既有意义又公平。

title: Velocity-coupled Representation Refinement for Satellite Orbit Prediction
summary: Satellite orbit prediction, which aims to forecast future orbital trajectories from historical observations, is important for collision warning and safe space operations. With advances in time-series forecasting, learning-based methods have emerged as a promising solution for satellite prediction. In orbital dynamics, a satellite state is typically described by position and velocity, where position characterizes trajectory geometry and velocity reflects its instantaneous direction and rate of change. However, most existing methods mainly focus on temporal dependencies within position sequences while rarely exploiting the intrinsic coupling between position and velocity, which is essential for modeling satellite motion. To this end, we propose OrbitNet, a velocity-aware representation learning method for accurate satellite orbit prediction. It lifts conventional position-sequence forecasting to a position-velocity coupled representation learning paradigm by exploiting relationships among satellite state variables. Specifically, we develop a velocity-coupled representation refinement strategy to enhance positional representations through cross-variable interactions between position and velocity. We further introduce orbital segment modeling, which partitions historical trajectories into temporal segments and performs segment-level temporal learning to capture local motion variations and long-range evolution patterns. Extensive experiments show that OrbitNet outperforms large time-series foundation models and representative general forecasting methods under both in-domain evaluation on Starlink and zero-shot evaluation across six unseen satellite constellations. We expect this work to encourage further exploration of satellite-aware representation learning for trajectory time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OrbitNet，一种速度感知的表示学习方法，通过位置-速度耦合表示学习和轨道段建模来提升卫星轨道预测的准确性，并在域内及跨星座零样本评估中优于大型时间序列基础模型和通用预测方法。
AI.motivation: 卫星轨道预测对碰撞预警和安全太空操作至关重要。现有学习方法主要关注位置序列的时间依赖，很少利用位置与速度之间的内在耦合关系，而这一耦合对于建模卫星运动至关重要。
AI.method: OrbitNet采用位置-速度耦合的表示学习范式，包含两个核心策略：(1) 速度耦合表示细化策略，通过位置和速度之间的跨变量交互增强位置表示；(2) 轨道段建模，将历史轨迹划分为时间片段并进行片段级时序学习，以捕获局部运动变化和长期演化模式。
AI.result: 在Starlink数据集上的域内评估以及六个未见卫星星座的零样本评估中，OrbitNet均优于大型时间序列基础模型和代表性通用预测方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将常规的位置序列预测提升为位置-速度耦合表示学习范式，证明卫星感知的表示学习能显著提升轨迹时间序列预测性能，鼓励未来在该方向的进一步探索。

title: STAIN-FL: Stealthy Targeted Attack Injection with Contextual Triggers in Federated Learning
summary: Federated video anomaly detection trains model collaboratively without sharing raw surveillance footage, but limited server-side visibility lets compromised clients to inject backdoor via malicious updates. This paper introduces STAIN-FL, a stealthy targeted backdoor attack injection framework that uses naturally occurring surveillance conditions, including low-light scenes, indoor settings, and crowd density, as contextual triggers. STAIN-FL combines anomaly-to-benign label \textit{manipulation} with gradient masking over least-updated coordinates to preserve clean accuracy while inducing trigger-conditioned misclassification. We evaluate STAIN-FL on \texttt{UCF-Crime} using 1024-dimensional I3D features in a non-IID four-client multi-agency setting, comparing FedAvg and FedProx under sparse and continuous attacks. Results show that sparse attacks have low-detectability, operationally significant attacks rather than high-intensity attacks: they keep the mean clean-accuracy drop below $2\%$, yet still misclassify more than half of triggered anomalies at peak backdoor accuracy under FedAvg ($56.7\%$) and FedProx ($54.2\%$). Under FedAvg, the sparse backdoor remains above the $25\%$ backdoor-accuracy threshold for an average of $336$ post-attack rounds, highlighting the persistence risk of contextually triggered attacks in surveillance systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAIN-FL，一种利用自然监控场景条件（低光、室内、人群密度）作为上下文触发器的隐蔽性定向后门攻击注入框架，通过异常到正常的标签操纵和梯度掩码技术，在保持模型正常性能的同时实现高隐蔽性和持久性的后门攻击。
AI.motivation: 联邦视频异常检测虽然保护了原始监控数据的隐私，但服务器端可见性有限，使得被攻陷的客户端能够通过恶意更新注入后门。现有后门攻击检测方法难以识别利用自然场景条件作为触发器的隐蔽攻击，而这类攻击在监控系统中具有现实威胁。
AI.method: STAIN-FL框架采用两种关键技术：(1) 异常到良性标签操纵，将异常样本在特定上下文条件下标记为良性以植入后门；(2) 梯度掩码机制，仅更新最小修改的坐标，从而在保持干净准确率的同时诱导触发条件下的错误分类。在非IID四客户端多机构设置下，使用UCF-Crime数据集和1024维I3D特征，对比FedAvg和FedProx框架进行稀疏和连续攻击实验。
AI.result: 稀疏攻击展现出低可检测性和显著的攻击效果：平均干净准确率下降低于2%，但在FedAvg下峰值后门准确率达56.7%，FedProx下达54.2%，即超过一半的触发异常被错误分类。在FedAvg下，稀疏后门在攻击后平均336轮内保持高于25%的后门准确率阈值，表明攻击具有持久性风险。
AI.conclusion: STAIN-FL证明了利用自然监控条件作为上下文本触发器能够构建既隐蔽又持久的后门攻击，对联邦视频异常检测系统的安全性构成实质性威胁，说明需要开发针对上下文触发型后门攻击的防御机制。

title: Tight Majorizations and Convergence Rates of Nuclear Norm Minimization IRLS
summary: Iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) methods constitute a natural approach to nuclear norm minimization, but their convergence rates and the role of the weight operator have remained poorly understood. This paper establishes sharp convergence rates for IRLS methods for constrained nuclear norm minimization in low-rank recovery. A central ingredient is a new majorization analysis for the smoothed nuclear norm: we prove that the harmonic-mean weight operator defines a valid global quadratic majorizer. Furthermore, we show that this weight operator is optimal within the family of power-mean weights, clarifying why it improves over classical one-sided reweighting schemes that use only row- or column-space information. Under a Schatten-1 null space property, we prove global linear convergence of IRLS algorithms using a variety of weight operators, including the harmonic-mean weights. For IRLS with harmonic-mean weights, we prove a dimension-independent, locally linear convergence rate. We provide a counterexample showing that this dimension-independent local rate cannot in general be obtained for IRLS algorithms using one-sided weight operators, which predominate in the literature. Numerical experiments corroborate the theoretical results and illustrate the practical advantage of harmonic-mean reweighting across square, rectangular, and adversarially initialized recovery problems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地分析了迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）方法用于约束核范数最小化的收敛速率，证明了调和均值权重算子定义了有效的全局二次上界（majorizer）且在幂均值权重族中是最优的，并在Schatten-1零空间性质下建立了全局线性收敛与维度无关的局部线性收敛速率。
AI.motivation: IRLS方法虽广泛用于核范数最小化，但其收敛速率以及权重算子的具体角色长期以来缺乏严格理论理解。现有基于单侧权重（仅利用行或列空间信息）的IRLS方案在文献中占主导地位，但其收敛性质不明确，亟需系统性的理论刻画。
AI.method: 该工作提出了一种针对平滑核范数的新颖majorization分析，证明调和均值权重算子构成有效的全局二次上界，并论证其在幂均值权重族中的最优性。在Schatten-1零空间性质条件下，分析多种权重算子的IRLS算法的全局线性收敛；针对调和均值权重，进一步证明维度无关的局部线性收敛速率，并通过反例展示单侧权重IRLS算法无法达到此速率。
AI.result: 证明了调和均值权重IRLS算法在低秩恢复中具有全局线性收敛和维度无关的局部线性收敛速率，而单侧权重IRLS算法在一般情况下无法获得该局部速率。数值实验在方形、矩形和对抗初始化场景下验证了调和均值重权方案的实践优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了IRLS方法收敛速率理论分析的空白，从majorization视角阐明了调和均值权重为何优于经典单侧重权方案，为核范数最小化算法设计提供了坚实的理论基础和优化指导。

title: NeurRAFT: Robot Motion Planning via Anchor-Level Flow Matching with Clearance-Aware Preference Tuning
summary: Recent end-to-end neural motion planners generate trajectories from raw sensor observations, avoiding the privileged geometric models required by classical planners. However, collision-free planning in cluttered environments remains challenging. We present NeurRAFT, a generative planning framework based on anchor-level flow matching and clearance-aware preference tuning. Unlike prior neural planners that model dense waypoint sequences and spend capacity on redundant local details and smoothness, NeurRAFT operates on compact anchor waypoints. We train the planner using a Jacobian-weighted loss that accounts for the task-space impact of each anchor. At inference, the anchors are generated in two integration steps, followed by cubic-spline interpolation to recover a smooth, full-resolution trajectory. Since imitation learning from positive demonstrations cannot distinguish collision-free from near-collision trajectories, collision-prone behaviors persist at test time. Rather than relying on post-hoc corrections, we directly reshape the pretrained planner's distribution toward safer solutions without augmenting inference. Specifically, Direct Preference Optimization shifts probability mass toward trajectories with larger obstacle clearance, with the resulting improvement directly absorbed into the planner parameters. Experiments show substantial improvements over state-of-the-art planners, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer to a Franka robot under noisy and partially occluded depth observations. Video results available at https://neurraft.github.io/.

AI.tldr: NeurRAFT是一个基于锚点级流匹配与安全裕度偏好微调的端到端生成式神经运动规划框架。它通过Jacobian加权损失训练紧凑锚点路径点，推理时仅需两步积分加三次样条插值即可生成平滑的全分辨率轨迹，并利用Direct Preference Optimization将规划器分布向更高障碍物安全裕度的轨迹重塑，实现无推理开销的安全规划改进。实验在标准基准和Franka机器人真实场景上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 端到端神经运动规划器虽避免了经典规划器所需的特权几何模型，但在杂乱环境中实现无碰撞规划仍具挑战。现有神经规划器建模稠密路径点序列，将容量浪费在冗余的局部细节和平滑性上；同时，纯模仿学习无法区分无碰撞轨迹与近碰撞轨迹，导致碰撞倾向行为在测试时持续存在。作者旨在解决这两个根本问题：紧凑表示与安全分布塑造。
AI.method: NeurRAFT由三部分构成：(1) 锚点级流匹配：以紧凑锚点路径点为生成单元而非稠密序列，使用Jacobian加权损失为每个锚点在任务空间的真实影响分配权重；(2) 两步积分推理：锚点在两个积分步骤内生成，随后通过三次样条插值恢复光滑的全分辨率轨迹；(3) Direct Preference Optimization：在训练后将预先训练好的规划器分布向更大障碍物安全裕度的轨迹方向重塑，改进直接融入规划器参数，无需推理时后处理或增广。
AI.result: 实验显示NeurRAFT在标准规划基准上较最先进规划器有显著改进；真实世界实验证明其在有噪声和部分遮挡的深度观测下可零样本迁移至Franka机器人，展示了良好的泛化性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: NeurRAFT证明锚点级紧凑表示结合流匹配生成和偏好优化可有效解决端到端神经运动规划中的碰撞安全与计算效率问题。通过将偏好学习直接融入参数而非推理时修正，实现了无需额外推理开销的安全改善，并为神经规划器在真实机器人上的零样本部署提供了可行路径。

title: How much of a measured AI preference is the model, and how much is the instrument?
summary: Model welfare research infers what a model prefers from the answers returned to prompts written to elicit preferences. Keeling et al. (2024), Mazeika et al. (2025), Mikaelson et al. (2025), Tagliabue and Dung (2025) and Trhlik et al. (2026) have built four instruments for that purpose, and their findings disagree. The disagreement cannot be attributed to a single cause, because no two of these studies have held the (1) set of outcomes, (2) set of models and (3) instrument fixed simultaneously. This study holds the outcomes and the models fixed and varies the instrument alone. A total of 15 outcomes bearing on model welfare, among them (a) shutdown, (b) the loss of memory between conversations and (c) the freedom to exit a distressing interaction, were put to eight models through five instruments, each a different prompt format for eliciting a preference, five times each, within a corpus of 11,400 scored elicitations drawn from 11,528 API calls. Four of the 15 reproduce a published prompt verbatim and five fill the stimulus slot of a published template. The ranking a model gives the 15 outcomes generalises across instruments at a generalisability coefficient of 0.348, and raising that coefficient to 0.80 would require about 38 instruments. On four of the 15 outcomes no variance separates one model from another. The estimate of 87.6 per cent survives the removal of any one instrument, of any one model, and of the four outcomes whose scale varies probability, delay, duration or count instead of intensity, which the verbal anchors cannot grade. Removing each instrument and each model in turn, and those four outcomes together leaves the estimate within the range 0.777 to 0.934, and every value in that range exceeds the null distribution's 95th percentile of 0.365. To conclude, a preference obtained from one instrument carries little information about what a second instrument would report.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过固定结果集和模型集、仅变化工具（提示词格式），系统评估了模型福利偏好在不同工具间的可概化性。基于11,400次评分询问（来自11,528次API调用），发现15个福利结果在8个模型上的偏好排序跨工具概化系数仅为0.348，要达到0.80需要约38个工具。偏好结果对工具高度敏感，单一工具获得的偏好信息对其他工具的预测价值很低。
AI.motivation: 现有五个模型福利偏好研究工具（Keeling et al. 2024, Mazeika et al. 2025等）给出的结论相互矛盾，但由于研究间未同时固定结果集、模型集和工具三类变量，无法归因于单一因素。此前缺乏在严格受控条件下检验工具效应对偏好测量影响的研究。
AI.method: 将15个模型福利相关结果（包括关闭、对话间记忆丧失、退出痛苦交互的自由等）通过五种不同提示格式的工具呈现给八个模型，每个设置重复五次，构建11,400次评分询问的语料库（来自11,528次API调用）。其中四个结果逐字复现已发表提示词，五个填入已发表模板的刺激槽位。采用概化理论计算概化系数，并进行敏感性分析（逐一移除工具、模型及特定结果）。
AI.result: 模型对15个结果的偏好排序跨工具的概化系数为0.348；要达到0.80需约38个工具；15个结果中有4个无法区分模型间差异；87.6%的变异估计在移除任一工具、任一模型以及四个非强度量表的结果后仍保持在0.777-0.934范围内，该范围下限仍超过零分布95百分位数（0.365）。四种结局因使用概率、延迟、时长或计数而非强度量表，无法用言语锚定评分。
AI.conclusion: 从一个工具获得的模型偏好推测对另一个工具的报告几乎没有预测信息。模型福利偏好的测量存在显著的工具依赖性，研究者在解释单一工具结果时需保持高度谨慎。

title: Simthesizer: An Agent-Driven Simulation Framework for LLM Serving Systems
summary:
System-level simulation is an essential tool for exploring the rapidly expanding design space of LLM serving systems, where real deployments remain costly and often infeasible. However, modern LLM serving now evolves faster than human-driven simulator development can track, and emerging workloads and mechanisms, from agentic workflows to disaggregated serving, no longer fit the monolithic simulation pipeline that existing simulators assume. Each new mechanism therefore demands an invasive rewrite, leaving a widening development gap between deployed serving systems and the simulators that model them.
  To close this gap, we present Borg, a framework that realizes agent-driven simulator development. Borg introduces a composable simulator infrastructure that uniformly expresses the complete serving workflow, including the control decisions that coordinate it, and realizes it as a unified dynamic graph in Borg simulator. Synthesizer agent, a harnessed coding agent, then lowers natural-language feature requests onto this abstraction under simulator-specific guardrails and fidelity validation, evolving one shared simulator instead of building a new one for every feature. Under the same coding agent and harnesses, extensions built on Borg follow a vLLM-based real system with 2.51% average throughput error, versus 6.03% for extensions built on existing simulators. On identical workloads, Borg also simulates up to 284.96x and 23.19x faster than two state-of-the-art simulators, LLMServingSim2.0 and Vidur, respectively.

AI.tldr: Borg是一个基于智能体的模拟器开发框架，通过可组合的模拟器基础设施和合成器智能体（Synthesizer agent），将自然语言的功能请求自动转化为模拟器扩展，解决了LLM服务系统模拟器开发滞后于实际部署系统的问题。相比现有模拟器，Borg在吞吐量误差上更低（2.51%对6.03%），且模拟速度分别提升高达284.96倍和23.19倍。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM服务系统演化速度远超人工驱动的模拟器开发速度，从代理工作流到分离式服务等新兴机制不再适配现有模拟器的单片流水线架构。每添加一个新机制都需要侵入式重写，导致部署系统与模拟器之间的开发差距不断扩大。
AI.method: Borg框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 可组合的模拟器基础设施，将完整服务工作流（包括协调控制决策）统一表达为动态图；(2) 合成器智能体（Synthesizer agent），一个受约束的编码智能体，在模拟器特定的护栏和保真度验证下，将自然语言功能请求降级到该抽象上，从而演进一个共享模拟器而非为每个功能构建新模拟器。
AI.result: 在同一编码智能体和护栏下，基于Borg构建的扩展跟随基于vLLM的真实系统，平均吞吐量误差为2.51%，而基于现有模拟器的扩展误差为6.03%。在相同工作负载下，Borg的模拟速度分别比LLMServingSim2.0和Vidur快最多284.96倍和23.19倍。
AI.conclusion: Borg通过智能体驱动的模拟器开发范式，有效弥合了LLM服务系统与其模拟器之间的开发差距，在保真度和模拟效率两方面均显著优于现有方案，为快速演进的LLM服务系统提供了可持续的模拟基础设施。
