title: SatDL: Jointly Optimizing Data Redistribution and Training for Satellite-Based Distributed Learning
summary:
Satellite-based distributed learning promises to train machine-learning models directly in orbit using massive, globally dispersed sensor data, thereby avoiding large-scale data downloads to ground servers. However, training convergence is significantly slowed by severe non-IID data, specifically label imbalance, as each satellite observes different geographic regions with distinct labels. This imbalance extends training duration and increases energy consumption for solar-powered satellites. Existing approaches either fully redistribute data to enforce IID conditions - accelerating convergence but incurring substantial communication delays - or avoid redistribution entirely by modifying local learning algorithms to mitigate the impact of label imbalance, which, however, still prolong training and increase energy use. Both extremes result in excessive total end-to-end learning time (data-transfer delay plus training time) and thus elevated onboard energy consumption.
  We present SatDL, a data-redistribution framework designed to minimize total end-to-end learning time. At its core, SatDL develops a Distributor-Critic framework that jointly models and optimizes data-transfer delay and training time. Evaluations through trace-driven simulations of a 1,584-satellite Starlink constellation and hardware emulations using NVIDIA Jetson and A100 GPUs across five datasets show SatDL reduces total end-to-end learning time by up to 18.6% and onboard energy consumption by 12.23-88.00%, while maintaining inference accuracy within a few percentage points of state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SatDL，一个面向卫星分布式学习的智能数据重分配框架，通过Distributor-Critic机制联合优化数据传输延迟和训练时间，在1,584颗卫星的Starlink星座仿真和NVIDIA硬件模拟中，将端到端学习时间降低最多18.6%，机载能耗降低12.23%-88.00%，同时推理精度与最先进基线仅相差几个百分点。
AI.motivation: 卫星分布式学习受严重非IID数据（标签不平衡）影响，训练收敛缓慢。现有方法要么通过完全重分配数据强制IID（加速收敛但产生较大通信延迟），要么不改动数据分布仅修改本地学习算法（训练时间仍长、能耗仍高），两种极端都会导致总端到端学习时间（数据传输延迟加训练时间）过长、机载能耗过高。
AI.method: SatDL提出一种数据重分配框架，核心是一个Distributor-Critic框架，将数据传输延迟和训练时间进行联合建模与优化，从而在通信开销与训练加速之间找到最优平衡点。
AI.result: 通过基于1,584颗卫星Starlink星座的轨迹驱动仿真以及NVIDIA Jetson和A100 GPU的硬件模拟（覆盖五个数据集），SatDL将总端到端学习时间最多降低18.6%，机载能耗降低12.23%-88.00%，推理精度与最先进基线相差仅在几个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: SatDL通过数据重分配与联合优化策略，有效缓解了卫星分布式学习中标签不平衡导致的收敛慢和能耗高问题，在保持精度接近基线的前提下显著缩短端到端学习时间并降低能耗。

title: Inter-dimension Dependence for Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Open-Ended Text
summary: LLM-as-a-judge methods are widely used for evaluating the quality of generated open-ended text. Such evaluations are generally multi-dimensional, since the error patterns in texts can be different for different dimensions. Therefore, reliable LLM judges should evaluate each target dimension independently. To quantify the extent to which LLM judges depend on non-target dimensions when evaluating a target dimension, i.e., inter-dimension dependence, we propose CorrGap. To measure this, CorrGap uses the difference in correlations between LLM-predicted scores and ground truth scores across different groups of texts. Using CorrGap, we show that inter-dimension dependence is pervasive across LLM judges in open-ended text evaluation tasks. To mitigate inter-dimension dependence, we propose DimCheck, a method that iteratively removes unrelated evidence from COTs generated by LLM judges in a step-wise way. We show that DimCheck mitigates inter-dimension dependence and outperforms strong baselines across three LLMs and four tasks. We also show that smaller trained LLMs can approximate larger LLMs in DimCheck, with much lower inference costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CorrGap指标来量化LLM-as-a-judge在评估开放文本时跨维度依赖问题，并提出DimCheck方法通过逐步从思维链中移除无关证据来缓解该问题。实验表明该方法在三个LLM和四个任务上优于强基线，且小模型在DimCheck中能以更低推理成本逼近大模型。
AI.motivation: LLM作为评判者被广泛用于评估开放文本质量，但评估通常是多维度的，各维度的错误模式不同，因此可靠评判者应独立评估每个目标维度。然而现有LLM评判者在评估某一维度时可能依赖其他非目标维度的信息，这种跨维度依赖会损害评估可靠性，但缺乏量化手段和缓解方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出CorrGap指标：通过计算LLM预测分数与真实分数之间在不同文本组上的相关性差异来量化跨维度依赖程度。2) 提出DimCheck方法：以逐步方式迭代地从LLM评判者生成的思维链中移除与目标维度无关的证据，从而缓解跨维度依赖。3) 探索使用较小训练好的LLM来近似大模型执行DimCheck，以降低推理成本。
AI.result: 通过CorrGap证实LLM评判者在开放文本评估任务中普遍存在跨维度依赖现象。DimCheck方法能够有效缓解跨维度依赖，并在三个LLM和四个任务上超越强基线。同时，较小的训练模型在DimCheck中可以近似大模型的性能，同时大幅降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-a-judge在开放文本多维度评估中普遍存在跨维度依赖问题，而本文提出的CorrGap能有效量化该问题，DimCheck能有效缓解该问题，且具有良好的成本效益。

title: More Motion Is Not Always Better Motion: Corpus Composition Governs Whether Augmentation Helps SMPL-Based Parkinsonian Gait Severity Estimation
summary: We grade MDS-UPDRS gait severity from SMPL motion using three frozen MotionAGFormer encoders as featurizers, reaching macro-F1 0.58 on a hidden, multi-site test set. Because the system's members differ only in their lifting corpus, evaluating encoders singly on that test set isolates what that corpus contributes. Six pools drawn from one inertial dataset, varying only in which walking tasks they include, score between 0.32 and 0.53, and just one of them beats the 0.51 of an encoder given no outside motion at all. What separates them is not how much data they hold but whether they carry a contrast in walking speed, the variation this representation appears to depend : a further pool adding a third collection site at fixed task composition does worse still. The same rule explains why exact synthetic motion and monocularly reconstructed web video both fail to help. Modifying the learned representation itself, rather than the corpus behind it, cost every variant that attempted it.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用三个冻结的MotionAGFormer编码器从SMPL运动数据中评估MDS-UPDRS步态严重程度，在隐藏多站点测试集上达到macro-F1 0.58。系统成员仅因训练语料不同，通过单独评估编码器可隔离语料贡献。来自单一惯性数据集的六个池（仅行走任务不同）得分在0.32-0.53之间，仅有一个超过无外部运动基线的0.51。决定性能差异的不是数据量，而是是否包含步行速度对比。该规则同样解释了为何精确合成运动和单目重建网络视频均无帮助。修改学到的表示本身而非语料，所有尝试变体均失败。
AI.motivation: 探究步态严重程度分级系统中，训练语料（尤其是惯性数据集）对系统性能的具体贡献，厘清到底是数据规模还是数据内容（如行走任务的速度对比）决定了表示学习的有效性，从而指导数据采集策略。
AI.method: 使用三个冻结的MotionAGFormer编码器作为特征提取器对SMPL运动进行MDS-UPDRS步态严重程度分级；系统成员仅训练语料不同，通过单独评估编码器来隔离语料贡献；从单一惯性数据集构建六个不同行走任务组合的数据池，并与无外部运动基线、合成运动、单目重建视频等多来源语料进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在隐藏多站点测试集上达到macro-F1 0.58；六个数据池得分0.32-0.53，仅一个超过基线0.51；性能差异的关键不是数据量而是是否存在行走速度对比；增加第三个采集站点但固定任务组成反而更差；精确合成运动和单目重建视频均无帮助；修改表示本身的所有变体尝试均失败。
AI.conclusion: 该表示的有效性依赖于训练语料中是否包含行走速度的对比（变化），而非数据规模。速度对比是步态表征学习的关键驱动因素，这解释了为何合成运动和重建视频无效。修改学习表示本身而非数据语料的路线不可行，未来应侧重于在采集策略中引入速度变化。

title: NeuronGuard: Robust LLM Safety Alignment via Ablation-Aware Safety Signal Redistribution
summary: Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs) remains brittle against a growing spectrum of attacks. Jailbreak attacks bypass safety mechanisms through crafted prompts, while neuron-level attacks directly prune safety-critical neurons post-deployment. Both exploit a common weakness: safety-relevant information concentrates in a sparse neuron subset. We present NeuronGuard, a fine-tuning-stage defense that simultaneously hardens LLMs against both attack classes by redistributing safety signals across a broader set of neurons. NeuronGuard dynamically identifies safety-critical neurons via periodically refreshed per-layer linear classifiers, forces refusal behavior under deliberate neuron ablation, and applies KL-divergence regularization for distributional consistency. A randomized gradient projection strategy preserves downstream task utility by resolving conflicts between the defense and task objectives. We provide a formal guarantee that NeuronGuard strictly reduces the attack success rate (ASR) upper bound, and experiments across three LLMs, six state-of-the-art attack strategies, and multimodal settings confirm near-zero ASR while maintaining task accuracy, including against white-box adaptive adversaries.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuronGuard，一种微调阶段的防御方法，通过将安全信号重新分配到更广泛的神经元子集，同时抵御越狱攻击和神经元级攻击，在保持下游任务准确率的同时将攻击成功率降至接近零。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的安全对齐在面对日益增长的攻击面时仍然脆弱。越狱攻击通过精心构造的提示词绕过安全机制，而神经元级攻击在部署后直接剪除安全关键神经元。这两类攻击的共同弱点是安全相关信息集中在稀疏的神经元子集中，因此需要一种同时防御这两种攻击类别的方法。
AI.method: NeuronGuard在微调阶段实现防御，包含三个核心组件：(1) 通过定期刷新的逐层线性分类器动态识别安全关键神经元；(2) 在故意删除神经元的情况下强制拒绝行为；(3) 应用KL散度正则化保证分布一致性。此外，采用随机梯度投影策略解决防御目标与任务目标之间的冲突，从而保持下游任务效用。论文还提供了形式化保证，证明NeuronGuard能严格降低攻击成功率上界。
AI.result: 在三个LLM、六种最先进的攻击策略以及多模态设置下的实验表明，NeuronGuard实现了接近零的攻击成功率，同时保持了任务准确率，且对白盒自适应攻击者同样有效。
AI.conclusion: NeuronGuard通过安全信号再分布策略，为LLM提供了一种同时防御越狱攻击和神经元级攻击的统一防御框架，兼顾了安全性与实用性，并具备形式化的安全保证和强大的鲁棒性。

title: Disentangled Skill Representations for Predictive Human Modeling
summary: Understanding human skill is important for AI systems that collaborate with, coach, or assist people. Unlike typical latent variable estimation problems which rely on single observations, skill is a persistent, compositional, and behaviorally grounded construct that must be inferred from patterns over time. We introduce Skill Abstraction with Interpretable Latents (SAIL), a method for modeling human skill as an interpretable, multi-dimensional construct inferred from naturalistic behavior. Our approach produces a skill embedding that is robust to transient performance fluctuations and learns a transferable representation of human subskills. Furthermore, SAIL supports skill-informed behavior prediction that generalizes across a variety of in-domain contexts. We represent each individual with a persistent skill embedding that controls a blend between expert and novice bases and is trained using counterfactual subskill swaps for disentanglement. This design encourages representations that are both robust to performance variation and structured for interpretability. We demonstrate across racing and baseball that SAIL achieves strong predictive performance and consistently improves behaviorally grounded disentanglement over the evaluated baselines, while also improving downstream AI coaching performance.

AI.tldr: SAIL是一种通过可解释的多维潜在变量建模人类技能的方法，将每个人表示为持久技能嵌入，控制专家与新手的混合基元，并通过反事实子技能交换实现解耦，在赛车和棒球领域取得了优于基线的预测性能和行为解耦效果。
AI.motivation: 人类技能不同于典型的潜在变量估计问题（依赖单一观测），它是一种持久性、组合性和行为根基性的构念，需要从时间模式中推断。现有方法无法有效捕捉技能的这一特性，需要一种能够从自然行为中建模可解释的多维技能的方法。
AI.method: SAIL通过以下核心设计实现：(1) 每个个体表示为持久性技能嵌入，控制专家与新手基元之间的混合；(2) 使用反事实子技能交换进行解耦训练，鼓励表示既对表现波动鲁棒又结构化可解释；(3) 学习可迁移的子技能表示，同时支持技能驱动的行为预测。
AI.result: 在赛车和棒球两个领域的实验表明，SAIL在预测性能上表现强劲，且在行为根基性的解耦指标上持续优于评估基线，同时改进了下游AI教练的表现。
AI.conclusion: SAIL证明了将人类技能建模为持久、可解释、多维度潜变量是可行的，且这种表示不仅有助于行为预测，还能有效支撑AI教练等下游应用，推动了AI系统在协作、指导与辅助人类方面的发展。

title: Design-to-Plan: A Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Manufacturing Process Planning from 3D CAD Models and 2D Engineering Drawings
summary: Manufacturing process planning transforms heterogeneous design information into coherent manufacturing decisions. However, existing approaches focus on isolated subtasks, such as feature recognition, drawing interpretation, or tool selection, and struggle to support the full reasoning chain from design artifacts to process plans. This is critical when planning must interpret 3D CAD models, 2D engineering drawings, materials, and domain-specific rules. To address this gap, this paper presents Design-to-Plan, a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for end-to-end manufacturing process planning. An orchestrator coordinates specialized agents for 3D feature recognition, 2D drawing analysis, 2D-3D context fusion, knowledge retrieval, process sequencing, tool selection, and report generation. Rather than using LLMs as standalone text generators, the framework deploys them as reasoning agents that interact with deterministic modules and knowledge sources to produce consistent and traceable decisions. In this hybrid design, deterministic modules and specialized agents extract structured information from CAD and drawing inputs, while LLM agents perform context-aware reasoning, retrieve manufacturing rules, resolve conflicts, and generate planning outputs. The framework is evaluated using 300 benchmark cases across three downstream ReAct-enabled agents, plus separate evaluations of CAD feature recognition, drawing analysis, and 2D-3D context fusion. The parallel architecture achieves 100% success across downstream agents, Tool F1 scores of 95.9%-97.6%, 90% source detection accuracy in conflict analysis, and a 60%-68% reduction in token usage for key planning tasks. Results show that structured LLM-based multi-agent coordination can bridge design representations and manufacturing knowledge, enabling scalable, efficient, and traceable design-to-plan automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Design-to-Plan，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，用于端到端制造工艺规划。该框架通过编排器协调7个专业智能体，采用LLM推理智能体与确定性模块混合的设计，从3D CAD模型和2D工程图纸中提取结构化信息并进行上下文感知推理。在300个基准案例上，下游智能体100%成功，Tool F1达95.9%-97.6%，冲突分析源检测准确率90%，关键规划任务token使用量减少60%-68%。
AI.motivation: 现有制造工艺规划方法仅关注孤立子任务（如特征识别、图纸解读或刀具选择），无法支持从设计产物到工艺规划的完整推理链。当规划需要同时解读3D CAD模型、2D工程图纸、材料和领域特定规则时，这一缺口尤为关键。作者旨在弥合设计表征与制造知识之间的鸿沟，实现端到端的自动化规划。
AI.method: 提出Design-to-Plan框架：由一个编排器协调7个专业智能体（3D特征识别、2D图纸分析、2D-3D上下文融合、知识检索、工艺排序、刀具选择、报告生成）。框架采用混合设计——确定性模块和专用智能体从CAD和图纸输入中提取结构化信息，LLM智能体则作为推理代理执行上下文感知推理、检索制造规则、解决冲突并生成规划输出。评估使用300个基准案例，涉及三个下游ReAct智能体，以及CAD特征识别、图纸分析和2D-3D上下文融合的单独评估。
AI.result: 并行架构在下游智能体上实现100%成功，Tool F1得分95.9%-97.6%，冲突分析中源检测准确率90%，关键规划任务token使用量减少60%-68%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的基于LLM的多智能体协调能够弥合设计表征与制造知识之间的鸿沟，实现可扩展、高效且可追溯的设计到工艺规划自动化，证明LLM不应仅作为独立文本生成器使用，而应作为与确定性模块交互的推理智能体部署。

title: AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop
summary: AI agents pose significant risks as they are granted increasing autonomy. A commonly proposed solution is human oversight and keeping a ''human in the loop'', but this is not a simple solution: Not only do current approaches to AI agent design impede effective human oversight, but the cognitive capacities required for it are also themselves degraded by extended use of AI systems. This position paper argues that current approaches to the development and deployment of AI agent systems do not support effective human oversight -- they contribute to its degradation. To address this, a top priority in the advancement of AI agents should be supporting the situated goals and cognitive requirements of effective human oversight, treating the human needs of overseers at the same level of importance as AI agent capability. To put this idea into practice, we connect work on automation and human-computer interaction to AI agent processes, outlining design-level affordances and organizational protocols that (1) support overseers in exercising critical judgement and (2) counteract the skill atrophy that arises from extended use of automation. We urge developers and deployers to adopt these or similar approaches. Without explicit support for the cognitive demands of effective human-agent interaction, AI agent systems will continue to passively incentivize the degradation of the very human skills they rely on.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张当前AI智能体系统的开发与部署方式不支持有效的人类监督，反而会导致监督所需认知能力的退化。作者呼吁将人类监督者的认知需求与AI智能体能力置于同等优先级，并提出设计层面的可供性和组织协议来支持监督者行使批判性判断并抵消技能萎缩。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体被赋予越来越多的自主性，它们带来了显著风险。虽然"人在环路"（human in the loop）常被提议作为解决方案，但作者指出这并非简单方案：当前AI智能体的设计方式阻碍了有效的人类监督，而监督所需的认知能力本身也会因长期使用AI系统而退化。这一矛盾凸显了需要重新审视AI智能体开发优先级的紧迫性。
AI.method: 作为一篇立场论文，作者并未提出新算法或实验，而是：（1）论证当前AI智能体系统设计如何阻碍人类监督并导致监督者认知能力退化；（2）将自动化与人机交互领域的研究成果与AI智能体流程相连接；（3）提出设计层面的可供性（affordances）和组织协议，具体支持监督者行使批判性判断并抵消因长期使用自动化而产生的技能萎缩。
AI.result: 论文提出了一套面向AI智能体系统的人类监督支持框架，包括设计可供性和组织协议两个层面的具体建议，旨在使监督者的认知需求与智能体能力同等重要。作者呼吁开发者和部署者采纳这些或类似的方法。
AI.conclusion: 如果不对有效人机交互的认知需求给予明确支持，AI智能体系统将持续被动地激励其所依赖的人类技能的退化。将人类监督者的认知需求作为AI智能体发展的首要优先级，是解决这一问题的关键方向。

title: Maia 200: A Software Defined Dataflow System for Large-scale AI Acceleration
summary: We introduce Maia 200, an advanced AI accelerator delivering high performance-10 145 Tflop/s FP4 and 5072 Tflop/s FP8 within a 750W TDP and 7 TB/s HBM bandwidth. Maia exemplifies a new class of Software Defined Locally Accessed Dataflow Architectures (SDLA), which explicitly program dataflow engines to orchestrate highly specialized memories and data movement engines. This approach shifts the focus from today's thread-centric to data-movement-centric architecture, improving efficiency and scalability. Our taxonomy of data management, inspired by Flynn's classification, highlights how SDLA addresses challenges in modern AI computing. Maia 200 achieves significant cost and energy savings while supporting massive parallelism for AI inference workloads, making it a compelling solution for next-generation high-performance computing systems.

AI.tldr: Maia 200是一种先进的AI加速器，提供145 Tflop/s FP4和5072 Tflop/s FP8的高性能，在750W TDP和7 TB/s HBM带宽下运行。它代表了一类新型的软件定义本地访问数据流架构（SDLA），通过显式编程数据流引擎来编排高度专业化的存储器和数据移动引擎，将计算架构从线程中心转向数据移动中心。
AI.motivation: 现代AI计算的效率和可扩展性面临挑战，传统的线程中心型架构在处理数据密集型AI工作负载时存在瓶颈。作者提出SDLA架构，旨在通过数据移动中心的方法解决这些问题，实现更高的效率、可扩展性以及成本和能耗节约。
AI.method: 提出SDLA（软件定义本地访问数据流架构）类别，该架构显式编程数据流引擎以编排专业化存储器和数据移动引擎。作者借鉴Flynn分类学思想，建立了一个数据管理分类体系，用以说明SDLA如何应对现代AI计算的挑战。Maia 200是该架构的具体实现，采用FP4/FP8精度支持AI推理工作负载的海量并行。
AI.result: Maia 200在750W TDP内实现145 Tflop/s FP4和5072 Tflop/s FP8性能，配备7 TB/s HBM带宽。该加速器在支持大规模AI推理并行性的同时，实现了显著的成本和能耗节约。
AI.conclusion: Maia 200作为SDLA架构的具体验证，证明了数据移动中心型架构在大规模AI推理中的有效性，为下一代高性能计算系统提供了有竞争力的解决方案。

title: Scalable datacenter replication with mostly-synchronous consensus on hardware
summary: Consistent replication of data among distributed processes -- a task involving the well-known consensus problem -- is notoriously expensive and hard to scale, affecting especially datacenter services with stringent performance requirements. To mitigate this problem, we introduce scalable replication in-hardware ( scarHW ): a network card design that improves throughput and latency of consistent replication even when increasing the number of replicas, whereas current systems operate at a small scale or with relaxed consistency guarantees. At the heart of scarHW is our novel POPUC consensus algorithm, implemented in an FPGA smartNIC to take full advantage of the "mostly synchronous" behavior of programmable network devices in the datacenter. Unlike widely-adopted "mostly asynchronous" coordination protocols such as Paxos or leaderless alternatives, POPUC implements a generalized variant of consensus dubbed collaborative consensus which allows for several simultaneous decisions, achieving great scalability without compromising availability. POPUC preserves safety guarantees in the presence of process crash-stop and message send/receive omission failures (capturing incidental asynchrony) and has been formally specified and verified in TLA+. Our FPGA prototype improves throughput and latency of widely-used services Redis and Zookeeper by up to two orders of magnitude compared to the state of the art. scarHW-based services also achieve zero downtime upon failure of a minority of replicas, offering a highly-robust, wire-speed, scalable replication system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 scarHW，一种基于 FPGA 智能网卡的可扩展硬件复制系统。其核心是新型 POPUC 共识算法，利用可编程网络设备的"几乎同步"特性实现协作式共识，允许多个决策同时进行，在增加副本数量时仍能提升吞吐量和延迟，相比现有系统（Paxos 等）性能提升最多两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 分布式进程中一致复制依赖的共识问题成本高昂且难以扩展，尤其影响数据中心中对性能要求苛刻的服务。现有系统要么规模受限，要么牺牲一致性保证，缺乏同时兼顾可扩展性、性能和强一致性的方案。
AI.method: 设计 scarHW 网卡架构，核心为在 FPGA 智能网卡上实现的 POPUC 共识算法。POPUC 采用"协作式共识"（collaborative consensus）这一广义共识变体，利用可编程网络设备在数据中心中"几乎同步"的行为特性，允许多个决策并发进行。算法在进程崩溃-停止及消息漏发/漏收故障（捕获偶发异步性）下仍保证安全性，并已用 TLA+ 形式化验证。
AI.result: FPGA 原型在 Redis 和 Zookeeper 等广泛使用的服务上，吞吐量和延迟相比现有最优技术提升最多两个数量级。基于 scarHW 的服务在少数副本故障时实现零停机，提供高鲁棒性、线速、可扩展的复制系统。
AI.conclusion: scarHW 证明了将共识算法卸载到可编程硬件（智能网卡）是解决一致复制可扩展性瓶颈的有效途径，为数据中心高一致性服务提供了兼顾性能、可扩展性和可用性的全新方案。

title: Giga-Embeddings: Mixture-of-Experts Encoders for High-Throughput Text Embeddings
summary: We introduce Giga-Embeddings, a family of text embedding models designed to combine strong retrieval quality with efficient serving. Its largest member is a sparse 10B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts encoder with approximately 1.8B active parameters per token. Across English, Russian, multilingual, and code MTEB benchmarks, this model achieves the strongest aggregate performance within the family on all four evaluated suites. In our vLLM benchmark with 1024-token inputs, it processes 114.5k tokens per second, providing 25 percent higher throughput than the dense 3B model and 1.56-2.65x the throughput of the evaluated external systems. The family also includes a dense 3B encoder and a distilled 480M encoder for tighter compute and memory budgets. We train the compact model using a dimension-agnostic objective that aligns teacher and student similarity distributions. The resulting 480M model scores 70.98 on Russian MTEB, surpassing FRIDA while using 42 percent fewer parameters. We release all three model checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Giga-Embeddings文本嵌入模型族，包含稀疏10B参数MoE编码器（约1.8B活跃参数）、稠密3B编码器和蒸馏480M编码器。最大模型在英、俄、多语言和代码MTEB基准上均取得家族最强性能，且在vLLM基准下达到114.5k tokens/s吞吐量。480M蒸馏模型在俄语MTEB上以70.98分超越FRIDA，参数减少42%。所有三个模型检查点均已开源。
AI.motivation: 当前的文本嵌入模型往往难以兼顾检索质量与服务效率，需要一种既能保持强检索性能又能在推理时高效服务的模型方案。
AI.method: 采用Mixture-of-Experts架构的稀疏10B参数编码器（约1.8B活跃参数/token）作为最大成员；同时提供稠密3B编码器和蒸馏480M编码器。紧凑模型使用维度无关的目标函数来对齐教师与学生模型的相似度分布。
AI.result: 最大模型在四个MTEB基准（英语、俄语、多语言、代码）上均取得家族内最强聚合性能；在vLLM基准（1024-token输入）下吞吐量达114.5k tokens/s，比稠密3B模型高25%，比外部系统高1.56-2.65倍。480M模型在俄语MTEB上达70.98分，超越FRIDA且参数减少42%。
AI.conclusion: Giga-Embeddings展示了通过MoE稀疏化与知识蒸馏，可以在不牺牲检索质量的前提下显著提升嵌入模型的服务吞吐量，为不同计算预算提供了可扩展的模型家族选择。

title: CRISP: Calibration-Aware Visual State Space Duality for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 22 pages, including supplementary material; 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/crazylifeha/CRISP
summary: State space models, especially Visual State Space Duality (VSSD), have emerged as efficient linear-time alternatives to Transformers for dense visual tasks. However, we observe that VSSD compresses spatial context into a global aggregation that suppresses high-frequency responses, causing excessive boundary smoothing in remote sensing semantic segmentation. To address this, we propose CRISP, a calibration framework with two components. Its core, the Duality Calibration Operator (DCO), restores local contrast and boundary responses through residual injection and frequency calibration within the VSSD backbone, without altering its linear complexity. To retain the recovered detail, an Orthogonal Multi-Prototype (OMP) head assigns multiple orthogonally constrained prototypes per class to model large intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on Potsdam, Vaihingen, and LoveDA show that, with approximately 30M parameters, CRISP achieves consistent gains in mean F1 (mF) and mIoU while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/crazylifeha/CRISP.

AI.tldr: CRISP是一个针对视觉状态空间对偶（VSSD）模型的校准框架，通过双重校准算子（DCO）和正交多原型（OMP）分类头，解决VSSD在遥感语义分割中因全局聚合导致的高频响应抑制和边界过度平滑问题，在约30M参数下取得一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: VSSD虽然作为Transformer的线性时间高效替代方案在密集视觉任务中表现优异，但其将空间上下文压缩为全局聚合的方式会抑制高频响应，导致遥感语义分割中边界过度平滑，影响分割精度。
AI.method: 提出CRISP校准框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 双重校准算子（DCO），通过在VSSD骨干网络内进行残差注入和频率校准来恢复局部对比度和边界响应，且不改变原有的线性复杂度；(2) 正交多原型（OMP）分类头，为每个类别分配多个正交约束的原型以建模较大的类内方差，从而保留恢复的细节信息。
AI.result: 在Potsdam、Vaihingen和LoveDA三个遥感数据集上的大量实验表明，CRISP在约30M参数下，在平均F1（mF）和mIoU指标上均取得一致的性能提升，并与最先进方法保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CRISP有效缓解了VSSD在遥感语义分割中的边界平滑问题，通过轻量级的校准机制在保持线性复杂度优势的同时提升了分割精度，代码已开源。

title: RAGSentinel: Certifiable Geometric Consensus for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in external documents, but it also exposes a critical security vulnerability: adversarial documents injected into the knowledge database can enter the context window and steer the model toward targeted incorrect answers. Existing post-retrieval defenses rely on instruction following, parametric knowledge, or text-level consistency, all of which can be imitated or optimized against by adaptive attackers. We propose RAGSentinel, a training-free, label-free defense for black-box RAG systems. RAGSentinel uses a surrogate encoder to measure query-conditioned hidden-state shifts induced by retrieved documents, removes shared topic directions, and filters poisoned documents as geometric outliers from a robust majority consensus. We prove that, under an honest-majority assumption and a representation-level separation condition, RAGSentinel exactly recovers a poison-free majority-sized context. Experiments across three question-answering datasets, three LLM families, and multiple poisoning attacks show that RAGSentinel consistently achieves low attack success rates while preserving competitive accuracy and remaining effective against adaptive attacks with full pipeline knowledge.

AI.tldr: RAGSentinel是一种针对RAG系统对抗性文档注入攻击的训练-free、标签-free防御方法，通过代理编码器测量查询条件下隐藏状态偏移，去除共享主题方向，并将有毒文档识别为几何离群点过滤掉。实验证明其在三个QA数据集、三个LLM家族和多种投毒攻击下保持低攻击成功率且不损害准确性。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）虽然通过外部文档提升了大语言模型的事实性，但也引入了严重的安全漏洞：攻击者可以向知识库注入对抗性文档，这些文档进入上下文窗口后会诱导模型输出错误答案。现有post-retrieval防御方法依赖指令遵循、参数化知识或文本级一致性，但这些方法都可以被自适应攻击者模仿或优化绕过，因此亟需一种对自适应攻击鲁棒的防御方案。
AI.method: RAGSentinel采用无训练、无标签的防御策略，适用于黑盒RAG系统。其核心机制包括：(1) 使用代理编码器度量查询条件下检索文档引发的隐藏状态偏移；(2) 移除文档间共享的主题方向以避免误判；(3) 利用鲁棒多数共识将中毒文档视为几何离群点进行过滤。作者还提供了理论保证：在诚实多数假设和表示层分离条件下，RAGSentinel能够精确恢复无毒的多数规模上下文。
AI.result: 在三个问答数据集、三个LLM家族及多种投毒攻击设置下，RAGSentinel一致地实现了低攻击成功率，同时保持了具有竞争力的准确性。即使在攻击者拥有完整pipeline知识的自适应攻击场景下，该方法仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: RAGSentinel通过基于表示几何的离群点检测，为黑盒RAG系统提供了一种无需训练、无需额外数据的鲁棒防御方案，在理论和实验两个层面验证了其有效性，为RAG安全研究提供了一个新的防御范式。

title: GAP-Prompt: Gated Adaptive Prompting for Efficient Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning faces the persistent challenge of catastrophic forgetting, where sequential task updates degrade previously acquired knowledge. While prompt-based methods integrated with pre-trained models offer a compelling solution by freezing the backbone, they often rely on static, task-level prompting strategies that overlook fine-grained intra-task diversity. In this paper, we propose Gated Adaptive Prompting (GAP-Prompt), a novel method that introduces instance-level adaptability to the prompting process. GAP-Prompt consists of three synergistic modules: (1) instance-conditioned gating, which dynamically determines optimal prompt injection layers for each individual image; (2) dynamic knowledge fusion, which performs instance-aware aggregation of current and historical prompts, enabling knowledge integration across tasks; and (3) shared prompt distillation, which anchors foundational knowledge in early shared layers to mitigate forgetting. Extensive evaluations on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 benchmarks demonstrate that GAP-Prompt consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, on the fine-grained CUB-200 dataset, GAP-Prompt reaches 87.29% accuracy, approaching the joint training upper bound (88.00%) and outperforming existing methods by a significant margin.

AI.tldr: 提出GAP-Prompt方法，通过实例级自适应的门控提示机制解决持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R和CUB-200基准上达到SOTA性能，在CUB-200上接近联合训练上界。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于提示（prompt）的持续学习方法通常采用静态的任务级提示策略，忽视了任务内部细粒度的实例多样性，导致对单个样本的适应性不足，限制了模型性能。
AI.method: 提出三个协同模块：(1) 实例条件门控（instance-conditioned gating），为每张图片动态决定最优的提示注入层；(2) 动态知识融合（dynamic knowledge fusion），对当前和历史提示进行实例感知的聚合，实现跨任务知识整合；(3) 共享提示蒸馏（shared prompt distillation），在早期共享层锚定基础性知识以缓解遗忘。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R和CUB-200三个基准上持续取得SOTA性能。在细粒度CUB-200数据集上达到87.29%准确率，接近联合训练上界（88.00%），显著超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 实例级自适应的提示机制能有效超越任务级静态提示策略，通过门控、知识融合和蒸馏三个模块的协同作用，在保留旧知识的同时增强新任务的适应能力，尤其对细粒度分类任务效果显著。

title: Hierarchical Skill Retrieval for Data-Efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pretrained on large-scale robot datasets provide a strong foundation for robot manipulation, their performance can degrade when adapted to new tasks with limited task-specific demonstrations. Retrieval offers a practical way to reuse existing demonstrations for data-efficient adaptation, but existing methods often rely on visual similarity, state-action representations, or task-level language matching. These approaches may overlook the hierarchical structure of long-horizon manipulation tasks, where complete task matches are rare but reusable skills are often abundant. To address this challenge, we propose Hierarchical Skill Retrieval (HSR), a retrieval framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Specifically, HSR first decomposes a target task into candidate skill sequences. It evaluates each plan based on both semantic plausibility and skill reliability estimated from the prior dataset. The selected decomposition is then used for hybrid retrieval. This combines subtask-level language retrieval with behavior-feature reranking to identify demonstrations that are both semantically relevant and compatible with the target task. Finally, we adapt the policy through a two-stage pretraining and finetuning pipeline, which separates general skill acquisition from task-specific adaptation. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark and several real-world robot manipulation tasks show that HSR improves the average success rate by 10.3% and 21.3% over the strongest baseline, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of structured skill-level retrieval for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Videos and code are available at https://hoar012.github.io/HSR-Project.

AI.tldr: 提出了层级技能检索（HSR）框架，用于数据高效的VLA模型自适应。HSR将目标任务分解为候选技能序列，基于语义合理性和技能可靠性评估选择最佳分解，随后通过结合子任务级语言检索与行为特征重排序的混合检索来选取示范数据，最后通过两阶段预训练和微调管线实现策略自适应。在LIBERO基准和真实机器人操作任务上，分别比最强基线平均成功率提升10.3%和21.3%。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练的VLA模型在适应新任务且仅有少量任务特定示范时性能会下降。检索提供了一种数据高效的自适应途径，但现有方法主要依赖视觉相似性、状态-动作表示或任务级语言匹配，忽略了长时序操作任务的层级结构——完整的任务匹配很少，但可复用的技能子序列往往很丰富。
AI.method: HSR框架包含三个关键环节：(1) 将目标任务分解为候选技能序列，并基于语义合理性和从先验数据集估计的技能可靠性进行评估；(2) 混合检索策略，结合子任务级语言检索与行为特征重排序，筛选既语义相关又与目标任务兼容的示范；(3) 两阶段预训练与微调管线，将通用技能获取与任务特定自适应分离。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上平均成功率比最强基线提升10.3%，在多个真实世界机器人操作任务上提升21.3%，验证了结构化技能级检索对数据高效VLA自适应的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 层级技能检索通过利用长时序任务中可复用的技能结构，显著提升了VLA模型在有限示范数据下的自适应性能，为数据高效的机器人操作策略提供了一种有效的检索框架。

title: FLARE: A Systematic, Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Evidence-Based Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being introduced into healthcare workflows, yet most evaluations emphasize model accuracy rather than whether adoption is economically worthwhile in real clinical settings. This study proposes FLARE, a systematic and uncertainty-aware framework for evaluating the financial and operational implications of adopting AI in healthcare. FLARE combines fuzzy logic, time-driven activity-based costing, and return on investment analysis to estimate the cost of clinical service delivery, the cost of AI development and operation, and the economic consequences of workflow integration under uncertainty. The framework was demonstrated through an early health technology assessment case study of AI-assisted large vessel occlusion detection in the CT stroke pathway for acute ischemic stroke. The case study shows how FLARE can quantify conventional pathway cost, AI-related development and recurring costs, and AI-enabled service savings within a unified activity-based model. Under expected assumptions, the analysis identified a break-even threshold of approximately 3,992 patients per year, with positive first-year return on investment at typical annual stroke volumes of about 5,000 patients. The results further show that economic benefit depends not only on algorithmic performance, but also on patient volume, verification time, infrastructure choices, and workflow design. FLARE provides a transparent and practical decision-support framework for early-stage evaluation of AI adoption in healthcare. By making uncertainty, resource use, and implementation trade-offs explicit, it helps clinicians, administrators, and policymakers determine when AI deployment is economically viable and where operational changes may improve value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLARE，一个基于模糊逻辑、时间驱动的作业成本法和投资回报分析的系统性不确定性感知评估框架，用于评估AI在医疗保健中采用的经济可行性和运营影响，并通过CT卒中路径中大血管闭塞检测案例证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI医疗评估大多仅关注模型准确度，而忽视了AI在实际临床环境中采用是否具有经济价值这一关键问题。缺乏系统性的框架来评估AI采用的财务和运营影响。
AI.method: FLARE框架结合模糊逻辑（处理不确定性）、时间驱动的作业成本法（TDABC，估算临床服务交付成本）和投资回报分析（ROI），在一个统一的基于活动的模型中估算常规临床路径成本、AI开发及运营成本，以及AI赋能后的服务节约。通过急性缺血性卒中CT路径中AI辅助大血管闭塞检测的早期卫生技术评估（eHTA）案例进行验证。
AI.result: 在预期假设下，分析确定了约每年3,992名患者的盈亏平衡阈值，在典型年卒中量约5,000名患者时实现首个正年度投资回报。同时发现经济收益不仅取决于算法性能，还受患者量、验证时间、基础设施选择和流程设计影响。
AI.conclusion: FLARE为医疗AI采用提供了透明、实用的早期阶段决策支持框架，通过显式呈现不确定性、资源使用和实施权衡，帮助临床医生、管理者和政策制定者判断AI部署的经济可行性并识别改善价值的运营改进方向。

title: Asynchronous Verifiable Information Dispersal with Low Space and Communication Complexity
summary:
The primary goal of a distributed storage system is to ensure that clients can both write and read data in a reliable and consistent manner, even in the presence of failures. While existing asynchronous verifiable information dispersal (AVID) protocols achieve optimal space complexity for storage and communication complexity for data retrieval in a Byzantine setting, the crucial operations of data dispersal and node recovery have received less attention.
  We propose an efficient AVID protocol that simultaneously guarantees low complexities for dispersal, storage, retrieval, and recovery. At the core of the proposed protocol lies a novel mechanism to encode data in a two-dimensional matrix and a bespoke dispersal algorithm. The protocol maintains an optimal communication complexity for retrieval while substantially improving upon the state of the art for recovery. Additionally, we describe how the protocol can be modified in order to reduce the space complexity and the communication complexity for dispersal, at the expense of a higher communication complexity for retrieval and recovery. As the proposed protocols strike a balance across all considered metrics, they are suitable for a broad range of real-world use cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的异步可验证信息分发（AVID）协议，通过二维矩阵编码和定制分发算法，在存储、分发、检索和恢复四个维度上同时实现低复杂度，其中检索复杂度达到最优，恢复复杂度显著优于现有方法，并可灵活调整以在不同指标间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的异步可验证信息分发（AVID）协议虽然在拜占庭环境下实现了存储空间复杂度和数据检索通信复杂度的最优性，但数据分发和节点恢复这两个关键操作的效率没有得到充分关注，缺乏在所有指标上同时高效的协议。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的二维矩阵数据编码机制和定制化的分发算法。协议在保持检索通信复杂度最优的同时显著改进恢复复杂度；此外，通过协议变体可在牺牲检索和恢复通信复杂度的代价下，进一步降低空间复杂度和分发通信复杂度。
AI.result: 协议在分发、存储、检索、恢复四个维度上同时保证低复杂度，其中检索通信复杂度达到最优，恢复复杂度大幅优于现有最优方案；变体协议还可实现更低的空间复杂度和分发通信复杂度，但检索和恢复复杂度有所增加。
AI.conclusion: 所提协议在所有考虑的性能指标间取得了良好的平衡，能够适应广泛的真实世界分布式存储应用场景。

title: From Preferences to Principles: Rubric-Based Alignment for Grounded Knowledge Answers
summary: Designing effective reward signals for open-domain question answering is challenging because high-quality responses must simultaneously satisfy multiple aspects of answer quality that are difficult to capture with a holistic scalar objective. We introduce a rubric-based reward framework that generates query-specific rubrics grounded in retrieved evidence and decomposed into multiple quality dimensions, providing fine-grained supervision during post-training. Averaged across three evaluation axes (composition, grounding, and instruction-following), our approach improves over the instruction-tuned baseline by 6.5% and over flat rubric variants by 4%, with consistent gains across all evaluation datasets. Conditioning rubrics on retrieved evidence improves factual support, while decomposing rubrics into quality-specific dimensions further improves coherence, organization, and adherence to query requirements. Our results show that grounded, multi-dimensional rubrics provide more effective reward supervision for complex open-domain question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于评分细则（rubric）的奖励框架，为开放域问答生成查询特定的、基于检索证据且分解为多个质量维度的评分标准，在后训练阶段提供细粒度监督，改善效果优于指令微调基线和扁平评分细则变体。
AI.motivation: 开放域问答的高质量回答需要同时满足多个方面的质量要求，而单一的整体标量奖励目标难以捕捉这些多维度的质量特征，导致有效的奖励信号设计充满挑战。
AI.method: 提出rubric-based奖励框架：生成查询特定的评分细则，它基于检索到的证据作为依据，并将回答质量分解为多个维度（如构成、接地性、指令遵循），在后训练阶段提供细粒度的监督信号。
AI.result: 在三个评估轴（构成、接地性和指令遵循）上，该方法相比指令微调基线提升6.5%，相比扁平评分细则变体提升4%，且在所有评估数据集上保持一致的性能增益。基于检索证据的评分细则增强了事实支撑，分解为质量特定维度的评分细则则进一步改善了连贯性、组织性和查询要求遵循度。
AI.conclusion: 基于证据且多维分解的评分细则为复杂开放域问答提供了更有效的奖励监督信号。

title: Too much of a good thing -- when knowledge distillation promotes overfitting, and how to avoid it
summary: The growing size of Convolutional Neural Networks has led to increasingly large and costly models. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large network (teacher) to a small one (student), also reducing the training data required. KD is traditionally applied only at the network's final output. However, its behaviour when applied at intermediate network layers has received little attention. This raises the question of whether intermediate block-wise KD, which provides supervision throughout the network, could offer an advantage under specific conditions, such as few instances per class, which is common in fine-grained datasets. This work proposes a student design based on simple, homogeneous blocks mirroring those of the teacher, distilling knowledge between corresponding blocks. Across eleven datasets, we show that on classic datasets, distilling only the last block is sufficient -- and often best--, whereas fine-grained, data-scarce settings benefit substantially from intermediate supervision, with even a single additional distillation point narrowing the gap considerably. We further study how this supervision should be guided, exploring configurations of varying granularity and informed by an explainability analysis based on attention maps, Centered Kernel Alignment, and Grad-CAM, alongside the impact of teacher and student fine-tuning strategies. This work shows that intermediate block-wise distillation, guided appropriately, is key to building compact data-efficient models without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中间层分块知识蒸馏的效用，提出一种学生网络设计（与教师网络使用相同的同质块），在对应块之间进行知识蒸馏。结果表明：在经典数据集上只需蒸馏最后一个块即可达到最佳效果；而在细粒度、数据稀缺场景下，中间层监督能显著提升性能，即使仅增加一个蒸馏点也能大幅缩小差距。研究还结合注意力图、CKA、Grad-CAM等可解释性分析探讨了监督的引导方式。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏（KD）传统上只应用于网络最终输出层，中间层分块蒸馏的行为很少被研究。作者质疑在特定条件下（如每类样本很少的细粒度数据集），通过对网络各层提供监督的中间分块蒸馏是否能带来优势，从而提升紧凑模型的效率与精度。
AI.method: 提出一种基于简单同质块的学生网络设计，其块结构与教师网络对应；在教师与学生的对应块之间执行分块知识蒸馏。在11个数据集上进行实验，对比仅蒸馏最后一层与多中间层蒸馏的效果；并通过注意力图、Centered Kernel Alignment（CKA）、Grad-CAM等可解释性分析以及教师/学生的微调策略研究来探索监督的粒度与引导方式。
AI.result: 在经典数据集上，仅蒸馏最后一块就足够且往往最佳；而在细粒度、数据稀缺的数据集上，中间层监督带来显著收益，即使只增加一个蒸馏点也能大幅缩小与全监督的差距。中间分块蒸馏在正确引导下能构建紧凑且数据高效的模型，不牺牲准确率。
AI.conclusion: 中间分块蒸馏并非普遍优于传统KD，其价值取决于数据场景：在数据充分时，最终层蒸馏已足够；在细粒度、少样本条件下，中间层监督是关键。正确地引导中间层监督（通过可解释性分析指导粒度配置）是在保持模型紧凑的同时提升数据效率的关键。

title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents
summary: The emerging W3C WebMCP proposal enables LLM agents to invoke tools exposed by web pages. In multi-party web environments, however, integrating agent execution into a browser security model centered on the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) leaves insufficient provenance and lifecycle guarantees for agent-accessible tools, creating three risks: subject-attribution spoofing, uncontrolled tool lifecycles, and semantic prompt injection. We propose WebMCP-Phalanx, a dual-layer agent runtime architecture. Its first layer provides a browser-native trust anchor that binds each tool to its registering principal through cryptographically protected capability credentials and propagates provenance labels throughout the tool lifecycle. Its second layer separates semantic inspection from privileged tool use. A Quarantine Agent (Q-LLM), without tool invocation authority, inspects tool metadata, outputs, and page-supplied content for prompt injection. Validated content is then forwarded to a Privileged Agent (P-LLM) for execution, while the Q-LLM's internal state remains hidden from page scripts. Empirical evaluation shows that the browser-native ownership mechanism reduces revocation and overwrite attack success from 100\% to 0\%. The dual-agent runtime blocks all 80 prompt-injection attempts embedded in tool descriptions and limits tool-return attacks to 2 successful cases out of 80. Across experiments, task utility remains statistically indistinguishable from the no-attack baseline. Under a white-box adaptive attacker, however, description-based filtering can be bypassed through malicious tool names invoked before inspection. This finding motivates a call-timing gate that delays tool invocation until all agent-visible tool metadata has been validated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WebMCP-Phalanx，一种面向多方可信Web环境下LLM代理工具调用的双层运行时安全架构。第一层通过浏览器原生信任锚，利用加密能力凭证将工具绑定到注册主体并在工具生命周期中传播来源标签；第二层通过无工具调用权限的Q-LLM进行语义检查、分离检查与特权执行。实验表明所有权机制将撤销和覆盖攻击成功率从100%降至0%，双代理运行时拦截全部80次基于工具描述的提示注入攻击。
AI.motivation: W3C WebMCP提案允许LLM代理调用网页暴露的工具，但在多方可信Web环境中，将代理执行集成到以同源策略为核心的浏览器安全模型中，对代理可访问工具缺乏足够的来源和生命周期保障，带来三类风险：主体归属欺骗、工具生命周期失控和语义提示注入。
AI.method: 提出双层代理运行时架构：第一层为浏览器原生信任锚，通过加密保护的能力凭证将工具绑定到注册主体，并在工具生命周期中传播来源标签；第二层分离语义检查与特权工具使用，由无调用权限的Q-LLM检查工具元数据、输出和页面提供内容的提示注入，验证后将内容转发给有执行权限的P-LLM，同时Q-LLM的内部状态对页面脚本隐藏。
AI.result: 浏览器原生所有权机制将撤销和覆盖攻击成功率从100%降至0%；双代理运行时拦截全部80次工具描述中的提示注入尝试，仅2/80次工具返回攻击成功；任务效用与无攻击基线统计上无显著差异。但面对白盒自适应攻击者，基于描述的内容过滤可通过在检查前调用恶意工具名被绕过，从而引出调用时序门控的改进需求。
AI.conclusion: WebMCP-Phalanx显著增强了WebMCP环境下LLM代理工具调用的安全性，但描述级过滤对自适应攻击者仍存在绕过路径，需要引入调用时序门控（延迟工具调用直至所有代理可见的工具元数据被验证）作为必要补充。

title: Mixture of Channel Experts: Static Sparse Supports with Input-Adaptive Mixing for Pointwise Projections
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales language models by routing each input through a small set of independently parameterized experts. We show that copying this design into convolutional networks fails for a structural reason: parallel convolutional experts that read the same input channels learn nearly identical filters. We therefore move the expert axis from operator duplication to channel selection. We introduce Mixture of Channel Experts (MoCE), a structured sparse channel-mixing layer, inspired by MoE, that replaces pointwise (1x1) channel-reduction projections. In MoCE, an expert is a single output channel with a learned sparse support of k << C input channels. The selected channels are combined by a softmax whose temperature is predicted per input, so each expert can move between mean-like and max-like aggregation. A residual expert summarizes the unselected channels, and a load-balancing loss keeps channel coverage complete. MoCE replaces a dense projection whose cost is quadratic in C with a mechanism whose relative cost scales as k/C, and the predicted savings hold in measured wall-clock time. Across ResNet backbones on ImageNet-1K and CIFAR-100, transfer learning, EfficientViT, and a strong modern training recipe, MoCE matches or exceeds dense baselines and prior channel-selection methods while reducing MACs by 16.7% and end-to-end latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合通道专家（MoCE），一种受MoE启发的结构化稀疏通道混合层，用通道选择替代算子复制来解决卷积网络中MoE设计失效的问题，并在多种基准上匹配或超越密集基线，同时减少16.7%的MACs和端到端延迟。
AI.motivation: 作者发现将MoE设计直接复制到卷积网络中会结构性失败：读取相同输入通道的并行卷积专家会学到几乎相同的滤波器。因此需要重新思考如何在卷积网络中有效地引入专家机制，从算子复制转向通道选择。
AI.method: MoCE用专家替代点式（1x1）通道降维投影。每个专家是一个输出通道，具有k << C个输入通道的学习稀疏支持集。被选中的通道通过温度可预测的softmax（每个输入预测温度，使专家可在均值与最大值聚合之间切换）进行组合。还包含一个残差专家汇总未选通道，以及一个负载均衡损失保证通道覆盖完整。MoCE的计算成本由O(C²)降到O(kC)。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K和CIFAR-100上以ResNet为骨干网络，以及迁移学习、EfficientViT和强现代训练配方上，MoCE匹配或超越密集基线和先前的通道选择方法，同时将MACs降低16.7%并减少端到端延迟。理论上的成本节省在实际墙钟时间测量中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: MoCE证明将专家的概念从算子复制转化为通道选择，能够在卷积网络中有效利用稀疏混合专家思想，在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低计算成本。这一方向为卷积架构的高效设计提供了新思路。

title: SIREN-Bench: Behavior-Driven Generation and Evaluation of Emergency-Vehicle Interactions
summary: Emergency vehicles (EMVs) can reorganize surrounding traffic as civilian vehicles brake, change lanes, or form rescue corridors in response to their passage. Evaluating these safety-critical interactions requires behavior-level control over both EMV privileges and civilian responses, together with consistent sensing and ground truth. Existing datasets and simulation benchmarks do not directly provide this combination. We present \textbf{SIREN}, a behavior-driven SUMO--CARLA co-simulation platform for generating EMV--civilian interactions. SIREN couples SUMO's network-level traffic evolution and behavior logic with CARLA's continuous vehicle control and synchronized onboard sensing; depending on the active behavior, the interaction is controlled by SUMO, CARLA, or jointly. We instantiate the platform as \textbf{SIREN-Bench-v1}, comprising seven parameterized interaction templates across emergency levels L1--L3 and three behavior families, with synchronized sensor observations and simulator-native annotations. We demonstrate the benchmark through three representative tasks: 3D object detection, trajectory prediction, and vision-language risk understanding. Evaluations of nine trajectory predictors, four LiDAR-based detectors, and five vision-language models reveal behavior-dependent failure modes. Traffic-clearance interactions are hardest for detection, privileged intersection traversal is hardest for prediction, and no learned predictor outperforms the constant-velocity reference on average. Vision-language models perform substantially better on normal traffic than on near-miss and collision events. These results demonstrate the value of behavior-centered benchmarking and establish SIREN as an extensible data-generation and evaluation platform for autonomous-driving and transportation safety research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIREN，一个行为驱动的SUMO-CARLA联合仿真平台，用于生成紧急车辆（EMV）与民用车辆之间的安全关键交互场景，并在此基础上构建SIREN-Bench-v1基准，通过多项任务评估揭示行为相关的模型失效模式。
AI.motivation: 评估EMV与民用车辆之间的安全关键交互需要同时对EMV特权和民用车辆响应进行行为级控制，并具备一致的感知与真值。然而现有数据集和仿真基准无法直接提供这种组合，缺乏行为中心化的EMV交互数据生成与评估平台。
AI.method: SIREN将SUMO的网络级交通演化与行为逻辑和CARLA的连续车辆控制与同步车载感知耦合起来；根据激活的行为类型，交互由SUMO、CARLA或两者联合控制。作者实例化为SIREN-Bench-v1，包含七个参数化交互模板，覆盖L1-L3紧急级别和三个行为家族，并提供同步传感器观测与仿真器原生标注。
AI.result: 在三个代表性任务（3D目标检测、轨迹预测、视觉-语言风险理解）上，评估了九个轨迹预测器、四个LiDAR检测器和五个视觉-语言模型。结果显示：交通清障交互对检测最难，特权路口穿越对预测最难，且没有学习型预测器在平均性能上超过恒定速度基线；视觉-语言模型在正常交通上显著优于近碰撞和碰撞事件。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了行为中心化基准测试的价值，并确立了SIREN作为自动驾驶与交通安全研究中可扩展的数据生成和评估平台的地位。

title: Ethical LLM-Assisted Research: A Framework for Responsible Delegation, Verification, and Epistemic Value
comment: This is a substantially revised version of submit/7664457. I have extensively revised the manuscript to clarify its scholarly contribution, strengthen the formal framework and literature grounding, and remove or reformulate claims that were not sufficiently supported
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming routine instruments of scientific research, assisting with literature synthesis, hypothesis development, coding, and formal reasoning. Their use raises a central epistemic question: when parts of scientific reasoning are delegated to an artificial system, what conditions must remain under human control for the resulting knowledge claims to retain epistemic legitimacy and accountable authorship? This paper develops a normative and conceptual framework for analyzing such delegation. Scientific reasoning is treated as a distributed process in which the origin of a contribution may vary between human and machine, while responsibility for its acceptance into the scientific record remains human. The framework distinguishes content origin $O(g)$, completion of human verification $V(g)$, responsibility assignment $R(g)$, accountable human ownership $M(g)$, and epistemic outcome $E(g)$. These constructs separate the provenance of a claim from the process by which it is checked, the epistemic outcome of that checking, and the human responsibility attached to its disposition. The central proposition is that the ethical boundary of LLM-assisted research is determined primarily by adequate verification and accountable human ownership rather than by the degree of machine involvement itself. On this basis, the paper develops the notion of an \emph{epistemic audit}: a structured record of delegation, verification, provenance, and responsibility intended to make AI-assisted reasoning transparent and reviewable. The resulting framework provides a formal vocabulary for distinguishing responsible cognitive delegation from the transfer or neglect of epistemic responsibility in scientific research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个关于大语言模型辅助科学研究的规范性框架，将科学推理视为分布式过程，通过区分内容起源、验证完成度、责任分配、人类所有权和认知结果等概念，论证LLM辅助研究的伦理边界主要取决于充分验证和负责任的人类归属，而非机器参与程度本身，并发展出"认知审计"概念以确保AI辅助推理的透明性和可审查性。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型日益成为科学研究中的常规工具（文献综合、假设发展、编码和形式推理），产生了一个核心认识论问题：当科学推理的部分环节被委派给人工系统时，哪些条件必须保留在人类控制之下，才能确保由此产生的知识主张具备认知合法性和可问责的作者身份。现有文献缺乏一个系统性的规范框架来分析这种委派。
AI.method: 论文采用概念分析和规范论证的方法，将科学推理建模为分布式过程，提出五个区分的构念：内容起源O(g)、人类验证完成度V(g)、责任分配R(g)、可问责的人类所有权M(g)和认知结果E(g)。这些构念将主张的来源、核验过程、核验的认知结果以及人类对处置所负的责任相分离。在此基础上发展出"认知审计"概念，作为委派、验证、来源和责任的记录机制。
AI.result: 论文的核心命题是：LLM辅助研究的伦理边界主要由充分验证和可问责的人类所有权决定，而非机器参与程度本身。该框架提供了一个形式化词汇，用于区分负责任的认知委派与认知责任的转移或忽视。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了一个规范性框架来界定AI辅助科学研究的伦理边界，其核心贡献在于：通过概念区分（起源与验证、责任与所有权等）阐明"问题不在于机器做了什么，而在于人类如何验证和承责"，并提出认知审计作为实践工具，以保证AI辅助推理的可审查性和透明度。

title: A Feature-Major Codebook for Memory-Efficient Sparse-Binary Self-Organizing Maps: Scaling a MEDLINE Atlas to 1.05 Million Neurons on a Single Consumer GPU
comment: 39 pages, 11 tables, 7 figures. Code, frozen results and reproduction pipeline: https://github.com/mongrolwarrior/sparsesom-paper1 (tag v1.0). Corpus: doi:10.5281/zenodo.20770707 (CC0). An instruction-roofline profiling addendum is included as an ancillary file and at https://github.com/mongrolwarrior/sparsesom-roofline-addendum (tag v1.0)
summary: A self-organising map turns a large corpus into a browsable two-dimensional atlas, but building one at MEDLINE scale has been impractical: the best-matching-unit (BMU) search that dominates training is bound by the bandwidth needed to read the codebook every epoch. I show that this bottleneck is largely an artefact of codebook layout. Storing it feature-major with each feature's weights contiguous, W[v.M+i], recasts the search as a tiled sparse-dense product in which every loaded weight column is reused across a tile of samples. Varying only the layout, with implementation, precision and update rule held fixed, accelerates the BMU search by 4.5-8.5x. Because an exact-argmin BMU is invariant to how the codebook is stored, this gain costs nothing: held-out quantisation error agrees with a cuSPARSE baseline to within 0.5% at every map size. Against that baseline the advantage is a crossover rather than a constant: cuSPARSE.SOM is faster at small maps, SparseBin.SOM is 1.5x faster at 128x128 and 2.6x at 256x256, and at 512x512 it is the only one that runs at all on 24 GB. Paired with a radius-independent box-blur update and a convergence-based stopping rule, it trains a converged map over 29.9 million MEDLINE articles in about 72 s at 64x64 on one 24 GB GPU, and accommodates 262,144 neurons (512x512 edges) where every alternative algorithm I tested exceeds memory constraints. On a 141 GB H200 it reaches 1,048,576 neurons (1024x1024 edges) - to my knowledge the largest self-organising map yet reported. Held-out error follows a smooth power law with no elbow across three decades of map size, so the limit on resolution is compute rather than any breakpoint in the data. At matched work the design is ~82x faster than MedSOM, the CUDA implementation behind our earlier MEDLINE atlases and, at 128x128, 621x faster than the best available multicore-CPU library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SparseBin.SOM，通过将自组织映射（SOM）的码本按特征主序（feature-major）存储，把最优匹配单元（BMU）搜索重铸为分块稀疏-稠密矩阵乘法，使每个加载的权重列可被一批样本复用，从而在保持精确argmin语义不变的前提下使BMU搜索加速4.5-8.5倍。该方法在单块24GB GPU上仅用约72秒就在64x64映射下完成对2990万条MEDLINE文献的收敛训练，并扩展到1024x1024（1,048,576个神经元）的自组织映射——据作者所知是迄今报道的最大SOM。相比MedSOM基线加速约82倍，比最好的多核CPU库快621倍。
AI.motivation: 构建大规模可浏览的二维自组织映射一直受限于训练瓶颈：BMU搜索受限于每次epoch读取码本的带宽。作者指出该瓶颈主要是码本布局的伪影，而非计算本身固有的限制，因此希望通过改变存储布局消除这一瓶颈，使SOM达到MEDLINE规模甚至更大。
AI.method: 核心方法是将码本按特征主序（feature-major）存储，即每个特征的权重连续存放（W[v.M+i]），从而将BMU搜索转化为分块稀疏-稠密矩阵乘法（tiled sparse-dense product），使每个加载的权重列被一个样本tile复用。保持实现、精度和更新规则不变，仅改变布局即可获得加速。同时搭配与半径无关的box-blur更新及基于收敛的停止准则。
AI.result: 仅改变布局即实现BMU搜索4.5-8.5倍加速；与cuSPARSE基线相比，在128x128时快1.5倍、256x256时快2.6倍，512x512时是唯一能在24GB显存上运行的方案；在141GB H200上达到1,048,576个神经元（1024x1024），为迄今最大SOM；在64x64下72秒完成2990万MEDLINE文献的收敛训练；与MedSOM相比加速~82倍，比最佳多核CPU库快621倍。
AI.conclusion: 码本布局是SOM扩展性的关键瓶颈，通过特征主序存储配合分块稀疏-稠密乘法可无损地获得数量级加速。SOM的分辨率极限由计算资源而非数据内在结构决定（误差幂律无拐点），这为在更大规模数据上构建超大型SOM铺平了道路。

title: Beyond Static and Linear: What Attention Constraints Best Fit Human Reading Times?
summary: Transformer-based language models are widely used as models of human language processing, yet their attention mechanisms allow lossless access to the full preceding context, unlike the limited memory systems of humans. We hypothesize that installing memory constraints into transformers' attention mechanisms can improve their fit to human behavioral data. While previous work has explored individual constraints in isolation, we conduct a systematic comparison of multiple attention-based memory mechanisms across different model sizes and training corpora, evaluating both psychometric predictive power for human reading times and grammatical competence. We additionally compare static constraints, in which the constraint strength is fixed throughout training, to dynamic memory curricula. We find that constraints that are sensitive to the content of intervening tokens consistently achieve the highest alignment with human reading times, outperforming distance-based constraints. We observe a dissociation between psychometric fit and grammatical competence under dynamic memory curricula, suggesting that Transformers cannot serve as a one-size-fits-all cognitive model.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较了多种基于注意力的记忆约束机制（静态与动态、内容敏感与距离敏感）对Transformer语言模型与人类阅读行为对齐度的影响，发现内容敏感的约束最能提升对人类阅读时间的预测力，但在动态记忆课程下心理测量拟合与语法能力出现分离。
AI.motivation: Transformer语言模型常被用作人类语言处理的认知模型，但其注意力机制可无损访问全部前文语境，与人类有限记忆系统不符。为提升与人类行为数据的一致性，需要在注意力机制中安装记忆约束，但以往研究仅孤立探索单一约束，缺乏系统比较。
AI.method: 系统比较多种基于注意力的记忆约束机制，跨越不同模型规模和训练语料，评估两类指标：对人类阅读时间的心理测量预测力和语法能力。同时比较固定强度约束与动态记忆课程（训练过程中强度变化）两类设定，并将中间内容敏感约束与距离敏感约束进行对比。
AI.result: 对中间令牌内容敏感的约束在人类阅读时间对齐上表现最佳，优于基于距离的约束。在动态记忆课程下，心理测量拟合与语法能力之间出现解离现象。
AI.conclusion: 内容敏感的记忆约束能更有效地提升Transformer模型作为人类阅读认知模型的逼真度；但心理测量与语法能力在动态课程下的解离表明，Transformer难以同时充当通用的认知模型，需要针对不同目标进行定制化约束设计。

title: What Guides the Agent? Adjudicating Unauthorized Behavior via Localizing Behavior-Guiding Instructions
summary: LLM agents integrated with external resources gain complex task capabilities, yet the unified natural-language context channel makes them vulnerable to injection attacks: untrusted external data may be dynamically parsed as behavior-guiding instructions during LLM inference, thereby subverting the agent's decision. Existing defenses focus on static detection or isolation of malicious content at the input/output level, remains insufficient for detecting such dynamic inducements that arise during model reasoning. We propose Attnlocate, a runtime framework for fine-grained localization of context spans that genuinely influence tool-calling decisions, i.e., behavior-guiding instructions. Attnlocate casts this localization problem as an object detection task, aiming to detect the distinctive activation traces induced by behavior-guiding instructions within the attention matrix. Specifically, we design a multi-head, multi-layer attention aggregation scheme to construct a token-level feature space tailored for object detection. Then, a 1-D U-Net equipped with an anchor-free detection head is deployed to detect these spans. Finally, based on the authority of the provider from which the detected behavior-guiding spans originate, Attnlocate dynamically adjudicates malicious invocation attempts. We evaluate Attnlocate across ten agent configurations from five LLM families, covering scenarios involving indirect prompt injection and tool poisoning. Attnlocate achieves a mean IoU of 0.743, an average AUROC of 0.956, and a 0.934 true-positive rate at 0.067 false-positive rate. It also transfers effectively across unseen models and supports authority policy adaptation without retraining.

AI.tldr: Attnlocate是一个运行时框架，通过将上下文跨度定位问题转化为目标检测任务，利用注意力矩阵中行为引导指令的独特激活痕迹，实现对工具调用决策真正影响力上下文的细粒度定位，并通过来源权威性判定抵御提示注入攻击。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体与外部资源集成后，统一自然语言上下文通道使其易受注入攻击——不可信外部数据在推理过程中被动态解析为行为引导指令，从而颠覆智能体决策。现有防御仅关注输入/输出层面的静态检测或隔离，无法识别推理过程中出现的动态诱导内容。
AI.method: Attnlocate将一个定位问题转化为目标检测任务：(1)设计多头、多层注意力聚合方案构建适用于目标检测的token级特征空间；(2)部署带有无锚检测头的1-D U-Net检测行为引导指令跨度；(3)基于检测到的行为引导跨度来源的权威性，动态判定恶意调用企图。
AI.result: 跨五个LLM家族、十种智能体配置进行评估（涵盖间接提示注入和工具中毒场景）：平均IoU 0.743，平均AUROC 0.956，真阳性率0.934（假阳性率0.067）。模型可有效迁移至未见模型，并支持无需重训练的权威策略自适应。
AI.conclusion: Attnlocate提供了一种全新的、基于注意力激活痕迹的运行时行为引导指令定位与防御方案，相比现有静态防御具有更强的泛化能力和适应性，有效弥补了动态注入检测的空白。

title: A Theory of Speciation in Generative Diffusion Models on Compact Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Speciation in generative diffusion models denotes the emergence of distinct stable branches during denoising, through which initially undifferentiated trajectories progressively commit to different data classes. In this work we develop an intrinsic theory of speciation for diffusion models supported on compact Riemannian manifolds: the aim is to go beyond existing theoretical descriptions, which usually identify speciation with a symmetric pitchfork bifurcation and assume to work in a large-dimensional space. We characterize speciation by bifurcations of the critical points of the evolving probability density. A spectral heat-kernel representation makes explicit the role of the manifold geometry, while Poincaré-Hopf and Morse theory impose global constraints on the number and type of score equilibria and reveal topologically-imposed geometrical modes. For mixtures of heat kernels, we prove that generic speciation events have a one-dimensional critical kernel and admit an A2 fold normal form; pitchforks and simultaneous multidirectional transitions arise from nongeneric symmetric configurations. We derive geometry-dependent estimates of speciation times for bimodal mixtures and Riemannian regular simplices. We further establish structural stability of nondegenerate folds under score perturbations and show that the first-order time shift is determined solely by the component of the score error along the critical direction. The theory is illustrated on the sphere using mixtures of von Mises-Fisher distributions, where pitchfork and saddle-node bifurcations, topological modes, and hierarchical multiple speciations are observed. Finally, a chart-based intrinsic score-learning scheme based on neural networks contrasts the theoretically predicted transitions on prototypal and more complex datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在紧致黎曼流形上扩散模型"物种形成"（speciation）现象的内在理论，用概率密度的临界点分叉来刻画这一现象，并通过谱热核表示、Poincaré-Hopf/Morse理论等工具揭示流形几何在物种形成中的根本作用。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型物种形成的理论描述通常将其等同于对称叉形分叉（pitchfork bifurcation），且假设工作在高维空间中，缺乏对几何因素和内在结构的深入刻画。作者希望超越这些简化假设，建立更一般的内在理论解释。
AI.method: 采用谱热核表示显式刻画黎曼流形几何的作用；利用Poincaré-Hopf定理和Morse理论对得分平衡点的数量和类型施加全局约束，揭示拓扑强制的几何模态。对热核混合物证明一般物种形成事件具有一维临界核并服从A2折叠正规形，叉形分叉和多方向同时转换源于非一般对称配置；推导物种形成时间的几何依赖估计；通过结构稳定性分析和一阶时间位移公式（由得分误差沿临界方向的分量决定）刻画得分扰动的影响。
AI.result: 在球面上用von Mises-Fisher分布混合验证了理论：观察到叉形分叉、鞍-结分叉、拓扑模态和分层多次物种形成；此外提出基于图表的、以神经网络为引擎的内在得分学习方案，在原型和更复杂数据集上对比了理论预测的转变。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的物种形成应由演化概率密度临界点的分叉来内在刻画，且流形拓扑和几何（而非单纯的维度效应或对称性）在决定物种形成的类型、数量和时间上起关键作用；一般配置下物种形成呈现为稳健的折叠型分叉，受拓扑约束且对得分扰动具有结构稳定性。

title: TrAct: Bridging Robot Control and Visual Prediction with Visual Tracks
summary: Robot actions are inherently embodiment-specific and only weakly aligned with image-space visual changes, limiting their effectiveness as conditioning signals for robot world models. In contrast, visual tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic representation of how task-relevant points move through a scene, offering dense image-space guidance for accurate and spatially precise future video prediction. Building on this observation, we propose TrAct, a world-model-based robot decision-making framework that uses visual tracks as an intermediate interface between control and prediction. TrAct consists of three components: a Vision-Language-Action-and-Track model (VLAT) that jointly predicts candidate actions and corresponding visual tracks from the current observation and language instruction; a track-conditioned world model (TWM) that predicts future visual outcomes conditioned on the proposed tracks; and a vision-language reward model (VLAC) that scores the predicted outcomes. At inference time, VLAT generates candidate action-track pairs, TWM rolls out their visual consequences, and VLAC selects the track whose predicted outcome best satisfies the instruction; the action paired with the selected track is then executed by the robot. Experiments on the proposed LIBERO-INTEGRAL benchmark and real-world Franka manipulation show that TrAct improves success rates from 27% to 55% in simulation and from 49% to 76% on real-world tasks compared with the strong VLA baseline $π_{0.5}$. Furthermore, TWM consistently improves video prediction quality over the action-conditioned world model (AWM). These results demonstrate that visual tracks provide an effective shared interface between robot control and visual prediction, enabling more accurate world modeling and stronger robot generalization.

AI.tldr: TrAct是一个基于世界模型的机器人决策框架，利用视觉轨迹（visual tracks）作为控制和预测之间的中间接口，通过VLAT生成候选动作-轨迹对、TWM预测视觉结果、VLAC评分选择最优方案，在LIBERO-INTEGRAL基准和真实Franka机器人上分别将成功率从27%提升到55%（仿真）和从49%提升到76%（真实任务）。
AI.motivation: 机器人动作（actions）本质上是与具体本体（embodiment）相关的，且与图像空间的视觉变化对齐较弱，导致它们作为世界模型的调节信号效果有限。相比之下，视觉轨迹提供了一种与本体无关的、稠密图像空间的任务关键点运动表示，能够为未来视频预测提供更精确的空间指导。
AI.method: TrAct包含三个核心组件：(1) VLAT（Vision-Language-Action-and-Track模型）：联合预测候选动作和对应的视觉轨迹；(2) TWM（track-conditioned world model）：以轨迹为条件预测未来视觉结果；(3) VLAC（vision-language reward model）：对预测结果进行指令满足度评分。推理时，VLAT生成候选动作-轨迹对，TWM推演视觉后果，VLAC选择最优轨迹对应的动作执行。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-INTEGRAL基准上，TrAct将成功率从27%提高到55%；在真实Franka操作任务上，从49%提高到76%（对比强VLA基线π0.5）。同时，TWM在视频预测质量上一致优于动作条件世界模型（AWM）。
AI.conclusion: 视觉轨迹是机器人控制和视觉预测之间有效的共享接口，能够实现更准确的世界建模和更强的机器人泛化能力，验证了以轨迹作为中间表示连接动作与预测这一范式的有效性。

title: MolEmb: Multimodal Large Language Models Can Be Strong Molecular Embedding Models
comment: Presented at the 3rd Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences (FM4LS), ICML 2026. Non-archival workshop
summary: Molecular embedding models can serve as foundational infrastructure for computational chemistry and drug discovery, where reusable vector representations support property prediction, virtual screening, and retrieval. Most molecular encoders are specialist models built around a single molecular view, producing unconditional vectors with no language interface for varying the representation. We ask whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), which natively process images, text, and symbolic inputs, can instead serve as \emph{general molecular embedding models} that produce embeddings conditioned on both a molecular profile and a natural-language semantic context. We introduce \textbf{MolEmb}, a lightweight framework that adapts MLLMs by aligning molecular profiles with textual descriptions in a shared embedding space using a bidirectional contrastive objective. The resulting embedding model is competitive on molecular property prediction and supports cross-modal molecule--text retrieval in the same space. We further introduce \textbf{MolCAR}, a diagnostic benchmark for context-aware retrieval, and find that context-aware molecular embedding is primarily a data property of the supervision. These results suggest that MLLMs are not merely chemistry assistants or generators, but a viable and extensible route to general molecular embedding models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MolEmb框架，将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）改编为通用分子嵌入模型，通过双向对比损失将分子特征与文本描述对齐到共享嵌入空间，并引入MolCAR基准测试上下文感知检索，验证了MLLMs作为通用分子嵌入模型的可行性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有的分子编码器大多是围绕单一分子视图构建的专家模型，产生无条件的向量表示，缺乏改变表示形式的语言接口。作者希望探索多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）是否能够超越其作为化学助手或生成器的角色，成为通用的分子嵌入模型，从而支持基于分子特征和自然语言语义上下文的条件嵌入。
AI.method: 提出了MolEmb轻量级框架，通过双向对比学习目标将分子特征（molecular profiles）与文本描述在共享嵌入空间中对齐，从而适配MLLMs。同时引入MolCAR诊断基准，用于评估上下文感知的分子-文本跨模态检索性能。
AI.result: MolEmb在分子性质预测任务上表现具有竞争力，并能在同一嵌入空间中支持分子-文本跨模态检索。MolCAR基准实验表明，上下文感知的分子嵌入主要由监督数据的数据属性决定。这些结果证明MLLMs可以作为通用分子嵌入模型的可行且可扩展的路径。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型不仅能作为化学助手或生成器，还可以通过轻量级对齐框架（MolEmb）转化为通用分子嵌入模型，为计算化学和药物发现提供可复用的、受自然语言语义上下文调控的向量表示。

title: Compression Trinity: Exploring Sparsity, Quantization, and Low-Rank Approximations for LLM Compression
comment: PhD thesis, University of Toronto, 2026. 156 pages. Chapters extend MKOR (arXiv:2306.01685), SLoPe (arXiv:2405.16325), OPTIMA (arXiv:2512.13886), PATCH (arXiv:2509.23410), and SLiM (arXiv:2410.09615). Official record: https://utoronto.scholaris.ca/items/2cde1f98-6084-46b9-aae2-dbcd045f1215
summary: Prohibitive computational and environmental costs impede the scalable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional compression techniques (sparsity, quantization, low-rank approximations) are typically applied in isolation, and each hits an accuracy-efficiency wall. This thesis proposes the "Compression Trinity," a unified framework that applies the three pillars jointly: sparsity to reduce computation, quantization to minimize memory bandwidth, and low-rank approximations to recover accuracy. To accelerate pretraining, we apply the Trinity to the optimizer and model architecture. MKOR approximates curvature via block-diagonal sparsity and low-rank inversion, maintaining numerical stability for quantized states; it reduces curvature update complexity from $O(d^3)$ to $O(d^2)$ and accelerates convergence by up to 1.85x over KFAC. SLoPe accelerates training by up to 1.25x via a double-pruned backward pass for N:M sparsity, using low-rank "lazy" adapters in the final 1% of training to recover accuracy. For post-training compression, OPTIMA stabilizes static masks in a zero-training regime by formulating weight reconstruction as globally optimal column-wise quadratic programs, improving zero-shot accuracy by up to 3.97%. Given a fine-tuning budget, PATCH breaks the ceiling of static masks by learning a dynamic hybrid sparsity ratio between 0% and 50%, yielding up to 1.38x speedups. Finally, SLiM realizes the full Compression Trinity in one shot, using mathematically derived low-rank adapters to recover information lost to quantization and sparsity, improving accuracy by up to 5.66% over state-of-the-art methods and outperforming uncompressed dense models at equal parameter budgets by 0.6%. Together, these results show that jointly applying the Compression Trinity is essential for efficient, scalable, high-performance LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"压缩三位一体"（Compression Trinity）统一框架，将稀疏化、量化和低秩近似三种压缩技术联合应用于大语言模型的预训练加速与训练后压缩（约简）。通过MKOR、SLoPe、OPTIMA、PATCH和SLiM五个方法分别在优化器端、架构端和训练后压缩端验证了三种技术协同作用的有效性，实现了加速比提升至高1.85倍、稀疏率超越静态掩码上限、精度最高提升5.66%等成果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM压缩方法（稀疏化、量化、低秩近似）通常被孤立地应用，各自面临精度-效率的瓶颈墙（accuracy-efficiency wall）。作者认为需要联合使用这三种正交的压缩维度才能突破单一方法的局限，实现LLM的高效规模化和高性价比部署。
AI.method: 提出Compression Trinity框架，将三支柱（稀疏化降低计算、量化最小化内存带宽、低秩近似恢复精度）联合应用。具体方法包括：(1) MKOR：在优化器侧通过块对角稀疏与低秩逆逼近曲率，并结合量化状态，将曲率更新复杂度从O(d³)降至O(d²)；(2) SLoPe：通过N:M稀疏性双剪枝反向传播加速训练，在最后1%训练阶段使用低秩"lazy"适配器恢复精度；(3) OPTIMA：在零训练（zero-training）场景下将权重重建表述为全局最优的逐列二次规划，稳定静态掩码；(4) PATCH：在微调预算下学习0%-50%的动态混合稀疏率，突破静态掩码天花板；(5) SLiM：一步实现完整的三位一体压缩，用数学推导的低秩适配器恢复量化和稀疏化损失的信息。
AI.result: MKOR相比KFAC加速收敛最高达1.85倍并降低曲率更新复杂度；SLoPe加速训练最高1.25倍；OPTIMA提升零样本准确率最高达3.97%；PATCH带来最高1.38倍加速；SLiM相比state-of-the-art方法提升精度最高达5.66%，并在同等参数预算下超越未压缩稠密模型0.6%。
AI.conclusion: 联合应用稀疏化、量化与低秩近似三种压缩技术对构建高效、可扩展且高性能的大语言模型至关重要。三位一体框架证明了跨维度协同压缩能突破单一压缩方法的瓶颈，是面向LLM规模化部署的关键路径。

title: Mitigating Exploration Bias in RL for Multi-Instruction Following
summary: RL has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing the instruction following capabilities of LLMs. While existing training recipes achieve substantial gains, we find that they suffer from exploration bias towards easy instructions when the training data has multiple instructions in a prompt. This bias is caused by two main reasons: 1) the policy model's initial ability to satisfy hard instructions is too low to trigger successful exploration during RL training, so the optimization is biased towards easy instructions; and 2) canonical RL training recipes typically employ a cumulative reward (the number of instructions fulfilled), treating all instructions equally, which biases the policy model towards fulfilling easy instructions to obtain the same amount of reward. To address these issues, we first propose two metrics to measure the exploration bias in instruction following and then introduce a two-stage framework to alleviate it: 1) Behavioral Bootstrapping, a lightweight rejection sampling fine-tuning stage before RL to activate hard instructions; and 2) Scarcity-Aware Rewards, a new RL reward function that assigns rewards to instructions based on their empirical scarcity. Experiments show that the proposed metrics are highly correlated with model performance, and our methods unleash the potential of RL training: our best models outperform the baselines by a significant margin across three verifiable instruction following benchmarks. We release codes at https://github.com/mianzhang/MulIF.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM指令跟随RL训练中存在的"探索偏差"问题（即模型偏向于完成简单指令而忽视困难指令），提出两种度量指标来量化该偏差，并设计了两阶段框架——行为引导（Behavioral Bootstrapping）和稀缺性感知奖励（Scarcity-Aware Rewards）——来缓解这一问题，在三个可验证的指令跟随基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RL训练配方虽然能提升LLM的指令跟随能力，但当单个提示中包含多条指令时，训练存在对简单指令的探索偏差。这一偏差源于两个原因：1）策略模型初始难以满足困难指令，导致RL训练中无法触发对困难指令的成功探索；2）传统RL训练使用累计奖励（满足指令的数量），将所有指令等同对待，使得模型倾向于选择简单指令以获取相同奖励。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：(1) 行为引导（Behavioral Bootstrapping）——在RL训练前进行轻量级的拒绝采样微调，以激活困难指令的探索能力；(2) 稀缺性感知奖励（Scarcity-Aware Rewards）——基于指令的经验稀缺性分配奖励权重。同时提出两种度量指标来衡量指令跟随中的探索偏差。
AI.result: 实验表明提出的度量指标与模型性能高度相关，且该框架能充分发挥RL训练的潜力——最佳模型在三个可验证的指令跟随基准上显著超越基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过行为引导和稀缺性感知奖励，可以有效缓解多指令场景下RL训练的探索偏差，释放RL在指令跟随任务中的更大潜力。代码已开源。

title: Restoring Without Forgetting: Continual Learning Across Image Degradations
summary: Recent progress in image restoration has converged on all-in-one architectures that jointly handle multiple degradations within a single network. These methods are effective on static benchmarks but target a closed-world setting that assumes simultaneous access to every target degradation at training time. In practice, degradations are encountered sequentially as field-deployed systems progressively face new environmental conditions, and historical training data is often unavailable due to privacy or storage constraints. Accommodating a new degradation then requires either retraining on the union of all prior data, which is often costly or infeasible, or fine-tuning, which causes catastrophic forgetting. We formulate multi-degradation image restoration as a continual domain-incremental learning problem, in which degradations arrive incrementally and prior data is unavailable. Our proposed Restoring without Forgetting (RwF) framework learns a lightweight adapter for each new degradation, eliminating forgetting by construction at a fraction of the cost of dedicated per-domain networks. To isolate degradation learning from dataset variation, we construct a benchmark spanning five degradation domains under shared image content. At test time, an unsupervised routing mechanism identifies the appropriate restoration path for unknown inputs without requiring domain labels. Across the five-domain sequence, RwF improves final average PSNR over naive sequential fine-tuning by 15.25 dB and 11.83 dB on the Restormer and NAFNet backbones, respectively. The framework transfers to eleven canonical real-degradation benchmarks (3,465 images) at 89.5% routing accuracy with only a +0.94 dB oracle PSNR gap, establishing, to our knowledge, the first systematic baseline for continual multi-degradation image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RwF框架，将多退化图像恢复问题形式化为持续域增量学习问题，通过为每种新退化学习轻量级适配器来避免灾难性遗忘，并利用无监督路由机制在推理时为未知输入选择正确的恢复路径。在五个退化域的序列中，RwF相比朴素顺序微调在Restormer和NAFNet骨干网络上分别提升15.25 dB和11.83 dB的平均PSNR，并在11个真实退化基准上实现89.5%的路由准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有全合一（all-in-one）图像恢复架构在静态基准上表现良好，但假设训练时可同时获得所有退化类型，属于封闭世界设定。实际部署中退化是顺序出现的，历史数据常因隐私或存储限制不可用，重新训练成本高昂，而微调会导致灾难性遗忘。因此需要一种能够持续学习新退化且不遗忘旧退化的方法。
AI.method: RwF框架将多退化图像恢复建模为持续域增量学习问题。核心方法包括：(1) 为每个新退化学习一个轻量级适配器，从结构上消除遗忘；(2) 构建包含五个退化域且共享图像内容的基准以隔离退化学习与数据集变化；(3) 设计无监督路由机制，在测试时无需域标签即可为未知输入选择正确的恢复路径。
AI.result: 在五个退化域的序列上，RwF相比朴素顺序微调在Restormer骨干上提升15.25 dB、在NAFNet骨干上提升11.83 dB的平均PSNR。在11个真实退化基准（3,465张图像）上达到89.5%的路由准确率，与Oracle PSNR仅差0.94 dB。
AI.conclusion: RwF建立了首个持续多退化图像恢复的系统性基线，以远低于专用逐域网络的成本实现了无遗忘的持续学习，并通过无监督路由机制在实际部署场景中有效运行，验证了该方法在开放动态环境中的可行性。

title: Anatomy of a Scam Call: What 10,000 real scam and spam calls reveal about how phone scammers operate
summary: Telephone fraud is pervasive and costly, but its inner workings are rarely observed at scale. We analyze a complete corpus of 10,211 inbound scam and spam calls -- 913 hours of audio and 330,956 transcribed turns from 5,780 distinct numbers -- collected over 54 days by an AI voice-agent honeypot that answered callers and kept them talking, and introduced in a companion data descriptor. We separate outright scams, which solicit sensitive information, from the larger stream of predatory but legal lead generation ("spam") that feeds them. Scam operations keep office hours (6.6x more calls per weekday than weekend day); thousands of disposable numbers run a small catalog of recycled scripts (thirty opening clusters, half the traffic in the top five); and callers solicit identity anchors -- a home address and a date of birth -- far more often than payment credentials, pressing through persistence and manufactured authority rather than overt threats. Our central experiment asks: does it matter who picks up? Every seeded lead carried one of ten fictitious identities drawn uniformly at random, so the identity a fraud operation reaches is fixed before the caller exists. Across 1,823 randomized calls, scammers spent about 15% more conversational turns per decade of the target's apparent age (rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.08-1.23; randomization p = 0.005) -- yet what they asked for did not change (26.3% of calls reached a request for sensitive information; odds ratio 0.99 per decade, 95% CI 0.90-1.08). A second experiment casts early detection as a benchmark: from a scammer's opening lines alone, on a caller-disjoint split, escalation is predictable at 0.72 ROC-AUC from the first line and 0.87 by the eighth, and a plain bag-of-words classifier matches a fine-tuned on-device language model. Telephone fraud emerges as a templated industry that varies how hard it works a target, but not what it wants.

AI.tldr: 本文基于AI语音代理蜜罐收集的54天内10,211通诈骗/骚扰电话语料（913小时音频、330,956轮对话、5,780个号码），分析了电话诈骗的运作模式，并通过两个随机化实验揭示：诈骗分子会因目标年龄增加15%的对话投入，但索取内容不变；早期升级预测从首句ROC-AUC 0.72提升至第八句0.87，且简单词袋模型可媲美微调语言模型。
AI.motivation: 电话诈骗普遍且代价高昂，但其内部运作机制在规模上极少被观察到。作者希望借助大规模真实通话语料，揭示诈骗产业的组织化模式（营业时间、脚本复用、号码轮换）以及其目标选择与索取行为是否因人而异，从而为检测和防御提供实证依据。
AI.method: 使用AI语音代理蜜罐在54天内收集10,211通入站诈骗/骚扰电话；区分诈骗（索取敏感信息）与合法但掠夺性的线索生成（spam）。对1,823次随机化通话，每通电话携带十个虚构身份之一（随机分配），通过目标表观年龄分析诈骗者的对话轮次投入与索取内容是否变化；并以说话者不相交分割评估从开场白预测升级的早期检测性能（词袋模型与微调设备端语言模型对比）。
AI.result: 诈骗运作保持办公时间规律（工作日通话量是周末6.6倍）；约三十个开场聚类覆盖半数流量；索取身份锚点（家庭住址、出生日期）远多于支付凭证。随机化实验显示：目标表观年龄每增加10岁，诈骗者多投入约15%对话轮次（RR=1.15, 95%CI 1.08-1.23, p=0.005），但索取事项无显著变化（OR=0.99/十年）。早期检测：首句AUC 0.72，第八句0.87，朴素词袋模型与微调语言模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 电话诈骗是一个模板化（templated）的产业：它有一套固定剧本、营业时间和号码轮换机制，会根据目标年龄调整"工作强度"（投入的对话轮次），但不会改变索取的最终目标。早期检测在有限对话片段内即可达到较高预测能力，且无需复杂模型。

title: Discovering Cross-Language Reasoning Invariance in LLMs with Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoders
comment: Accepted as a poster at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Multilingual language models can solve the same mathematical problem in different languages, but it remains unclear whether they rely on shared features or on language-specific computations that only produce similar outputs. We study this question in five models from four families using the Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) dataset, with problems solved in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese, retaining problems with valid reasoning traces in all six languages and replaying those traces through the model to record representations at multiple layers. For each model, we first use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to identify layers with cross-language alignment. At each selected layer, we train two sparse autoencoders (SAE): a baseline reconstruction-only model and a contrastive variant introduced in this work, the Geometry-Invariant SAE (GI-SAE). GI-SAE supplements the reconstruction loss with an Information Noise-Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) loss that trains the encoder to produce similar activations for traces of the same problem, regardless of language or token position. We then test whether the resulting shared features are functionally interchangeable by swapping their values between languages during the model's forward pass and measuring the resulting change in output, quantified by Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence per feature. Although GI-SAE yields higher CKA and Jaccard similarity at nearly every layer, higher geometric similarity does not consistently imply greater functional interchangeability. We find that cross-language feature sharing is model- and architecture-dependent in this sample and appears at different depths in different models. GI-SAE primarily amplifies cross-language structure already present: the pattern is model-specific, with strengthening in Qwen, no functional benefit in Gemma, and mixed layer-dependent effects in Llama and Phi.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言模型在解决数学问题时是否依赖跨语言共享特征还是语言特定的计算，提出了Geometry-Invariant SAE（GI-SAE）方法，通过在重建损失基础上增加InfoNCE对比损失来学习跨语言共享特征，并在五个模型的MGSM数据集上验证。结果表明几何相似性提高并不总能带来功能可互换性，跨语言特征共享因模型和架构而异。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型能用不同语言解决相同的数学问题，但不确定它们依赖的是共享特征还是仅产生相似输出的语言特定计算。理解这一点对于解释多语言模型的内部工作机制至关重要。
AI.method: 使用五个模型（四个家族）在MGSM数据集上以六种语言解决问题；用CKA识别跨语言对齐层；在每层训练两种SAE（基线重建模型和新提出的GI-SAE，后者增加InfoNCE损失使编码器对同一问题不同语言和位置的激活相似）；通过交换特征值并测量KL散度来测试功能可互换性。
AI.result: GI-SAE在几乎所有层产生更高的CKA和Jaccard相似度，但几何相似性的提高并不一致地意味着功能可互换性更强。跨语言特征共享在不同模型中出现深度不同：Qwen显著增强，Gemma无功能获益，Llama和Phi呈现混合的层依赖效应。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言特征共享是模型和架构依赖的，GI-SAE主要放大已存在的跨语言结构而非创造新结构。几何对齐与功能可互换性之间不存在一致的对应关系。

title: Trajectory-Level Continuous Action Representation for Robotic Manipulation
summary: We propose CAT, a trajectory-level continuous action representation framework for robotic manipulation. Existing visuomotor systems often entangle action representation with control frequency or rely on fixed temporal parameterizations. This leads to representational redundancy at high sampling rates and limits the modeling of critical motion. CAT instead encodes action trajectories within a fixed real-time interval into a set of continuous latent tokens. To ensure temporal consistency across varying control frequencies, we further incorporate a frequency-aware positional encoding that establishs a shared temporal coordinate system. Trajectory-level regularization further stabilizes the latent representation. This approach prevents representation growth with timestep density and avoids reliance on predefined temporal parameterizations. Extensive system-level evaluations on LIBERO, MimicGen, and real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that CAT-based policies consistently outperform both competitive VQ-based and continuous visuomotor baselines under matched training settings. Across various model backbones and control frequencies, CAT consistently improves success rates. These results highlight the advantages of trajectory-level continuous action modeling for scalable robotic manipulation across varying control rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAT，一种用于机器人操作的轨迹级连续动作表示框架。CAT将固定实时时间间隔内的动作轨迹编码为一组连续潜在token，并通过频率感知位置编码建立共享时间坐标系以保持跨控制频率的时间一致性。实验表明CAT在LIBERO、MimicGen和真实世界长时程操作任务上，在多种模型主干和控制频率下均优于VQ-based和连续动作基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉运动系统通常将动作表示与控制频率耦合或依赖固定的时间参数化方案，导致高采样率下产生表示冗余，并限制了关键运动建模能力。
AI.method: 1) 将固定实时时间间隔内的动作轨迹编码为连续潜在token集合；2) 引入频率感知位置编码建立共享时间坐标系，保证不同控制频率下的时间一致性；3) 通过轨迹级正则化稳定潜在表示；4) 避免表示随时间步密度增长，不依赖预设时间参数化。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、MimicGen和真实世界长时程操作任务上的系统级评估显示，在匹配的训练设置下，CAT-based策略一致优于VQ-based和连续视觉运动基线；跨多种模型主干和控制频率均稳定提升成功率。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级连续动作建模在可扩展的机器人操作和跨可变控制频率方面具有显著优势。

title: Gated Activation Steering for Reducing Sycophancy & Hallucination in Medical Question Answering
summary: Sycophancy and hallucination are persistent failure modes of Large Language Models (LLMs) across domains. However, it becomes particularly consequential in clinical question answering, where responses must remain grounded in the provided context and robust to user pressure. Hallucination can introduce information that is unsupported by the context, while sycophancy can cause a model to abandon a previously correct answer when challenged by the user.
