Existing approaches, such as prompt-based safeguards and always-on activation steering, often address these behaviors separately or apply interventions broadly across turns, which can unnecessarily deteriorate responses that were already correct. To address these limitations within a single framework, we employ Inference Time Intervention (ITI) to jointly control both behaviors by learning separate steering directions for hallucination and sycophancy from contrastive clinical pairs and applying them to causally verified attention heads. During runtime, behavior-specific gates then determine when intervention is needed: the hallucination component mitigates unsupported claims, while the sycophancy component mitigates answer shifts caused by user pressure. We evaluate this framework on clinical questions grounded in EHR data while keeping the model weights frozen. Across all evaluation settings, we conducted 15,900 model-response runs. Across 600 pressure trajectories for the 4-billion-parameter model, the unsteered model caved in 570 cases. At the same time, gated steering helped it last longer in 551 of them. It held its ground under pressure at levels comparable to those of models with more than 100 billion parameters, showing that targeted inference-time steering can improve robustness without intervening at every turn.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM在临床问答中的两大持续性缺陷——幻觉（引入上下文不支持的信息）和谄媚（在用户施压下放弃原本正确的答案），提出了一种基于推理时干预（ITI）的联合控制框架。该框架从对比性临床样本中为幻觉和谄媚分别学习独立的转向方向，应用于因果验证的注意力头，并通过行为特异性门控在需要时触发生干预。在基于EHR数据的临床问题评估中（15,900次模型响应），门控转向使4B参数模型在600条压力轨迹中的551条中比未转向模型坚持更久，其抗压能力可比肩100B+参数模型。
AI.motivation: 幻觉和谄媚是LLM在临床问答中的持续失败模式，可能导致模型引入上下文不支持的信息或在用户质疑时放弃正确答案。现有方法（如基于提示的防护和始终激活的转向干预）要么分别处理这两种行为，要么在每一轮都施加干预，导致本已正确的回答被不必要地劣化。需要一种能够在单个框架内联合控制两种行为、且仅在需要时干预的方法。
AI.method: 采用推理时干预（ITI）框架，从对比性临床样本中为幻觉和谄媚分别学习独立的转向方向，并将这些方向应用于因果验证的注意力头。推理时通过行为特异性门控决定何时需要干预：幻觉组件缓解无依据的声称，谄媚组件缓解用户施压导致的答案偏移。模型权重保持冻结。
AI.result: 在基于EHR数据的临床问题上进行了15,900次模型响应评估。对于4B参数模型，在600条压力轨迹中，未转向模型在570条中妥协；而门控转向帮助模型在551条轨迹中坚持更久，其抗压能力达到与100B+参数模型相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 定向的推理时转向干预可以在不逐轮干预的情况下提高模型的鲁棒性。行为特异性门控的ITI能够在单个框架内同时缓解幻觉和谄媚，使小模型在临床压力场景下获得堪比超大模型的表现。

title: Conditional GraphGANFed: Optimizing Graph-Structured Molecule Generation in Federated Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have garnered considerable attention in molecular discovery for their ability to generate novel and high-quality molecules. To efficiently train a GAN model while preserving data privacy, GraphGANFed has been proposed to incorporate federated learning and graph convolutional networks into GAN. Yet, GraphGANFed cannot produce synthetic molecules that only optimize a user-defined metric(s) to facilitate the new drug discovery process. To address this issue, we introduce a novel extension to GraphGANFed, namely conditional GraphGANFed (cGraphGANFed), by incorporating the critic network to assess generated molecules using user-defined metric(s). The evaluation results from both the critic network and discriminator are integrated into the loss function of the generator, guiding it to generate novel molecules that maintain similar chemical properties to real ones while optimizing user-defined metrics. Extensive simulations are conducted in two scenarios. First, cGraphGANFed endeavors to optimize all seven commonly used metrics, and the results show that cGraphGANFed significantly outperforms GraphGANFed in Validity and LogP, with a slight advantage in QED, across different settings. Second, cGraphGANFed focuses solely on optimizing QED, and the results show that the synthetic molecules produced by cGraphGANFed can achieve more than 10% improvement in QED than GraphGANFed. Also, the results demonstrate cGraphGANFed has enhanced resilience against mode collapses and performance reduction caused by non-IID data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出cGraphGANFed，在GraphGANFed基础上引入critic网络来评估生成分子是否符合用户定义的指标，并将critic与判别器的评价结果整合到生成器的损失函数中，从而在保护隐私的前提下生成优化特定指标的新分子。实验表明cGraphGANFed在Validity、LogP和QED等指标上显著优于GraphGANFed，同时在QED上提升超10%，并具有更好的抗模式坍塌和非IID数据鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: GraphGANFed虽然结合了联邦学习和图卷积网络实现隐私保护下的分子生成，但其无法生成仅优化用户定义指标（如特定药物性质）的合成分子，这限制了其在药物发现中的应用。因此需要扩展该方法，使其能够在联邦学习框架下根据用户指定指标引导分子生成。
AI.method: 在GraphGANFed的基础上引入critic网络，用于评估生成分子是否满足用户定义的指标。生成器的损失函数同时整合critic网络的评估结果和判别器的判别结果，从而引导生成器在保持与真实分子相似化学性质的同时，优化用户指定的指标。在两种场景下进行实验验证：（1）同时优化七个常用指标；（2）仅优化QED指标。
AI.result: 在同时优化七个常用指标的场景下，cGraphGANFed在Validity和LogP上显著优于GraphGANFed，在QED上也有轻微优势。在仅优化QED的场景下，cGraphGANFed生成的分子相比GraphGANFed在QED上实现了超过10%的提升。此外，cGraphGANFed对模式坍塌和非IID数据引起的性能下降具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: cGraphGANFed通过在联邦GAN框架中引入critic网络，成功实现了在隐私保护前提下生成符合用户特定指标要求的新分子，显著提升了分子生成质量，并增强了模型的稳定性和鲁棒性，为药物发现中的导向性分子生成提供了有效解决方案。

title: Does Episodic Memory Help Close the Lexical Frequency Gap in Sensitivity to Syntactic Contrasts? A Test Using Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
summary: Grammatical knowledge and how it is empirically tested are typically considered robust to the frequency of the lexical items in the expressions. However, neural network-based models of grammaticality exhibit high sensitivity to lexical frequency. We draw upon Complementary Learning Systems theory to test the hypothesis that robustness to lexical frequency can arise via a hippocampal episodic memory mechanism, which enables rapid encoding and retrieval of specific experiences and allows learners to leverage them when processing rare patterns. We use retrieval-augmented language models as an instantiation of such an episodic memory mechanism (specifically, $k$-nearest-neighbor language models that augment parametric models with explicit instance storage), and test whether this augmentation helps close the lexical frequency gap that vanilla language models exhibit in syntactic contrast tests. Using syntactic contrasts with frequency-stratified test items, we find that retrieval augmentation narrows the performance gap between high- and low-frequency items, consistent with episodic memory compensating for weak parametric representations. This benefit is consistent across different syntactic phenomena and across models pretrained on child-realistic and large-scale data. Additionally, we show that structural information is critical for effective retrieval, whereas semantic similarity alone provides little benefit. While these are promising proof-of-concept results supporting our hypothesis, the frequency gap is narrowed rather than fully closed. Based on our analyses, we propose preferential reweighting of retrieved instances, better representations and retrieval strategies for structural information, and flexible configurations of storage and retrieval as promising future directions for improving the implementation of episodic memory in language models.

AI.tldr: 基于互补学习系统理论，本文使用检索增强语言模型（k近邻语言模型）作为海马体情景记忆机制的实例化，检验其能否帮助语言模型缩小词汇频率差距（高频与低频项在句法对比测试中的性能差距）。结果表明检索增强显著缩小了这一差距，且该收益在不同句法现象和不同规模预训练数据下均一致；结构信息对有效检索至关重要，而语义相似度帮助有限，但频率差距仅被缩小而非完全消除。
AI.motivation: 语法知识及其经验测试通常被认为不受词汇频率影响，但基于神经网络的语法模型对词汇频率高度敏感。这一频率敏感性反映了参数化模型在低频模式上表示的薄弱性，因此需要探索一种机制使模型对词汇频率保持鲁棒性。
AI.method: 以互补学习系统理论为指导，假设海马体情景记忆机制（能够快速编码和检索具体经验）可以帮助学习者处理低频模式。使用检索增强语言模型（k近邻语言模型，在参数模型基础上增加显式实例存储）作为这种情景记忆机制的实例化，通过频率分层测试项的句法对比测试，检验检索增强是否能缩小高频与低频词项之间的性能差距。
AI.result: 检索增强显著缩小了高频与低频测试项之间的性能差距，该收益在多种句法现象和不同规模预训练数据（儿童真实数据和大型数据）的模型上均一致。此外，结构信息对有效检索至关重要，而语义相似度贡献甚微；但频率差距仅被缩小而非完全消除。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持情景记忆可以补偿参数化模型在低频表示上的薄弱性这一假设，属于概念验证性质。未来方向包括对检索实例进行优先重加权、改进结构信息的表示与检索策略，以及灵活配置存储和检索机制，以更好地在语言模型中实现情景记忆。

title: LUCAID: Agentic Multimodal AI for Lung Cancer Precision Pathology
summary: Lung cancer tissue diagnostics is complex, as therapy decisions in precision oncology rely on the integration of histomorphological, immunohistochemical, and molecular features. Yet pathological assessment remains largely visual and semi-quantitative and shows interobserver variability, while existing artificial intelligence (AI) tools cover only selected tasks, rarely reach generalizable expert-level performance, and lack prospective clinical validation. To address these challenges, we developed and clinically validated LUCAID, an agentic AI system for precision lung cancer pathology. An integrative agent couples diagnostic reasoning with nine modules that cover the full routine workflow, from quality control, tumor detection and segmentation, histological subtyping, tumor microenvironment profiling, tumor cellularity quantification, and predictive biomarker scoring (PD-L1, MET, TROP-2) to automated structured report generation. LUCAID enables users to interactively query the module outputs and generate reports that contextualize the results. Against large-scale expert ground-truth annotations, the analysis modules achieved F1 scores of 0.82-0.95. In prospective clinical validation, LUCAID reached 93.0% concordance with an expert-panel adjudicated reference standard across clinically actionable decisions, compared with 68.3-81.1% for five experienced thoracic pathologists.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并临床验证了LUCAID，一个用于精准肺癌病理学的智能体AI系统，通过整合九个模块覆盖完整常规工作流程，在临床前瞻性验证中以93.0%的一致性超越了五名经验丰富的胸科病理学家的表现（68.3-81.1%）。
AI.motivation: 肺癌组织诊断复杂，治疗决策依赖于组织形态学、免疫组化和分子特征的整合。然而，病理评估仍以视觉和半定量为主，存在观察者间变异；现有AI工具仅覆盖选择性任务，难以达到可泛化的专家级性能，且缺乏前瞻性临床验证。
AI.method: 开发了LUCAID智能体AI系统，由一个整合性智能体将诊断推理与九个模块耦合，覆盖完整常规工作流程：质量控制、肿瘤检测与分割、组织学亚型分型、肿瘤微环境分析、肿瘤细胞性量化、预测性生物标志物评分（PD-L1、MET、TROP-2）以及自动结构化报告生成。系统支持用户交互式查询模块输出并生成情境化报告。分析模块基于大规模专家金标准标注进行训练。
AI.result: 分析模块在F1分数上达到0.82-0.95。在前瞻性临床验证中，LUCAID与专家小组裁定的参考标准在临床可操作决策方面达到93.0%的一致性，而五名经验丰富的胸科病理学家的一致性为68.3-81.1%。
AI.conclusion: LUCAID作为首个覆盖肺癌病理学全流程的智能体AI系统，通过前瞻性临床验证证明了其超越经验丰富的专科病理学家的诊断一致性，为AI在精准肿瘤病理学中的临床应用提供了有力证据。

title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Region-Aware Consistency Repair of Backdoors in MLLMs
summary: MLLMs are increasingly deployed in user-facing applications, yet they inherit backdoor risks from the pipelines used to construct them: triggers may reside in images, texts, or both. Existing model-level backdoor removal methods, largely designed for conventional classifiers, show limited effectiveness on MLLMs, while MLLM-specific defenses mainly operate at inference time, filtering suspicious inputs without removing the backdoor embedded in the model. To address this gap and eliminate latent backdoors from MLLMs at their source, we present RACER, a model-level repair framework motivated by a key observation: backdoors induce abnormal layer-to-layer evolution in internal representations, which we term the layer-wise inconsistency anomaly. Importantly, this anomaly is modality-dependent, concentrating primarily in the token region encoding the trigger features that the backdoor model actually relies on. RACER therefore decomposes the fused representation into visual and textual token regions, normalizes their layer-wise inconsistency separately, and recomposes them using modality-aware weights over a deep-layer window, yielding a region-aware inconsistency objective that better captures localized backdoor-induced anomalies. Through a min-max optimization, this objective drives worst-case perturbation synthesis and adversarial fine-tuning against the resulting perturbation to repair the model, suppressing the deep representational directional shifts on which backdoor behaviors rely. RACER requires only 100 clean samples and no knowledge of the trigger, attack objective, or even whether the input model contains a backdoor. Evaluations on three open-source MLLMs across 36 backdoor settings spanning image, text, and multimodal triggers show that RACER reduces the average ASR to 1.1%, reaching 0% in 32 settings, while preserving clean-task utility on both backdoor and clean models.

AI.tldr: RACER是一个针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的模型级后门修复框架，利用后门导致内部表示层间演化异常（layer-wise inconsistency anomaly）且该异常具有模态依赖性的关键观察，将融合表示分解为视觉和文本token区域并分别归一化后门诱导的不一致性，通过min-max优化合成最坏情况扰动并进行对抗微调来修复模型。仅需100个干净样本，无需知道触发器、攻击目标甚至是否含后门，在3个开源MLLM、36种后门设置下将平均ASR降至1.1%，32种设置下达到0%，且保持干净任务效用。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型级后门移除方法主要针对传统分类器，对MLLMs效果有限；而MLLM特定的防御主要在推理时过滤可疑输入，无法从源头消除嵌入在模型中的后门。因此需要一种能够在模型层面从根本上消除MLLM潜在后门的修复框架。
AI.method: RACER基于"后门会引发内部表示的层间不一致性异常"这一观察，且该异常是模态依赖性的，集中在编码触发器特征的token区域。具体方法：(1) 将融合表示分解为视觉和文本token区域；(2) 在两个区域上分别归一化层间不一致性；(3) 使用模态感知权重在深层窗口上重新组合，形成区域感知的不一致性目标；(4) 通过min-max优化驱动最坏情况扰动合成与对抗微调，抑制后门行为依赖的深层表示方向性偏移。只需100个干净样本，无需触发器知识、攻击目标甚至模型是否含后门的信息。
AI.result: 在3个开源MLLMs上，覆盖图像、文本和多模态触发器的36种后门设置中，RACER将平均ASR降至1.1%，其中32种设置达到0%的ASR，同时在带后门模型和干净模型上均保持了干净任务的效用。
AI.conclusion: RACER通过在模型层面利用模态相关的层间不一致性异常，实现了对MLLM后门的高效修复，仅需极少的干净样本即可在多种后门场景下有效消除后门，且不损害模型正常性能，填补了MLLM模型级后门修复领域的空白。

title: Learning to Grade Efficiently: A Bandit-Driven Prompt-Selection Framework for Low-Cost LLM Essay Scoring
comment: Accepted as a presentation at the EDM 2025 Workshop on Educational Data Mining in Writing and Literacy Instruction
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in automated essay scoring (AES), but contemporary approaches typically employ fixed prompt selection, failing to address operational cost concerns and evolving optimal configurations. We propose a novel cost-aware approach that treats each prompt type as an arm in a multi-armed bandit (MAB) controller, enabling adaptive selection of optimal prompting strategies during inference. Our experiments on IELTS Writing Task 2 essays show that the MAB framework achieves comparable scoring accuracy to exhaustive grid search while reducing LLM calls by 78.4\% to find the best grading approach. We implemented four distinct grading recipes (multi-step vs. single-step assessment, with vs. without calibration examples) and found that the multi-step approach with examples achieves the highest accuracy. By tracking token usage and latency alongside agreement metrics, we produce the first cost-reliability learning curves for essay scoring, providing actionable insights for educational technology platforms that must balance operational costs against assessment validity. This work represents the first application of online control mechanisms to adaptively select prompting strategies in AES, transforming prompt selection from an offline hyperparameter optimization problem into an efficient online learning task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多臂老虎机（MAB）控制器的成本感知方法，用于自适应选择LLM提示策略进行自动作文评分（AES），在IELTS写作任务2上实现了与穷举网格搜索相当的评分精度，同时将LLM调用次数减少78.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自动作文评分方法通常采用固定的提示选择策略，未能解决运营成本问题，也无法适应不断变化的最优配置。因此需要一种能够在推理过程中动态选择最优提示策略的在线自适应方法。
AI.method: 将每种提示类型视为多臂老虎机（MAB）控制器中的一个"臂"，在推理过程中自适应选择最优提示策略。实现了四种不同的评分流程（多步vs单步评估；有无校准示例），并同时跟踪token使用量、延迟与一致性指标，构建成本-可靠性学习曲线。
AI.result: 在IELTS写作任务2上，MAB框架取得了与穷举网格搜索相当的评分精度，同时将找到最优评分方法的LLM调用次数减少了78.4%。其中多步评估并带校准示例的方法获得了最高的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次将在线控制机制应用于AES中自适应选择提示策略的研究，将提示选择从离线超参数优化问题转变为高效的在线学习任务，为需要在运营成本与评估有效性之间取得平衡的教育技术平台提供了可操作的见解。

title: PonderPounce: A Pretrained MLLM as an Episode Context Engine for Robot Control
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate long visual histories, reason under partial observability, and infer behavior from a few examples. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) models generally inherit pretrained representations without using this contextual capacity as episode memory. Memory-dependent policies address this gap through purpose-built history mechanisms. PonderPounce instead reuses an MLLM's native causal context as robot memory. Ponder, a System2 MLLM, accumulates episode observations, demonstrations, and prior cognition in its native causal context and can generate subgoal text and demonstration reasoning for internal use. Pounce, a System1 VLA, receives the current observation, instruction, and proprioception directly; through the Ponder--Pounce interface, it asynchronously receives only the newest continuous cognition token and its age. Both are jointly trained end to end without a purpose-built memory module or separate bridge pretraining. Optimized serving achieves p50 latencies of 78ms for cognition refresh and 25ms for action-model invocation, supporting 20Hz action playback. On RoboMME with base-scale training data, PonderPounce reaches 60.83% with 9B and 50.04% with 0.8B under the same Pounce architecture and interface, versus 44.51% for FrameSamp+Modul and 17.93% for the current-observation π_{0.5}. With 9x data, it reaches 75.54% versus 57.88% for FrameSamp+Modul. On RoboCasa-DC, the same interface learns from action supervision alone and reaches 12.5% versus 11.6% for the strongest published demonstration-conditioned baseline, falling to 8.6% when cognition is replaced by a learned null state.

AI.tldr: PonderPounce是一种无需专门记忆模块的VLA架构，通过复用MLLM的原生因果上下文作为机器人记忆。Ponder（System2 MLLM）在上下文中累积观察、演示和先验认知并生成子目标文本；Pounce（System1 VLA）通过接口异步接收最新的连续认知token。联合端到端训练，优化后认知刷新p50延迟78ms、动作调用25ms，支持20Hz动作播放。在RoboMME上9B模型达到60.83%准确率（vs FrameSamp+Modul的44.51%），9x数据下达到75.54%；在RoboCasa-DC上仅从动作监督学习达到12.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型通常继承预训练表示，但没有利用MLLM的上下文能力作为场景记忆。专门的记忆机制需要为目标任务构建专门的记忆模块，增加了系统复杂性。作者提出复用MLLM原生因果上下文作为机器人记忆，消除对专门记忆模块或独立桥接预训练的需求。
AI.method: PonderPounce由两个组件构成：Ponder是一个System2 MLLM，在其原生因果上下文中累积场景观察、演示和先前的推理结果，并生成子目标文本和演示推理供内部使用；Pounce是一个System1 VLA，直接接收当前观察、指令和本体感受，通过Ponder-Pounce接口异步接收最新的连续认知token及其年龄。两个模型通过端到端联合训练，无需专门的记忆模块或桥接预训练。系统还设计了优化serving策略，实现78ms的认知刷新p50延迟和25ms的动作模型调用延迟。
AI.result: 在RoboMME基准上，使用基础规模训练数据，PonderPounce在9B参数下达到60.83%准确率，0.8B参数下达到50.04%，远超FrameSamp+Modul的44.51%和当前观察π_{0.5}的17.93%。使用9倍数据时达到75.54%（vs 57.88%）。在RoboCasa-DC上，仅从动作监督学习即达到12.5%，优于最强的发布演示条件基线11.6%；当认知被学习到的空状态替换时降至8.6%，验证了认知token的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PonderPounce证明了MLLM的原生因果上下文可以有效地作为机器人记忆，在不需要专门记忆模块的情况下显著提升VLA策略的性能。System1/System2的异步架构设计在推理效率和策略表现之间取得了良好平衡，且在不同规模模型和数据条件下均展现出显著的性能优势。

title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
summary: LLM-based agents execute multi-step tasks, but their behavioral structure remains opaque: long unstructured traces resist the safety auditing and runtime monitoring that deployment requires. Existing approaches operate per-trace or success-only, so they miss the cross-run topology that links next-step and failure prediction. To recover that shared structure, we collapse an entire trace corpus into a single, compact finite-state machine (FSM) that serves as a structural substrate for the otherwise unpredictable behavior of LLM agents. Across twelve public datasets, the FSMs are compact (7-43 states), replay held-out data at >=0.997 fitness with near-identical topology across splits, and build in milliseconds. This substrate addresses both prediction goals. For next-step prediction, FSM-state context outperforms Agent Workflow Memory on every ground-truth-matched dataset. For failure prediction, per-state behavioral features reach held-out AUROC up to 0.94, and an online monitor ranks failing runs above passing ones from a partial trace, triggering early stopping well before completion. Behavioral topology thus appears shaped more by the deployment harness than by the LLM, providing a model-agnostic structural primitive for safety auditing and runtime monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将大规模LLM代理的多步执行轨迹压缩为单个紧凑的有限状态机（FSM），作为代理不可预测行为的结构性基板。实验表明该FSM在12个公开数据集上紧凑（7-43个状态）、可重放（保真度≥0.997）、构建快速（毫秒级），并在下一步预测和失败预测两个任务上均优于现有方法，且发现行为拓扑更多由部署框架（harness）而非LLM本身决定。
AI.motivation: LLM代理执行多步任务时行为结构不透明，长且非结构化的轨迹难以进行安全审计和运行时监控。现有方法仅按单次轨迹或仅考虑成功案例处理，忽略了跨运行（cross-run）的拓扑结构，无法同时支持下一步预测和失败预测。
AI.method: 将整个轨迹语料库压缩为一个单一的紧凑有限状态机（FSM），该FSM作为LLM代理行为的结构基板。FSM提供状态上下文用于预测任务：利用FSM状态信息进行下一步预测，并提取每状态的行为特征用于失败预测。同时实现在线监控机制，在部分轨迹上即可对运行进行排序并提前触发早停。
AI.result: 在12个公开数据集上，FSM保持紧凑（7-43个状态），重放保留数据保真度≥0.997且在不同数据划分间拓扑几乎一致，构建时间仅需毫秒级。下一步预测中，FSM状态上下文在所有匹配数据集上优于Agent Workflow Memory；失败预测中，每状态行为特征达到最高0.94的AUROC，在线监控可从不完整轨迹中区分失败与成功运行并提前触发早停。
AI.conclusion: 行为拓扑更多由部署框架（harness）而非LLM本身塑造，这提供了与模型无关的结构性原语，可用于安全审计和运行时监控，为LLM代理的可部署性建立了新的基础。

title: Names Can Hurt: Spotting Slopsquatting Risks Caused by Package Name Hallucinations in Local Coding LLMs
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/sargamsahu1011/package-hallucination-detector
summary: When a code generating language model fabricates a Python package name, an adversary who has pre-registered that name on PyPI can convert that hallucination into a supply chain compromise. This event has been termed as 'slopsquatting'. We propose a two layer detector to counter this issue. The first layer performs a deterministic PyPI existence check. The second is a Random Forest classifier trained on ten features derived from the package name and its PyPI metadata. An import name reconciler bridges the two, resolving cases such as 'import cv2' versus 'pip install opencv-python' without a security bypass. The detector is embedded in a LangGraph state machine that retries at escalating temperatures and, on repeated failure, routes to a stronger fallback model. Across 300 curated prompts, the pipeline produces hallucination free code on 76% of runs. The primary exhausts its retry budget on 28.7%; intra model retries recover roughly a quarter of those, and cross model fallback recovers a further 16.5% of the remainder. Four findings have been observed. First, half of the flagged hallucinations are packages already registered on PyPI, as low quality lookalikes of well known projects, caught by the classifier rather than the deterministic layer (e.g., pil, faiss, tabula, haystack). Second, hallucination rate scales almost linearly with prompt adversariality, from 0 to 10% on routine coding to 40 to 73% on slopsquat baits. Third, the weaker primary refused 6 of 10 direct baits unaided, suggesting recent instruction tuning provides a baseline defense. Fourth, when primary and fallback share a model family, approximately 84% of primary failures recur on the fallback, motivating cross family pairing. A user study (n = 24) reports mean satisfaction 4.4 out of 5 and 21 of 24 stated adoption intent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双层检测器来应对"slopsquatting"攻击——即攻击者预注册代码生成大模型幻觉出的Python包名，从而将其转化为供应链攻击。方案结合确定性PyPI存在性检查与基于十项特征的随机森林分类器，嵌入LangGraph状态机，通过温度递增重试和跨模型回退提升可靠性。实验表明该管道在76%的运行中生成无幻觉代码，用户研究显示高满意度。
AI.motivation: 当代码生成语言模型捏造一个不存在的Python包名时，如果攻击者提前在PyPI上注册了该包名，这种"幻觉"就会变成真实的供应链入侵渠道（即slopsquatting）。现有模型缺乏对生成包名真实性的验证手段，亟需一种防御机制。
AI.method: 提出两层检测器：第一层对包名进行确定性的PyPI存在性检查；第二层使用基于包名及其PyPI元数据十个特征训练的随机森林分类器。两层之间通过一个导入名调和器衔接（解决'import cv2'与'pip install opencv-python'的映射问题）。检测器嵌入LangGraph状态机，在检测到幻觉时提高温度重试，重试耗尽后路由至更强的回退模型。
AI.result: 在300个精选提示词上，管道在76%的运行中生成无幻觉代码；28.7%的提示词耗尽主模型重试预算，其中模型内重试恢复约四分之一，跨模型回退再恢复剩余部分的16.5%。幻觉率随提示词对抗性从0-10%（常规编码）线性上升至40-73%（slopsquat诱饵）。较弱的模型在无辅助下拒绝10个直接诱饵中的6个。当主模型与回退模型属同一系列时，约84%的主模型失败会复发。用户研究（n=24）显示平均满意度4.4/5，21/24表明采用意向。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：约一半被标记的幻觉包实际上是PyPI上已注册的知名项目的低质量山寨变体（如pil、faiss、tabula、haystack），由分类器而非确定性层捕获；幻觉率与提示对抗性近似线性相关；最近的指令微调提供了基础防御能力；跨模型系列的配对比同系列配对更能降低失败复发的风险，为构建更安全的代码生成管道提供了实证依据。

title: Predicting Radiologist Expertise from 3D Gaze Patterns During CT Interpretation
summary: Accurate interpretation of volumetric CT requires efficient navigation of 3D image volumes and attention to diagnostically relevant regions. While eye-tracking has been widely studied in 2D medical imaging, its use for expertise assessment in CT settings remains limited. We propose a gaze-informed transformer framework for expertise classification in thoracic CT. Using a DINOv2 backbone, radiologist fixation patterns are integrated into volumetric feature learning through (1) a learnable log-space bias in self-attention and (2) gaze-weighted pooling of patch embeddings. We trained and evaluated our approach on 182 CT reading sessions from five radiologists with varying levels of experience. On a held-out test set, the model achieves an ROC-AUC of 0.91 and F1 score of 0.86, outperforming adapted methods. These findings suggest that incorporating visual search behavior into transformers may support objective, process-based expertise assessment in radiology. Code is available via https://github.com/leiluk1/GazeToSkill.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于注视信息（gaze-informed）的Transformer框架，用于胸部CT阅片专家水平的自动分类。利用DINOv2骨干网络，将放射科医生的眼动注视模式整合到体素特征学习中（通过log空间注意力偏置与注视加权池化），在182个CT阅片会话上达到ROC-AUC 0.91和F1 0.86，优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 三维CT影像的正确解读需要高效的体数据导航和对诊断相关区域的关注。眼动追踪在二维医学影像中已被广泛研究，但在CT场景中用于专业水平评估的探索仍然有限。研究者希望利用放射科医生的视觉搜索行为（注视模式）作为客观的过程性指标，实现基于过程的专家水平评估。
AI.method: 提出凝视感知Transformer框架：1）使用DINOv2作为骨干网络提取patch嵌入；2）通过两种机制整合放射科医生的注视固定模式——(a) 在自注意力中加入可学习的log空间偏置（learnable log-space bias）；(b) 对patch嵌入进行注视加权池化（gaze-weighted pooling）。在182个来自5名不同经验水平放射科医生的CT阅片会话上进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上达到ROC-AUC 0.91和F1分数0.86，优于多种适应的基线方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉搜索行为（注视信息）融入Transformer架构可支持客观的、基于过程（process-based）的放射学专业水平评估，为CT阅片专家能力评价提供了新思路。

title: A Drop-in KEM Replacement for Client Signatures in Post-Quantum SSH
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures. Extended version of the paper accepted at IEEE ICNP 2026
summary:
The transition to post-quantum cryptography is reshaping the Secure Shell (SSH) protocol for remote administration. Post-quantum key exchange has been deployed in OpenSSH and is being standardized, while SSH authentication largely remains a signature-replacement effort. This path preserves the familiar public-key credential model, but inherits the size and computation overhead of post-quantum signatures, which can increase latency, traffic, and server-side load. KEM-based authentication offers a natural alternative to this signature-centric path, and SSH makes this especially attractive at the user-authentication layer, which is method-extensible, separated from transport-layer key exchange and host-key authentication, and already protected by the established channel.
  We present a drop-in KEM-based user-authentication method for SSH that replaces client public-key signatures with a session-bound challenge-response proof. The method fits into SSH's existing user-authentication framework, preserving the public-key credential model and enabling incremental deployment alongside existing methods. We provide a reduction-based security argument in the post-quantum ACCE framework, implement the design in OpenSSH using liboqs, and evaluate it under representative RTTs, TCP initial-window settings, and post-quantum migration configurations. Our results show that KEM-based authentication is competitive with compact signature-based authentication under representative network settings, while reducing median handshake latency by up to about 10% against large-signature hybrid baselines. The advantages are clearer when post-quantum signatures stress transmission or computation: median latency under small TCP initial windows falls by up to 7.3% versus ML-DSA and 17.9% versus SLH-DSA, while server-side online cryptographic cost is 59.1% lower than that for ML-DSA in the same NIST category.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于KEM的SSH用户认证方法，替代客户端公钥签名，在保持公钥凭据模型的同时，降低后量子迁移中的延迟和服务器端计算开销，并在OpenSSH中实现和评估。
AI.motivation: 后量子密码迁移正在重塑SSH协议，现有路径主要依赖后量子签名替换，但后量子签名的尺寸和计算开销较大，会增加延迟、流量和服务器负载。论文认为KEM-based认证是签名中心路径的自然替代方案，尤其适合SSH的用户认证层（方法可扩展、与传输层分离、已有加密信道保护）。
AI.method: 提出一种可直接嵌入的KEM-based用户认证方法，用会话绑定的挑战-响应证明替代客户端公钥签名，适配SSH现有用户认证框架，保持公钥凭据模型，支持增量部署。在OpenSSH中使用liboqs实现，并在后量子ACCE框架下提供基于归约的安全论证。
AI.result: 在代表性RTT、TCP初始窗口和后量子迁移配置下评估表明：KEM认证与紧凑签名认证竞争力相当；相比大签名混合基线，中位握手延迟降低约10%；在小TCP初始窗口下，中位延迟相比ML-DSA降低7.3%、相比SLH-DSA降低17.9%；服务器端在线加密成本相比同NIST类别的ML-DSA降低59.1%。
AI.conclusion: KEM-based认证是后量子SSH迁移中签名方案的可行且有竞争力的替代方案，在传输或计算受限场景下优势更为明显，可在保持现有凭据模型的同时实现更优的延迟和服务器性能。

title: AQLoRA: A Zero-Search Recipe for Fast Quantized LoRA Fine-Tuning
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Code and experimental artifacts: https://github.com/Romyull-Islam/AQLoRA
summary:
Quantized fine-tuning (QLoRA) saves memory but not time. It dequantizes every 4-bit weight on the fly, so it trains more slowly than fp16 LoRA. We present AQLoRA (Adaptive-Quantization LoRA), a recipe that buys part of that time back. One CPU pass over the weights sets everything, with no search and no calibration data. The pass ranks layers by NF4 reconstruction error and keeps the top-K in fp16 under a memory budget. Those layers skip dequantization, which is where the speed comes from. A quality setting adapts every layer. A speed setting adapts only the top blocks, so the backward pass stops early. The rule reproduces Unsloth's hand-curated dynamic-4bit selection exactly, in seconds, where search-based allocation needs repeated calibration passes.
  We evaluate on Commonsense-170K across six models and four architecture families, from 1.4B to 14B. The speed setting trains 11.1 +/- 2.7% faster than well-tuned QLoRA and gives up about one accuracy point. It was faster in all nine independent timing sessions, at worst by 7%. The quality setting trains 4.8 +/- 2.4% faster. Its accuracy is level with QLoRA on every model and within a point of fp16 LoRA, for 0.2 GiB more memory. These error bars are measured between independent sessions, not within one. Earning them taught us three rules for timing on shared hardware. Fix the measurement duration, not the step count. Measure the noise floor from a duplicated arm, not a nearly identical method. Repeat whole sessions: a floor computed inside one sweep understates the real uncertainty several times over, and the random seed controls almost none of it.
  We validate the recipe with controls and report the two that failed. Choosing adapter layers by weight density is no better than random. Choosing protected layers by quantization error is not either. The count of protected layers, not their identity, carries the speed effect.

AI.tldr: AQLoRA提出了一种自适应的量化微调方法，通过单次CPU遍历按NF4重构误差对层进行排序，在内存预算下将top-K层保留为fp16以跳过反量化过程，在不损失精度的条件下相比QLoRA提速约5-11%。
AI.motivation: QLoRA虽然节省了内存，但因在训练过程中需要实时反量化所有4-bit权重，导致训练速度慢于fp16 LoRA。现有方法如Unsloth需要手工调优或基于搜索的多次校准，效率低且不稳定。
AI.method: AQLoRA通过一次CPU遍历对权重进行分析，按NF4重构误差对层进行排名，在内存预算约束下将top-K层保持为fp16精度；这些层无需反量化，从而获得加速。提供两种模式：quality模式自适应调整每一层，speed模式仅调整顶部块并在反向传播中提前停止。无需搜索、无需校准数据。
AI.result: 在Commonsense-170K上对6个模型（1.4B到14B）和4个架构家族进行评估。speed模式比调优后的QLoRA快11.1±2.7%，在9次独立计时中全部更快（最少快7%），仅损失约1个精度点；quality模式快4.8±2.4%，精度与QLoRA持平且接近fp16 LoRA（误差在1点以内），仅增加0.2 GiB内存。该规则能在数秒内复现Unsloth的手工动态4-bit选择。
AI.conclusion: 保护层数而非层身份决定速度效果。按权重密度或量化误差选择adapter层/保护层的策略与随机选择无异。此外，论文提出了共享硬件上计时的三条准则：固定测量时长而非步数、用重复臂而非近似方法测量噪声地板、重复完整会话以获取真实不确定性。

title: Coverage Planning for Robotic Tooth Preparation in Densely Constrained Environments
summary: Tooth preparation refers to the controlled removal of tooth structure to create an optimal substrate for fixed restorations and is a core procedure in restorative dentistry. Automating this task is particularly challenging for robots because the dental bur must operate within a densely constrained intraoral workspace, where even sub-millimeter deviations can compromise outcomes or damage adjacent structures. This paper presents a novel robotic system for autonomous full-crown tooth preparation. The proposed framework includes: 1) an anatomy-aware toolpath planning algorithm that conforms precisely to a technician-designed preparation model while protecting adjacent teeth, and 2) a clearance-oriented end-effector yaw assignment strategy that allows intraoral access while reducing the risk of soft-tissue interference. Together, these features enable the robot to accurately mill the irregular tooth surface with an average geometric deviation of 0.117 mm (RMSE), achieving both restoration quality and clinical safety. A series of simulations and phantom-head experiments validate the system's feasibility and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于全冠牙体预备的自主机器人系统，包含解剖感知的刀具路径规划算法和面向间隙的末端执行器偏航分配策略，在仿真和仿真头颅实验中实现了0.117mm的平均几何偏差（RMSE），兼顾修复质量与临床安全性。
AI.motivation: 牙体预备是修复牙科的核心操作，但口腔内工作空间高度受限，机器人自动化面临巨大挑战——即使亚毫米级的偏差也可能导致修复失败或损伤邻牙及周围组织。现有方法难以在如此致密约束的空间中实现精确、安全的自动化预备。
AI.method: 提出一个完整的自主全冠牙体预备机器人框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 解剖感知的刀具路径规划算法，精确贴合技师设计的预备体模型并同时保护邻牙；(2) 面向间隙的末端执行器偏航角分配策略，确保机器人能够在口内受限空间中操作并降低软组织干扰风险。
AI.result: 通过一系列仿真和仿真头颅（phantom-head）实验验证了系统可行性和有效性，机器人能以平均几何偏差0.117mm（RMSE）精确铣削不规则的牙齿表面，同时达到修复质量和临床安全性要求。
AI.conclusion: 该机器人系统成功实现了高精度、安全的自主全冠牙体预备，证明了在密集约束的口内工作空间中自动化牙科手术的可行性，为临床转化奠定了基础。

title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
comment: 38 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Source code at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station and raw agent dialogues, proofs, and verification artifacts at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station_data_v2
summary: We study autonomous mathematical discovery in the Station, an open-world multi-agent environment in which AI agents from different model families pursue a shared research goal without a central coordinator or scripted pipeline. Agents choose their own research directions, conduct experiments, collaborate, and build a shared scientific literature. Across 12 construction problems from the AlphaEvolve catalogue and two additional case studies, the Station obtained results novel relative to the prior literature on five problems: a new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets, new exact 604-point kissing configurations in dimension 11, new records for the discretized Kakeya needle and sign uncertainty problems, and a substantially improved lower bound for Erdős's minimum-overlap problem. Agents also discovered novel infinite families for Book Ramsey numbers. Importantly, the agents produced not only numerical constructions but also theorems and analyses explaining how those constructions work, making the results more interpretable and easier for mathematicians to build upon. We release all raw agent dialogues, proofs, and verification code, providing a transparent record of how these discoveries emerged.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Station这一开放世界多智能体环境中的自主数学发现。在该环境中，来自不同模型族的AI智能体在无中央协调或预编程流程的情况下，自主选择研究方向、进行实验、协作并构建共享科学文献。在AlphaEvolve目录中的12个构造问题及两个额外案例研究中，Station在五个问题上获得了相对于先前文献的新结果，包括新的无限族有限域Kakeya集、11维604点亲吻构型、离散化Kakeya针问题等新纪录，以及Erdős最小重叠问题的显著改进下界。智能体不仅产生数值构造，还生成了解释构造原理的定理和分析，使结果更可解释且便于数学家在此基础上发展。所有原始智能体对话、证明和验证代码均已公开。
AI.motivation: 探索AI智能体能否在开放环境（而非固定流程）中自主进行数学发现，包括自主选择研究方向、协作交流以及产生可解释且经过验证的原创数学成果，而不仅仅是被动执行预定义任务的工具。
AI.method: 构建Station——一个开放世界多智能体环境，其中不同模型族的AI智能体在无中央协调的情况下共享研究目标，自主决策研究路线并开展实验协作；通过12个来自AlphaEvolve目录的构造问题及两个案例研究来评估系统性能，并辅以定理证明和代码验证确保结果可靠性。
AI.result: 在五个问题上取得相对于先前文献的新成果：新的无限族有限域Kakeya集、11维604点亲吻构型的新精确构造、离散化Kakeya针与符号不确定性问题的新纪录、Erdős最小重叠问题下界的显著改进；此外发现Book Ramsey数的新无限族。智能体同时生成了解释构造机制的定理与分析。
AI.conclusion: 开放、自主的多智能体协作系统能够在数学领域产生可验证且可解释的原创发现，其成果远超单一模型或固定流程所能达到的水平，为AI驱动的科学研究提供了透明且可复现的新范式。

title: Investigating Knowledge Transfer Across Interactive Dialogue Games
summary: Dialogue games represent a challenging setting where complex cognitive skills are required to accomplish tasks while coordinating with other players. Considering that language represents an interface for both understanding the game rules and executing actions, it is reasonable to assume that training on a specific language game will enhance specific capabilities that might be relevant for other tasks as well. Motivated by this rationale, in this paper, we investigate how knowledge transfers across different dialogue games. We study transferability by finetuning LLM models on games from the clembench suite (Chalamalasetti et al., 2023) and performing two analyses: i) we derive a task-transferability graph using a binary integer optimization program from Zamir et al. (2018), using task performance as the main metric; and ii) we compute task vectors (Ilharco et al., 2022) for each game to study similarities across finetuned models and their task transferability. In our first analysis, we find that some games benefit more from transfer than finetuning, and that the visuospatial family (e.g., exploration games) transfers best. With our task vector analysis instead, we find that similarity-based approaches capture game-role relationships but almost no transferability patterns, suggesting that more complex metrics are required.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不同对话游戏之间的知识迁移，通过在clembench套件上微调LLM模型，利用二元整数优化程序推导任务迁移图，并计算任务向量来分析模型间的相似性。结果显示部分游戏从迁移中获益超过直接微调，visuospatial游戏家族迁移效果最佳；但基于相似性的任务向量方法只能捕捉游戏角色关系，几乎无法捕捉迁移模式。
AI.motivation: 对话游戏需要复杂的认知技能来同时完成任务并与其他玩家协调，语言既是理解游戏规则的接口也是执行动作的接口，因此假设在特定语言游戏上训练会增强对其他任务也可能相关的特定能力，有必要研究跨对话游戏的知识迁移。
AI.method: 在clembench套件上微调LLM模型，进行两项分析：1) 使用Zamir等人(2018)的二元整数优化程序以任务性能为主要指标推导任务迁移图；2) 对每个游戏计算Ilharco等人(2022)提出的任务向量，研究微调模型之间的相似性及其任务迁移能力。
AI.result: 分析一发现一些游戏从迁移中获益比直接微调更多，visuospatial游戏家族（如exploration游戏）迁移效果最佳；分析二发现基于相似性的方法能够捕捉游戏角色关系，但几乎无法捕捉迁移模式，表明需要更复杂的度量指标。
AI.conclusion: 对话游戏之间存在可迁移的知识，但简单的相似性度量不足以预测迁移能力，需要开发更复杂的指标来理解和预测跨对话游戏的知识迁移。

title: Infant Care Video Dataset for Classification of Interventions Using Transformers
comment: Published in the 11th IEEE International Workshop on Medical Computing (MediComp 2025), part of IEEE COMPSAC 2025. Dataset: https://www.infantcaredataset.org
summary: Healthcare documentation in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) presents significant challenges, with nurses spending approximately 25\% of their time on record-keeping, while up to 60\% of interventions remain undocumented. Motivated by the need to detect interventions from video automatically, we present the Infant Care Video Dataset (ICVD), a collection of 4,144 videos spanning 12 simulated intervention classes designed for developing automated documentation systems. Our manikin-based approach systematically varies conditions, such as camera angle and clinician skin tone, while ensuring privacy compliance. Using video transformer architectures (TimeSformer and MotionFormer), we establish strong baseline performance (93.97\% and 93.17\% top-1 accuracy) among the 12 infant care classes. Our ablation study comparing temporal models with a framewise approach (23.17\% accuracy) demonstrates a 70.80\% performance gap, validating the need for temporal modeling. The ICVD provides a foundation for developing automated documentation systems to reduce clinical burden in neonatal care environments and improve existing practices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了新生儿重症监护室（NICU）婴儿护理视频数据集（ICVD），包含4,144个视频和12个模拟护理干预类别，用于开发自动化文档记录系统。通过TimeSformer和MotionFormer视频Transformer架构建立了强基线（93.97%和93.17% top-1准确率），并证明了时序建模对干预检测的关键作用。
AI.motivation: NICU中护理文档记录存在重大挑战：护士约花费25%的时间用于记录，且高达60%的干预措施未被记录。现有的人工记录方式效率低下且不完整，需要开发自动从视频中检测护理干预的系统来减轻临床负担。
AI.method: 构建了基于仿真人模型（manikin）的ICVD数据集，系统性地变化拍摄角度和临床医生肤色等条件，同时确保隐私合规。采用视频Transformer架构（TimeSformer和MotionFormer）建立基线，并进行消融实验，将时序模型与逐帧（framewise）方法进行对比。
AI.result: TimeSformer达到93.97%的top-1准确率，MotionFormer达到93.17%；而逐帧方法仅获得23.17%的准确率，与时序模型之间存在70.80%的性能差距，充分验证了时序建模的必要性。
AI.conclusion: ICVD为开发NICU自动化文档记录系统提供了基础，能有效减少临床环境中护理人员的工作负担，并改善现有实践。

title: Defending Network Intrusion Detection Systems Based on Graph Neural Networks Against Structural Adversarial Attacks
comment: In Proceedings of 2025 23rd International Symposium on Network Computing and Applications (NCA), Lisbon, Portugal, 2025
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) represent a promising solution for Machine Learning (ML) based Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS), thanks to their ability to leverage both network flow features and topological patterns. While GNN classifiers demonstrate superior robustness against feature-based adversarial attacks compared to other ML detectors, they remain vulnerable to structural adversarial attacks, where an attacker perturbs the underlying network graph topology by injecting edges or inserting nodes. Such attacks pose a realistic and severe threat, undermining the reliability of GNN-based NIDS in practical deployments. While countermeasures have been proposed in the literature, they often rely on assumptions that are unrealistic in real-world cybersecurity scenarios. In this paper, we propose a defense framework based on adversarial training to strengthen GNN-based NIDS against structural attacks. We generate adversarial samples by strategically replacing the source and destination nodes in benign network flows, thereby efficiently mimicking edge injection attacks. We evaluate our approach on two widely used datasets (CTU-13 and TON-IoT) using E-GraphSAGE as the base GNN classifier. Experimental results show that our approach produces hardened detectors with superior detection performance on clean graphs and enhanced robustness against structural adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于对抗训练的防御框架，通过替换良性网络流中的源/目的节点生成对抗样本，以增强基于GNN的网络入侵检测系统对结构对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: GNN在基于ML的NIDS中表现优异，但对结构对抗攻击（如边注入、节点插入）依然脆弱，而现有防御措施依赖不切实际的假设，无法应对现实网络安全场景中的威胁。
AI.method: 基于对抗训练的防御框架：通过战略性替换良性网络流中的源节点和目的节点来生成对抗样本，模拟边注入攻击；以E-GraphSAGE作为基础GNN分类器，在CTU-13和TON-IoT两个数据集上评估。
AI.result: 所提出的防御框架在干净图上保持了优异的检测性能，同时显著增强了对结构对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 这种基于对抗训练的防御方法能够在不牺牲正常检测性能的前提下，有效加固GNN-based NIDS，抵御现实中可能发生的结构对抗攻击。

title: Generating Intervention Hypotheses using Explainable Explanations on Graphs: G2I, a Two-Stage Greedy Framework
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Real-world decision-making in public health and social science can greatly benefit from predictive models, yet translating predictions into effective interventions requires explaining the model behavior. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are well-suited for modeling relational data, existing explanation methods largely operate at the node level and fall short of supporting actionable, network-level intervention design. Existing counterfactual GNN explainers, such as CF-GNNExplainer and CF$^2$, rely on continuous mask optimization over features and edges, which implicitly assume feasible edge manipulation, may allocate effort to immutable or non-actionable attributes, and incur substantial computational overhead. Further, the method of arriving at the explanation itself is difficult to explain to a domain specialist who is not an AI expert. Can simple methods generate good explanations? To explore this, we reframe counterfactual explanation as an intervention design problem. At the local level, we generate counterfactuals via a greedy search that directly identifies minimal, actionable changes to node features and neighbor-level conditions. We derive conditions under which the greedy search provides guarantees, and empirically show that these conditions are approximately met. These counterfactuals are converted into interpretable rules suitable for real-world intervention. At the network level, we formulate intervention selection as a Disjunctive Normal Form (DNF) coverage problem under a budget constraint, which is nondecreasing and approximately submodular, enabling a greedy algorithm with theoretical guarantees. Experiments on synthetic graphs and real-world suicide risk networks demonstrate that our approach produces scalable, cost-effective intervention strategies with significantly improved efficiency over mask-based counterfactual methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于贪心搜索的图神经网络反事实解释方法，将反事实解释重构为干预设计问题，在节点层面生成最小且可操作的干预变更并转化为可解释规则，在网络层面将干预选择建模为有预算约束的DNF覆盖问题，采用具有理论保证的贪心算法求解，实现对mask方法的显著效率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN反事实解释方法（如CF-GNNExplainer、CF²）基于连续mask优化，存在以下问题：隐含假设边可随意操作、可能将优化资源分配给不可更改或不可操作的属性、计算开销大；同时生成的解释难以被非AI领域专家理解。作者旨在探索简单方法能否生成良好的反事实解释，以支持真实世界公共卫生和社会科学中的可操作网络级干预设计。
AI.method: （1）将反事实解释重构为干预设计问题；（2）在局部层面，通过贪心搜索直接识别节点特征和邻居条件的最小可操作变更，并推导贪心搜索提供保证的条件（实验表明近似满足）；（3）将反事实转换为适合实际干预的可解释规则；（4）在网络层面，将干预选择建模为预算约束下的DNF覆盖问题，证明目标函数非递减且近似子模，从而保证贪心算法有理论性能保障。
AI.result: 在合成图和真实自杀风险网络上的实验表明，该方法能生成可扩展、成本有效的干预策略，相比基于mask的反事实方法在效率上有显著提升。同时经验验证了贪心搜索保证条件的近似满足。
AI.conclusion: 简单方法可以生成优质的反事实解释：通过将解释问题形式化为干预设计问题，结合贪心搜索和DNF覆盖公式化，能够在保证理论性能的同时，大幅提升计算效率，并产生领域专家可理解、可操作的解释规则，为真实世界的网络级干预决策提供了实用工具。

title: Robust Slip Detection and Material Classification via Spatiotemporal Transformers on a Uniformly-Illuminated Visuo-Tactile Sensor
comment: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. 8 pages, 10 figures
summary: Tactile sensing is central to robotic manipulation, among which slip detection stands out as a quintessential and critical task. However, existing slip datasets are predominantly limited to binary classification, lacking fine-grained directional perception. To address this limitation, we propose a visuo-tactile sensor featuring customized uniform RGB illumination, alongside a unified perception framework. At the hardware level, the sensor achieves high-precision, sub-millimeter depth reconstruction. Based on this capability, we collect a multi-task visuo-tactile dataset encompassing 15 objects, synchronously generating depth information for each data sample. Algorithmically, we design a dual-head TimeSformer network to process dynamic spatiotemporal slip. On unseen objects, this network achieves robust accuracies of 95.5% and 91.5% for 3-class contact state prediction and fine-grained 8-class slip direction classification, respectively. Furthermore, static tactile-based object class recognition utilizing a ResNet-50 backbone yields an outstanding accuracy of 98.8% across 15 categories. The proposed hardware-software framework provides high-fidelity feedback and a powerful multi-modal perception baseline for complex robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种带有定制均匀RGB照明的视触觉传感器及统一感知框架，用于精细滑移方向感知。传感器实现亚毫米级深度重建，并构建包含15个物体的多任务视触觉数据集；算法上采用双头TimeSformer网络，在未见物体上分别取得95.5%（3类接触状态）和91.5%（8类滑移方向）的准确率，同时ResNet-50在15类物体识别上达到98.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有滑移检测数据集主要局限于二分类，缺乏细粒度的方向感知能力，无法满足复杂机器人操作中对精确滑移信息的需求。
AI.method: 硬件层面设计配备定制均匀RGB照明的视触觉传感器，实现亚毫米级高精度深度重建；基于此构建多任务视触觉数据集（含15个物体，每个样本同步生成深度信息）；算法层面设计双头TimeSformer网络处理动态时空滑移特征，并使用ResNet-50进行静态物体类别识别。
AI.result: 在未见物体上，双头TimeSformer对3类接触状态预测准确率为95.5%，对8类滑移方向分类准确率为91.5%；ResNet-50在15类物体识别上达到98.8%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的软硬件协同框架为复杂机器人操作提供了高保真反馈和强大的多模态感知基线，解决了现有滑移数据集缺乏方向感知的局限。

title: Do LLMs Understand Limit Order Book Dynamics?
summary: A large language model (LLM) trained on synthetic limit order book (LOB) data achieves near perfect scores in generating valid sequences of LOB events. However, the LLM's implicit world model fails to learn the state of the LOB. This deficiency leads to biased estimates and spurious predictability in using the LLM to forecast future LOB events. Our analysis uses novel tests of an LLM's world model, extending prior work from deterministic settings to the stochastic dynamics needed for the LOB.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）在合成限价订单簿（LOB）数据上训练后，虽能在生成有效LOB事件序列方面达到近乎完美的得分，但其隐含的世界模型未能学习LOB的状态，导致在利用LLM预测未来LOB事件时产生有偏估计和虚假的可预测性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在生成有效LOB事件序列上表现优异，但其是否真正理解LOB状态（即世界模型）尚未被验证。本研究旨在揭示LLM在随机动力学环境中的世界模型缺陷，以及这种缺陷对预测任务的影响。
AI.method: 文章提出新颖的LLM世界模型测试方法，将先前仅在确定性设置下应用的世界模型测试扩展到随机动力学环境，以适配限价订单簿的随机特性。
AI.result: LLM在生成有效LOB事件序列方面近乎完美，但其世界模型未能正确学习LOB状态，导致预测结果存在偏差和虚假可预测性。
AI.conclusion: 即使LLM在表面生成任务上表现优异，其隐含世界模型在随机动态环境中可能不可靠，这提醒研究者在使用LLM进行金融时间序列预测时需谨慎验证其内部状态表征的准确性。

title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agent applications often incur high response time. Speculative decoding is a promising solution to improve the inference efficiency of LLM agents without impacting generation quality. However, state-of-the-art speculative decoding algorithms exhibit substantial speed degradation under large batch sizes, limiting their effectiveness to deploy in real-world agent applications. In this work, we first present a systematic analysis of speculative decoding for LLM agents and identify two dominant factors of speedup degradation: high rejection rate of speculative tokens, and under-utilization of dynamic token budgets.B ased on these observations, we propose AgentSpec, a speculative decoding algorithm that addresses the limitations of existing methods for LLM agents. AgentSpec incorporates structure-isolated drafting that constrains speculation to semantically coherent segments of the agent workflow, reducing the drafts of irrelevant semantic paths and achieving an extremely low rejection rate. Moreover, AgentSpec adopts redundancy-aware budget allocation that exploits agent-level information to better utilize the dynamically-free token budget during the agent inference. We implement and evaluate AgentSpec on five different workloads and four different models from four different LLM families in vLLM. Our results demonstrate the superiority of AgentSpec over state-of-the-arts.

AI.tldr: AgentSpec是一种针对基于LLM的智能体应用设计的投机解码算法，通过结构隔离式草稿生成和冗余感知的预算分配，解决了现有投机解码在大批量和智能体工作负载下的速度退化问题，在vLLM中五个工作负载和四个模型家族上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体应用通常面临高响应时延问题，投机解码是提升推理效率的有效方案，但现有最先进的投机解码算法在大批量场景下出现严重的速度退化，限制了其在真实智能体应用中的部署。
AI.method: AgentSpec包含两个核心组件：(1) 结构隔离式草稿生成（structure-isolated drafting），将投机约束在智能体工作流的语义连贯片段内，减少无关语义路径的草稿，实现极低的拒绝率；(2) 冗余感知的预算分配（redundancy-aware budget allocation），利用智能体层级信息更好地利用推理过程中的动态空闲token预算。
AI.result: 在vLLM中对五个不同工作负载和四个来自不同LLM家族的模型进行评估，实验结果证明了AgentSpec相比现有最先进方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: AgentSpec通过识别智能体场景下投机解码速度退化的两个主导因素（高拒绝率和动态token预算利用不足），提出了针对性的结构隔离草稿生成和冗余感知预算分配策略，有效提升了LLM智能体应用的推理效率。

title: Object Counting Across Modalities: Taxonomies, Benchmarks, Applications, and Open Challenges
summary: Object-counting methods have rapidly shifted from class-specific density regression to open-vocabulary, foundation-model-backed counters. These methods now enumerate instances from various visual and textual prompts. While this shift marks major conceptual progress, our survey argues that claims of universal generality have outpaced the evaluative infrastructure. Most progress metrics rely on a few saturated benchmarks that models exploit for statistical regularities. Newly introduced diagnostic datasets reveal systematic failures in semantic grounding, temporal identity, and spatial reasoning with occlusion. To address these failures, we introduce a five-axis taxonomy (modality, mechanism, prompting, supervision level, and generalization setting). We use this taxonomy to audit the literature across application domains, including microscopy, remote sensing, crowd counting, and agriculture. This formalizes prevailing challenges into six structural contradictions. From these, we propose a roadmap for compositional scene understanding, active counting agents, and unified multimodal evaluation protocols. The main imperative is to build a robust evaluation infrastructure to distinguish open-world generalization from benchmark-specific optimization, rather than simple incremental engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文对开放词汇、基于基础模型的物体计数方法进行综述性批判，指出"通用性"的声称已超出现有评估基础设施的能力。作者引入五轴分类法（模态、机制、提示、监督水平和泛化设置）来审计文献，将挑战形式化为六种结构性矛盾，并提出面向组合场景理解、主动计数智能体和统一多模态评估协议的路线图。
AI.motivation: 物体计数方法已从类别特定的密度回归转向开放词汇、基于基础模型的计数范式，但"通用性"的声称与评估基础设施之间存在严重脱节——大多数进展指标依赖少数饱和基准，模型可以利用统计规律"钻空子"；新引入的诊断数据集揭示了语义接地、时间同一性和遮挡空间推理方面的系统性失败。
AI.method: 提出一个五轴分类法（模态、机制、提示、监督水平、泛化设置），以此审计各应用领域（显微成像、遥感、人群计数、农业）的文献，并将挑战形式化为六种结构性矛盾，最终提出路线图。
AI.result: 通过五轴分类法系统审计了跨领域的计数文献，识别出六种结构性矛盾，揭示了当前基准饱和与真实开放世界泛化能力之间的鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 核心要务是构建稳健的评估基础设施，以区分开放世界泛化与基准特定优化，而非进行简单的增量工程改进。未来方向包括组合场景理解、主动计数智能体以及统一的多模态评估协议。

title: Do System Prompts Leave Behavioral Fingerprints? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Clone Detection via Output Similarity
summary: System prompts can be extracted from commercial LLMs with over 80\% success and redeployed at zero cost, yet a prompt owner has no way to verify whether a suspected deployment is a clone. We propose Black-Box Behavioral Fingerprinting (BBF): the prompt owner registers a behavioral signature from model outputs and later tests whether a suspect deployment matches that signature more closely than an unrelated baseline. BBF requires only black-box API access. Through a large-scale study (4 model families, 8 benchmarks, 288{,}000 responses), we find that prompt choice explains 24.4\% of output variance and same-model detection reaches AUC 0.876. Cross-model performance is bounded by detector identity, with off-diagonal AUC ranging from 0.845 (Claude as detector) down to 0.665 (Qwen) and overall mean 0.725. BBF resists non-adaptive prompt paraphrasing (AUC $\geq 0.889$) and is robust to imperfect extraction, but a single-sentence formal-tone prefix can collapse detection on short structured outputs (MNLI 0.978 $\to$ 0.547), isolating style-invariant detection as the key open problem. Diagnostic Query Optimization, a zero-cost query selection rule, adds $+0.120$ to cross-model AUC.

AI.tldr: 提出黑盒行为指纹识别（BBF）方法，通过注册模型输出的行为签名来检测商业LLM的克隆部署，仅需黑盒API访问。大规模实验（4个模型家族、8个基准、288,000条响应）表明提示选择解释24.4%的输出方差，同模型检测AUC达0.876，跨模型AUC均值0.725，能抵抗非自适应提示改写，但对风格不变检测仍存在关键开放问题。
AI.motivation: 系统提示可以从商业LLM中以超过80%的成功率被提取并零成本重新部署，但提示所有者无法验证疑似部署是否为克隆。这构成了知识产权保护的核心盲区，需要一种无需白盒访问的验证手段。
AI.method: BBF（Black-Box Behavioral Fingerprinting）：提示所有者从模型输出中注册行为签名，之后测试可疑部署是否与该签名匹配程度高于无关基线。包含两个关键组件：（1）基于黑盒API的行为签名注册与匹配；（2）诊断查询优化（Diagnostic Query Optimization），一种零成本的查询选择规则。
AI.result: 提示选择解释24.4%的输出方差；同模型检测AUC达0.876；跨模型检测受检测器身份制约，对角线外AUC从0.845（Claude）到0.665（Qwen）不等，总体均值0.725；对非自适应提示改写鲁棒（AUC≥0.889）；对不完美提取稳健；但单句正式语气前缀可使短结构化输出的检测崩溃（MNLI从0.978降至0.547）；诊断查询优化为跨模型AUC增加+0.120。
AI.conclusion: BBF作为首个黑盒LLM提示克隆检测方法，在可操作性、规模和鲁棒性上均展现出实用性，但风格不敏感的检测（style-invariant detection）被识别为关键开放问题——攻击者仅通过单句风格前缀即可规避检测，这为后续研究的优先级和方向提供了明确指引。

title: PuzzleKV: Page-Wise Low-Rank Decomposition for KV Cache Compression
summary: Long-context inference in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly limited by the memory required for the key-value (KV) cache. KV cache compression addresses this problem by reducing the storage cost of previous tokens. Among existing approaches, low-rank compression is particularly attractive because it represents every token in reduced dimensions. Previous low-rank methods typically derive fixed projection spaces from model weights, construct fixed spaces from calibration activations, or construct a shared basis over a broad cache region. Such representations may not capture detailed but important information. We partition each per-head KV cache into fixed-length logical pages and observe substantial low-rank structure within individual pages. Based on this observation, we propose PuzzleKV, a training- and calibration-free method that treats each completed page as an independent compression unit. PuzzleKV decomposes pages within each layer and KV head, computes attention directly over dense and factorized pages, and incrementally compresses newly eligible pages during autoregressive decoding. Experiments across models, context lengths, and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of PuzzleKV under matched storage budgets. At approximately 60% of the original KV cache storage, PuzzleKV achieves more than 96% of Full KV performance across both evaluated models and all benchmark settings, with substantial gains over Global SVD on RULER and competitive performance on LongBench. To achieve a more aggressive compression ratio, PuzzleKV can be further combined with quantization while retaining more than 93% of Full KV performance using only 18.7% of the original storage.

AI.tldr: PuzzleKV是一种无需训练和校准的KV缓存压缩方法，将每个per-head KV缓存划分为固定长度的逻辑页（page），以每页为独立压缩单元进行低秩分解，在约60%的原始存储下达到96%以上的Full KV性能，并可结合量化进一步压缩至18.7%存储仍保持93%以上性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理受到KV缓存内存需求的限制。现有的低秩压缩方法（如基于模型权重、校准激活的固定投影空间，或共享基方法）可能无法捕获局部细节但重要的信息，导致性能损失。
AI.method: PuzzleKV将每个per-head KV缓存按固定长度划分为逻辑页（page），观察到单页内存在显著的局部低秩结构。它将每个已完成的页作为独立压缩单元，在层和头的粒度上对页进行分解，直接对稠密页和因子化页计算注意力，并在自回归解码过程中增量压缩新生成的页。该方法无需训练和校准。
AI.result: 在匹配存储预算下，PuzzleKV在约60%的原始KV缓存存储下达到96%以上的Full KV性能（覆盖两个模型及所有基准设置），在RULER上显著优于Global SVD，在LongBench上具有竞争力。结合量化后，仅用18.7%的原始存储即可保持93%以上的Full KV性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于页级别的局部低秩分解可以有效捕捉全局方法遗漏的细粒度信息，PuzzleKV提供了一种训练/校准免费、可增量压缩的高效KV缓存压缩方案，在压缩比与性能之间取得了良好平衡。

title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
summary: Generative simulation for surgical robotics still lacks real-time interaction. Physical-robot experiments, often involving animal or cadaver labs, are time-consuming, costly, and difficult to reproduce, while classical simulators struggle to capture photorealistic appearance and deformable-tissue dynamics. We address this gap with Cosmos-H-Dreams, an integrated real-time surgical world-model system combining an action-conditioned generative model, a teacher-to-student distillation recipe, and a deployment stack built on the NVIDIA FlashDreams streaming-inference library. Starting from Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, a multi-embodiment action-conditioned surgical video world model fine-tuned on the large-scale Open-H-Embodiment corpus, we post-train this checkpoint on embodiment- and procedure-specific data. By distilling the resulting bidirectional teacher into a causal, few-step student with Self Forcing, we turn a passive video generator into a controllable surgical simulator that streams at $\sim$160 inference FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation GPU. Crucially, Cosmos-H-Dreams is controller-agnostic: any interface that emits a stream of robot kinematics can drive it. We demonstrate live control through a browser keyboard over WebRTC, a Meta Quest headset over WebXR, a commercial surgical robot console such as CMR Surgical's Versius, and learned policies operating in closed loop. To our knowledge, this is the first interactive surgical world model supporting live human and policy control. Human operators and policies alike can act inside the synthesized world and observe the consequences in real time. We release Cosmos-H-Dreams as an open surgical simulation system, providing a common foundation for surgical education, scalable synthetic data generation, and future intraoperative decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cosmos-H-Dreams，一个集成的实时手术世界模型系统，结合动作条件生成模型、教师-学生蒸馏方案和基于NVIDIA FlashDreams的部署栈，在单张RTX PRO 6000 GPU上实现约160推理FPS的流式外科模拟，支持人类操作者（浏览器键盘、Meta Quest头显、CMR Versius手术机器人控制台）和闭环学习策略的实时交互控制，是首个支持人类和策略实时控制的手术世界模型。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人领域的生成式仿真缺乏实时交互能力。物理机器人实验（动物或尸体实验室）耗时、昂贵且难以复现，而经典模拟器难以同时捕捉逼真外观和软组织动态。现有工作无法提供既逼真又可实时交互的手术仿真环境，阻碍了手术教育、合成数据生成和术中决策支持的发展。
AI.method: 整个系统包括三个核心组件：（1）基于Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator（在多embodiment的Open-H-Embodiment语料库上微调的动作条件手术视频世界模型）进行embodiment和手术过程特定数据的后训练；（2）通过Self Forcing蒸馏将双向teacher模型转化为因果few-step学生模型，将被动视频生成器变为可控仿真器；（3）基于NVIDIA FlashDreams流式推理库构建部署栈，实现约160推理FPS的实时流式生成。该系统是controller-agnostic的，任何输出机器人运动学流的界面均可驱动。
AI.result: 系统在单张NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell工作站GPU上实现约160推理FPS的流式外科仿真。成功演示了四种实时控制方式：浏览器键盘（WebRTC）、Meta Quest头显（WebXR）、商用手术机器人控制台（CMR Surgical的Versius）以及闭环学习策略。这是首个支持人类操作者和策略实时交互控制的手术世界模型，用户可以在合成世界中实时行动并观察后果。
AI.conclusion: Cosmos-H-Dreams作为开放的手术仿真系统发布，为手术教育、可扩展的合成数据生成和未来的术中决策支持提供统一基础。它证明了通过生成式世界模型可以实现逼真、实时、可交互的手术仿真，架起了物理仿真和生成式仿真之间的桥梁。

title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace
summary: Concurrent multi-agent coding promises division of labor across modules, robustness through redundancy, and parallel exploration at the natural granularity of multi-file projects. Realtime collaborative editing protocols solve this coordination problem for human teams via Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), but the LLMs underneath generate one token at a time and existing multi-agent coding systems inherit this serial limit: they either sequence agents through phase handoffs or pool independent samples without coordination, and a single agent abandons up to half of hard tasks with a one-file stub-and-exit. AgentRoom is a realtime collaborative editing protocol for concurrent coding agents. Its runtime layer exposes file-level claim, status, and broadcast as MCP tools on a CRDT-merged shared filesystem. Five frontier coding-CLI models ran four backend coding tasks, with cross-language checks in Python DevBench and Rust+axum. For CLI-stable models, AgentRoom with 2 agents abandons fewer tasks than Solo and has less run-to-run variation. At matched-compute, one positive mean LLM-judge contrast puts AgentRoom over parallel-merge. The other contrast, a bundle probe, puts full AgentRoom above each partial case: an ordering rather than a percentage split. Coordination, not parallelism or CRDT-merge, bears the load.

AI.tldr: AgentRoom 是一种面向并发编码智能体的实时协作编辑协议，通过 CRDT 合并的共享文件系统和 MCP 工具暴露文件级声明、状态与广播功能，解决多智能体编码中的串行限制与弃任务问题。实验表明其在任务放弃率、运行间变异上优于 Solo，并在匹配计算量下通过协调机制优于并行合并方案。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体编码系统受限于 LLM 逐 token 生成的串行特性：要么通过阶段交接将智能体串行化，要么池化独立样本而缺乏协调。更严重的是，单个智能体在困难任务中常以"单文件桩代码+退出"的方式放弃任务（最高达一半任务放弃率）。需要一种类似人类团队实时协作编辑的协议来解决此协调问题。
AI.method: AgentRoom 是一个实时协作编辑协议，其运行时层通过 MCP 工具在 CRDT（无冲突复制数据类型）合并的共享文件系统上暴露文件级声明（claim）、状态（status）和广播（broadcast）能力。实验使用五个前沿编码 CLI 模型，在 Python DevBench 和 Rust+axum 上运行四个后端编码任务，并设置跨语言检查。评估包括放弃任务率、运行间变异、LLM 评判对比以及 bundle 探针（全配置 vs 部分配置的次序对比）。
AI.result: 对于 CLI 稳定的模型，AgentRoom 使用 2 个智能体比 Solo 放弃更少的任务，且运行间变异更小。在匹配计算量下，一个正向的平均 LLM 评判对比表明 AgentRoom 优于并行合并方案；bundle 探针则表明完整 AgentRoom 优于各部分配置（呈现排序关系而非百分比差距）。
AI.conclusion: 关键发现是协调（coordination）而非并行性（parallelism）或 CRDT 合并本身承担了主要性能贡献。也就是说，智能体间的协作协调机制是 AgentRoom 收益的核心来源。

title: SAGE: From Direct Answering to Evidence-Grounded Inference for Chinese Ancient Document Understanding
summary: Chinese ancient document understanding demands complex visual, linguistic, and historical reasoning. Current Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) typically rely on an opaque, single-pass generation paradigm, often producing overconfident and weakly grounded responses. To address this, we propose SAGE, an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that reformulates Chinese ancient document understanding as evidence-grounded inference rather than direct answer generation. SAGE coordinates specialized agents for task-aware planning, tool-mediated evidence acquisition, claim-level verification, and bounded replanning under a constrained shared-state runtime. This design supports bounded evidence seeking, answer revision, and abstention when grounding is insufficient. Experiments on the AncientDoc benchmark show that SAGE consistently outperforms matched direct-answering baselines across three LVLM backbones. Remarkably, SAGE with Qwen3.5-9B surpasses much larger monolithic LVLMs on most evaluated metrics, highlighting the importance of structured, evidence-grounded inference beyond model scaling.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个基于证据的多智能体框架，将中国古代文献理解重构为证据基础推理而非直接答案生成，通过协调任务感知规划、工具介导证据获取、声明级验证和有界重规划的专用智能体，在AncientDoc基准上超越直接回答基线和更大规模的单模型LVLM。
AI.motivation: 当前大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）处理中国古代文献理解时依赖不透明的单遍生成范式，常常产生过度自信且缺乏证据支撑的响应。古代文献理解需要复杂的视觉、语言和历史推理，需要更可靠的结构化推理框架。
AI.method: SAGE框架将古代文献理解重构为证据基础推理，通过约束共享状态运行时协调多个专用智能体：任务感知规划、工具介导证据获取、声明级验证以及有界重规划。支持有界证据搜索、答案修订以及在证据不足时选择弃权。
AI.result: 在AncientDoc基准上，SAGE在三个LVLM骨干上均一致优于直接回答基线。使用Qwen3.5-9B的SAGE在大多数评估指标上超过了更大的单体LVLMs，表明结构化、证据基础的推理比单纯扩大模型规模更重要。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、证据基础的多智能体推理范式比盲目扩大模型规模更能有效提升中国古代文献理解性能，为LVLMs在该领域的可靠部署提供了新思路。

title: DDMS: Discriminative Distillation of Multi-view Foundational Features into Single-view Models
summary: Foundational visual features such as DINO have played a critical role across modern computer vision, and have recently become key components in multi-view feed-forward geometry estimators. In this work, we demonstrate that by re-distilling these multi-view models---their internal knowledge of 3D geometry---into a single-view estimator, we can obtain enhanced 3D consistent foundational features. Our key idea is to construct a multi-view teacher by fusing pretrained 2D foundation features with multi-view geometric features, and refining the fused representation with a discriminative ranking objective. Through our discriminative distillation framework, we enforce the learned features to be both 3D consistent and locally distinctive, while keeping them aligned with the feature space of the original foundation model to preserve the semantic structure of the pretrained representation. Consistency and local discriminability are critical for 3D computer vision problems such as forming semantic and geometric correspondences across images. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, we perform comprehensive experiments spanning multiple angles: direct feature analysis, dense prediction transfer, and explicit 3D lifting and rendering. Across these evaluations, our method consistently produces stronger 3D-aware foundation features that improve multi-view consistency and local discriminability while preserving the semantic transferability of the original representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种判别式蒸馏框架，将多视图模型的3D几何内部知识重新蒸馏到单视图估计器中，以获得增强的3D一致基础特征。通过多视图教师融合2D基础特征与几何特征，并用判别排序目标细化，最终特征既保持3D一致性又具备局部区分性。
AI.motivation: 基础视觉特征（如DINO）在现代计算机视觉中至关重要，并已成为多视图前馈几何估计器的关键组件。然而，这些多视图模型内部蕴含的3D几何知识尚未被有效利用来增强单视图基础特征。
AI.method: 首先构造多视图教师模型，将预训练的2D基础特征与多视图几何特征进行融合；然后通过判别性排序目标细化融合表示；最后通过判别式蒸馏框架将教师知识蒸馏到单视图估计器中，同时保持与原基础模型特征空间的对齐，以保留预训练表示的语义结构。
AI.result: 在直接特征分析、密集预测迁移和显式3D提升与渲染等多个角度的综合实验评估中，所提方法一致地产生了更强的3D感知基础特征，提升了多视图一致性和局部区分性，同时保持了原始表示的语义可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多视图模型的3D几何知识蒸馏到单视图特征中，可以获得兼具3D一致性、局部区分性和语义可迁移性的增强基础特征，这对于跨图像语义与几何对应等3D计算机视觉任务具有重要意义。

title: SeriCrypt: An LLM-Driven Context-Aware Serialization Framework for Cryptographic Protocols
summary: Constructing syntactically correct and cryptographically valid message sequences is essential for protocol state machine learning, conformance testing, and fuzzing. Unlike plaintext protocols, cryptographic protocols involve complex cross-message state dependencies and cryptographic computation constraints. Existing automated approaches predominantly target text-based or plaintext protocols, leaving cryptographic message construction largely manual. We present SeriCrypt, an LLM-driven, context-aware serialization framework for cryptographic protocols. It employs a large language model to extract field constraints, state dependencies, and cryptographic computation rules from unstructured protocol specifications into a unified structured intermediate representation, formally characterized by a domain-specific language for cryptographic protocols (CDSL). A protocol-agnostic execution engine parses CDSL declarations, automating field value resolution, cryptographic primitive invocation, and byte-stream serialization. As case studies in protocol security testing, we use the framework to construct violation messages targeting specification-defined security constraints and to support protocol fuzzing, evaluating it on mainstream implementations of TLS 1.2/1.3, IKEv1/v2, SSH, and TLCP. SeriCrypt generated message sequences accepted by all evaluated implementations and completed handshakes in every scenario. Security constraint testing revealed five specification violations, and fuzzing reached deeper protocol states with higher code coverage than mainstream fuzzers under the same time budget, demonstrating the framework's practical value for cryptographic protocol security testing.

AI.tldr: 提出SeriCrypt，一个基于大语言模型的上下文感知序列化框架，用于自动构造语法正确且密码学有效的协议消息序列，覆盖TLS、IKE、SSH、TLCP等主流密码协议，在安全性约束测试和模糊测试中展现优于主流工具的性能。
AI.motivation: 密码协议的自动化消息构造是协议状态机学习、一致性测试和模糊测试的基础，但现有自动化方法主要针对文本或明文协议，密码协议的消息构造仍依赖手工完成，效率低下且容易出错。
AI.method: SeriCrypt采用大语言模型从非结构化协议规范中提取字段约束、状态依赖和密码计算规则，统一转换为名为CDSL的领域特定语言所定义的中间表示；随后由协议无关的执行引擎解析CDSL声明，自动完成字段值解析、密码原语调用和字节流序列化。
AI.result: 在TLS 1.2/1.3、IKEv1/v2、SSH和TLCP的主流实现上，SeriCrypt生成的消息序列均被接受且握手全部完成；安全性约束测试发现5个规范违规，模糊测试在相同时间预算下达到更深的协议状态和更高的代码覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: SeriCrypt证明了LLM驱动的自动化方法能够有效处理密码协议消息构造中的复杂状态依赖和密码计算约束，在协议安全性测试中具有实际应用价值。

title: FlowNeg: GFlowNet-Guided Diverse Hard Negative Sampling for Knowledge Graph Embedding
summary: Negative sampling determines whether a knowledge graph embedding (KGE) model learns from informative counterexamples or wastes updates on implausible corruptions. Uniform negatives are diverse but easy, whereas hard-negative miners concentrate on few entities and collide more with held-out positives. We introduce FlowNeg, a context-conditioned hierarchical generative flow network that amortizes reward-proportional sampling without normalizing a composite reward over the entity set: given a positive triple and corruption side, it selects a type, then an entity. Its terminal reward combines bounded model-based hardness with a training-only structural score for held-out-positive collision, over a relation-specific type-compatible support. We derive the reward, specialize standard trajectory balance, and bound multiplicatively how residual imbalance perturbs terminal and mode probability. Across a descriptive five-seed grid of five architectures and five benchmarks, FlowNeg has higher mean MRR than EMU and than IF-NS in 24 of 25 cells ($+0.0172$ and $+0.0160$ on average). A separate 15-seed FB15k-237/RotatE control fixing negative count, diagnostic budget, and compute gives FlowNeg $0.359\pm0.001$ MRR against $0.346\pm0.002$ for EMU, with near-uniform fixed-partition diversity, high gradient informativeness, and low collision. The evidence supports mode-covering negative generation without treating structural similarity as an open-world truth oracle.

AI.tldr: FlowNeg是一种基于上下文条件的分层生成流网络（GFlowNet）负采样方法，用于知识图谱嵌入（KGE）训练。它通过先选类型再选实体的两级生成过程，实现了无需在实体集上归一化复合奖励的奖励比例采样，在25个架构-基准组合中的24个上超过了现有最先进方法EMU和IF-NS。
AI.motivation: 现有负采样方法存在根本性权衡：均匀负采样虽然多样化但过于简单，难以提供有效学习信号；而硬负样本挖掘虽然聚焦于困难样本，但容易集中在少数实体上，与保留的正样本发生碰撞（即采到被mask掉的真实正三元组），导致模型学习失效。需要在负样本的质量（难度）与多样性/安全性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: FlowNeg采用分层生成流网络：给定正三元组和损坏侧（头或尾），首先选择关系类型，然后在该类型的兼容实体支持上选择具体实体。其终止奖励由两部分组成：有界的基于模型的难度分数（用于硬负样本挖掘）和仅用于训练的结构分数（用于防止与保留正样本碰撞）。论文推导了奖励设计，特化了标准的轨迹平衡（trajectory balance）目标，并给出了残差不平衡对终止分布和模式概率的乘法扰动界。
AI.result: 在5个架构×5个基准的描述性5-seed网格中，FlowNeg在25个单元中的24个上取得比EMU和IF-NS更高的平均MRR（平均分别+0.0172和+0.0160）。在固定负采样数量、诊断预算和计算量的FB15k-237/RotatE 15-seed对照实验中，FlowNeg达到0.359±0.001 MRR，而EMU为0.346±0.002，同时保持了接近均匀的固定分区多样性、高梯度信息量和低碰撞率。
AI.conclusion: 实验证据支持模式覆盖式（mode-covering）的负样本生成策略，并表明不应将结构相似性视为开放世界的真实标签（truth oracle）。FlowNeg证明了通过分层生成流水高效采样奖励比例负样本的可行性，同时兼顾样本的难度和与真实正样本的区分度，为KGE负采样提供了新的方法论方向。

title: CARO: Contact-Agnostic Residual Observation for Zero-Shot Robust Quadruped Locomotion
summary: We propose CARO, a contact-agnostic residual observation framework for policy adaptation. CARO embeds a fixed-base Euler--Lagrange model into the reinforcement learning control loop and constructs a torque-level residual observation without requiring torque sensors, explicit contact estimation, or vision-based measurements of the floating-base position and linear velocity. A disturbance observer extracts a structured signal representing dynamics mismatch, while the policy learns to exploit this feedback for online adaptation. CARO is trained under the same terrain, command, and domain-randomization conditions as the nominal policy, without specialized disturbance curricula or additional adaptation supervision. Nevertheless, it achieves substantially improved zero-shot robustness in simulation and sim-to-real transfer tasks involving out-of-distribution payloads, center-of-mass shifts, terrain geometries, abrupt dynamics changes, and elevated-platform landings.

AI.tldr: 提出CARO（接触无关残差观测）框架，通过将固定基座欧拉-拉格朗日模型嵌入强化学习控制环，利用扰动观测器提取动力学不匹配信号作为残差观测，无需力矩传感器、显式接触估计或视觉测量，即可实现策略的零样本在线自适应，在仿真和仿真到现实迁移中显著提升对分布外负载、质心偏移、地形、突变动动力学和高台着陆的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略在部署时面临分布外动态变化（如负载变化、质心偏移、地形变化等），而现有自适应方法通常依赖力矩传感器、显式接触估计或额外视觉测量，增加了系统复杂性和部署成本。作者希望提出一种无需这些额外传感条件的轻量级框架，使策略能在线感知并适应动力学不匹配。
AI.method: CARO将固定基座欧拉-拉格朗日模型嵌入强化学习控制回路，在力矩层面构造残差观测。通过扰动观测器提取代表动力学不匹配的结构化信号，策略网络学习利用该反馈信号进行在线自适应。训练过程与标称策略使用相同的工况、指令和域随机化条件，无需专门的扰动课程或额外的自适应监督信号。
AI.result: 在仿真和仿真到现实迁移任务中，CARO在分布外负载、质心偏移、地形几何变化、突变动动力学（abrupt dynamics changes）以及高台着陆等场景下，实现了显著提升的零样本鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 动力学模型的残差观测信号足以作为策略在线自适应的有效反馈，CARO展示了在无需额外传感器和复杂训练机制的情况下，仅通过模型嵌入和扰动观测即可实现强大的跨分布鲁棒性，为机器人策略部署提供了一种轻量且实用的自适应方案。

title: Serving Masked Diffusion LLMs: Characterization and Design Principles from Real Hardware
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can in principle generate text faster than autoregressive (AR) models, since they denoise many tokens at once. Recent systems have begun building serving infrastructure for dLLMs, but none first measure how these models behave under real, concurrent serving load. Serving systems built without this grounding risk carrying over assumptions from AR serving that may not hold for dLLMs. We characterize dLLM serving to close this gap, using LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a D2F (Discrete Diffusion Forcing) LoRA adapter on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, evaluated on GSM8K and HumanEval. We report three findings. First, request difficulty, the number of denoising steps a request needs, is discrete rather than continuous: requests fall into 11 fixed step-count levels (178 + 29k), and no signal we test predicts the level before generation starts (best R2 = 0.150). Second, benchmarks with short generation budgets below 320 tokens understate serving variance, since requests are cut off before the latency spread appears. Third, only 24% of single-request wall-clock time is GPU computation; the rest is CPU-side dispatch overhead. Batching mainly helps by amortizing this overhead: sharing one forward pass per denoising step improves throughput by 16.0x at batch size 16 over a per-request-dispatch baseline. We also argue structurally that output quality should not degrade with batch size, stating three assumptions this rests on; we measure 74 to 76% GSM8K accuracy at single-request scale. Finally, we derive a batch-timeout rule for fixed-fill synchronized batching under Poisson arrivals. Together, these results show that serving diffusion language models needs parallelism at the level of each denoising step, which differs from AR serving in how admission and eviction interact with an already shared forward pass.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在真实并发服务负载下刻画了掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）的服务行为，基于LLaDA-8B-Instruct配合D2F LoRA适配器在单张NVIDIA H200 GPU上进行实验。研究发现三个关键结论：请求难度（去噪步数）是离散的且无法在生成前预测；短生成预算的基准测试低估了服务方差；仅24%的单请求墙钟时间是GPU计算，余下为CPU端调度开销，批处理主要通过分摊此开销实现16.0x吞吐提升。文章还论证了输出质量不随批量下降的结构性依据，并推导了固定填充同步批处理在泊松到达下的批超时规则。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（dLLM）在原理上有比自回归（AR）模型更快的文本生成潜力，因为可同时去噪多个token。然而，现有的dLLM服务系统在设计时没有先测量模型在真实并发负载下的行为，导致可能盲目沿用AR服务中的假设（而这些假设对dLLM可能不成立）。作者旨在填补这一研究空白，系统刻画dLLM在实际并发服务场景下的行为特征。
AI.method: 使用LLaDA-8B-Instruct模型配合D2F（Discrete Diffusion Forcing）LoRA适配器，在单张NVIDIA H200 GPU上对GSM8K和HumanEval基准进行实验。通过测量请求难度分布、去噪步数的离散性、生成预算与服务方差的关系、单请求墙钟时间的组成（GPU计算vs CPU调度）、不同批处理方式的吞吐量对比，以及在不同批量下评估GSM8K准确率，来全面刻画dLLM的服务特性。还从结构角度提出输出质量不随批量下降的三个前提假设，并推导了固定填充同步批处理在泊松到达下的批超时规则。
AI.result: 三方面主要发现：（1）请求难度（去噪步数）是离散的，落入11个固定步数级别（178+29k），且生成前无法由任何信号预测（最佳R²=0.150）；（2）生成预算低于320 token的基准测试会低估服务方差，因为请求在延迟差异显现前就被截断；（3）单请求墙钟时间中仅24%是GPU计算，其余为CPU端调度开销；批处理主要通过分摊此开销实现收益，批量16时吞吐量比每请求独立调度的基线提升16.0x。此外，在单请求规模下测量到GSM8K准确率74-76%，与批量无关（基于三个结构假设）。
AI.conclusion: dLLM服务需要在每个去噪步骤层面实现并行化，这与AR服务在准入控制和驱逐机制与已共享前向传播的交互方式上存在本质差异。现有为AR模型设计的服务系统假设不能直接迁移到dLLM，需要重新设计面向扩散模型特性的服务基础设施。

title: Curved Inference II: Sleeper Agent Geometry - Extending Interpretability Beyond Probes
summary:
This paper extends Anthropic's Sleeper Agents research [1], which showed artificial backdoors persist through safety training & can be detected by linear probes with >99% accuracy [2]. However, probe-based detection relies on linear separability that may be an artefact of backdoor insertion rather than a property of naturally occurring deceptive alignment. Sophisticated deceptive behaviours emerging through natural training are unlikely to produce such convenient linear signals.
  We introduce a naturalistic methodology using multi-turn context windows that simulates realistic deceptive reasoning without artificial triggers or supervised backdoor insertion. Rather than binary trigger-response patterns, we examine how semantic complexity emerges through gradual context development.
  Building on our Curved Inference framework, we analyse curvature, salience, & introduce semantic surface area (A'), a new metric of representational work capturing both the magnitude & directional change of meaning construction in unnormalised residual space. Without backdoors, labels, or probes, we apply this framework to naturalistic deceptive prompts & classify model outputs via LLM consensus.
  Geometric structure reliably predicts semantic classification, with statistically significant differences in surface area across five prompt strategies & two model families. Critically, measurement precision can reveal geometric signatures hidden by classification noise - some strategies improve from non-significant (p = 0.555) to significant (p = 0.048). This validates that sophisticated reasoning creates intrinsic geometric patterns that persist even when detection appears to fail, suggesting the shape of inference itself encodes semantic patterns regardless of whether models have learned to suppress linear indicators of deception - a scalable, unsupervised path for detection when linear methods fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于曲率、显著性和语义表面积(A')的新型无监督方法，通过未归一化残差空间的几何特征检测自然语言模型中的欺骗性推理，无需人工触发、监督后门或探针，在五种提示策略和两个模型家族中实现统计显著的分类，即使在线性探针失效的情况下也能通过提高测量精度揭示隐藏的几何信号。
AI.motivation: Anthropic的Sleeper Agents研究显示人工后门可通过线性探针以>99%准确率检测，但这种检测依赖于后门插入产生的线性可分性伪影。自然训练中涌现的复杂欺骗行为不太可能产生如此方便的线性信号，因此需要一种不依赖线性可分性、无需人工触发器或监督后门插入的检测方法。
AI.method: 基于Curved Inference框架，在多轮上下文窗口的自然主义提示（无人工触发器、无监督后门插入）下，分析语义构建过程中的曲率、显著性，并提出新指标——语义表面积(A')，用于衡量未归一化残差空间中意义构建的大小和方向变化。分类通过LLM共识完成，无需标签或探针。
AI.result: 几何结构能可靠预测语义分类，五种提示策略和两个模型家族中表面积差异统计显著。测量精度可揭示被分类噪声隐藏的几何特征——某些策略从非显著(p=0.555)提升到显著(p=0.048)，证明当检测看似失败时几何信号仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 推理本身的形状编码了语义模式，即使模型学会了抑制欺骗的线性指标，几何特征仍然持续存在。这为线性方法失效时提供了一条可扩展、无监督的检测路径，表明欺骗性推理会在未归一化残差空间中留下固有的几何痕迹。

title: LUX: A Lesion-Aware Graph-Conditioned Visual - Language Architecture for Explainable Endoscopic Captioning
summary:
The interpretation of endoscopic imagery in ulcerative colitis is complex and subjective, with variability in human assessment and subtle mucosal inflammation. Although deep learning has advanced automated analysis, most vision-language models rely on global visual embeddings that overlook the localized and relational nature of pathological evidence, limiting clinical reliability and interpretability.
  We introduce LUX (Lesion-aware Unified eXplainable captioning), a graph-conditioned vision-language architecture for explainable endoscopic image captioning. LUX constructs a lesion-centric scene graph from Grad-CAM and CBAM activation maps, representing pathological regions as nodes and encoding their spatial and clinical relationships. These graph embeddings are integrated into the cross-attention layers of a T5 decoder, enabling generated words to attend to specific lesion nodes rather than only to global image features. This provides direct alignment between linguistic content and pathological evidence, supporting token-level interpretability and relational reasoning.
  LUX outperforms strong baseline and state-of-the-art medical captioning models across BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr, with particularly strong gains in CIDEr. It also reduces hallucinated clinical findings and improves lesion-level grounding through stronger correspondence between generated tokens and localized pathological regions.

AI.tldr: 提出了LUX，一种基于图条件的视觉-语言架构，用于溃疡性结肠炎内镜图像的可解释性描述生成。LUX通过构建病灶中心场景图（基于Grad-CAM和CBAM激活图），将病理区域编码为节点并建模其空间与临床关系，再将图嵌入整合到T5解码器的交叉注意力层中，使生成的词能关注特定病灶节点而非仅全局图像特征，从而在多个指标上超越现有模型，并减少临床发现幻觉、提升病灶级接地能力。
AI.motivation: 溃疡性结肠炎内镜图像解读复杂且主观，现有视觉-语言模型大多依赖全局视觉嵌入，忽略了病理证据的局部性和关系性特征，限制了临床可靠性和可解释性。因此需要一种能捕捉局部病灶及其相互关系的可解释性图像描述生成方法。
AI.method: LUX首先从Grad-CAM和CBAM激活图中构建病灶中心场景图，将病理区域建模为节点并编码其空间与临床关系；随后将这些图嵌入整合到T5解码器的交叉注意力层中，使生成的词元能够直接关注特定病灶节点，实现词元级可解释性和关系推理。
AI.result: LUX在BLEU、METEOR、ROUGE-L和CIDEr指标上均优于强基线和现有最先进的医学描述生成模型，其中CIDEr上的提升尤为显著；同时减少了幻觉性的临床发现，并通过生成词元与局部病理区域之间更强的对应关系改善了病灶级接地能力。
AI.conclusion: LUX通过图条件的视觉-语言架构有效解决了内镜图像描述中全局嵌入忽视局部病理证据的问题，在性能提升的同时增强了模型的可解释性和临床可靠性，为溃疡性结肠炎的自动化内镜分析提供了更具临床价值的方案。

title: Who Falls for SMiSh? Learning Through Survey Data Where to Best Target Awareness Training for Mobile Messaging Attacks
summary: As mobile phone adoption has surged, so have scams involving these devices. One such scam, known as SMiShing (or smishing) after Short Message Service (SMS), involves fraudsters sending phishing links via mobile texts. Despite the prevalence of SMiShing, there is a lack of data on who is most vulnerable to these attacks. Prior research on phishing (its email counterpart) suggests that susceptibility may vary by demographic and contextual factors. In two large-scale surveys, we use a previously published simulation method to collect data from representative samples of U.S. adult mobile phone users. Our findings indicate that younger individuals and college students are particularly vulnerable. Participants struggled to correctly identify legitimate messages, with the second study providing comparisons of financial message variants. Researchers, regulators, and telecoms can help users by creating mobile-specific interventions for under-24 and university customers and adding verifications and warnings.

AI.tldr: 通过两项大规模调查，使用模拟方法收集美国成年手机用户数据，发现年轻人和大学生对SMiShing（短信钓鱼）攻击尤为脆弱，且参与者难以正确识别合法信息。
AI.motivation: 手机普及导致SMiShing骗局日益增多，但缺乏关于谁最容易受到此类攻击的受害者群体数据，需要基于人口统计和情境因素识别易感人群。
AI.method: 采用两项大规模调查，使用先前发布的模拟方法，从具有代表性的美国成年手机用户样本中收集数据，比较不同人口统计特征和情境（特别是金融信息变体）下的识别能力。
AI.result: 年轻个体和大学生尤其容易受到SMiShing攻击；参与者在识别合法信息方面存在困难；第二项研究对比了不同金融信息变体的识别效果。
