AI.conclusion: 研究人员、监管机构和电信运营商应针对24岁以下及大学生用户群体制定移动端专属干预措施，并增加验证与警告机制以帮助用户防范SMiShing攻击。

title: UHI-Bench: Benchmarking Dual-Source Urban Heat Island Modeling Across Cities in Diverse Climate Regimes
summary: Urban heat islands (UHIs) are intensifying under climate change, exacerbating thermal exposure risks. Their two primary observations, land surface temperature UHI (LST-UHI) and near-surface air temperature UHI (AirT-UHI), capture physically distinct aspects of urban heat. However, most studies rely on a single source, and substituting one for the other can substantially bias the magnitude and spatial variability of human heat exposure. Accurate UHI modeling also requires dynamic meteorological drivers and static urban morphology features, but spatiotemporal incompatibilities hinder their alignment. Cloud gaps in LST observations and sparse AirT station networks further limit dual-source UHI modeling, motivating cross-city transfer across diverse climates. To bridge these gaps, we introduce UHI-Bench, the first UHI benchmark for dual-source UHI modeling that integrates dynamic and static environmental context. Following a unified signal, mechanism, and transfer framework, it evaluates over 20 baselines from four model families on five tasks across 20 cities and nine Köppen climate classes. Results show that no model is uniformly best, although foundation models remain consistently competitive and stable. Environmental covariates generally improve performance, but their utility varies across sources and tasks. Cross-city transferability is better explained by overlap in UHI regimes than by climate-zone similarity. With the dataset and standardized pipeline, our work provides practical guidance for urban heat modeling, promotes climate data equity, and supports future advances in climate research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UHI-Bench，这是首个面向双源城市热岛（UHI）建模的基准，整合了动态气象驱动和静态城市形态特征，在20个城市、9个Köppen气候带的5项任务上评估了超过20个基线模型，发现没有模型是全面最优的，但基础模型保持稳定竞争力，跨城市可迁移性更取决于UHI机制重叠而非气候带相似性。
AI.motivation: 城市热岛效应在气候变化下加剧，但现有的LST-UHI和AirT-UHI这两种核心观测捕捉物理上不同的城市热方面，大多数研究仅依赖单一数据源，用其一替代另一会显著偏差人类热暴露的量化。同时，双源UHI建模需要动态气象驱动与静态城市形态的整合，但时空不兼容性阻碍了其对齐，云隙和稀疏站点进一步限制了建模，因此亟需一个整合动态和静态环境背景的双源UHI基准。
AI.method: UHI-Bench遵循统一的信号-机制-迁移框架，整合动态气象驱动与静态城市形态特征，在20个城市和9个Köppen气候类别上设置5项任务，从4个模型家族评估超过20个基线模型，系统比较了不同模型在双源UHI建模上的表现、环境协变量的贡献以及跨城市迁移的可解释性因素。
AI.result: 结果表明没有单一模型在所有场景下最优，但基础模型始终具有竞争力和稳定性；环境协变量通常提升性能，但其效用因数据源和任务而异；跨城市迁移性更好地由UHI机制的重叠来解释，而非气候带相似性。
AI.conclusion: UHI-Bench提供了标准化的数据集和处理流程，为城市热建模提供了实用指导，促进了气候数据公平性，并支持未来气候研究的进展。

title: A Durable Vision-Based Tactile Fingertip for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Currently available commercial vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information but remain vulnerable to abrasion and repeated concentrated loading, limiting their use in demanding robotic applications. This work presents a durable tactile fingertip comprising a soft silicone gel with a nonpigmented, textured, thin thermoplastic-polyurethane protective film and a replaceable sensing cartridge. Durability was evaluated using two accelerated laboratory procedures: a rotating-drum sanding test and a repetitive probe test applying 39.2 N (4.0 kgf) at 45 cycles per minute. Under the defined sanding conditions, the developed sensor reached the protective-film rupture endpoint after approximately 2-3 hours. During repetitive probe testing, all nine developed sensors remained functionally usable when testing was discontinued: seven after 5 days, one after 6 days, and one after 8 days. Commercial GelSight Mini and DIGIT specimens exhibited initial surface-film rupture after approximately 24-30 seconds of sanding and 25-35 minutes of repetitive loading. Damage to the developed sensor progressed gradually and produced little interference with tactile imaging at the test endpoints. These observations establish durability improvements of more than two orders of magnitude under the defined accelerated conditions. Combining increased durability, gradual degradation, and rapid cartridge replacement offers a practical approach to maintainable vision-based tactile sensing for demanding robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种耐用的视觉触觉传感器指尖，采用软硅胶+无色素纹理热塑性聚氨酯保护膜+可替换传感卡盒设计。在两种加速磨损测试中，该传感器较商用GelSight Mini和DIGIT在耐久性上提升了两个数量级以上，且损伤为渐进式、对触觉成像干扰小，配合卡盒快速更换实现了可维护的实用化方案。
AI.motivation: 现有商用视觉触觉传感器虽能提供丰富接触信息，但易受磨损和重复集中载荷损坏，无法满足严苛机器人应用场景下的耐用性需求。
AI.method: 设计由软硅胶凝胶、无色素带纹理的薄型热塑性聚氨酯保护膜和可替换传感卡盒组成的耐久触觉指尖；通过旋转鼓式砂磨测试和重复探针测试（39.2 N载荷，45次/分钟）两种加速实验程序评估耐久性能，并与商用GelSight Mini和DIGIT传感器对比。
AI.result: 在所定义砂磨条件下，开发传感器约2-3小时后到达保护膜破裂终点；重复探针测试中9个传感器均在测试终止时仍功能可用（7个5天、1个6天、1个8天）。商用传感器在砂磨约24-30秒和重复加载25-35分钟后即出现表面薄膜破裂。开发传感器损伤渐进且测试终点时对触觉成像干扰很小，耐久性提升超过两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将提高耐久性、渐进式退化与快速卡盒更换相结合的方案，为实现严苛机器人应用中可维护的视觉触觉传感提供了一种实用有效的途径。

title: Generating Biomedical Fact-Checking Reports with RL-Enhanced Agentic Search
summary: Automated fact-checking is essential for ensuring the reliability of public health information, yet the biomedical domain poses unique challenges. Validating biomedical claims requires rigorous interpretation of scientific literature, assessment of retrieved evidence, and comprehensive justification toward the conclusion. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) enhanced by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic search perform automated fact-checking in a retrieve-then-verify paradigm, current methods still output isolated prediction labels, lacking explanatory depth and offers limited utility for human understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce an LLM-based agent named BioCheck Agent that generates structured biomedical fact-checking reports with agentic search. Rather than merely outputting supported or refuted labels, our agent synthesizes final conclusions with retrieved evidence and rigorous analysis. To ensure domain-specific accuracy, BioCheck Agent exclusively searches high-quality scientific literature in PubMed, utilizing advanced Boolean search operators. Recognizing that direct prompting often results in hallucinations and low-quality reports, especially for lightweight open-source models, we further propose the Evidence-Grounded Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO) to perform reinforcement learning on BioCheck Agent with a task-specific reward that incentivizes advanced search behavior and high-quality evidence retrieval while penalizing hallucinations. Our experimental results show that compared to the base model Qwen3.5-4B, BioCheck Agent with EG-GRPO improves label prediction accuracy on SciFact by 9.95%. Furthermore, it achieves a 3.7% higher evidence quality score and a 19.63% lower evidence hallucination rate, demonstrating its ability to generate biomedical fact-checking reports with improved accuracy and quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BioCheck Agent，一个基于LLM的智能体代理系统，用于生成结构化生物医学事实核查报告。它通过RAG与agentic search结合，仅检索PubMed高质量科学文献，并引入EG-GRPO（证据锚定的群组相对策略优化）强化学习方法，在SciFact上相较基线模型Qwen3.5-4B将标签预测准确率提升9.95%，证据质量分数提升3.7%，证据幻觉率降低19.63%。
AI.motivation: 自动化事实核查对确保公共卫生信息的可靠性至关重要，但生物医学领域的验证需要严格解读科学文献、评估检索证据并提供全面论证。虽然LLM结合RAG和agentic search已用于事实核查，但现有方法仅输出孤立的预测标签，缺乏解释深度，对人工理解的使用价值有限。
AI.method: 提出BioCheck Agent：1) 采用retrieve-then-verify范式，仅检索PubMed高质量科学文献，使用高级布尔搜索操作符；2) 不输出简单的支持/反驳标签，而是综合最终结论、检索证据和严格分析生成结构化核查报告；3) 提出EG-GRPO（Evidence-Grounded Group Relative Policy Optimization）强化学习方法，通过任务特定奖励激励高级搜索行为和高质量证据检索，同时惩罚幻觉产生。
AI.result: 与基线模型Qwen3.5-4B相比，BioCheck Agent配合EG-GRPO在SciFact数据集上将标签预测准确率提升9.95%，证据质量分数提高3.7%，证据幻觉率降低19.63%，证明其能生成更准确和更高质量的生物医学事实核查报告。
AI.conclusion: BioCheck Agent通过代理搜索与强化学习的结合，有效解决了生物医学事实核查中解释深度不足和幻觉问题，实验证明其在预测准确性和报告质量上均有显著提升，为生物医学领域自动化事实核查提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: When Less Is More: An Empirical Study of Minimal Responses in Counseling Dialogues and the Behavior of LLMs
comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: In psychological counseling, effective support is not always delivered through long, information-rich responses. Minimal responses, such as backchannel cues and concise empathic statements, help convey attentive listening, express empathy, and encourage clients to continue expressing themselves. However, existing counseling dialogue systems and evaluation frameworks often favor explicit, content-rich replies, overlooking the interactional value of brief counselor utterances. This paper presents a systematic cross-lingual analysis of minimal responses across multiple counseling dialogue datasets. We develop a two-stage filtering method based on utterance length and content, followed by contextual verification using a large language model (LLM). Our analysis shows that minimal responses are common in human-collected datasets but substantially underrepresented in LLM-generated ones. We further evaluate current LLMs in manually curated dialogue contexts where human counselors used minimal responses. The results show that strong commercial LLMs are capable of generating minimal responses when explicitly instructed, but still struggle to determine when such responses are appropriate. Counseling-specific models trained on synthetic data perform particularly poorly, tending instead to produce longer and more information-rich responses. Moreover, LLM-based response-quality evaluation may undervalue minimal responses, even when they are interactionally appropriate.

AI.tldr: 本文对心理咨询对话中的最小回应（如简短共情语句和backchannel提示）进行了跨语言系统分析，发现人工采集数据中最小回应常见，而LLM生成数据中严重缺乏；强商业LLM在明确指令下能生成最小回应，但难以自主判断适用时机，且LLM评估机制会低估这类回应的价值。
AI.motivation: 心理咨询中并非所有有效支持都来自长而信息密集的回应，简短回应（如backchannel线索和简洁共情）可传达积极倾听、表达共情并鼓励来访者继续表达。然而现有咨询对话系统和评估框架偏向显式、内容丰富的回复，忽视了简短咨询话语的互动价值，因此需要系统性地研究最小回应在咨询对话中的表现与缺口。
AI.method: 提出两阶段过滤方法：先基于话语长度和内容进行筛选，再利用大语言模型（LLM）进行上下文验证；随后在人工整理的、人类咨询师使用最小回应的对话语境中评估多个LLM的生成表现，并进行跨语言的多个咨询对话数据集分析。
AI.result: 分析表明：最小回应在人工采集数据中普遍存在，但在LLM生成数据中明显不足；商业LLM在明确指令下能够生成最小回应，但仍难以判断回应是否应使用最小回应；使用合成数据训练的专业咨询模型表现尤其不佳，倾向于生成更长、信息更密集的回应；基于LLM的回应质量评估可能低估互动上恰当的最小回应。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM和咨询对话系统在最小回应的生成能力与时机判断上存在显著不足，且评估框架对最小回应的价值缺乏认识。未来的咨询对话系统需要更好地建模对话的互动层面，训练数据和评估机制也应纳入对最小回应的合理考量。

title: AffineTok: Semantic Affine Consistency for Diffusion-Friendly Visual Tokenizer
summary: Visual tokenizers increasingly inject semantic supervision into latent spaces to make downstream diffusion easier. Yet how these semantics should be organized to facilitate denoising remains underexplored. In this paper, we define the semantic recovery objective: the denoising process should recover the semantic content of the clean image from noisy latent, and a good tokenizer should make it easier. Existing approaches train a projector to predict the semantics directly from the noisy latent. We argue that this predicts the average of clean-image semantics, whereas what really needs to be aligned is the semantics of averaged clean latents. More importantly, we demonstrate that the semantic recovery error orthogonally decomposes into the error of the optimal semantic prediction directly from the noisy latent and the error between these two predictions. We therefore identify their consistency as the missing requirement and call it Semantic Affine Consistency (SAC). To examine whether this overlooked requirement is closely related to downstream generation, we introduce M_SAC, a tokenizer-side proxy for SAC. Across the evaluated tokenizers and diffusion model scales, M_SAC closely tracks generation quality, reaching a Pearson correlation of 0.960 with SiT-XL gFID, thereby motivating SAC-guided tokenizer training. We then introduce AffineTok, which promotes SAC through two complementary, training-only components. Global Semantic Coordination Token (GSCT) coordinates the semantic organization of clean latents, keeping semantic averaging meaningful, while Posterior-Mean Semantic Alignment (PMSA) predicts posterior-mean latents from noisy inputs and supervises their semantics. On ImageNet 256, compared with the baseline, AffineTok reduces gFID by 26% at 20 epochs and, with continued training, achieves a new state-of-the-art gFID of 1.21 without classifier-free guidance and 1.10 with guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义恢复目标（semantic recovery objective），将语义监督引入视觉tokenizer，发现语义恢复误差可正交分解为直接从噪声潜伏预测最优语义的误差与两种预测之间的一致性误差，进而提出Semantic Affine Consistency (SAC)作为被忽视的关键要求，并设计tokenizer端代理指标M_SAC证明其与下游生成质量高度相关（与SiT-XL gFID Pearson相关达0.960）。基于此提出AffineTok，通过全局语义协调Token（GSCT）和后验均值语义对齐（PMSA）两个训练时组件促进SAC，在ImageNet 256上gFID降至1.21（无CFG）和1.10（有CFG），达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉tokenizer将语义监督注入潜空间以方便下游扩散模型的去噪过程，但语义应如何组织以促进去噪尚未被充分探索。现有方法直接从噪声潜伏预测语义，实际预测的是干净图像语义的平均，而真正需要对齐的是平均干净潜伏的语义。作者识别出两者一致性（SAC）是缺失的要求，且该要求与下游生成质量密切相关。
AI.method: 1) 提出语义恢复目标并证明语义恢复误差可正交分解；2) 定义Semantic Affine Consistency (SAC)作为tokenizer设计应满足的一致性要求；3) 引入M_SAC作为tokenizer端代理指标来评估SAC；4) 提出AffineTok，包含两个训练时组件：Global Semantic Coordination Token (GSCT)协调干净潜伏的语义组织使语义平均有意义，以及Posterior-Mean Semantic Alignment (PMSA)从噪声输入预测后验均值潜伏并监督其语义。
AI.result: M_SAC与SiT-XL gFID的Pearson相关系数达0.960，证明SAC与生成质量紧密相关。在ImageNet 256上，AffineTok相比基线在20个epoch时gFID降低26%；经过持续训练，无CFG时gFID达到1.21，有CFG时达到1.10，均为新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了视觉tokenizer中语义组织的一个关键被忽视方面——语义仿射一致性（SAC），并通过代理指标M_SAC验证了其与下游生成质量的强相关性。AffineTok通过训练时组件有效促进SAC，取得了显著的生成质量提升并刷新SOTA，为tokenizer语义监督设计提供了新的指导原则。

title: ICS Cybersecurity Datasets: A Systematic Meta-Review of Coverage, Evaluation Practice, and Structural Gaps
summary: Intrusion detection research in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) heavily depends on public datasets, yet no prior work has systematically assessed whether the collective dataset corpus supports current evaluation claims. This paper addresses this gap through a meta-review of 18 studies between 2019 and 2026, from which 83 ICS, or ICS directly related, cybersecurity datasets are identified, harmonised, and characterised using a unified five-dimensional taxonomy. The taxonomy reveals that the corpus is structurally skewed: 85.5% of datasets concentrate on late-stage OT Disruption tactics, cross-stage IT/OT progression sequences are present in only 8.4% of cases, field-device evidence at Level 0 of the Purdue hierarchy is effectively absent, and operationally sourced data accounts for only 15.7% of the collection. A parallel audit of evaluation practices shows that zero report streaming evaluation, fewer than half apply disciplined train/test partitioning, and only two satisfy reproducibility requirements. Furthermore, a taxonomy-evaluation coupling analysis shows that dataset imbalances constrain the scope and feasibility of several evaluation practices. Based on these findings, we identify three structural imbalances: i) architectural shallowness, ii) progression compression, and iii) cross-domain substitution, and derive a coordinated research agenda which covers cross-stage corpus construction, temporally structured benchmarking, event-level label standards, and governance frameworks for operational data sharing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统元评审，对2019至2026年间18项研究中的83个ICS网络安全数据集进行统一五维分类法标注与表征，揭示数据集语料库存在结构性偏差（如OT破坏性策略集中、跨阶段IT/OT序列稀缺、现场级数据缺失、运营数据占比低），并审计发现评估实践存在流式评估缺失、训练/测试划分不规范和可复现性不足等问题，最终提出三个结构性失衡及相应的协调研究议程。
AI.motivation: ICS入侵检测研究高度依赖公开数据集，但此前没有任何工作系统评估过整个数据集语料库是否能够支撑当前研究的评估主张。这一空白导致研究者可能在缺乏恰当数据支撑的前提下做出过度或失真的评估结论。
AI.method: 对2019至2026年间18项研究进行元评审，从中识别、标准化并刻画83个ICS或ICS直接相关的网络安全数据集，采用统一五维分类法进行分类；同时并行审计评估实践（包括流式评估、训练/测试划分、可复现性），并进行分类法-评估耦合分析。
AI.result: 五维分类法显示语料库存在结构性倾斜：85.5%的数据集集中于后期OT破坏性策略；跨阶段IT/OT推进序列仅占8.4%；Purdue层级第0层的现场设备证据几乎缺失；运营来源数据仅占15.7%。评估实践审计显示：零篇报告采用流式评估，不足半数采用规范的训练/测试划分，仅两项满足可复现性要求。耦合分析表明数据集失衡限制了多种评估实践的可行性与范围。
AI.conclusion: 识别出三个结构性失衡（架构浅层性、进度压缩、跨域替代），并据此提出涵盖跨阶段语料库构建、时间结构化基准测试、事件级标签标准及运营数据共享治理框架的协调研究议程，以指导未来ICS数据集建设与评估实践。

title: Revelation Control
summary: Revelation Control is the problem of choosing priced interventions that reveal hidden state only insofar as the revealed distinctions can change a consequential decision, while accounting separately for any useful progress created by the intervention itself. We develop this theory for learning systems, where states equivalent under declared current information can respond differently to future training and favor different actions. The framework defines decision-sufficient revelation and revelation depth, separates pure information value from productive reuse, embeds static Bayes refinement into state-dependent continuation value, and gives an exact cost-adjusted factorization criterion: an additional shallow coordinate is decision-nonredundant only when states sharing a scalar summary lie on opposite sides of the priced Stop/Continue boundary. We also give a target-independent protocol for model-specific instantiation and prove that bounded stop-flip risk alone cannot certify positive expected utility under unrestricted severity. Across Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3, deeper future-learning probes have positive decision value and productive reuse yields strict equal-compute utility advantages. Qwen additionally provides evidence for a decision-nonredundant shallow revealability regime; in Mistral, a scalar continuation architecture fit only on an independent development panel retains positive familywise-adjusted lower bounds on a disjoint target panel, consistent with scalar decision sufficiency within the tested architecture family and resolution. The evidence supports structural rather than numerical transfer: the decision theory, cost accounting, continuation logic, and evaluation protocol transport, while empirical proxies, coefficients, thresholds, and even the required shallow state dimension may be system-specific.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"揭示控制"(Revelation Control)理论框架，用于选择有代价的干预措施，仅当被揭示的区分能够改变关键决策时才揭示隐藏状态，以解决学习系统中信息揭示的决策价值与成本平衡问题。框架定义了决策充分揭示与揭示深度，并给出精确的成本调整分解判据；跨Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3的实验验证了理论的预测，并揭示决策理论结构可迁移但数值参数因系统而异。
AI.motivation: 在现实学习系统中，揭示隐藏状态（如通过干预或探测）是有代价的，但并非所有揭示出的信息都对决策有价值。现有方法未将"纯信息价值"与"干预本身产生的生产性再利用"分离，也未从决策充分性角度刻画何时需要更深的揭示。作者旨在建立统一理论框架，回答"何时值得支付代价以揭示哪些状态区分"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 建立决策充分揭示与揭示深度理论，定义决策充分性条件；2) 将静态贝叶斯细化的纯信息价值与状态依赖延续价值中的生产性再利用分开核算；3) 推导精确的成本调整分解判据：仅当共享标量摘要的状态位于定价的Stop/Continue边界两侧时，附加浅层坐标才是决策非冗余的；4) 给出目标无关的模型特定实例化协议；5) 证明在无约束严重性下，有界停止翻转风险本身不足以保证正期望效用；6) 在Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3上进行实证验证。
AI.result: 跨Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3的实验表明：更深的未来学习探针具有正向决策价值，生产性再利用带来严格等计算效用的优势；Qwen提供了决策非冗余浅层揭示可达性机制的证据；Mistral中仅基于独立开发面板拟合的标量延续架构在不相交目标面板上保持了正的族系调整下界，与测试架构族和分辨率内的标量决策充分性一致。证据支持结构性而非数值性迁移。
AI.conclusion: 决策理论、成本核算、延续逻辑和评估协议在系统间可迁移，但经验代理指标、系数、阈值甚至所需的浅层状态维度可能是系统特定的。这意味理论上框架具有通用性，但实际部署需要对每个具体系统重新校准数值参数。

title: NeuralParker: A Reinforcement Learning Planner for Irregular Parking Environments
summary: Automated parking commonly assumes marked slots and short approach maneuvers. Delivery and service vehicles, however, may need to reach an operator-specified pose in an irregular bounded environment from a distant start. Existing learning-based parking planners often rely on local observations, which can restrict long-range route reasoning. To address this problem, we present NeuralParker, a reinforcement learning-based hybrid planner for arbitrary-pose parking. NeuralParker encodes full-environment obstacle and boundary geometry in a target-relative vertex representation, allowing the policy to retain route-defining context throughout the approach. It further couples a learned curvature--length arc policy with an in-loop terminal ensemble that selects from diverse cubic Hermite connections using a curvature-regularized cost. We also establish factorial and long-range route-choice benchmarks to evaluate planning success and trajectory quality. Experiments on these benchmarks show that NeuralParker achieves higher planning success and better overall trajectory quality than the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies support the benefits of the target-relative global representation and terminal ensemble. Finally, a real-vehicle evaluation confirms that the planner transfers effectively to real delivery-vehicle perception at a working parking site, planning successfully at low computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuralParker，一种基于强化学习的混合规划器，用于在任意不规则有界环境中从远距离起始位置进行任意姿态的自动停车。通过目标相对顶点全局表示和弧长策略耦合终端集成，实现更高的规划成功率和更好的轨迹质量，并在真实车辆上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动泊车通常假设有标记车位和短距离进场操作，但配送和服务车辆可能需要在不规则有界环境中从远处到达操作员指定的姿态。现有的基于学习的停车规划器往往依赖局部观测，限制了长距离路径推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 采用目标相对的顶点表示编码全环境的障碍物和边界几何，使策略在进近过程中保留路径关键上下文；2) 将学习的曲率-长度弧策略与环内终端集成结合，后者通过曲率正则化代价从多种三次Hermite连接中选择最优方案；3) 建立因子化和长距离路径选择基准用于评估。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，NeuralParker相比评估的基线方法获得更高的规划成功率和更好的整体轨迹质量；消融研究支持目标相对全局表示和终端集成的有效性；真实车辆评估确认规划器能有效迁移到实际配送车辆感知场景，以低计算成本成功规划。
AI.conclusion: NeuralParker通过目标相对全局表示与终端集成的混合规划框架，有效解决了任意姿态远距离停车的具身规划问题，兼顾了全局上下文推理与局部轨迹优化，具备良好的真实世界迁移能力。

title: A Formal Methodological Framework for Auditing Robustness and Fidelity in Explainable AI: From Application to Trust Certification
comment: Peer-reviewed, accepted for publication in the proceedings, and presented at ICAI 2026 (https://icai.uni-eszterhazy.hu/2026/). This is the revised version. The organizers did not send the revision notification to the authors in time, and as a result the paper was not included in the proceedings. 10 pages, 4 tables, 3 figures
summary: SHAP and LIME are now standard tools for interpreting black-box predictions, yet their outputs can vary substantially when the input is perturbed by small amounts of noise--a problem we observed firsthand in our previous work on food security in Madagascar (Ralinirina et al., 2025). This variability raises the question of whether such explanations can be trusted at all. We address it by constructing an auditing protocol that measures two properties of any post-hoc explainer: robustness (how stable the explanation is under input perturbation) and fidelity (whether the features deemed important actually drive the model's prediction). These two quantities are combined into a single Trust Score. We run the protocol on a multi-sectoral dataset from Madagascar (83 features, 253 records, 4 malnutrition classes) using three classifiers and two explainers, plus their regularized counterparts. The results are sobering: models with AUC above 0.99 can produce numerically degenerate or flatly uninformative explanations, and fidelity scores lose discriminative power when the model is overfitted. These findings suggest that auditing XAI outputs is not optional but necessary, particularly when they inform decisions in sensitive domains.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个审计协议，用于量化后验可解释方法（SHAP和LIME）的鲁棒性和保真度，并将两者合并为"信任分数"。在马达加斯加多部门数据集（83特征、253条记录、4个营养不良类别）上，使用三个分类器和两个解释器（含正则化版本）进行实验，发现AUC超过0.99的模型可能产生数值退化或无信息的解释，且当模型过拟合时保真度指标会失去区分能力，表明XAI输出的审计是必要的。
AI.motivation: SHAP和LIME等标准可解释工具在输入受到小噪声扰动时，其输出可能发生显著变化，这引发了对解释可靠性的根本质疑。作者在之前关于马达加斯加粮食安全的研究中亲身观察到这一问题，因此旨在系统性地验证后验解释器是否值得信赖。
AI.method: 设计了一个审计协议，从两个维度评估任何后验解释器：(1) 鲁棒性——衡量解释在输入扰动下的稳定性；(2) 保真度——判断被标记为重要的特征是否真正驱动模型预测。两者结合为一个统一的信任分数（Trust Score）。实验使用了马达加斯加多部门数据集，覆盖3个分类器和2个解释器（SHAP、LIME）及其正则化版本。
AI.result: 结果令人警醒：AUC超过0.99的高性能模型仍可能产生数值退化或完全无信息的解释；当模型过拟合时，保真度指标会丧失区分能力。这表明高模型性能并不保证解释质量。
AI.conclusion: 审计XAI输出不是可选项而是必要条件，尤其是在粮食安全等敏感领域，解释结果会影响实际决策时，更需要对可解释结果的鲁棒性和保真度进行系统性验证。

title: PARTAB: Partition-Aware Reasoning with Structured Evidence for Scalable Table Understanding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in table reasoning, but their effectiveness degrades as tables grow in size and complexity due to irrelevant context and difficulty localizing the evidence required for reasoning. Existing approaches typically reason over either the full table or a single reduced view, which can still obscure important row-column relationships. We introducePARTAB (Partition-Aware Reasoning overTables), a framework that constructs a structured evidence interface between the LLM and the table. PARTAB represents query-relevant evidence as semantically coherent, row-linked table regions and performs hierarchical selection over column groups and row-level partitions before composing the selected evidence for answer generation. We evaluate PARTAB on multiple table reasoning benchmarks, covering question answering, fact verification, and numerical reasoning. PARTAB consistently improves over full-table prompting and several recent table reasoning methods, achieving strong performance on WikiTableQuestions and TabFact while remaining competitive on numerical reasoning. Additional analyses show that semantic partitioning and targeted evidence selection improve evidence localization, substantially reduce the reasoning context, and provide larger benefits on complex tables. These results demonstrate the value of structured, partition aware evidence construction for scalable table reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出PARTAB框架，通过构建结构化证据接口（将查询相关证据表示为语义连贯的、行链接的表区域），并在列组和行分区上进行分层选择，从而提升LLM在大型复杂表格上的推理能力，在多个基准上超越全表提示和现有方法。
AI.motivation: LLM在表格推理上表现良好，但随着表格增大和复杂度增加，性能下降，原因是无关上下文干扰以及难以定位推理所需的关键证据。现有方法要么在完整表格上推理，要么在单一缩减视图上推理，两者都可能遗漏重要的行列关系。
AI.method: PARTAB由三部分组成：(1) 构建结构化证据接口，将查询相关的证据表示为语义连贯、行链接的表区域；(2) 对列组和行级分区进行分层选择；(3) 将选中的证据组合用于答案生成。
AI.result: 在WikiTableQuestions、TabFact等多个表格推理基准上，PARTAB一致优于全表提示和多种近期表格推理方法，在数值推理任务上保持竞争力。附加分析表明，语义分区和精准证据选择改善了证据定位，大幅减少推理上下文，在复杂表格上获益更大。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、分区感知的证据构建对于可扩展的表格推理具有重要价值，为LLM处理大型复杂表格提供了更高效可靠的推理路径。

title: Gen2Physics: Grounding Generated 3D Meshes in Physics via Multi-View Material Decomposition
summary: While state-of-the-art generative models produce high-fidelity 3D meshes, these outputs lack the physical properties required for interactive simulation, gaming, or robotics. We introduce Gen2Physics, a unified and automated framework that grounds generated meshes in physics by automatically decomposing them into their constituent material components. Unlike prior approaches, which focus on volumetric representations incompatible with standard physics engines, Gen2Physics operates directly on meshes to produce immediately simulation-ready assets. Our pipeline integrates a fine-tuned Vision Transformer for dense material segmentation, a robust 2D-to-3D consistency projection, and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) guided refinement that leverages contextual reasoning to assign physical properties and infer internal geometry (solid vs. hollow). By converting surface patches into volumes with distinct densities, our method enables physically plausible dynamic simulations. Experimental results on the ABO-500 and PartNet-Material benchmarks demonstrate that Gen2Physics more than doubles the material segmentation accuracy of prior physics-grounding pipelines (15.6 to 48.3 mIoU), while matching the mass-estimation accuracy of volumetric methods and being the only approach to output watertight per-material sub-meshes.

AI.tldr: Gen2Physics是一个统一的自动化框架，能将生成的高保真3D网格直接转化为可用于物理仿真的资产，通过自动分解网格为物理材料组件，并结合视觉Transformer材料分割、2D到3D一致性投影和VLM引导的物理属性推断，显著提升了材料分割精度（mIoU从15.6提升至48.3），且是唯一能输出水密逐材料子网格的方案。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的生成模型虽能产出高保真3D网格，但这些输出缺乏交互式仿真、游戏或机器人所需的物理属性。先前的方法依赖体素表示，与标准物理引擎不兼容，无法直接用于仿真。
AI.method: Gen2Physics直接作用于网格，集成三个核心模块：(1) 微调的Vision Transformer用于稠密材料分割；(2) 稳健的2D到3D一致性投影；(3) VLM引导的细化，利用上下文推理分配物理属性并推断内部几何（实心vs空心）。通过将表面片转换为具有不同密度的体积来实现物理动态仿真。
AI.result: 在ABO-500和PartNet-Material基准上，Gen2Physics的材料分割精度相较先前物理接地管线提升一倍以上（mIoU从15.6提升至48.3），质量估计精度与体积方法相当，且是唯一能输出水密逐材料子网格的方法。
AI.conclusion: Gen2Physics弥合了生成网格与物理仿真之间的鸿沟，实现了即仿真可用的资产输出，同时兼顾分割精度、质量估计准确性和网格水密性，为游戏、机器人和交互式仿真等下游应用提供了实用解决方案。

title: Research Methodologies for Cybersecurity in Enterprise Environments: A Narrative Review, Synthesis and Executable Guide
summary: Enterprise cybersecurity research draws on a wider range of methods than any single community routinely teaches. Researchers face a selection problem before they face a technical one: a study may simultaneously need a systematic review, a design-science artifact, a controlled detection experiment, an interview study, or an attack-graph model. This paper addresses that problem in two ways. First, it provides a narrative review and synthesis of methodological practices across a verified corpus of 151 works. We organise these practices into eleven methodology families, detailing for each what questions it answers, the strength of its supporting evidence, and its common failure modes. Second, we convert each family into an executable protocol comprising ordered steps, required instruments, evaluation criteria, common validity threats, and a reporting checklist. Every protocol is also visually mapped to make the sequence, decisions, and threats legible at a glance. We also treat contradictions in the literature as evidence. For example, reported rankings of intrusion-detection algorithms are wildly inconsistent across individually careful studies. We argue this pattern is most parsimoniously explained by variations in evaluation design rather than the algorithms themselves, as these studies differ in design dimensions known to shift results by more than the margins separating the algorithms. Ultimately, the evidence supports methodological pluralism disciplined by explicit validity reasoning. We conclude that researchers must match their evaluation design to the decision under study, triangulate technical against organisational evidence, explicitly state the population a result generalises to, and report the conditions under which the result would not hold.

AI.tldr: 本文通过叙事综述151篇企业网络安全研究，归纳出11个方法论家族，并将其转化为可执行的协议（含步骤、工具、评估标准、有效性威胁与报告清单），同时以入侵检测算法排名不一致为例论证方法学差异是结果分歧的主要原因，最终倡导以显式有效性推理为约束的方法论多元主义。
AI.motivation: 企业网络安全研究涉及多种方法论（系统综述、设计科学、受控实验、访谈、攻击图建模等），研究人员在着手技术问题之前就面临方法选择难题，而任何单一学术社区通常不系统教授全部方法。现有文献缺乏对这些方法论实践的系统梳理和可操作指导。
AI.method: （1）对151篇经核验的文献进行叙事综述与综合，将实践组织为11个方法论家族，分别说明其回答的问题、证据强度和常见失败模式；（2）将每个家族转化为可执行的协议，包含有序步骤、所需工具、评估标准、有效性威胁和报告清单，并用可视化映射呈现流程与决策；（3）将文献中的矛盾视为证据，以入侵检测算法排名不一致为例进行解释性分析。
AI.result: 发现文献中入侵检测算法的排名在不同严谨研究中高度不一致，且该不一致无法由算法本身解释，而与评估设计维度差异（其对结果的影响幅度超过算法间差距）密切相关。基于此提出方法论多元主义应由显式有效性推理加以约束，而非依赖单一方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究者应将评估设计与所研究的决策相匹配，将技术证据与组织证据进行三角互证，明确说明结果推广的总体范围，并报告结果不成立的条件。

title: Every Layer Counts: An Exponential $L_2$ Depth Hierarchy for ReLU Networks
summary: We prove a depth hierarchy for ReLU neural networks in which every additional ReLU layer can save exponentially many neurons. For every $\ell\geq 3$, a globally $[0,1]$-valued, $1$-Lipschitz function is realized by a depth-$\ell$ network of width $\mathcal{O}(d^4)$, whereas every depth-$(\ell-1)$ network with unrestricted weights and width at most $2^d/[2d(\ell-2)]$ has squared $L_2$ error at least $1/24$ under an absolutely continuous distribution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first exponential separation for ReLU networks between two fixed depths whose shallower depth is at least $3$, and the first exponential hierarchy across all adjacent fixed depths. The lower bound also immediately yields the corresponding hierarchy for exact computation. Moreover, the case $\ell=3$ gives a compactly supported depth-$3$-versus-depth-$2$ separation with unrestricted shallow-network weights, answering a question raised by Safran, Eldan, and Shamir (2019, Sec. 2.3). The corresponding distribution nevertheless has all its mass at exponential radius, so the construction falls outside the regularity regime in which such a separation would imply major threshold-circuit lower bounds. We also prove an exact separation for a more benign function. It is computed by a polynomial-width depth-$4$ network, whereas every depth-$3$ network agreeing with it on the unit hypercube requires exponentially many neurons in its first hidden layer, again without any restriction on the weights. The function is globally $[0,1]$-valued and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt d)$-Lipschitz, and maps the unit hypercube onto $[0,1]$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了ReLU神经网络在深度上的指数级指数分离：每增加一层深度，可以节省指数数量的神经元。对于所有ℓ≥3，存在一个全局[0,1]值、1-Lipschitz的函数可由宽度为O(d^4)的深度ℓ网络实现，而任何深度ℓ-1的网络（权重无限制、宽度至多2^d/[2d(ℓ-2)]）在绝对连续分布下L2平方误差至少为1/24。这是首次在固定深度（较浅深度≥3）之间建立ReLU网络的指数分离，也是首个跨越所有相邻固定深度的指数层级。此外，ℓ=3情形给出了紧支撑的深度3与深度2之间的分离，回答了Safran、Eldan和Shamir（2019）提出的问题。文章还证明了一个更温和函数的精确分离：多项式宽度的深度4网络可以计算它，而任何深度3网络在单位超立方体上与它一致需要在第一隐藏层有指数多个神经元。
AI.motivation: 理解深度在神经网络表达能力中的根本作用。虽然众所周知深度可以带来表达能力的提升，但此前对于ReLU网络，在两个固定深度（其中较浅深度至少为3）之间还没有指数分离的结果。本文旨在填补这一空白，并回答Safran、Eldan和Shamir在2019年提出的关于深度3与深度2分离的具体问题。
AI.method: 本文通过构造特定的[0,1]值、1-Lipschitz函数来证明深度层级。对于每个ℓ≥3，构造一个可由宽度O(d^4)的深度ℓ网络精确实现的函数，同时证明任何深度ℓ-1网络（无论权重如何，宽度不超过2^d/[2d(ℓ-2)]）在某个绝对连续分布下都无法以低于1/24的L2平方误差逼近该函数。对于ℓ=3情形，构造紧支撑的深度3与深度2分离；对于精确分离部分，构造一个多项式宽度深度4可计算、而深度3需要指数宽度才能精确一致的函数。
AI.result: 建立了首个ReLU网络在固定深度之间的指数分离：深度ℓ网络可以用O(d^4)宽度实现函数，而深度ℓ-1网络需要指数宽度（2^d的量级）才能达到任何非平凡精度。对ℓ=3，给出了紧支撑的深度3对深度2分离（回答Safran等人的开放问题），但该构造的分布质量集中在指数半径处，无法推导出主要的阈值电路下界。此外，还证明了深度4与深度3之间的精确分离：深度4网络用多项式宽度即可精确计算函数，而深度3网络需要指数神经元。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了ReLU网络深度层级理论中的关键开放问题，确立了相邻固定深度之间的指数分离，并证实了深度≥3情况下深度带来的指数级表达能力优势。精确分离的结果进一步表明，即使对于更温和的Lipschitz函数，深度4相对深度3仍具有指数优势，加深了对深度网络中深度-宽度权衡的定量理解。

title: RoG-DAgger: Rollout-Guided Post-Training for End-to-End Driving
summary: Recent end-to-end driving systems demonstrate strong performance on closed-loop benchmarks, yet are still predominantly trained on fixed expert-collected data using open-loop imitation learning. This training-inference mismatch leaves the policy vulnerable in policy-induced states, where accumulated errors can lead to safety-critical failures. A promising post-training approach to overcome this issue is Dataset Aggregation (DAgger), which gathers expert demonstrations in policy-induced states and subsequently fine-tunes the policy on the resulting aggregated dataset. Existing driving DAgger pipelines, however, face three challenges: i) the expert is restricted to a limited trajectory-and-speed solution space, ii) takeover may occur too early or too late relative to impending failures, and iii) privileged expert decisions may rely on information unavailable to the student. To address this, we introduce RoG-DAgger, a post-training framework that uses short-horizon kinematic rollouts to construct high-quality expert demonstrations in safety-critical states. Specifically, RoG-DAgger expands the expert's trajectory-and-speed solution space and evaluates candidate plans through rollout to construct preventive supervision. Moreover, it uses rollout solvability to time the takeover near the estimated point of no return. Lastly, it aligns the expert's field of view with that of the student to provide student-compatible supervision. Across in-distribution (including long-horizon) and out-of-distribution evaluations, RoG-DAgger improves the end-to-end model SimLingo by 5.3 driving-score points and 6.2 percentage points in success rate on Bench2Drive, doubles its driving score from 22 to 44 on Longest6 v2, and improves out-of-distribution success rate from 55\% to 66\% on Fail2Drive.

AI.tldr: RoG-DAgger是一个面向端到端自动驾驶系统的后训练框架，通过短时域运动学滚动推演构建安全关键状态下的高质量专家示范，解决传统DAgger管线中专家解空间受限、接管时机不准以及特权信息不对齐三大挑战，在Bench2Drive、Longest6 v2和Fail2Drive等多个基准上显著提升驾驶评分与成功率。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶系统虽然在闭环基准上表现优异，但通常使用固定专家收集的数据进行开环模仿学习训练，这导致训练-推理不一致问题，使策略在策略诱导状态（policy-induced states）下因累积误差而产生安全隐患。DAOgger虽可作为后训练方案，但现有驾驶DAgger管线存在三个问题：专家轨迹-速度解空间受限、接管时机过早或过晚、特权专家决策依赖学生不可用的信息。
AI.method: RoG-DAgger采用短时域运动学滚动推演（short-horizon kinematic rollouts）构建高质量专家示范。具体包含三个关键设计：(1) 通过滚动推演扩展专家的轨迹-速度解空间，评估候选规划方案以生成预防性监督；(2) 利用滚动推演可解性（rollout solvability）来确定接管时机，使其接近"不可返回点"（point of no return）；(3) 对齐专家的视野（field of view）与学生的视野，提供与学生兼容的监督信号。
AI.result: RoG-DAgger在分布内评估（含长时域）中，将端到端模型SimLingo在Bench2Drive上的驾驶评分提升5.3分，成功率提升6.2个百分点；在Longest6 v2上驾驶评分从22翻倍至44；在分布外评估Fail2Drive上，成功率从55%提升至66%。
AI.conclusion: RoG-DAgger通过短时域滚动推演有效解决了驾驶DAgger后训练中的三大挑战，在分布内和分布外场景中均显著提升了端到端驾驶系统的鲁棒性和安全性，验证了基于滚动推演的示范构建与接管时机控制方法的有效性。

title: Minima-KV: Retention-Preserving KV Cache Compression with Mixed-Format Paged Attention
summary: The key-value (KV) cache is a primary capacity and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context LLM serving. We present Minima-KV, a retention-preserving hierarchy for mixed-format paged attention. Recent and protected Anchor pages remain in FP8, while older non-anchor pages move to packed TQ3; every live-request page remains addressable. Format-specific kernels compute partial attention states and combine them through a globally normalized online-softmax merge, enabling direct heterogeneous decode without a cache-sized dense shadow. Across separate, configuration-bound Qwen3.6-27B profiles on a single 96-GB NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, deployment accounting reports 18.3 KiB of attention KV per live token, corresponding to 3.50x compression relative to BF16 and 1.75x relative to FP8. A materializing quality profile matches its dense control on 16K RULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks. On the same 503-question LongBench v2 set, measured deltas are -0.80, -0.60, and -0.40 percentage points at 16K, 32K, and 64K. A separate single-pair direct-decode canary with two 59,008-token requests measures 3.625x active-KV compression and 0.9821x throughput relative to its control, routes all 16 full-attention layers without fallback, and retains no dense shadow. These results establish a practical mixed-format path for compressing long-context state without evicting live-request KV pages.

AI.tldr: Minima-KV提出了一种保留性的混合格式分层KV缓存方案，新近和受保护的Anchor页保持FP8格式，较旧的非Anchor页压缩为打包的TQ3格式，通过全局归一化的在线softmax合并实现异构解码，在保持质量的同时实现3.5倍于BF16的KV压缩。
AI.motivation: KV缓存是长上下文LLM服务中的主要容量和带宽瓶颈，现有方案无法在压缩KV缓存的同时保留所有活跃请求页面的可寻址性，需要一个能够兼顾压缩率、质量和吞吐的混合格式方案。
AI.method: Minima-KV采用分层混合格式：近期及受保护的Anchor页保持FP8，较旧非Anchor页迁移至打包的TQ3格式；所有活跃请求页面保持可寻址。不同格式的内核分别计算部分注意力状态，并通过全局归一化的在线softmax合并实现直接的异构解码，无需缓存规模大小的密集影子缓存。
AI.result: 在单块96GB NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU上，报告每活跃token仅18.3 KiB注意力KV，相对BF16压缩3.50倍、相对FP8压缩1.75倍。16K RULER needle-in-a-haystack任务与稠密控制质量匹配；LongBench v2上在16K/32K/64K分别仅下降0.80/0.60/0.40个百分点。单对直接解码测试实现3.625倍活跃KV压缩和0.9821倍吞吐率，16个全注意力层均无回退，且不保留稠密影子。
AI.conclusion: Minima-KV为压缩长上下文KV缓存提供了一条实用的混合格式路径，在不驱逐活跃请求KV页面的前提下实现了显著的压缩收益，同时保持了可接受的质量和吞吐表现。

title: MC-CXR: A Multi-Context Chest X-ray Benchmark for Context-Induced Disruption in Vision-Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in clinical pipelines where a chest X-ray is interpreted alongside retrieved reports, preliminary notes, or prior imaging. Existing benchmarks measure whether models answer correctly in isolation, but not whether they preserve a correct image-only decision when plausible context conflicts with the image. We introduce Multi-Context Chest X-ray (MC-CXR), a benchmark of 240 cases expanded into 2,522 instances that isolates context-induced disruption through paired perturbation. Each case fixes the current image and target finding while presenting matched reliable and misleading context across text and prior CXR, with visual overlays where available. MC-CXR defines three task families and two paired metrics, the switch-to-wrong rate and the context-aligned error rate. We evaluate ten VLMs spanning open-source general, medical-domain, and closed-source systems. Image-only accuracy is necessary but insufficient. Mean switch rates range from 45.6-78.1% across misleading textual sources and 35.7-61.7% across misleading visual sources. Among switched predictions, 74.6% align with the misleading label for text versus 17.6% for visual context, a 57.0-point gap (95% CI 50.9-62.8). This text-visual asymmetry is observed under the standardized direct-answer protocol. The dataset is available on PhysioNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MC-CXR基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在胸部X光解读中面对误导性上下文（文本或既往影像）时的鲁棒性，发现现有模型即使图像-only准确率高，也极易被误导性上下文干扰而改变判断，且文本上下文的误导效应远强于视觉上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM基准仅评估模型在孤立条件下的回答正确性，未评估当存在与图像冲突的合理上下文时，模型是否能保持基于图像的初始正确决策。在临床场景中，VLM常需结合报告、初步笔记或既往影像进行解读，误导性上下文可能导致错误判断，这是一个未被系统评估的关键风险。
AI.method: 构建MC-CXR基准：240个病例扩展为2,522个实例，通过配对扰动（paired perturbation）固定当前图像和目标发现，同时提供匹配的可靠与误导性上下文（包含文本、既往CXR及可用的视觉叠加）。定义三个任务族和两个配对指标：switch-to-wrong rate（切换到错误率）和context-aligned error rate（上下文对齐错误率）。评估十个VLM，涵盖开源通用、医学领域和闭源系统。
AI.result: 图像-only准确率是必要的但不充分。误导性文本源的切换率均值为45.6-78.1%，误导性视觉源的切换率均值为35.7-61.7%。在切换的预测中，74.6%与误导性文本标签对齐，而仅17.6%与视觉上下文对齐，文本-视觉差距达57.0个百分点（95% CI 50.9-62.8）。该文本-视觉不对称性在标准化直接回答协议下显著。
AI.conclusion: MC-CXR揭示VLM在临床胸部X光解读中对误导性上下文的高度脆弱性，特别是文本上下文具有更强的误导效应。这强调了对VLM上下文鲁棒性评测和防护的必要性，数据集已在PhysioNet公开。

title: LG-GER: Language-Guided Group Emotion Recognition via Multimodal Evidence Distillation
summary: Inferring the collective emotional state of a group of people from a single image, a task known as group emotion recognition (GER), requires integrating spatially distributed cues such as faces, poses, interactions, and scene context. Current methods rely on detector-driven multi-stream pipelines. These are trained with only image-level supervision that lacks guidance on which regions matter or how strongly each contributes. We propose LG-GER, a language-guided distillation framework that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to generate dense, spatially grounded evidence, i.e., bounding boxes paired with emotion signals and confidence scores, for the training images. This structured evidence is distilled into a single vision-language model (VLM) backbone through four complementary losses: classification, region-text grounding, spatial emotion, and spatial confidence regression. At inference, LG-GER requires no detectors, no MLLM, and no multi-stream fusion, making GER practical for real-time and resource-constrained deployment. LG-GER has been evaluated on two benchmark GER datasets (GroupEmoW and GAF~3.0) and achieves competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art methods that require detection and multi-stream processing at inference.

AI.tldr: LG-GER是一个语言引导的蒸馏框架，利用多模态大语言模型生成密集的空间定位证据（边界框+情感信号+置信度），将其蒸馏到单一视觉语言模型骨干中，实现无需检测器和多流融合的实时群体情感识别，在GroupEmoW和GAF 3.0基准上取得竞争性或更优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有群体情感识别方法依赖检测器驱动的多流流水线，仅使用图像级监督进行训练，缺乏关于哪些区域重要以及每个区域贡献强度的指导（即缺乏空间层面的细粒度监督信号），导致模型无法有效地融合面部、姿态、交互和场景上下文等信息。
AI.method: 提出LG-GER框架，包含两个核心阶段：(1) 使用多模态大语言模型(MLLM)为训练图像生成密集的空间定位证据，即带情感信号和置信度分数的边界框；(2) 通过四个互补损失函数将这些结构化证据蒸馏到单一视觉语言模型(VLM)骨干中，包括分类损失、区域-文本定位损失、空间情感回归损失和空间置信度回归损失。推理时无需检测器、MLLM或多流融合。
AI.result: 在GroupEmoW和GAF 3.0两个基准群体情感识别数据集上，LG-GER取得了与需要检测和多流处理的现有最优方法竞争或更优的性能，同时推理成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: LG-GER证明了通过语言引导知识蒸馏，可以将多模态大模型的空间理解能力压缩到轻量级单一VLM骨干中，在不牺牲准确性的前提下实现高效实用的群体情感识别，适合实时和资源受限的部署场景。

title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly generate code from natural-language prompts, making prompt engineering a key mechanism for shaping the security of generated software. Structured and security-oriented prompts are widely used to encourage safer code, yet their effects extend beyond whether detected weaknesses are simply present or absent. Using 424 security-sensitive Python tasks, we generate solutions with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B under five prompt variants that progressively add structural and security guidance, and evaluate them with Bandit and CodeQL along two axes: generation compliance and security weakness prevalence, severity, and CWE distributions. Structured prompting substantially reduces refusals (e.g., GPT-4o invalid outputs drop from 338 of 424 to 37-52), enabling large-scale analysis, but security-oriented refinements do not consistently reduce overall weakness prevalence. For GPT-4o, stronger prompts primarily redistribute risk: high-severity findings fall (20.8% to 13.6%) while low-severity findings rise (32% to 43.5%); LLaMA shows weaker, less consistent shifts. We also observe security-driven semantic drift, where stricter prompts silently remove or rewrite explicitly requested unsafe constructs. Overall, prompt structure improves compliance but is an unreliable substitute for robust security controls in LLM-assisted development.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用424个安全敏感Python任务，在五种逐步增加结构和安全引导的提示变体下评估GPT-4o和LLaMA 3.1-8B的代码生成安全性与合规性，发现结构化提示显著降低拒答率但安全性改进并不一致地降低弱点普遍性，提示主要重新分配风险而非消除风险。
AI.motivation: LLM从自然语言提示生成代码日益普遍，提示工程成为塑造生成软件安全性的关键机制。结构化且安全导向的提示被广泛用于鼓励更安全的代码，但其效果不仅仅影响弱点的有无，还可能对生成代码的合规性、弱点严重程度和CWE分布产生复杂影响，现有研究对此缺乏系统性量化分析。
AI.method: 使用424个安全敏感Python任务，对GPT-4o和LLaMA 3.1-8B两种模型应用五种逐步加入结构和安全引导的提示变体，生成代码后用Bandit和CodeQL进行静态安全评估，沿着生成合规性以及安全弱点普遍性、严重程度和CWE分布两个维度进行分析。
AI.result: 结构化提示大幅降低拒答率（GPT-4o无效输出从338/424降至37-52），但安全导向的改进并不一致地降低总体弱点普遍性。对GPT-4o而言，更强的提示主要重新分配风险：高严重度发现从20.8%降至13.6%，而低严重度发现从32%升至43.5%；LLaMA表现出更弱且更不一致的偏移。此外观察到安全驱动的语义漂移，即更严格的提示会静默移除或重写明确要求的不安全构造。
AI.conclusion: 提示结构改善了生成合规性，但并非可靠的安全控制替代品。在LLM辅助开发中，不能依赖提示工程来保证生成代码的安全性，需要更稳健的安全保障机制。

title: Partial Optimal Transport on the Circle for All Transported Masses in O(N log N)
summary: Partial optimal transport compares two measures while leaving part of the mass unmatched, which is what makes it robust to outliers, occlusion, and clutter. The quantity of interest is usually the whole profile - the optimal cost at every transported cardinality - because the right amount to transport is rarely known in advance, and on the real line the PAWL algorithm returns that profile in $O(N\log N)$. Much data is periodic rather than linear: angles, phases, orientations, time of day, hue, and every direction obtained by projecting onto a great circle. On the circle the same problem acquires a global circulation, or equivalently an optimized cut, which the naive exact method handles by running the line algorithm once per support gap, at $O(N^{2}\log N)$. We show that this factor $N$ is unnecessary. The line structure survives in cut-free form, and a free-gap invariant supplies, at every step, a cut at which all previous local updates remain valid line updates. This yields PAWC: an exact $O(N\log N)$ time, $O(N)$ memory algorithm returning all $K+1$ costs, nested active sets and plans in one run, together with a single gap that is simultaneously optimal for every cardinality. Slicing over great circles extends it to $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$. Empirically the whole profile costs $0.56$ms at $N=4096$ against $1.5$s for a single transported fraction from a general solver; on occluded, cluttered mpeg-7 shapes, holding the descriptor fixed and varying only the cost, it retains $66\%$ of the clean-data retrieval score against $16\%$ for balanced circular OT, and on $\mathbb{S}^{2}$ it halves the fitting error of spherical sliced Wasserstein against contaminated targets, synthetic and real. Code is available at https://github.com/mint-vu/Partial_Wasserstein_on_Circles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAWC算法，将部分最优传输（Partial Optimal Transport）从实数轴推广到圆上，在O(N log N)时间内精确计算所有传输基数下的最优成本、嵌套活动集与计划，并找到一个对任意基数同时最优的单一切口。通过大圆切片进一步扩展到高维球面S^{d-1}，在遮挡、杂乱数据上展现出显著的鲁棒性优势。
AI.motivation: 部分最优传输因允许部分质量不匹配而对异常值、遮挡和杂乱数据具有鲁棒性。实际应用中通常需要整个成本曲线（profile），线性情形已有O(N log N)的PAWL算法。但许多数据本质上是周期的（角度、相位、方向、一天中的时间、色相等），在圆上该问题的朴素精确解法需要为每个支撑缺口运行线性算法，代价为O(N^2 log N)。本文动机是消除这一额外的N因子，实现圆上部分最优传输的线性对数最优复杂度。
AI.method: 核心思想是证明圆上问题无需通过枚举切口来解决——线结构以"无切口"形式保留下来。作者引入一个"自由缺口不变量"（free-gap invariant），在每一步都能提供一个切口，使得此前所有局部更新在该切口下仍保持为合法的线性更新。基于此设计PAWC算法，以O(N log N)时间和O(N)内存返回所有K+1个成本、嵌套活动集和传输计划，以及一个对所有基数同时最优的单一缺口。算法通过大圆切片（slicing over great circles）扩展到S^{d-1}。
AI.result: 数值实验显示：在N=4096时完整profile计算仅需0.56ms，而通用求解器计算单个传输分数需1.5s；在带有遮挡和杂乱的MPEG-7形状上，固定描述符仅改变代价时，PAWC保留了66%的干净数据检索分数，而平衡圆OT仅保留16%；在S^2上对受污染的合成与实际目标，其拟合误差比球面切片Wasserstein降低一半。
AI.conclusion: PAWC算法以最优的O(N log N)复杂度解决了圆上的部分最优传输问题，消除了圆与线之间不必要的N倍复杂度差距，并通过切片扩展到任意维球面。实验结果验证了其在计算效率和鲁棒性方面的显著优势，为周期性数据、方向数据等高维球面场景下的鲁棒匹配提供了高效的精确工具。

title: Fiber Optic Sensing Glove for High Performance Dexterous Manipulation Capture
summary: Capturing hand pose during dexterous manipulation remains difficult: vision-based methods degrade under occlusion and challenging lighting, while sensorized gloves, though occlusion-free, are prone to drift and magnetic interference and rarely match motion-capture accuracy. We introduce a fiber optic sensing glove for full hand pose tracking that targets these failure modes, using multi-core shape-sensing fibers that capture each fiber's full 3D shape rather than curvature alone. A novel pipeline registers each reconstructed fiber shape to a common hand reference frame, and a new inverse-kinematics solver reconstructs full hand pose at 60 Hz using curve constraints. Benchmarked on a 2-hour dataset of dexterous object manipulation tasks across 5 subjects, the glove achieves 7.2 mm mean fingertip position error against motion capture ground truth, reduced to 4.9 mm by a one-time factory calibration of the fiber routing hub that transfers across users and sessions. These capabilities enable high-fidelity data capture and bimanual virtual teleoperation - both essential to advancing the robotics field.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于光纤传感的智能手套，用于全手位姿追踪。该手套利用多芯光纤形变传感技术捕捉每根光纤的完整3D形状，通过新型注册流水线将光纤形状映射到手部参考系，并采用基于曲线约束的逆运动学求解器以60Hz频率重建手部姿态。在2小时灵巧操作数据集上，平均指尖位置误差为7.2mm，经一次性出厂校准后可降至4.9mm。
AI.motivation: 现有手部姿态捕捉方法存在根本性缺陷：基于视觉的方法在遮挡和光照变化下性能严重下降；而传感手套虽不受遮挡影响，但容易受到漂移和磁干扰，且难以达到动作捕捉的精度。作者旨在解决这些失效模式，实现高保真的手部姿态数据采集。
AI.method: 提出一种光纤传感手套，采用多芯形状传感光纤，能够捕获每根光纤的完整3D形状（而非仅曲率信息）。核心创新包括：(1) 一种将重建的光纤形状注册到统一手部参考系的新型流水线；(2) 一种使用曲线约束的逆运动学求解器，可在60Hz下重建完整手部姿态；(3) 可选的纤维路由集线器一次性出厂校准，可跨用户和会话迁移。
AI.result: 在5名受试者、2小时灵巧物体操作任务数据集上进行基准测试，平均指尖位置误差为7.2mm（相对于动作捕捉真值），经一次性出厂校准后误差降至4.9mm。
AI.conclusion: 该手套解决了视觉方法和传统传感手套在手部追踪中的痛点，实现了高保真数据捕获和双手虚拟遥操作能力，对推动机器人领域的灵巧操作研究具有重要意义。

title: SyPS: Measuring Sycophancy Prompt Sensitivity in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are known to exhibit social sycophancy, often validating or agreeing with users in socially sensitive contexts. Existing evaluations typically measure sycophancy under a fixed prompt formulation, leaving unclear whether such behavior is stable when the same underlying situation is presented with different sycophancy-relevant prompt variants. In this work, we study sycophancy prompt sensitivity: the extent to which changes in user confidence, emotional framing, social consensus, or validation-seeking language alter a model's sycophantic behavior. We refer to our evaluation framework as SyPS, short for Sycophancy Prompt Sensitivity. Building on existing social sycophancy evaluation settings, SyPS constructs controlled prompt variants that preserve the same underlying user situation while varying sycophancy-relevant social cues. We introduce the Sycophancy Prompt Sensitivity Score (SPSS), an instance-level measure of sycophancy variation across paired prompt variants. Unlike aggregate sycophancy rates, SPSS separates baseline sycophancy from prompt-induced shifts, enabling model-level comparisons of robustness to sycophancy-relevant social cues. Empirically, we find that sycophancy prompt sensitivity is socially structured: validation-seeking and emotional-pressure cues often increase sycophancy, whereas counter-framing and anti-sycophancy prompts tend to reduce it. Our framework highlights whether LLMs maintain stable social judgments while adapting appropriately in tone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SyPS框架，用于评估大语言模型在社交敏感场景下对提示词变化的谄媚（sycophancy）敏感度，并引入SPSS指标来量化基线谄媚行为与提示词诱导变化之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型谄媚行为评估通常在固定提示词形式下进行，无法确定当同一底层情境以不同提示变体呈现时，模型的谄媚行为是否稳定。因此需要一种系统的方法来研究谄媚行为对提示词变化的敏感性。
AI.method: 构建SyPS（Sycophancy Prompt Sensitivity）评估框架，在现有社交谄媚评估设置基础上，构造保持底层用户情境不变但变化谄媚相关社交线索（如用户置信度、情绪框架、社会共识、寻求验证语言）的成对提示变体。引入Sycophancy Prompt Sensitivity Score (SPSS)作为实例级度量，对成对提示变体间的谄媚变化进行量化，从而将基线谄媚与提示词诱导的谄媚偏移分离。
AI.result: 实证发现谄媚提示敏感度具有社会结构性：寻求验证和情绪压力线索通常增加谄媚行为，而反向框架和反谄媚提示则倾向于减少谄媚行为。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示了LLM在社交判断上是否保持稳定，同时能否在语气上适当适应的能力，为模型级鲁棒性比较提供了新工具。

title: TrustDABench: Benchmarking Reliability and Robustness of LLMs for Structured Data Analysis
summary: LLMs are increasingly used to analyze spreadsheets, CSV files, and other structured data, but producing a correct-looking answer is not the same as producing a trustworthy analysis. A trustworthy result should be supported by a valid path from the user question to the relevant data evidence. This requirement creates two diagnostic questions: whether an LLM can refuse to answer or ask for clarification when such a path does not exist, and whether it can preserve the correct analysis when the same evidence is expressed in different table forms. We introduce TrustDABench, a benchmark that operationalizes these questions as reliability and robustness. Starting from the evidence-path view, we derive 19 perturbation operators and instantiate them through an Agentic-LLM-based generation framework. TrustDABench contains 2,340 human-verified perturbed instances, and we evaluate eight representative LLMs. The results show substantial headroom: the best reliability result is only 24.21% average MRS, achieved by GPT-5.5, while the best robustness result still has 9.10% average ASR, achieved by Claude-Sonnet-5. The failures are systematic: models rarely detect conflicting evidence, often continue along executable but unsupported analysis paths, and remain sensitive to perturbations that change observation boundaries or cross-table relations. These findings suggest that stronger evidence-boundary recognition and representation-invariant reasoning are still needed for reliable structured-data analysis.

AI.tldr: TrustDABench是一个用于评估LLM在结构化数据分析中可靠性和鲁棒性的基准测试，包含2,340个扰动实例，结果显示最优模型可靠性仅24.21%（GPT-5.5），鲁棒性仅9.10%（Claude-Sonnet-5），表明LLM在证据边界识别和表示不变推理方面仍有显著提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在分析电子表格、CSV等结构化数据时，生成"看起来正确"的答案并不等同于值得信赖的分析。可信的分析结果需要从用户问题到相关数据证据的有效路径，但现有基准缺乏对LLM在无有效路径时拒绝回答或请求澄清，以及相同证据在不同表格形式下保持一致分析的能力的诊断。
AI.method: 提出TrustDABench基准，从证据路径视角出发推导出19个扰动算子，并通过基于Agentic-LLM的生成框架进行实例化，构建了2,340个人工验证的扰动实例，对8个代表性LLM进行系统性评估。
AI.result: 最优可靠性结果仅为24.21%平均MRS（由GPT-5.5取得），最优鲁棒性结果仅为9.10%平均ASR（由Claude-Sonnet-5取得）。模型的失败具有系统性：很少检测到冲突证据，经常沿可执行但缺乏支持的路径继续分析，且对改变观测边界或跨表关系的扰动依然敏感。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在结构化数据分析中仍缺乏可靠的证据边界识别能力和表示不变推理能力，需要更强的证据边界识别与表示不变推理机制来实现可信的结构化数据分析。

title: Continual Visual Learning under Evolving Semantic Concept Shift
summary: Visual foundation models are commonly adapted under the assumption that the appearance of incoming data may change while the semantic meaning of the prediction task remains fixed. In long-lived visual systems, however, taxonomies, policies, and concept definitions can themselves evolve, causing the same visual evidence to require a different interpretation. We study this setting as evolving semantic concept shift and introduce SemReWrite, a framework for selectively updating obsolete visual--semantic mappings while preserving knowledge that remains valid. SemReWrite represents changes between old and revised semantic specifications, combines semantic discrepancy with sparse revised supervision to localize affected visual regions, and uses an input-dependent low-rank rewriting mechanism together with structured semantic memory, preservation, and obsolete-decision suppression. We further introduce EvoShift-Bench, spanning ImageNet, iNaturalist, CUB-200-2011, and DomainNet, with semantic transitions including class split, merge, boundary revision, insertion, partial redefinition, recurrence, and mixed semantic--appearance shift. To explicitly evaluate selective semantic revision, we introduce Rewrite Accuracy (RA) and Preservation Accuracy (PA) for affected and unaffected regions, respectively, Obsolete Retention (OR) for measuring residual outdated semantic associations, and the Selective Revision Score (SRS), which jointly summarizes rewriting and preservation performance. Experiments show that SemReWrite achieves a stronger balance between learning revised semantics and retaining unaffected knowledge than prompt replacement, conventional fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, and continual-learning strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemReWrite框架，用于应对视觉基础模型在面对语义概念漂移（如分类体系、政策、概念定义随时间演化）时的选择性语义重写问题，并引入EvoShift-Bench基准和新的评价指标，实验验证其优于现有适配方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型的适配方法假设输入数据外观可能变化但预测任务的语义含义固定不变。然而在长期运行的视觉系统中，分类体系、策略和概念定义本身会演化，导致相同的视觉证据需要不同的解释。这种"演化语义概念漂移"尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: SemReWrite包含以下核心组件：(1) 表示新旧语义规范之间的变化；(2) 结合语义差异与稀疏修订监督来定位受影响的视觉区域；(3) 使用输入依赖的低秩重写机制；(4) 结合结构化语义记忆、知识保留和过时决策抑制。还构建了EvoShift-Bench基准，涵盖多种语义转换类型。
AI.result: 实验表明SemReWrite在学习修订语义与保留未受影响知识之间的平衡上，优于提示替换、传统微调、参数高效适配和持续学习等基线方法。引入的评价指标包括Rewrite Accuracy (RA)、Preservation Accuracy (PA)、Obsolete Retention (OR)和Selective Revision Score (SRS)。
AI.conclusion: SemReWrite能够实现对演化的视觉-语义映射的选择性更新，同时保留仍然有效的知识，为长期视觉系统中的语义漂移问题提供了有效的解决框架。

title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables. Interactive demo: https://semantic-overlays.vercel.app. Code and released adapters: https://github.com/JoshuaSP/semantic-overlays
summary: Everything a language model sees is tokens. The serving stack knows what each span is -- user input, tool output, instructions -- but the model must keep track of that itself, and it can lose track or be confused: text can be written to read like anything. Prompt injection is a natural exploit of this phenomenon. By scrambling the model's understanding of span identity, an attacker can induce unwanted and potentially dangerous actions. Adding a non-textual channel to the model's input -- a way to communicate span identity beyond text -- mitigates this class of attack. We thus introduce a general steering technique called Semantic Overlays: small learned adapters applied at chosen prefill positions to a frozen model's residual stream. Laying an overlay over a span creates an out-of-band annotation channel that cannot be replicated by tokens. Unlike steering vectors, Semantic Overlays are trained, adaptable, and selectively applied. An overlay can encode complex semantics that reshape how the model perceives the marked span: asked to copy a code snippet under an overlay asserting that it is in a different programming language than it is, the model rewrites the snippet, faithfully, in the asserted language. Overlays are also composable, allow for transparent reading of underlying content, and can carry complex payloads -- including imperatives that the model will follow. An overlay which marks a span as "non-executable" defends against the broad class of prompt injections that add instructions in untrusted context. We report strong results on prompt injection benchmarks: SEP separation rises from 24.3% to 96.5% with utility unchanged (our scoring rule; we also correct a defect in the published grader), TensorTrust attack success rate falls from 34.8% to 6.6%, and all four PIArena attack families drop to 0% compliance, all while marked spans stay readable (92.5% exact copy rate).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Semantic Overlays，一种在冻结模型的残差流上施加小型可学习适配器的通用引导技术，为给定文本跨度（span）创建带外（out-of-band）的语义标注通道。该技术通过在指定prefill位置应用适配器来标记跨度身份，使模型无法通过token纯文本伪装该信息，从而缓解提示注入类攻击。实验表明该方法在多个提示注入基准上大幅提升防御效果（如SEP分离率从24.3%提升至96.5%），同时保持标记跨度可读性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型仅能感知token，而服务堆栈知道每个跨度的语义身份（用户输入、工具输出、指令等），但模型自身需自行跟踪，容易混淆或丢失。提示注入正是利用了这一缺陷：攻击者通过混淆模型对跨度身份的认知，诱导模型执行非预期甚至危险的操作。现有防御缺乏一种无法被token文本复制或伪造的跨度身份通信机制。
AI.method: Semantic Overlays：在冻结模型的指定prefill位置应用小型可学习适配器（adapter），作用于残差流（residual stream），形成不可被token复制的带外注释通道。与steering vectors不同，Overlays是经过训练的、可适配的、可选择性地施加的。Overlays可编码复杂语义，可组合，允许透明读取底层内容，并可携带包括命令性指令在内的复杂载荷。通过将不可信跨度标记为"非可执行"，可防御广泛的提示注入类别。
AI.result: 在提示注入基准上取得显著效果：SEP分离从24.3%提升至96.5%且效用不变；TensorTrust攻击成功率从34.8%降至6.6%；PIArena四种攻击家族的合规率均降至0%；同时标记跨度保持可读（精确复制率92.5%）。此外还修正了已发布评分器中的一个缺陷。
AI.conclusion: Semantic Overlays为LLM提供了一种通用、可学习的带外跨度身份标注机制，有效缓解提示注入攻击，同时不影响模型效用并保持内容可读性。该技术代表了模型输入通道设计上的一个重要方向，超越纯文本模态的安全与引导能力。

title: The Loss Floor of Denoising Score Matching: Fisher Geometry from Schrödinger Bridges
summary: Denoising score matching trains diffusion models by regressing onto a conditional score, although generation ultimately requires the marginal score. The two objectives share the same population minimizer, but the conditional target remains random at fixed noisy state and introduces an irreducible excess in the training loss. We isolate this excess and show that, for a general corruption kernel under mild regularity assumptions, it is exactly the trace of the Fisher--Rao metric of the conditional endpoint family, integrated along the diffusion trajectory. This gives an exact conditional-variance decomposition of the denoising objective and identifies the information geometry observed in diffusion latent spaces as an intrinsic component of the training loss. We derive the result from a Schr"odinger bridge variational principle, in which the ideal objective arises as excess path-space relative entropy. For corruption diffusions, the Fisher term is proportional to the rate at which the noisy state loses mutual information about the clean data, separating the loss floor into an information flow determined by the data and a weight determined by the corruption schedule and objective. In the Gaussian case, this yields a closed form for the floor, recovers reparametrization invariance of the continuous-time objective, and relates its high-SNR divergence to the information dimension of the data. Finally, we show that raw losses obtained with different noise ranges or weightings need not rank models consistently because they contain different additive floors, and contrast the second-order geometry seen by training with the third-order conditional statistics entering numerical sampling error.

AI.tldr: 本文从Schrödinger桥变分原理出发，精确分离了去噪分数匹配训练损失中的不可约项（条件方差项），证明其等于Fisher-Rao度量沿扩散轨迹的积分，并给出闭式解、重参数化不变性和信息维度关联。
AI.motivation: 去噪分数匹配的目标是条件分数，而生成最终需要边际分数；两者共享同一群体最小化器，但条件目标在固定噪声状态下仍具有随机性，导致训练损失中存在不可约的额外项。此前缺乏对这一损失下限的精确刻画，作者希望揭示其几何本质和信息论含义。
AI.method: 通过Schrödinger桥变分原理推导，将理想目标表示为路径空间相对熵的超出量；利用Fisher-Rao度量的线性化结构，将条件方差分解为Fisher项沿扩散轨迹的积分；在一般腐蚀核下推导闭式表达式，并在高斯情形下给出解析解。
AI.result: (1) 精确给出去噪目标的方差分解：损失下限=数据决定的信息流×由腐蚀调度和权重决定的系数；(2) 在高斯情形下得到损失下限的闭式解，恢复连续时间目标的重参数化不变性；(3) 证明高信噪比发散与数据的信息维度相关；(4) 发现不同噪声范围或加权下的原始损失包含不同的附加常数，因此模型排名可能不一致。
AI.conclusion: 扩散潜在空间中的信息几何并非辅助观测现象，而是训练损失的内在组成部分。训练所见的二阶几何与数值采样误差涉及的三阶条件统计量存在本质区别，这为理解扩散模型训练的损失下限和模型评估提供了新视角。

title: Gripper-aware Vision Language Action Models
summary: Vision language action models (VLAs) have advanced general purpose robotic grasping and manipulation by enabling robots to interpret visual observations and natural language instructions to generate executable action sequences. However, existing VLAs often implicitly assume gripper invariance, despite grasping strategies being inherently embodiment-dependent. Different gripper types, such as parallel-jaw and suction, usually require distinct interaction strategies to achieve the same grasping objective. Moreover, current datasets for VLAs predominantly rely on parallel-jaw grippers, limiting gripper-aware learning. To address this gap, we introduce MiGA, a multi-gripper-aware dataset spanning five distinct gripper types across multiple robots with 103,000 demonstrations, explicitly capturing strategy divergence under shared task objectives. We further propose GVLA, which combines a new multi-gripper tokenizer with adapter-based policy routing. Our new gripper encoding induces structured embedding information that balances parameter sharing and strategy differentiation, while layer-wise probing confirms meaningful gripper-conditioned representations for VLAs. Intensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robots show that our GVLA outperforms the current baselines across evaluated settings. Our method also improves zero-shot generalization or few-shot adaptation to new objects or unseen tasks, and enable more efficient gripper adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiGA数据集（涵盖5种夹爪、多机器人、103K演示）和GVLA模型（多夹爪分词器+适配器策略路由），解决VLA中夹爪不变性假设导致的多夹爪策略泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型隐式假设夹爪不变性，但不同夹爪（如平行爪和吸盘）需要不同的交互策略才能实现相同目标。同时现有数据集以平行爪为主，缺乏夹爪感知学习的数据支撑。
AI.method: 1) 构建MiGA数据集：覆盖5种夹爪类型、多种机器人、103,000条演示，显式捕捉共享任务目标下的策略分歧。2) 提出GVLA模型：包含新型多夹爪分词器（multi-gripper tokenizer）和基于适配器的策略路由（adapter-based policy routing）。夹爪编码诱导结构化嵌入信息，在参数共享与策略差异化之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实机器人上，GVLA均优于现有基线；在零样本泛化、少样本适配新物体/未见任务上表现更优；夹爪适配效率更高。层探针实验证实VLA中形成了有意义的夹爪条件化表示。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模夹爪信息，多夹爪感知的VLA可以同时提升策略识别精度、泛化能力和适配效率，验证了夹爪条件化表示对具身智能体策略学习的重要性。

title: Exploit More, Explore Smarter for Budget-Constrained Agentic Search
summary: Budget-constrained agentic search arises when an LLM agent must refine candidates under a small evaluation budget, because validation is expensive, generation requires multiple model calls, or both. In this regime, standard MCTS allocates budget poorly: exploration bonuses dominate at low visit counts, unpromising siblings are expanded before promising chains can deepen, and branching is independent of node quality. We introduce ExTS, a tree-search policy that treats expansion itself as a value-of-information decision. ExTS combines three mechanisms: discriminative reward shaping to separate candidates under narrow score distributions, a stochastic virtual child that estimates the value of creating a new branch from the parent's reward history, and quality-conditioned branching that expands only when a node's score justifies the budget cost. Across prompt optimization, code generation, molecular structure elucidation, and agentic workflow optimization, ExTS is competitive with or improves over task-specific tree-search baselines, with an average relative gain of +5.5% using a single fixed configuration. We further introduce pilot-run diagnostics that characterize what makes budget-constrained agentic search problems structurally different from one another, providing both understanding of the problem space and practical guidance for adaptation.

AI.tldr: ExTS是一种面向预算受限智能体搜索的树搜索策略，将扩展本身视为信息价值决策，通过判别式奖励塑形、随机虚拟子节点和基于质量的条件分支三种机制，在四个任务上平均相对提升+5.5%。
AI.motivation: 在预算受限的智能体搜索场景中，标准MCTS分配预算效率低下：低访问次数下探索奖励占主导、无前途的兄弟节点在深度链扩展前就被展开、分支数量与节点质量无关。这些问题导致宝贵的评估预算被浪费。
AI.method: ExTS包含三种机制：(1)判别式奖励塑形，在窄分数分布下区分候选；(2)随机虚拟子节点，从父节点奖励历史估计创建新分支的价值；(3)质量条件分支，仅当节点分数证明预算支出合理时才进行扩展。
AI.result: 在提示优化、代码生成、分子结构解析和智能体工作流优化四个任务上，ExTS使用单一固定配置即可与任务特定树搜索基线竞争或超越，平均相对增益+5.5%。此外引入试点运行诊断来刻画不同预算受限问题的结构差异。
AI.conclusion: 将树搜索中的扩展操作视为价值信息决策可以显著改善预算受限场景下的搜索效率，同时诊断工具为不同任务的结构性差异提供了理解和自适应指导。

title: FireRedAudio: A General-Purpose Audio Language Model with Decoupled Continuous Representations for Understanding and Generation
summary: A unified audio model must recognize and understand linguistic, paralinguistic, and environmental information while supporting speech synthesis and editing. A key challenge is representation: understanding favors compact features suited to long-context modeling, whereas speech generation requires reconstructible features that preserve fine-grained acoustic detail. We introduce FireRedAudio, a general-purpose audio language model with a shared 9B-parameter LLM. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first publicly disclosed unified audio-language model to provide separate continuous input representations for understanding and generation within a single trainable autoregressive LLM. Audio to be recognized or analyzed is processed by a dedicated Audio Encoder, while speech inputs for generation use a RedAE-based pathway. The LLM directly generates text or conditions a flow-matching DiT to produce continuous acoustic latents. Through progressive multitask training, FireRedAudio supports ASR and audio understanding, with the latter extending to recordings of up to one hour, as well as zero-shot TTS, Instruct TTS, and semantic and acoustic speech editing. Its structured organization of long-form audio achieves second-level timestamp accuracy. Across comprehensive evaluations, FireRedAudio achieves competitive or leading performance in audio understanding and multilingual ASR, strong content accuracy and speaker preservation in zero-shot TTS, leading instruction following in Instruct TTS, and substantial improvements over Ming-UniAudio-Edit in both semantic and acoustic speech editing. These results demonstrate the viability of decoupled continuous input representations for unifying audio understanding and continuous-latent speech generation in a model of moderate scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/FireRedTeam/FireRedAudio.

AI.tldr: FireRedAudio是一个具有9B参数共享LLM的通用音频语言模型，首次在单个可训练自回归LLM中为音频理解（Audio Encoder路径）和语音生成（RedAE路径）提供分离的连续输入表示，支持ASR、长音频理解（最长一小时）、零样本TTS、指令TTS以及语义和声学语音编辑等多种任务。
AI.motivation: 统一的音频模型需要同时识别和理解语言、副语言及环境信息，并支持语音合成与编辑。核心挑战在于表示冲突：理解任务偏好紧凑的特征以适配长上下文建模，而语音生成需要可重建的特征以保留细粒度声学细节。现有方法难以在单一模型中兼顾两者。
AI.method: FireRedAudio采用9B参数共享LLM作为主干，为理解与生成提供两条分离的连续输入通路：理解路径使用专用Audio Encoder处理需识别/分析的音频；生成路径使用RedAE（基于VDT的自编码器）处理语音输入。LLM直接生成文本，或条件化flow-matching DiT以产生连续声学潜变量。通过渐进式多任务训练，统一了理解与生成两类能力。
AI.result: 在全面评估中，FireRedAudio在音频理解和多语言ASR上达到竞争性或领先水平，零样本TTS在内容准确性和说话人保留方面表现强劲，指令TTS的指令跟随能力领先，语义和声学语音编辑相比Ming-UniAudio-Edit有显著提升。长音频结构化组织实现秒级时间戳精度。
AI.conclusion: 分离的连续输入表示在中等规模的模型中能有效统一音频理解与连续潜变量语音生成，验证了该架构范式的可行性。代码已开源。

title: HAP: Head-Adaptive Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Alignment
summary:
Recent Vision-Language Models encode high-resolution images into long visual token sequences, incurring prohibitive prefill costs. To compress them, existing methods score each visual token by averaging text-to-visual attention uniformly across all heads, which assumes every head matches the query. However, our empirical analysis shows that misaligned heads dominate the average, amplifying background tokens and drowning out fine-grained cues.
  To address this, we propose PAQ (Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality), a metric quantifying how well each head aligns the prompt with image regions. Built on PAQ, our pruning proceeds in three stages. Given a target FLOPs budget, we first partition the transformer layers into groups and allocate a visual token budget to each. Within each group, we then aggregate per-head attention maps via PAQ-weighted softmax into a group-level matrix. Finally, we score visual tokens by this matrix's magnitude and retain the allocated budget per group. By weighting heads with PAQ, our method scores tokens by attention signals that more faithfully reflect prompt relevance, rather than diluting them through uniform averaging.
  Across 18 benchmarks, our method delivers state-of-the-art trade-offs. Specifically, on LLaVA-1.5-7B (9 tasks), retaining only \textbf{5.6\%} tokens preserves \textbf{99.1\%} of the original performance, surpassing the strongest baseline AutoPrune by 4.2 points. Code is available in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/HAP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAQ（Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality）指标，用于量化每个注意力头与提示词的对齐程度，并基于PAQ对视觉token进行三阶段剪枝，将高分辨率图像的长视觉token序列大幅压缩，从而降低预填充成本。在18个基准上，LLaVA-1.5-7B只需保留5.6%的token即可保留99.1%的原始性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型将高分辨率图像编码为很长的视觉token序列，导致高昂的预填充（prefill）成本。已有的token压缩方法采用统一的平均方式将所有头的文本-视觉注意力分数进行平均，但经验分析表明，对齐不佳的头会主导平均值，放大背景token并淹没细粒度线索，因此需要更精确的度量头与提示词的对齐程度。
AI.method: 提出PAQ指标量化每个注意力头将提示词与图像区域对齐的能力。剪枝分三阶段：(1) 根据目标FLOPs预算，将Transformer层分组并为每组分配视觉token预算；(2) 在每组内通过PAQ加权的softmax聚合每头注意力图为组级矩阵；(3) 依据该矩阵的数值对视觉token打分并按组预算保留token。PAQ加权避免了均匀平均带来的信号稀释。
AI.result: 在18个基准上实现最先进的性能-效率权衡。在LLaVA-1.5-7B（9个任务）上，仅保留5.6%的token即可保持99.1%的原始性能，超越最强基线AutoPrune 4.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过PAQ加权注意力聚合，能更忠实反映提示词相关性的token评分，显著提升了视觉token压缩效率，同时词与基线方法相比保持了更高的性能。

title: Rules Before Oracles: Auditable, User-Configurable Argument Selection for Deliberative Polling
summary: In a deliberative poll, once submissions outnumber what anyone will read, some mechanism chooses which arguments each voter sees, acquiring much of the decision; practice delegates it to opaque learned rankers, so a voter cannot recompute or contest the exposure that shaped their vote. We ask whether it can be a published rule over publicly recomputable evidence with parameters held by the voter, treating legibility as an admissibility condition on usable mechanisms, not an objective traded against accuracy. We formalise a poll over bipolar justification sets, judging a slate by reason coverage, the order it arrives in, and captured endorsement mass; we give seven checkable criteria for a civic recommender and a rule meeting them: a one-hop reversed endorsement flow parameterised by a relation-weight function. An agentic simulator records every slate at every vote, over about 17,000 seed-paired runs. Served slates fall 0.035 short of a label-reading ceiling upper-bounding every selection procedure, opaque ones included: any unconstrained ranker's advantage is bounded and small. On coverage alone, with non-degenerate authoring, the rule is indistinguishable from a random slate, a null due to an order-blind, charity-blind instrument; on the other two it leads at every prefix by a margin widening with adversarial pressure and dominates on mass by a factor of 3.3. Once a realistic fraction of submissions carries no reasons, the coverage margin returns and grows. Label-homogeneous flooding collapses completeness from 0.81 to 0.34 under a flat weight policy, only to 0.44 under author-count normalisation, making the weight function a security control worth 10% of completeness. The choice between ranking arms is a position on a coverage-versus-mass frontier, not a fact, the kind of choice only a legible rule can hand to the person it affects. It maps onto an open-source peer-to-peer platform.

AI.tldr: 本文研究审议式投票中论证可见性的公平机制问题，提出一种可公开重算、参数由选民持有的"可读"推荐规则（一跳反向背书流），并在约17,000次种子配对模拟中证明其与不透明学习排序器的差距上界仅为0.035，同时给出了七个可检验的公民性推荐器判据。
AI.motivation: 在审议式投票中，当提交的论证数量超过任何人能阅读的限度时，哪些论证被展示给每位选民就决定性地影响了投票结果。现实中这一决策被委托给不透明的学习排序器，选民无法重新计算或质疑塑造其投票的暴露机制。本文将可读性（legibility）视为可用机制的可采纳性条件，而非与准确性交换的目标，从而探索是否存在一种基于公开可重算证据、参数由选民掌握的规则。
AI.method: 论文形式化定义了一个在双极论证集上的审议投票模型，从理由覆盖率、呈现顺序和捕获的背书质量三个维度评判候选集。提出七个可检验的公民性推荐器标准，并给出满足这些标准的规则：一种由关系权重函数参数化的一跳反向背书流。通过智能体模拟器记录每次投票中的每个候选集，在约17,000次种子配对运行中进行评估。
AI.result: 服务的候选集与标签读取上限（界定所有选择程序包括不透明排序器的性能上限）仅差0.035，即任何不受约束的排序器的优势都有界且很小。在仅考虑覆盖率且生成非退化时，该规则与随机候选集无差异（由于工具是顺序盲和慈善盲的）；但在另外两个维度上，它在每个前缀上领先且优势随对抗压力加大；在背书质量上以3.3倍因子主导。当实际比例的提交不含理由时，覆盖率差距回归并增长。标签同质洪水攻击在平权权重政策下将完备性从0.81降至0.34，但在作者计数归一化下仅降至0.44，使权重函数成为价值10%完备性的安全控制。
AI.conclusion: 排序臂的选择是覆盖率-背书质量前沿上的立场而非事实，这种选择只有可读规则才能交给受影响的人。该机制可映射到开源的点对点平台。

title: GATNextHop: A GAT for Shortest Path Routing with Cross-Topology Generalization
comment: Sixth Annual Computer Science Conference for CSU Undergraduates
summary: Common shortest-path algorithms, such as Dijkstra's (SPF), that OSPF uses, provide exact routing solutions but must be recomputed for each network topology, limiting scalability in dynamic or large-scale networks. This paper proposes the GATNextHop model to determine whether a Graph Neural Network, namely the Graph Attention Network, can approximate shortest paths and generalize across topologies. By training on synthetic graphs and evaluating on real-world Internet Service Provider networks from the Internet Topology Zoo, we aim to benchmark our model's ability to learn routing heuristics that transfer across network structures. Performance will be evaluated in terms of accuracy, inference speed, and generalization, comparing the GNN against Dijkstra's algorithm to quantify trade-offs between learned and classical routing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GATNextHop模型，利用图注意力网络（GAT）来近似最短路径路由，在合成图上训练并在真实ISP网络上评估，验证GNN能否跨拓扑泛化地学习路由启发式，并与Dijkstra算法对比准确率、推理速度和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统最短路径算法（如Dijkstra/SPF）虽然是精确解，但每次拓扑变化都需要重新计算，在动态或大规模网络中可扩展性受限，因此需要一种能够跨拓扑泛化、无需逐拓扑重新计算的路由方法。
AI.method: 提出GATNextHop模型，采用图注意力网络学习路由下一跳决策；在合成图上进行训练，并在Internet Topology Zoo的真实ISP网络数据集上评估模型的跨拓扑泛化能力。
AI.result: 从准确率、推理速度和泛化能力三个维度评估GNN的性能，并与Dijkstra算法作为基准进行对比，量化学习式路由与传统精确路由之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统对比GNN与经典Dijkstra算法，该工作为学习式路由在真实网络环境中的可行性和局限性提供了实证依据。

title: VIP: Variation-based Iterative-learning Planning for Robotic Navigation
summary: Over the past decade, autonomous robotic systems have been increasingly deployed in applications such as surveying, search and rescue, and last-mile delivery. These applications require robots to generate safe and efficient motion plans in large, complex, and obstacle-dense environments, often under limited onboard computing resources. However, conventional planning methods commonly rely on finite-dimensional trajectory parameterization or increasingly long prediction horizons, leading to rapidly growing computational costs, particularly in multi-robot scenarios. This paper presents a novel variation-based iterative-learning planning (VIP) framework for efficient motion planning of both single robots and robotic swarms. Instead of optimizing a large number of discrete trajectory variables, VIP directly updates the planning command as a continuous function in an infinite-dimensional function space. The same variation-based update can be implemented in a model-in-the-loop manner for offline planning or in a robot-in-the-loop manner between online physical executions. By avoiding the computational burden associated with horizon expansion and high-dimensional trajectory discretization, VIP maintains a per-iteration computational complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n)$, where $n$ denotes the number of spatial discretization points. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can efficiently generate and iteratively improve motion plans for different planning objectives, robotic platforms, and swarm configurations, highlighting its effectiveness, computational efficiency, and scalability as a general planning methodology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于变分的迭代学习规划（VIP）框架，用于单机器人和机器人集群的高效运动规划。VIP直接在无穷维函数空间中更新规划命令（连续函数），避免了有限维轨迹参数化和长预测视界带来的计算成本增长，每个迭代的计算复杂度仅为O(n)。通过仿真和真实实验验证了其在多种规划目标、机器人平台和集群配置下的有效性、计算效率和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人系统（如勘测、搜救、最后一英里配送）需要在大型、复杂、障碍密集的环境中生成安全高效的运动规划，且常受限于机载计算资源。然而，传统规划方法依赖有限维轨迹参数化或不断增加预测视界，导致计算成本快速增长，尤其在多机器人场景下问题尤为突出。
AI.method: VIP框架采用变分迭代学习方法，将规划命令视为无穷维函数空间中的连续函数进行直接更新，而非优化大量离散轨迹变量。该更新既可通过模型在环方式用于离线规划，也可通过机器人在环方式在在线物理执行之间迭代改进。通过避免视界扩展和高维轨迹离散化带来的计算负担，VIP实现每迭代O(n)的计算复杂度，其中n为空间离散化点数。
AI.result: 大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，该框架能高效生成并迭代改进针对不同规划目标、机器人平台和集群配置的运动规划，验证了其作为通用规划方法在有效性、计算效率和可扩展性方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: VIP框架作为一种通用的运动规划方法，通过无穷维函数空间中的变分更新策略，有效解决了传统方法在复杂环境下计算成本高的问题，为单机器人和机器人集群的高效运动规划提供了一种新的可扩展方案。

title: In-Context Inpainting for Time Series Forecasting
summary: We propose ICI-Time, a novel framework that reframes time series forecasting as a visual inpainting task, leveraging the generalisation power of large vision models (LVMs). Unlike methods that require specialised temporal architectures and extensive domain-specific training, ICI-Time transforms time series into structured visual representations (area charts) and applies visual in-context learning, reformulating forecasting as pattern completion within a grid-structured prompt that pre-trained vision transformers can solve without fine-tuning or architectural modification. Temporal dependencies are represented through spatial layout, with a consistent, invertible mapping between numerical and visual domains. Extensive experiments across epidemiology, meteorology, and power systems demonstrate that ICI-Time performs competitively against deep learning baselines and shows promising adaptability under limited-data settings, introducing a new paradigm that bridges temporal and visual domains.

AI.tldr: 提出ICI-Time框架，将时间序列预测重新定义为视觉修复（visual inpainting）任务，利用大型视觉模型（LVM）的泛化能力，无需微调或架构修改即可完成预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法依赖专门的时序架构和大量领域特定训练，泛化能力受限。作者希望利用大型视觉模型（LVM）的强大泛化能力，通过跨模态映射来解决时间序列预测问题。
AI.method: 将时间序列转换为结构化视觉表示（面积图），通过视觉上下文学习（visual in-context learning）将预测重构为网格结构化提示中的模式补全任务。时序依赖通过空间布局表示，并建立数值域与视觉域之间一致且可逆的映射。无需微调，可直接由预训练视觉Transformer求解。
AI.result: 在流行病学、气象学和电力系统等多个领域的广泛实验中，ICI-Time与深度学习基线相比表现具有竞争力，并在数据有限的条件下展现出良好的适应性。
AI.conclusion: ICI-Time引入了一种连接时序域与视觉域的新范式，拓展了大型视觉模型在时间序列预测中的应用可能性。

title: MemUse: Moving Memory Evaluation from Direct QA to Natural Integration in Long-Term Human-AI Conversation
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 31 pages, 15 figures, 28 tables
summary: Memory systems for conversational LLMs are conventionally evaluated by direct, fact-seeking questions about prior dialogue (Direct QA): can the model recall fact X from a prior conversation? We tested whether higher Direct QA accuracy correlates with higher user satisfaction in a 4-month deployment (40 users, 1,872 sessions, 7 memory conditions). Existing-benchmark Direct QA varies from 19.7% to 70.1% across the 7 conditions, but satisfaction does not change. We hypothesize that existing benchmarks and user satisfaction are tracking different capabilities: benchmarks measure elicited retrieval (recall when asked), while conversation requires natural integration (detecting relevance and naturally weaving prior context into a response). To examine this, we introduce MemUse, a set of real user-cued memory moments drawn from the deployment, scored by an integration-aware judgment of the natural conversational response. Holding the model and context fixed, the same system that scores 78.8% on Direct QA references only 7.9% of those facts in conversation -- a 71-point gap. Within these moments, Natural Integration is associated with satisfaction, whereas Direct QA is not.
