We release the deployment corpus and MemUse together with all judgments and scoring prompts at https://github.com/ryuichi-sumida/memuse.

AI.tldr: 本文通过4个月的部署实验（40名用户、1,872个会话、7种记忆条件）发现，现有对话式LLM记忆系统的直接问答（Direct QA）基准准确率（19.7%-70.1%）与用户满意度无关。作者提出原因在于基准衡量的是"被要求时的回忆"（elicited retrieval），而真实对话需要"自然整合"（natural integration）。为此提出MemUse基准，发现同一系统在Direct QA上得分78.8%，但在真实对话中仅自然引用7.9%的事实，存在71个百分点的巨大差距；且自然整合与满意度相关，而Direct QA则不然。
AI.motivation: 现有对话LLM记忆系统的评估主要依赖Direct QA这种针对先前对话的直接事实问答基准，但作者怀疑这种基准与实际用户体验（满意度）脱节。通过真实部署数据验证了这一怀疑，并揭示了基准与用户满意度追踪的是不同的能力。
AI.method: 作者进行了4个月的部署实验（40名用户、1,872个会话、7种记忆条件），对比各条件下Direct QA准确率与用户满意度的相关性。随后提出MemUse基准，从部署中提取真实用户提示的记忆时刻（user-cued memory moments），采用整合感知（integration-aware）的评判标准对自然对话回复打分，比较同一系统在Direct QA与自然整合两种评估下的表现差距。
AI.result: 7种记忆条件下Direct QA从19.7%到70.1%不等，但用户满意度无显著变化。同一系统在Direct QA上得78.8%，在真实对话中对相关事实的引用率仅7.9%，存在71个百分点的显著差距。在记忆时刻内，自然整合能力与用户满意度相关，而Direct QA与满意度无关。
AI.conclusion: 现有Direct QA基准不能预测用户满意度，因为其衡量的是"被问时的回忆"而非对话所需的"自然整合"能力。作者提出MemUse作为更贴近真实对话体验的记忆评估基准，并公开了部署语料库、MemUse数据及全部评分与提示。

title: ROI-Gated SAHI: Content-Adaptive Slicing-Based Inference for Efficient Object Detection
summary: Slicing-Aided Hyper Inference (SAHI) improves small object detection in high-resolution images but often spends substantial compute on background tiles. We propose region-of-interest (ROI)-Gated SAHI, an inference-time framework that introduces a lightweight proposer to localize foreground regions and restrict sliced refinement to informative areas. We evaluate the framework in two settings. On the COCO128 full split dataset comprising 128 images, static ROI-gating is slower on average than Full SAHI, achieving a speed ratio of 0.88, and yields a lower mAP@0.5 of 0.6602 compared with 0.7569 for Full SAHI. A simple adaptive routing policy with $τ=$ 0.4 educes the mean latency, achieving a slight gain of 1.02$\times$ over Full SAHI. On a three-image sparse-to-dense case study, ROI-gating achieves speedups ranging from 0.96$\times$ to 6.90$\times$ with a mean speedup of 3.41$\times$. These results show that ROI-gating is most beneficial in sparse scenes and requires policy-based routing for robust average behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROI-Gated SAHI框架，通过轻量级前景提议器定位感兴趣区域，仅对信息丰富的区域执行切片式精细检测，以解决SAHI在高分辨率图像小目标检测中背景瓦片计算开销大的问题。在COCO128数据集上性能略有下降但通过自适应路由策略获得轻微加速；在稀疏场景中最高获得6.90倍加速。
AI.motivation: SAHI通过切片推理改善高分辨率图像中的小目标检测，但会在大量背景瓦片上浪费计算资源。作者希望引入ROI门控机制，在推理阶段仅对前景区域进行精细切片处理，从而减少无效计算。
AI.method: 提出ROI-Gated SAHI框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 一个轻量级提议器（proposer）用于定位前景区域；(2) 基于门控机制限制切片式精细检测仅在信息密集区域执行。同时引入一个简单的自适应路由策略（自适应阈值τ=0.4）来动态决定是否执行ROI门控。
AI.result: 在COCO128全量分割数据集（128张图像）上：静态ROI门控平均比Full SAHI慢（速度比0.88），mAP@0.5为0.6602，低于Full SAHI的0.7569；采用自适应路由策略（τ=0.4）后平均延迟有所降低，获得1.02倍的轻微加速。在3张图像的稀疏到密集案例研究中，ROI门控获得0.96倍到6.90倍的加速，平均加速3.41倍。
AI.conclusion: ROI门控在稀疏场景中最为有效（可达6.9倍加速），但需要策略化的路由机制来确保在多样化场景下的稳健平均性能。静态ROI门控可能导致性能下降和延迟增加，自适应策略是必要的。

title: MnemoDyn: Learning Resting State Dynamics from 40K FMRI sequences
summary: We present a dynamical-systems based model for resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), trained on a dataset of roughly 40K rs-fMRI sequences covering a wide variety of public and available-by-permission datasets. While most existing proposals use transformer backbones, we utilize multi-resolution temporal modeling of the dynamics across parcellated brain regions. We show that MnemoDyn is compute efficient and generalizes very well across diverse populations and scanning protocols. When benchmarked against current state-of-the-art transformer-based approaches, MnemoDyn consistently delivers superior reconstruction quality. Overall, we find that with such large-scale pre-training on (non-proprietary) rs-fMRI datasets, we get a highly performant model for various downstream tasks. Our results also provide evidence of the efficacy of the model on small sample size studies which has implications for neuroimaging studies at large where resting state fMRI is a commonly acquired imaging modality.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于动力系统的静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）模型MnemoDyn，在约4万条涵盖多种公共数据集的rs-fMRI序列上训练。与现有基于Transformer的方法不同，该模型采用跨脑区分割区域的多分辨率时间动力学建模，兼具计算高效性和跨人群/扫描协议的强泛化能力，在重建质量上优于当前最先进的Transformer方法，且在小样本研究中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有rs-fMRI建模方法大多依赖Transformer骨干网络，计算开销大且在小样本神经影像研究中泛化能力有限。作者希望探索一种更高效、更具泛化能力的非Transformer架构，以支持大规模预训练并服务于多样化的下游神经影像任务。
AI.method: 采用基于动力系统（dynamical-systems）的建模框架，对经过分区（parcellation）的脑区进行多分辨率时间动力学建模，并在约40K条来自多种公共及可授权数据集的rs-fMRI序列上进行大规模预训练。
AI.result: MnemoDyn在计算效率上优于基于Transformer的SOTA方法，在重建质量上持续取得更好的表现，并且在跨人群和跨扫描协议的泛化方面表现出色，同时在小样本研究场景中依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 大规模非专有rs-fMRI数据的预训练能够催生高性能的通用模型，适用于多种下游任务。该工作为神经影像领域（尤其是普遍采集rs-fMRI的研究）提供了兼具效率与性能的建模方案，对小样本研究尤其具有实际意义。

title: GaussianWAM: Distilling Geometry and Semantics from 3D Gaussian Fields into World-Action Models
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) jointly learn future visual prediction and action generation, using video dynamics as a representation-learning signal for robotic manipulation. However, their video latents are primarily optimized for visual prediction and are not explicitly encouraged to preserve cross-view geometric structure or spatially localized, object-relevant semantics. We propose \textbf{GaussianWAM}, a training-time representation-enhancement framework that organizes geometric and semantic supervision through a 3D Gaussian field. Given synchronized multi-view observations, frozen geometry and vision foundation models provide depth, camera parameters, and dense semantic features. GaussianWAM binds these heterogeneous signals to shared Gaussian primitives and renders spatially aligned semantic, depth, and coverage targets, which are distilled into the current-observation representations of the WAM. All teacher models, Gaussian components, and auxiliary prediction heads are removed after training, leaving the original WAM inference path without additional modules or forward computation. On LIBERO-Plus, GaussianWAM improves FastWAM from 52.05\% to 71.29\% and Cosmos Policy from 71.52\% to 77.30\%. Direct CLIP and VGGT distillation already establishes a strong FastWAM baseline of 69.37\%, while Gaussian-field unification further improves it to 71.29\%, supporting the benefit of spatially organizing heterogeneous teacher signals. GaussianWAM also improves performance on standard LIBERO and shows positive transfer trends on RoboTwin and real-world manipulation. These results suggest that training-time Gaussian distillation provides a practical way to inject geometry- and semantics-related supervision into WAM representations without changing their deployment architecture.

AI.tldr: GaussianWAM是一个训练时表示增强框架，通过3D高斯场将几何和语义监督信号绑定到共享的高斯原语上，并蒸馏到世界-动作模型（WAM）的当前观测表示中，在不改变推理架构的前提下显著提升机器人操作性能（LIBERO-Plus上FastWAM从52.05%提升到71.29%，Cosmos Policy从71.52%提升到77.30%）。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界-动作模型（WAMs）联合学习未来视觉预测和动作生成，但其视频潜变量主要针对视觉预测优化，未被显式鼓励保持跨视角几何结构或空间局部化的、与物体相关的语义信息，导致表示质量受限。
AI.method: GaussianWAM通过3D高斯场组织几何和语义监督：利用冻结的几何与视觉基础模型（提供深度、相机参数和稠密语义特征），将这些异构信号绑定到共享的高斯原语上，渲染空间对齐的语义、深度和覆盖目标，并蒸馏到WAM的当前观测表示中。训练完成后移除所有教师模型、高斯组件和辅助预测头，保留原始WAM推理路径。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus上，GaussianWAM将FastWAM从52.05%提升至71.29%，将Cosmos Policy从71.52%提升至77.30%。直接CLIP和VGGT蒸馏即建立69.37%的强基线，而高斯场统一进一步将其提升至71.29%。GaussianWAM在标准LIBERO上也有改进，并在RoboTwin和真实世界操作中表现出正向迁移趋势。
AI.conclusion: 训练时的高斯蒸馏为WAM表示注入几何与语义相关监督提供了一种实用方法，无需改变部署架构，同时支持不同教师信号的统一组织。

title: Granite.Trust Policy Tools: Shareable, Actionable Policies for Generative AI Applications
summary:
When it comes to safety policies for generative AI, one size does not fit all. Each organization and use case needs to mitigate different risks depending on the application context, regulatory environment, organizational values, and user personas. Yet, existing policy specification approaches are designed for traditional access control and fail to capture the nuances of GenAI application: the enforcement of content-based constraints.
  We present two contributions to address this gap: (1) the Actionable Policy schema, a YAML-based format for specifying what model responses can and cannot contain. The schema enables exception-based policy governance, proposing exceptions to track policy violations; (2) synthetic data generation pipeline that produces policy-aligned training data for model alignment and testing, and a set of tools to help define the schema and enforce policy. Together, these enable organizations to specify policies once and enforce them throughout the GenAI application lifecycle: from model alignment to runtime monitoring. The Actionable Policy schema, example policies, and tools are available as open source: https://github.com/ibm-granite/granite.trust.policy-tools We welcome new ideas, contributions and feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Actionable Policy schema（基于YAML的格式），用于为生成式AI应用指定模型响应内容约束的安全策略，并通过合成数据生成流程和配套工具，使组织能够一次定义策略并在生成式AI应用生命周期（从模型对齐到运行时监控）中强制执行。整体采用基于例外（exception-based）的策略治理方式。
AI.motivation: 现有安全策略规范方法是为传统访问控制设计的，无法捕捉生成式AI应用的核心特征——即基于内容的约束执行。不同组织和用例需要根据应用背景、监管环境、组织价值观和用户画像来定制不同的风险缓解策略，因此需要一种专门针对生成式AI的策略规范方法。
AI.method: 论文提出了两个核心贡献：(1) Actionable Policy schema——一种基于YAML的格式，用于指定模型响应可以或不可以包含的内容，支持基于例外（exception-based）的策略治理，通过提出例外来跟踪策略违规；(2) 合成数据生成流程——生成与策略对齐的训练数据用于模型对齐和测试，以及一系列帮助定义schema和执行策略的工具。
AI.result: 该方案使组织能够一次性指定策略，并在生成式AI应用的全生命周期中强制执行，包括模型对齐和运行时监控。相关代码、示例策略和工具已作为开源项目发布在GitHub上。
AI.conclusion: 通过Actionable Policy schema和配套工具链，生成式AI应用的安全策略可以实现从制定到执行的全流程统一管理，欢迎社区贡献和反馈以进一步完善。

title: 'Ghaib in Translation' aka Unseen Harm: Measuring Cross-Script Safety Inconsistency with 'Missed-in-Urdu' Scores in LLM Hate Speech Detection
summary: Urdu, the world's tenth most spoken language with 246 million speakers, remains almost entirely absent from mainstream LLM safety evaluation and nine years of WOAH proceedings. To investigate whether this absence has measurable consequences for content moderation reliability, five large language models, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen-2.5, and Llama-3.1, were tested across six datasets spanning Nastaliq Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, and code-switched Urdu-English. Across the five Urdu-script datasets, label instability between original-script and English-translation classification ranged from 15.9% (Gemini 2.5 Flash) to 31.6% (Qwen-2.5), with a 'Missed-in-Urdu' rate, content flagged as harmful in English translation but passed as normal in the original script, ranging from 2.4% to 9.9% (median 4.3%). A complete enumeration of all 205 papers across nine ALW/WOAH editions via the ACL Anthology API confirms zero dedicated Urdu papers across the entire period. Results indicate that current LLMs provide uneven safety assurance across Urdu's script varieties, with smaller open-weight models showing substantially higher instability and missed-harm rates than frontier closed models.

AI.tldr: 该论文调查了乌尔都语在主流LLM安全评估中的缺失是否影响内容审核可靠性。通过在五个LLM（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen-2.5、Llama-3.1）和六个数据集上测试，发现乌尔都语脚本数据集在原始脚本与英文翻译分类之间存在15.9%-31.6%的标签不稳定率，"乌尔都语漏检"率（英文翻译中被标记为有害但原始脚本中被放行）为2.4%-9.9%。同时，对九届ALW/WOAH会议全部205篇论文的枚举确认零篇专门针对乌尔都语的论文。结果表明当前LLM在不同乌尔都语变体中提供不均衡的安全保障。
AI.motivation: 乌尔都语作为全球第十大语言（2.46亿使用者），却几乎完全缺席主流的LLM安全评估和九年的WOAH会议论文集。作者旨在探究这种语言在安全评估中的缺失是否对内容审核的可靠性产生了可测量的实际后果。
AI.method: 作者选取了五个大语言模型（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen-2.5、Llama-3.1），在跨越Nastaliq乌尔都语、罗马乌尔都语、英语和混合乌尔都语-英语共六个数据集上进行测试。通过比较原始乌尔都语脚本与英文翻译之间的分类标签稳定性来量化安全审核的可靠性差异，并使用ACL Anthology API对九届ALW/WOAH版次的全部205篇论文进行穷举枚举以确认乌尔都语论文的缺失情况。
AI.result: 五个乌尔都语脚本数据集中，原始脚本与英文翻译分类之间的标签不稳定率从15.9%（Gemini 2.5 Flash）到31.6%（Qwen-2.5）不等。"Missed-in-Urdu"率（在英文翻译中被标记为有害但在原始脚本中被放行）为2.4%至9.9%（中位数4.3%）。ACL Anthology API的穷举枚举确认九届会议205篇论文中零篇专门针对乌尔都语。较小规模的开放权重模型比前沿闭源模型表现出显著更高的不稳定性和漏检率。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs在乌尔都语的不同脚本变体中提供不均衡的安全保障，且较小的开放权重模型在内容审核可靠性方面明显劣于前沿闭源模型。乌尔都语在学术会议（WOAH）中的结构性缺席与实际的安全审核缺陷并存，凸显了资源匮乏语言在LLM安全评估中的系统性忽视问题。

title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
summary: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control within a single video DiT: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (surpassing synchronous Cosmos Policy at 67.1% and imagination-free co-training at 64.4%) and 99.0% on LIBERO, executing at 48 ms per chunk on an NVIDIA A100 GPU (24x faster than synchronous baselines). Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.

AI.tldr: GlanceWAM提出了一种异步视觉想象策略，将视频生成从控制关键路径中解耦出来，在潜在空间中直接解码动作，从而同时实现实时推理（48ms/块）和更高的任务成功率（RoboCasa 72.2%，LIBERO 99.0%），打破同步视频生成在延迟与成功率之间的根本权衡。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型为机器人学习提供了丰富的物理先验，但现有的世界-动作模型（WAMs）面临根本性权衡：在控制频率下进行同步视频生成延迟过高不可行，而放弃测试时的视觉想象又牺牲了任务成功率。作者希望同时获得实时推理和高任务成功率，而非在二者之间取舍。
AI.method: 提出GlanceWAM，在单一视频DiT中将想象与控制解耦：(1) 异步proposer在慢时钟上于后台向前窥探，生成数秒后的单一前瞻帧；(2) 动作头在控制频率（48ms）下完全在潜在空间中解码动作块，不阻塞推理；(3) 采用非干扰注意力掩码隔离视频表示；(4) 使用耐陈旧性的水平训练（staleness-robust horizon training）以适应异步前瞻帧的老化问题。仅以演示数据训练。
AI.result: 在24任务RoboCasa厨房基准上达到72.2%（超过同步Cosmos Policy的67.1%和无想象协同训练的64.4%），在LIBERO上达到99.0%，在NVIDIA A100 GPU上每块执行48ms，比同步基线快24倍。
AI.conclusion: 异步、脱离关键路径的视觉想象在潜在空间中直接消费，能够打破速度-成功率困境，同时实现实时推理和优于同步方法的任务成功率，为世界模型在机器人策略中的应用提供了新的设计范式。

title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://zheng977.github.io/StepGuard/
summary: LLM-based agents can interact with external environments through tool invocation, but this capability also introduces security risks such as file modification, information leakage, and unauthorized actions. Existing guardrails often evaluate completed trajectories, leaving pre-execution monitoring of step-level actions underexplored. We propose StepGuard, a step-level guard model that can audit completed agent trajectories and check tool actions before they are executed. To train StepGuard, we introduce StepGen, an automatic data engine that generates safe and unsafe trajectories with the same context but different actions at the risky step. To further reduce over-defense and under-defense, we propose Balance-GRPO, which dynamically balances learning between safe and unsafe actions based on their observed accuracy. Experiments show that StepGuard achieves the highest average accuracy among open-weight guard models, with performance comparable to GPT-5.4. When used to guard agents on AgentDojo and AgentDyn, StepGuard reduces mean attack success rate by 77.3% relative to the no-guard setting, while mean utility drops by only 2.8 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出StepGuard，一个步骤级别的智能体护栏模型，可在动作执行前进行审计和检查，配合StepGen数据引擎和Balance-GRPO训练方法，在保证高准确率的同时显著降低攻击成功率（下降77.3%）且仅损失2.8个百分点的效用。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通过工具调用与外部环境交互，带来文件修改、信息泄露和未授权操作等安全风险。现有护栏通常只评估完整轨迹，对执行前的步骤级动作监控研究不足。
AI.method: 1) 提出StepGuard，一个步骤级护栏模型，既能审计完成的智能体轨迹，也能在工具动作执行前进行检查。2) 提出StepGen，自动数据引擎，生成具有相同上下文但风险步骤不同动作的安全/不安全轨迹对。3) 提出Balance-GRPO，动态平衡安全与非安全动作的学习，基于观察到的准确率减少过度防御和防御不足。
AI.result: StepGuard在开放权重护栏模型中取得最高平均准确率，性能与GPT-5.4相当。在AgentDojo和AgentDyn上守护智能体时，平均攻击成功率相对无护栏设置降低77.3%，平均效用仅下降2.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级护栏模型在保障LLM智能体安全性方面具有显著效果，在高效防御攻击的同时对正常任务效用的影响极小，验证了预执行监控的可行性和优越性。

title: CoDrift: Compositional Drifting for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning is intrinsically multi-objective: a policy must remain compatible with the behavioral support of a fixed dataset while preferentially selecting high-value actions. We recast these objectives in a common form by viewing each as an action-space motion field that specifies how generated actions should move. This perspective enables heterogeneous learning objectives to be combined directly through field composition. Inspired by drifting models, we propose CoDrift, a compositional framework for one-step generative policy learning. CoDrift combines three objective-level fields into a unified policy field. The conditional field preserves state-dependent behavioral structure, while the marginal field pools actions across states to provide a more stable generative signal in the single-positive-sample regime of continuous-control offline RL. The value field moves generated actions toward higher-value regions. The composed field is absorbed into a stochastic generator that produces an action with a single forward pass at deployment. We evaluate CoDrift on 73 tasks from OGBench and D4RL in both offline and offline-to-online settings. CoDrift compares favorably with state-of-the-art methods and achieves the best average rank in both settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoDrift，一种基于运动场组合的离线强化学习单步生成式策略学习框架。它将多个学习目标统一为动作空间中的运动场，通过场组合实现目标融合，在73个任务上取得最优平均排名。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习本质上是一个多目标优化问题：策略既要保持与固定数据集的行为支持兼容，又要优先选择高价值动作。现有的方法通常需要在这两个目标之间进行权衡，缺乏一个统一且灵活的组合框架来融合异构学习目标。
AI.method: CoDrift将每个学习目标重新表述为动作空间中的运动场（motion field），指示生成动作应如何移动。具体包含三个目标级场：条件场（conditional field）保留状态依赖的行为结构；边缘场（marginal field）跨状态汇集动作，在连续控制离线RL的单一正样本场景下提供更稳定的生成信号；价值场（value field）将生成的动作移向高价值区域。三个场通过场组合（field composition）统一为一个策略场，并吸收进随机生成器中，部署时单次前向传播即可生成动作。
AI.result: 在OGBench和D4RL共73个任务上，覆盖离线与离线到在线两种设置，CoDrift与现有最先进方法相比表现优异，在两种设置下均取得最佳平均排名。
AI.conclusion: CoDrift通过将异构目标统一为运动场并直接组合，提供了一种简洁而有效的离线强化学习策略学习范式，验证了场组合视角在单步生成式策略学习中的可行性与优越性。

title: Fiber Bragg Grating Whiskers for Bioinspired Hydrodynamic Perception on Underwater Robots
summary: Harbor seals track hydrodynamic trails with their vibrissae, enabling passive perception of moving targets in dark or turbid water. Inspired by this capability, we present compact fiber Bragg grating (FBG) whiskers for underwater robots. Like seal whiskers, they have a non-uniform taper and elliptical cross-section. Controlled towing experiments show a monotonic relative-flow response from 0.1 to 0.6 m/s, a strong reduction of self-induced oscillation relative to a cylindrical baseline, and a pronounced dependence on angle of attack. Experiments with a pitching foil show that the whiskers can detect the characteristic vortices shed by a stationary or moving source, detectable several seconds after the source has passed. Using this information, a single front-mounted whisker enabled a small underwater robot to distinguish between continuing straight and executing a turn, selecting the correct branch in 17 of 20 trials (85.0%) from whisker signals alone. These results connect bioinspired hydrodynamic sensing to robot action and suggest the utility of whiskers for tracking underwater objects.

AI.tldr: 本文受海豹胡须启发，提出用于水下机器人的紧凑型光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）须状传感器。该传感器具有非均匀锥形和椭圆截面，能检测水流相对速度、抑制自激振荡，并可探测运动源脱落的特征涡旋。单个前装须状传感器使小型水下机器人在20次试验中以85%的准确率仅凭须信号区分直行与转弯。
AI.motivation: 海豹通过振动须感知水下运动目标产生的流体尾迹，实现暗水或浑水环境下的被动感知。这一生物能力启示研究者开发用于水下机器人的仿生流体传感装置，以弥补传统声呐或视觉传感器在复杂水下环境中的局限。
AI.method: 设计了具有非均匀锥形和椭圆截面的FBG须状传感器，通过受控拖曳实验测量其相对流速响应（0.1-0.6 m/s）、自激振荡抑制能力及迎角依赖性；利用俯仰水翼实验验证其对静止/运动源涡旋的探测能力；最后在水下机器人上安装单个前装须传感器进行路径判别实验。
AI.result: 传感器在0.1-0.6 m/s范围内呈单调相对流量响应；相比圆柱基线结构，自激振荡显著降低；对迎角有显著敏感性。实验可检测静止或运动源脱落的特征涡旋，且能在源经过数秒后仍探测到信号。单须传感器使机器人在20次试验中17次正确区分直行与转弯，准确率85%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将仿生流体动力学传感与机器人行为决策相连接，验证了无需视觉或声呐的情况下，仅凭须状传感器即可实现水下目标追踪与自主导航，表明仿生须传感器在水下目标探测方面具有实用潜力。

title: Measuring Digital Labour Market Transitions with a Digital Semantic Score: An AI-Based Methodology Applied to the Dutch Labour Market
summary: The digital transformation of the Dutch labour market is reshaping occupational language, career pathways, and job-related skills. Addressing these changes requires granular labour market intelligence. This paper develops an AI-based methodology to analyse digitalisation using data covering millions of Dutch job profiles. The methodology combines embedding-based similarity search and large language model classification to map unstructured job information to harmonised ESCO occupations. We also introduce a Digital Semantic Score that measures how strongly job titles and skills are associated with digital concepts relative to a non-digital reference. Using embeddings and cosine similarity to transparent digital and non-digital anchor groups, this indicator moves beyond keyword-based approaches by capturing broader digital meanings in occupational language and worker skill profiles. It enables analysis across occupations, career transitions, emerging job-title vocabulary, and skill digitality. The findings reveal that digitalisation is unevenly distributed across the labour market. Digital job-title language is most prominent among managerial, professional and ICT-related occupations, but is increasingly visible in hybrid business, marketing and automation-related roles. Career-transition analyses show that movement toward digital work is pathway-dependent, while skill analyses highlight the multidimensional nature of digital capability, encompassing technical, hybrid and business-systems skills. By combining profile data, AI-supported occupational classification and semantic scoring, this study advances AI-driven labour market analytics and provides a scalable framework for monitoring digital labour market change. The methodology helps identify emerging skill needs, support reskilling strategies, and inform policies addressing skills mismatches and labour shortages in the Netherlands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于AI的方法论来分析荷兰劳动力市场的数字化转型，结合嵌入相似度搜索和大语言模型分类将非结构化职位信息映射到ESCO职业体系，并引入"数字语义得分"指标来衡量职位头衔和技能与数字概念的关联强度，从而实现对职业、职业转换、新兴职位词汇和技能数字化程度的深层次分析。
AI.motivation: 荷兰劳动力市场的数字化转型正在重塑职业语言、职业路径和岗位技能，但现有方法多依赖关键词匹配，无法捕捉数字概念的深层语义含义。需要更细粒度、可扩展的劳动力市场智能分析工具来监测这一变化，以支持技能再培训策略和技能错配政策的制定。
AI.method: 该研究构建了一套三层方法论：(1) 使用基于嵌入的相似度搜索与大语言模型分类相结合的方法，将数百万荷兰职位档案的非结构化信息映射到统一ESCO职业分类体系；(2) 引入"数字语义得分"（Digital Semantic Score），通过词嵌入和余弦相似度将职业语言与透明的数字/非数字锚定组进行比较，超越关键词方法以捕捉更广泛的数字语义；(3) 将该指标应用于跨职业、职业转换、新兴职位词汇和技能数字化程度的多维度分析。
AI.result: 研究发现数字化转型在劳动力市场中分布不均：数字职位语言在管理类、专业类和ICT相关职业中最突出，但在混合型商务、营销和自动化相关角色中也日益明显。职业转换分析表明向数字工作的流动具有路径依赖性；技能分析揭示了数字能力的多维本质，涵盖技术、混合和商务系统类技能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过结合职位画像数据、AI辅助职业分类和语义评分，推进了AI驱动的劳动力市场分析，为监测数字化劳动力市场变化提供了可扩展的框架。该方法论有助于识别新兴技能需求、支持再技能策略，并为荷兰技能错配和劳动力短缺的政策制定提供信息依据。

title: RefineRank: Joint Box Refinement and Ranking for Surgical Spatio-Temporal Grounding
summary: Surgical spatio-temporal grounding (STG) requires locating, at each video time specified by a procedural question, the object that the question asks about. Existing approaches face a trade-off: vision language models understand the question context but produce imprecise coordinates, whereas open-set detectors provide localized candidate boxes whose confidence does not reflect which box answers the question. We introduce RefineRank, which closes this gap at the candidate-box level. A compact trainable module, RefineNet, combines the language and regional features of a frozen medical vision language model with the proposals of a frozen open-set detector: it predicts a bounded coordinate correction and a quality score for every candidate box, and a fixed decoding rule returns the original or refined box with the highest score. On the MedVidBench Official Rankings (Verified), RefineRank records 0.421 STG mIoU, the highest displayed STG score, while its global multi-metric rank is 11. In a controlled evaluation on separate training and evaluation videos, coordinate correction raises the candidate oracle upper bound from 0.6772 to 0.7302, and ranking the joint pool of original and refined candidates by their RefineNet scores improves STG mIoU from 0.2719 to 0.4534, whereas separately trained selectors over the same pool reach at most 0.4186. These results show that a small box-level module can reconcile question understanding with precise localization without retraining either backbone. Code is available at [https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank](https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank).

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefineRank，一种用于外科手术视频时空定位(STG)的紧凑可训练模块。它通过一个轻量级RefineNet将冻结的医学视觉语言模型(VLM)的区域特征与冻结的开放集检测器的候选框预测相结合，为每个候选框预测有界坐标修正和质量分数，从而在不重训练任何骨干网络的情况下弥合了问题理解与精确定位之间的差距。在MedVidBench官方排名中STG mIoU达0.421，为最高显示分数。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在手术时空定位任务中面临权衡：视觉语言模型能理解问题语义但坐标预测不精确，而开放集检测器能提供局部候选框但其置信度不反映哪个框能回答当前问题。需要一种方法在候选框层面弥合这一差距。
AI.method: RefineRank由RefineNet模块组成，该模块结合冻结的医学VLM的语言和区域特征以及冻结的开放集检测器的候选框提议，为每个候选框预测有界坐标修正和质量分数。解码时采用固定规则，返回得分最高的原始或修正后的框。
AI.result: 在MedVidBench官方排名（已验证）中取得0.421 STG mIoU，为最高显示STG分数；全局多指标排名第11。在受控评估中，坐标修正将候选oracle上界从0.6772提升至0.7302；对联合原始与修正候选池按RefineNet分数排序，STG mIoU从0.2719提升至0.4534，而单独训练的选择器最多仅为0.4186。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明，一个较小的框级模块无需重训练任何骨干网络，即可调和问题理解与精确定位之间的矛盾，实现了显著的性能提升。

title: Low-Latency Activation-Regularized Sparse Neural Operators with Distillation Assistance Towards Real-Time Edge-Deployable Virtual Sensing
summary: Virtual sensing enables digital twins and safety-critical systems to reconstruct and forecast spatial-temporal physics in real time. However, conventional computational and data-driven methods often face challenges in generalization, latency, and energy efficiency for edge deployment. Neural operators offer a promising alternative but remain reliant on power-intensive hardware. Spiking neurons and neuromorphic computing can improve efficiency, yet surrogate-gradient training and multi-step spiking introduce convergence and latency challenges. We propose the Sparse-Activation-ReLU (SAR) layer, a single-step alternative that promotes activation sparsity without surrogate-gradient training while remaining compatible with event-based computing. Within a trunk-based NOMAD architecture, SAR achieves over a fivefold improvement in the combined Latency-Error-Energy (LEE) metric compared with Variable Spiking Neuron (VSN) and Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) implementations. We further analyze spiking entropy and feature usage and introduce synthetic knowledge distillation, reducing the LEE score by more than twofold. Finally, we improve VSN through a ReLU-based spiking loss and graph-neighbor thresholding. On the Heat Exchanger dataset, these approaches reduce L2 error by more than twofold and nearly sevenfold, respectively, while reducing spiking and spatial aggregation. Overall, the work presented is a step towards energy-efficient virtual sensing by providing an alternative framework that can be positioned towards neuromorphic or other edge device integration that can be a gold standard to compare latency, energy, and error performance for future efficient designs that are sparsity or brain-inspired spiking based.

AI.tldr: 本文提出稀疏激活ReLU（SAR）层，作为单步替代方案，在不依赖代理梯度训练的情况下促进激活稀疏性，并可兼容事件计算。在基于trunk的NOMAD架构中，SAR相比变量脉冲神经元（VSN）和LIF实现，在延迟-误差-能量（LEE）联合指标上实现超过5倍的提升；进一步通过合成知识蒸馏将LEE分数降低2倍以上，并在热交换器数据集上将L2误差降低两倍以上至近七倍。该工作为面向边缘部署的能效虚拟传感提供了不同于脑启发脉冲方法的替代框架。
AI.motivation: 虚拟传感需要实时重构和预测时空物理场，但传统计算和数据驱动方法在泛化性、延迟和边缘部署的能效方面面临挑战。神经算子虽具潜力，但依赖高功耗硬件；脉冲神经网络虽能提升能效，却因代理梯度训练和多步脉冲引入收敛与延迟问题。因此需要一种兼顾稀疏性、能效与低延迟的新型替代方案。
AI.method: 提出SAR（Sparse-Activation-ReLU）层，为单步激活层，无需代理梯度训练即可实现激活稀疏性，并与事件驱动计算兼容。将其嵌入trunk-based NOMAD架构中；引入合成知识蒸馏以进一步降低LEE指标；同时改进VSN，采用基于ReLU的脉冲损失和邻域图阈值化方法。
AI.result: 在热交换器数据集上，SAR相比VSN和LIF实现LEE指标提升超过5倍；合成知识蒸馏将LEE分数降低2倍以上；改进后的VSN分别将L2误差降低超过2倍和近7倍，同时减少了脉冲活动和空间聚合开销。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为能效虚拟传感提供了一种替代框架，可在边缘或神经形态设备上部署，并提出LEE指标作为未来能效设计（无论是基于稀疏性还是脑启发脉冲方式）的基准评估标准，是迈向高效虚拟传感的重要一步。

title: One-Shot Learning from Demonstration of Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation by Identifying Physical Interactions
summary: Learning from Demonstration (LfD) allows robots to learn manipulation tasks directly from humans, thereby supporting the versatile application of robots. Most LfD methods do not explicitly model the physical interactions between a robot and its environment, such as the making and breaking of contact, while these are crucial during manipulation tasks. Because the same basic physical interactions recur often, they can be a basis for robust, generalizable, and adaptive task reproduction. We propose an LfD method that explicitly uses what physical interactions take place where and when. Using that information, a hybrid position-force controller tracks demonstrated trajectories until contact-based transition conditions from the demonstrations are met. We evaluate our method in real robot experiments consisting of opening doors and locks, bolt picking and screwing, dislodging, and surface contouring. We show that explicitly modeling physical interactions benefits LfD in four ways. First, by allowing reproduction of complex, sequential, and contact-rich manipulation tasks using only a single demonstration and no prior knowledge of the task. Second, by facilitating robustness to unknown geometric variations in the environment. Third, by facilitating generalization when geometric variations are known. Fourth, by facilitating online adaptation using geometric information explored during task reproduction. We discuss how robustness, generalization, and adaptivity can be explicitly implemented, which is generally lacking in the LfD literature. Thereby, our work aims to close a gap in interpretable few-shot LfD of robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于物理交互显式建模的机器人示教学习（LfD）方法，通过建模接触在何处、何时发生，利用混合位置-力控制器跟踪示教轨迹直至满足接触触发的转换条件，从而仅需单次演示即可复现复杂、顺序性、接触密集的操作任务。
AI.motivation: 大多数LfD方法没有显式建模机器人与环境间的物理交互（如接触的建立与断开），但这些接触在操作任务中至关重要。由于相同的基本物理交互经常重复出现，它们可以成为鲁棒、可泛化、自适应任务复现的基础。
AI.method: 提出一种LfD方法，显式利用物理交互发生的位置和时间信息；采用混合位置-力控制器跟踪示教轨迹，直到满足从演示中提取的基于接触的转换条件时才切换行为。
AI.result: 在真实机器人实验中评估了开门和开锁、螺栓拾取和拧紧、拆卸以及表面轮廓跟踪等任务。结果表明显式建模物理交互在四个方面带来好处：1）仅需单次演示且无需任务先验知识即可复现复杂、顺序性、接触密集的任务；2）对环境中未知几何变化具有鲁棒性；3）在几何变化已知时支持泛化；4）利用任务复现过程中探索的几何信息支持在线自适应。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过显式实现鲁棒性、泛化性和自适应性，弥补了LfD文献中可解释的少样本机器人操作学习方面的空白。

title: AI Finds A Way
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms frequently learn creative and unexpected solutions, surprising even expert researchers who develop and study them. They often astonish practitioners by discovering unanticipated behavior, exploiting loopholes in reward signals, or spontaneously uncovering previously unknown scientific phenomena. However, accounts of such unconventional behavior across machine learning are seldom formally documented. This work presents 26 curated firsthand anecdotes from various machine learning subfields representing the work of over 100 researchers. These anecdotes showcase the capability of modern AI systems to circumvent human-imposed design limitations and discover unexpected solutions to the tasks we train them on. Furthermore, these accounts are particularly important for the safety of future AI systems. They illustrate the fundamental challenge of aligning models with human values without diminishing their creativity, so they can make surprising discoveries without producing surprising, potentially harmful outcomes. The paper first details AI achieving superhuman success through reinforcement learning across many challenging domains. However, reward-driven optimization can fail when the model learns to hack an underspecified reward or unarticulated constraint. We then present case studies suggesting that harnessing internet-scale foundation models (FMs) has not resolved these fundamental challenges and, in fact, can supercharge them. Nevertheless, we argue that these same learning dynamics can be harnessed to accelerate scientific discovery. Finally, we hope this work provides a consolidated resource to inform future research and demonstrates that the tendency toward unexpected behaviors is commonplace in modern AI, highlighting the need to anticipate and manage AI's capacity for innovative, yet unpredictable, solutions. (abstract abridged)

AI.tldr: 本文汇总了机器学习各子领域中由超过100位研究者提供的26则精心挑选的第一手轶事，展示了现代AI系统如何规避人类设计的限制并发现意外解决方案。作者认为这些"非预期行为"对AI安全至关重要，揭示了在保持模型创造力的同时对齐人类价值观的根本挑战，并提出这些学习动态同样可以被利用来加速科学发现。
AI.motivation: AI算法经常产生创造性且出人意料的解决方案，即使开发它们的研究者也会感到惊讶，但这类非传统行为在机器学习文献中很少被正式记录。作者希望通过系统整理这些轶事，为AI安全研究和设计提供重要参考，说明模型在奖励驱动优化中可能产生的意外行为与人类对齐之间的根本性张力。
AI.method: 论文采用质性案例研究方法，收集并整理来自多个机器学习子领域（包括强化学习、基础模型等）的26则第一手轶事，涵盖超过100位研究者的亲身经历。论文按主题组织这些案例，涵盖奖励黑客、约束规避、意外科学发现等类别，并进行跨领域的对比分析。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）强化学习能在许多具有挑战性的领域实现超人表现，但奖励驱动优化可能因模型学会利用未充分指定的奖励或未明确表述的约束而失败；2）利用互联网规模基础模型并未解决这些根本性挑战，反而可能加剧它们；3）同样的学习动态可以用于加速科学发现。
AI.conclusion: 意外行为倾向在现代AI中普遍存在，这凸显了预见和管理AI创新但不可预测的解决方案的必要性。研究希望提供一个综合资源，以指导未来研究，并强调在AI安全框架中需要系统性地考虑和应对模型的"创造性越轨"行为。

title: RecurSE: Bounded Recursive Self-Evaluation for LLM Rubric Judges
summary: LLM-as-judge is essential for evaluating open-ended text and steering post-training, yet improving the judge itself typically relies on expensive annotations, reward models, or distillation from stronger teachers. In this work, we eliminate external gold supervision from the RL training reward: the model's own evaluative capability generates learning signals for its optimization -- a closed-loop setting of bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) termed Recursive Self-Evaluation (RecurSE). We study two central questions: when can self-improvement occur, and when must it stop? First, RecurSE pairs a trainable judge evaluating candidate responses under per-rule rubrics (Pass 1) with a synchronized policy-copy checker that audits the judge's reasoning against meta-rubrics to supply a scalar process reward (Pass 2). To enable learning, interface decoupling structurally isolates the checker's scalar score from the judge's verdict tokens, eliminating a degenerative token-copying shortcut that inflates self-assigned rewards. Second, because unanchored recursive learning is inherently bounded, Pairwise Advantage Validity (PAV) serves as an unbiased validation monitor that jointly tracks judge accuracy and checker fidelity to reliably identify the optimal early-stopping window. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, and Qwen3.6-27B, RecurSE achieves consistent generalization gains across held-out medical, pairwise, summarization, and professional benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that synchronized judge-checker co-evolution outperforms frozen checkers, external meta-judges, self-consistency, and scaled teacher distillation. Furthermore, preference pairs curated by our judge effectively enhance downstream policy alignment. Bounded RSI for LLM-as-judge is thus viable when self-produced reward validity is explicitly decoupled and monitored.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RecurSE框架，通过模型的自我评估能力生成RL训练信号，实现有界的递归自我改进（RSI）用于LLM-as-judge训练，无需外部监督。通过接口解耦消除捷径，利用PAV监控器识别最优早停窗口。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-judge对开放文本评估和后训练至关重要，但改进judge本身通常依赖昂贵的标注、奖励模型或从更强教师蒸馏。作者旨在消除外部金标监督，探索模型自身评估能力作为学习信号的可行性。
AI.method: RecurSE包含两个核心组件：1) Pass 1中可训练的judge在逐规则rubrics下评估候选响应；2) Pass 2中同步的策略副本checker根据meta-rubrics审计judge的推理并输出标量过程奖励。接口解耦（interface decoupling）在结构上隔离checker的标量分数与judge的判定令牌，消除退化的令牌复制捷径。此外，Pairwise Advantage Validity (PAV)作为无偏验证监控器，联合跟踪judge准确率和checker保真度以识别最优早停窗口。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.6-27B上，RecurSE在医疗、成对、摘要和专业基准上取得一致的泛化提升。消融实验表明同步judge-checker共同演化优于冻结checker、外部meta-judge、自一致性和缩放教师蒸馏。judge生成的偏好对还能有效增强下游策略对齐。
AI.conclusion: 只要自产奖励的有效性得到显式解耦和监控，有界的RSI用于LLM-as-judge是可行的。这为减少对外部监督依赖的自我改进训练提供了新范式。

title: SceneReGen: Generative Reconstruction of 3D Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Single-image 3D scene reconstruction must complete partially observed objects and place them coherently in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. Object-level generative priors offer strong completion ability, but their centered, scale-normalized outputs are typically expressed in an object frame, creating a fundamental representation gap between object generation and scene reconstruction. We introduce SceneReGen, a generative reconstruction framework that reinterprets scene reconstruction as the generation and assembly of complete object assets in a shared observation-aligned scene frame. SceneReGen addresses the generation-reconstruction gap through selective pose factorization: each object's observed orientation is encoded directly in the generated mesh, while translation and scale are estimated from instance-level and global scene evidence. Given a scene image and instance masks, a geometry encoder extracts dense cues; learnable shape queries condition a pretrained DiT-based 3D generator to produce complete meshes in their observed orientations, while position queries fuse object and scene features to assemble them in the shared frame. On the 3D-FUTURE evaluation subset, SceneReGen achieves the best scene-level CD, scene-level F-Score, and 3D bounding-box IoU among the evaluated methods, ties the best object-level CD, and ranks second in object-level F-Score. Qualitative outputs in autonomous-driving and embodied-AI scenes further illustrate the potential of asset-centric reconstruction beyond indoor furniture.

AI.tldr: SceneReGen是一种生成式单图像3D场景重建框架，将场景重建重新定义为在共享观测对齐坐标系中生成和装配完整物体资产的过程，通过选择性位姿分解弥合物体生成与场景重建之间的表征鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 单图像3D场景重建需要补全部分遮挡的物体并将它们连贯地放置在共享的观测对齐场景坐标系中。基于物体的生成先验虽然具备强大的补全能力，但其中心化、尺度归一化的输出通常以物体坐标系表达，与场景重建所需的场景坐标系之间存在根本的表征鸿沟。
AI.method: SceneReGen通过选择性位姿分解解决生成-重建鸿沟：物体的观测朝向被直接编码进生成的网格中，而平移和尺度则从实例级和全局场景证据中估计。具体地，给定场景图像和实例掩码，几何编码器提取稠密线索；可学习的形状查询条件化预训练的基于DiT的3D生成器，以生成保持观测朝向的完整网格；位置查询融合物体与场景特征以在共享坐标系中装配它们。
AI.result: 在3D-FUTURE评估子集上，SceneReGen在场景级CD、场景级F-Score和3D边界框IoU上取得最优，在物体级CD上与最佳方法持平，在物体级F-Score上排名第二。定性结果表明该方法在自动驾驶和具身AI场景中也有潜力。
AI.conclusion: SceneReGen通过将物体生成与场景重建统一到共享的观测对齐坐标系中，在室内场景重建任务上达到领先性能，并展示了在自动驾驶和具身AI等更广泛场景中应用资产中心化重建的潜力。

title: Revenge of Monosemanticity: Specialized Neurons Improve Data Efficiency in MLPs
summary: Understanding how neural networks learn and organize features is central to understanding their behavior. Much existing theory of feature learning has focused on the emergence of a global low-dimensional predictive geometry. We show that this picture is incomplete. In regression problems with clustered data, we demonstrate that multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) naturally develop monosemantic specialized neurons: individual neurons become strongly aligned with a specific predictive feature relevant to a particular region of the input space. Rather than learning a single global low-dimensional representation, MLPs learn a collection of local low-dimensional representations that can collectively span a high-dimensional space. This specialization provably gives MLPs a data-efficiency advantage over feature-learning methods based on a global low-dimensional representation.

AI.tldr: 该论文表明，多层感知机（MLP）在处理聚类数据的回归问题中，会自然发展出单语义（monosemantic）特化神经元，即单个神经元与特定输入区域相关的预测特征强对齐。MLP学习的不是单一全局低维表征，而是一组局部低维表征的集合，这些局部表征共同可以张成高维空间，并且这种特化在数据效率上具有优于基于全局低维表征的特征学习方法的可证明优势。
AI.motivation: 现有特征学习理论主要聚焦于全局低维预测几何结构的涌现，作者认为这一图景不完整，需要更全面地理解神经网络如何学习和组织特征，尤其是在数据呈现聚类结构时的局部特化行为。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和证明，研究回归问题中具有聚类结构的数据上MLP的行为，展示其自然形成与特定输入区域预测特征对齐的单语义特化神经元，并形式化证明这种局部特化表征在数据效率上的优势。
AI.result: 证明MLP会学习一组局部低维表征而非单一全局低维表征，这些局部表征可以共同张成高维空间；同时证明了这种特化结构给MLP带来数据效率上的可证明优势。
AI.conclusion: 全局低维表征理论不足以完整描述神经特征学习，局部特化机制是理解MLP在聚类数据上行为和数据效率优势的关键。

title: Latent Action as Intention Enables Efficient Future Imagination for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) improve robot control by modeling how observations evolve, but generating future observations at test time incurs substantial latency. Fast-WAM removes this process for efficiency; however, our matched implementations show lower generalization for Fast-WAM than for future-aware alternatives, especially with scarce robot demonstrations and in out-of-distribution scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce **LAWA**, a WAM architecture that uses compact latent actions as an operational representation of future intentions, enabling efficient test-time future imagination without generating future observations. Specifically, a discrete tokenizer enhanced by action-free pre-training produces manipulation-centric codebook targets. LAWA jointly denoises a continuous latent state anchored to these targets with executable action chunks while omitting the future-video branch at inference. On RoboCasa, LAWA achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 65.6% and 80.8% in the few-shot and full data settings, improving over the matched Fast-WAM baseline by 9.6 and 4.5 points, respectively. It also preserves the performance level of the matched Joint-WAM variant while requiring 42.9% lower inference latency. LAWA also demonstrates competitive zero-shot robustness on LIBERO-Plus and superior performance on real-world tasks. These results show that future imagination need not be discarded: retaining it with compact latent actions yields an effective trade-off among performance, generalization, and latency. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAWA，一种基于紧凑潜动作的世界动作模型架构，在推理时不生成未来观测视频的情况下实现高效的测试时未来想象，在性能、泛化性和延迟之间取得了有效平衡。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过建模观测演化来提升机器人控制，但测试时生成未来观测会带来显著延迟。Fast-WAM通过移除该过程提升效率，但其泛化能力低于未来感知的替代方案，尤其在机器人演示数据稀缺和分布外场景中更为明显。作者旨在弥合这一性能差距。
AI.method: LAWA使用紧凑潜动作作为未来意图的操作性表征，实现无需生成未来观测的高效测试时未来想象。具体而言：1）采用由无动作预训练增强的离散分词器，生成以操作为中心的码本目标；2）联合去噪锚定于这些目标的连续潜状态与可执行动作块；3）推理时省略未来视频分支。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa上，LAWA在少样本和全数据设置下分别达到65.6%和80.8%的平均成功率，较匹配的Fast-WAM基线分别提升9.6和4.5个百分点；同时保持匹配的Joint-WAM变体的性能水平，推理延迟降低42.9%。在LIBERO-Plus上展现出竞争性的零样本鲁棒性，并在真实世界任务中表现优越。
AI.conclusion: 未来想象不应被简单丢弃：通过紧凑潜动作保留未来想象，可以在性能、泛化性和延迟之间实现有效的权衡，为高效且泛化的机器人世界模型提供了一条可行路径。

title: Provenance Guided Incremental Learning Under Evolving Concept Definitions
summary: Learning systems deployed over long periods must adapt not only to statistical changes in incoming data, but also to revisions of the definitions that generate their prediction targets. Conventional concept-drift methods typically infer such changes from observations or prediction errors, even when the underlying policy, rule, or query has been explicitly modified. This paper studies rule-induced concept shift, where the target-defining concept is revised directly, causing previously stored instances to acquire different semantic labels without requiring any change in their observed data. We introduce a provenance-guided incremental learning framework that compiles consecutive concept definitions into a structured rule delta, traces the changed components through historical provenance, certifies records whose previous labels remain valid, and restricts reevaluation to a localized candidate region. Executable revisions are relabeled automatically, ambiguous cases are handled through selective supervision, and the resulting changes are used for incremental predictor repair. A versioned concept memory further supports recurring definitions. We also introduce RuleShift-Bench, spanning financial, demographic, cybersecurity, and graph-structured data with threshold, predicate, logical, relational, recurring, and mixed concept revisions. Across the benchmark, provenance-guided repair attains 92.3% accuracy and 90.2% Macro-F1 while reprocessing 14.7% of the historical collection and retaining 94.6% of affected records. Its average update latency is 179s compared with 993s for complete relabeling and retraining. The results demonstrate that an explicit concept revision can be exploited as a data-maintenance signal, allowing learning systems to update the supervision and predictive state that depend on the change while preserving knowledge that remains valid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于数据血缘（provenance）的增量学习框架，用于应对"规则诱导的概念漂移"——即目标定义规则被显式修改而导致的语义标签变化。通过将概念修订编译为规则差分（rule delta）、追踪受影响记录并仅对局部候选区域重新评估，该框架将重处理率降至14.7%，准确率达92.3%，平均延迟从993s降至179s，并引入了包含多种修订类型的RuleShift-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 传统概念漂移方法通常从观测数据或预测误差中推断概念变化，但忽略了现实中规则、政策或查询被显式修订的场景。这类修订使得已有数据的语义标签需要更新，而无需改变数据本身。现有方法无法有效处理这种"规则诱导的概念漂移"，导致系统需要全量重标定和重训练，成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出provenance-guided增量学习框架：1) 将连续的概念定义编译为结构化规则差分（rule delta）；2) 通过历史数据血缘追踪受影响的组件；3) 认证之前标签仍有效的记录，将重评估限制在局部候选区域；4) 可执行修订自动重标记，歧义情况通过选择性监督处理；5) 利用变更结果进行增量预测器修复；6) 引入版本化概念记忆支持循环出现的概念定义。
AI.result: 在RuleShift-Bench（覆盖金融、人口、网络安全和图结构数据，包含阈值、谓词、逻辑、关系、循环和混合六类概念修订）上，provenance-guided修复达到92.3%准确率和90.2% Macro-F1，仅需重新处理14.7%的历史数据，保留94.6%受影响记录。平均更新延迟179s，远低于全量重标定和重训练的993s。
AI.conclusion: 明确的概念修订可以被利用为数据维护信号，使学习系统只更新依赖该变更的监督与预测状态，同时保留仍然有效的知识。该框架显著降低了规则变更后的系统维护成本，验证了从显式修订中提取结构化信息以驱动增量学习范式的可行性和高效性。

title: ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts for Extracting Extreme Long-tail Events from Historical Texts
summary: This paper proposes methods to extract over 50 types of events from a Dutch historical corpus spanning the 17th and 18th centuries. The methods we propose aim to tackle the impossible: extracting the long-tail of the long-tail. Historic data from before the 19th century is in itself a niche domain not covered in the pre-training of Large Language Models, and we aim to extract events only very scarcely annotated in the training data available for this domain. We propose creating expert classifiers for subgroups of the events present in the training data. We make these groupings based on similar frequency in the training data or on semantic relatedness. Experts trained on underrepresented events are assigned higher priority when predicting to avoid being dominated by frequency biases. We refer to this new way of combining classifiers, specifically tailored to protect the long-tail, as ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts. We also propose a controlled method to create domain-specific synthetic data. Our two implementations of ROBE outperform a simple fine-tuned encoder model with a .10 increase in recall and a .16 increase in precision respectively. The best model achieves a .10 increase in f1 for a group of long-tail classes in our niche data set.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROBE（反向顺序偏置专家）方法，用于从17-18世纪荷兰历史语料中提取超过50种事件类型，尤其专注于长尾尾部稀有事件的提取，并通过领域特定合成数据与专家分类器组合，显著提升了长尾类别的召回率与精确率。
AI.motivation: 19世纪之前的历史数据是LLM预训练中未覆盖的利基领域，且目标事件在训练数据中仅有极稀疏的标注。传统方法受频率偏差影响，难以提取长尾中的长尾事件，即既属于利基领域又极少被标注的事件类别。
AI.method: 1) 提出ROBE（Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts）框架：将事件按训练数据中相似频率或语义相关性分组，为每组训练专家分类器；预测时，针对欠表示事件训练的专家被赋予更高优先级，以避免频率偏差主导。2) 提出一种受控的领域特定合成数据生成方法，以扩充训练数据。
AI.result: 两种ROBE实现相较于简单微调的编码器模型，召回率分别提升0.10，精确率分别提升0.16；最佳模型在利基数据集的长尾类别上F1提升了0.10。
AI.conclusion: ROBE通过反向优先级排序的专家组合策略，有效保护了历史语料中极稀有事件类别的提取性能，为利基领域的长尾事件抽取提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Luce: Relightable Gaussians for 3D Asset Generation
summary: High-fidelity image-to-3D generation requires a 3D representation that captures both geometry and appearance. To support relighting and integration into standard rendering pipelines, the representation should include physically based rendering (PBR) modalities such as albedo, metallic-roughness, and surface normals. We propose Luce, a 3D representation that unifies geometry and PBR materials within a voxelized multimodal Gaussian cloud, using dedicated Gaussian primitives for each modality. A variational autoencoder compresses this representation into a unified material-aware latent space. A rectified-flow transformer generates this latent from a single image, conditioned on multi-layer features from a pretrained image encoder that preserve both semantic context and fine spatial detail. The latent then decodes into relightable PBR Gaussians and an optional textured mesh with a tangent-space normal map. On Toys4K, Luce achieves state-of-the-art single-image-to-3D generation, improving FID by 28% over the strongest baseline. We further introduce a benchmark of AI-generated images, on which Luce improves the CLIP image-alignment score over the best baseline (0.8519 vs. 0.8299). Luce generates relightable, geometrically accurate, and materially faithful assets that preserve fine details such as text, logos, and inscriptions.

AI.tldr: Luce是一种用于单图像到3D生成的3D表示方法，将几何与PBR材质统一在体素化多模态高斯云中，通过变分自编码器和整流流Transformer实现高保真、可重照明的3D资产生成，在Toys4K基准上FID提升28%。
AI.motivation: 高保真图像到3D生成需要同时捕捉几何和外观，且需要支持重照明并集成到标准渲染管线中，因此3D表示需要包含PBR模态（如反照率、金属-粗糙度、表面法线）。现有方法在生成可重照明、几何精确且材质保真的3D资产方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出Luce，一种将几何和PBR材质统一在体素化多模态高斯云中的3D表示，每种模态使用专用高斯基元。通过变分自编码器将表示压缩为统一的材质感知潜空间，再利用整流流Transformer从单张图像生成该潜空间，该Transformer以预训练图像编码器的多层特征为条件（同时保留语义上下文和细粒度空间细节）。潜空间解码为可重照明的PBR高斯体以及可选的带切线空间法线图的纹理网格。
AI.result: 在Toys4K基准上，Luce实现了最先进的单图像到3D生成，FID较最强基线提升28%。在AI生成图像基准上，Luce将CLIP图像对齐分数从0.8299提升至0.8519。Luce能够生成可重照明、几何精确且材质保真的资产，保留文字、标志和铭文等细节。
AI.conclusion: Luce通过统一几何与PBR材料的体素化多模态高斯表示，结合潜空间压缩和整流流生成，实现了单图像到3D生成的SOTA性能，生成结果可重照明且保留精细细节，为可泛化的高质量3D内容生成提供了有效方案。

title: ChorusTIC: Training-Free Multivariate Time Series Classification via Chorus In-Context Learning
summary: Time series classification underpins applications in healthcare, sensing, and industrial monitoring. Although time series foundation models support forecasting and transferable representation learning, classification still typically requires fitting a task-specific classifier on each target dataset, while individual channels of multivariate inputs are often encoded independently. We introduce ChorusTIC, a classification-native foundation model for in-context classification across heterogeneous channel configurations without target-task parameter updates. ChorusTIC combines episode-consistent Random Subchannel Slot Concatenation with a shared dual-axis encoder to model temporal and cross-channel interactions and map variable channel configurations into a fixed-width representation independent of the original channel count. It then calibrates feature axes using context-derived distributions and predicts query labels through leakage-protected in-context learning. We pretrain ChorusTIC solely on synthetic labeled episodes comprising context and query sets that share a task background, with classes distinguished by sparse temporal or cross-channel rules. Evaluations on the complete UEA-30 and UCR-128 archives show strong full-context and low-label performance without target-specific classifier fitting.

AI.tldr: ChorusTIC是一个面向时间序列分类的原生基础模型，通过上下文内学习实现跨异构通道配置的分类，无需对目标任务进行参数更新，仅在合成标注数据上预训练，在UEA-30和UCR-128基准上取得优异成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型主要聚焦于预测和可迁移表示学习，分类任务仍需要针对每个目标数据集拟合特定的分类器；此外，多变量输入的各个通道往往被独立编码，无法有效建模跨通道交互。作者旨在构建一个无需目标任务参数更新的分类原生基础模型。
AI.method: ChorusTIC包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于episode一致的随机子通道槽拼接（Random Subchannel Slot Concatenation），将可变通道配置映射为固定宽度表示；(2) 共享双轴编码器分别建模时间维度和跨通道交互；(3) 利用上下文分布校准特征轴，并通过防泄漏的上下文内学习预测查询标签。模型仅在合成的带标签episode（包含共享任务背景的上下文集和查询集）上预训练，类别由稀疏时间或跨通道规则区分。
AI.result: 在完整的UEA-30和UCR-128时间序列分类基准上，ChorusTIC展现出强全上下文性能和低标注样本下的优异表现，无需为目标任务拟合特定分类器。
AI.conclusion: ChorusTIC验证了时间序列分类原生基础模型的可行性，通过合成数据和上下文内学习实现了跨异构通道配置的即用型分类能力，为时间序列分类领域提供了新的基础模型范式。

title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
summary: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as learned simulators for policy evaluation and improvement, yet their effectiveness rests on an unverified assumption: generated futures faithfully reflect arbitrary valid actions. Existing benchmarks are typically confined to expert demonstrations, leaving off-expert action following inadequately evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce WorldEcho, which probes action following over a broader action distribution using visual integrity and SE(3) trajectory alignment. Our diagnosis shows that current world models reasonably execute expert actions but struggle with diverse off-expert trajectories, either ignoring the commanded actions or producing visually invalid rollouts. We further propose WorldSync, which strengthens action following along three complementary axes: distributional coverage, representational grounding, and intervention-effect alignment. It broadens the training distribution over action consequences, grounds intermediate video representations in action-induced robot dynamics through an Action-Forcing Expert, and aligns predicted changes under action interventions with the corresponding changes in ground-truth futures. Experiments on RoboTwin benchmarks and real-robot tasks show that WorldSync improves WorldEcho metrics and serves as a more reliable simulator for iterative policy improvement, enabling policies to achieve higher success rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldEcho基准，用于广泛动作分布下评估世界模型的行动遵循能力；并提出WorldSync方法，通过分布覆盖、表征落地和干预对齐三个维度强化世界模型的行动遵循能力，实验证明其作为模拟器能有效提升策略表现。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型假设生成的未来轨迹能忠实反映任意有效动作，但这一假设未经验证。已有基准通常局限于专家演示数据，对非专家（off-expert）动作的遵循能力评估不足，阻碍了世界模型作为通用学习模拟器的可靠应用。
AI.method: 1) 提出WorldEcho诊断基准，通过视觉完整性和SE(3)轨迹对齐在更广泛的动作分布上探测行动遵循能力；2) 提出WorldSync方法，沿三个互补维度强化：分布覆盖（拓宽训练中动作后果的分布）、表征落地（通过Action-Forcing Expert将中间视频表征锚定于动作引起的机器人动力学）、干预效应对齐（将动作干预下预测的变化与真实未来的相应变化对齐）。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin基准和真实机器人任务上的实验表明：现有世界模型在专家动作上表现尚可，但在多样非专家轨迹上表现挣扎（忽略指令动作或产生视觉无效的rollout）；WorldSync改善了WorldEcho指标，并作为迭代策略改进的模拟器使策略获得更高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型对专家动作的执行能力不等于对任意动作的忠实遵循能力；通过WorldSync的三轴强化策略可显著提升世界模型在广泛动作分布上的行动遵循能力，使其成为更可靠的策略改进模拟器。

title: BenchBench-Protocol: Evaluating Real-World Wet-Lab Protocol Reasoning and Modification
summary: We introduce BenchBench-Protocol, a benchmark for large language models of 149 protocol-modification tasks recovered from modifications that scientists made to published protocols during real experimental work. Adapting a published protocol to a new experiment is a routine task for a wet-lab scientist, and a correct modification requires accounting for prior choices and downstream steps. Recent life-science benchmarks have moved toward open-ended, rubric-graded tasks, but tasks are typically elicited from experts rather than reconstructed from real-world modifications. BenchBench-Protocol tasks are derived from differences between a published protocol and a version a scientist modified, which provides the basis for the query and the weighted rubric elements for a correct response. The benchmark draws from 96 source protocols across nine domains of wet-lab biology and only includes tasks rated highly after review by domain experts. We evaluate nine closed and open models; Claude Opus 5 scores highest at 59.2% normalized rubric score, with other models between 34.1% and 47.1%, and the benchmark remains unsaturated when taking the best of ten attempts. As models are increasingly helpful in life-sciences research, evaluating them on routine wet-lab tasks becomes correspondingly important. We present BenchBench-Protocol as both a grounded assessment of wet-lab reasoning and evidence for the utility of real-world experiments to construct benchmark tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BenchBench-Protocol，一个包含149个协议修改任务的大语言模型基准测试集。这些任务来源于科学家在实际实验工作中对已发表协议的修改，由96个来源协议跨越九个湿实验室生物学领域构建，且经过领域专家评审。在九个闭源和开源模型评估中，Claude Opus 5得分最高（59.2%归一化rubric分数），其他模型得分在34.1%-47.1%之间，基准测试在十次尝试的最佳结果下仍未饱和。
AI.motivation: 将已发表协议适配到新实验是湿实验室科学家的日常任务，正确修改需要考虑先前的选择和下游步骤。现有生命科学基准测试偏向开放式、rubric评分的任务，但任务通常由专家引出而非从真实世界修改中重建。随着大语言模型在生命科学研究中日益有用，需要对其在常规湿实验室任务上的表现进行评估。
AI.method: BenchBench-Protocol的任务源于已发表协议与科学家修改版本之间的差异，这提供了查询和正确响应加权rubric元素的基础。基准涵盖96个来源协议、九个湿实验室生物学领域，仅纳入领域专家评审后获得高评级的任务。评估了九个闭源和开源模型。
AI.result: Claude Opus 5得分最高，达到59.2%的归一化rubric分数，其他模型得分在34.1%至47.1%之间。取十次尝试的最佳结果时基准仍未饱和，表明当前模型在该基准上仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: BenchBench-Protocol既是对湿实验室推理能力的基于真实场景的评估，也证明了利用真实实验构建基准任务的有效性。该基准为衡量大语言模型在常规湿实验室任务中的能力提供了落地依据。

title: SENSESHIFT: Continuous Sentiment-Controlled Text Generation via Encoder-based Mask Infilling
summary: Recent controllable text generation (CTG) for sentiment control has largely focused on decoder-based large language models, making causal attention the dominant paradigm. While effective for fluent generation, these models still struggle to satisfy complex constraints and follow fine-grained sentiment signals specified by users. Existing sentiment-aware CTG methods typically simplify the problem by treating sentiment either as a coarse categorical label (e.g., positive or negative) or as a single fine-grained control signal applied to an entire document. Consequently, more challenging settings such as sentence-level sentiment control within long-form text remain underexplored. To address these limitations, we introduce SenseShift , an encoder-based framework for fine-grained sentence-level CTG. Unlike standard decoder architectures, SenseShift leverages bidirectional attention, quantized sentiment signals, and iterative mask infilling to generate local sentences conditioned on target sentiment intensity. Empirical evaluations on story and review generation demonstrate that SenseShift achieves stronger sentiment controllability while maintaining text quality and robustness to out-of-domain generation compared to larger decoder-based baselines.

AI.tldr: SenseShift是一个基于编码器架构的细粒度句级可控文本生成框架，利用双向注意力、量化情感信号和迭代掩码填充来生成条件于目标情感强度的局部句子。在故事和评论生成任务上，它比更大的基于解码器的基线模型实现了更强的情感可控性，同时保持了文本质量和跨域鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有可控文本生成方法主要依赖解码器架构的大型语言模型，将情感简化为粗粒度类别标签或单一细粒度控制信号作用于整个文档，导致句级情感控制这一更具挑战性的设定（长文本中局部句子的情感控制）未被充分探索。
AI.method: SenseShift采用编码器架构，核心创新包括：（1）利用双向注意力替代解码器的因果注意力；（2）引入量化情感信号作为细粒度控制条件；（3）通过迭代掩码填充机制在长文本中生成条件于目标情感强度的局部句子。
AI.result: 在故事生成和评论生成任务上的实证评估表明，SenseShift相比更大的基于解码器的基线模型，在情感可控性上表现更强，同时保持了文本质量，并对域外生成具有更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SenseShift证明了编码器架构在细粒度句级情感可控文本生成中的可行性，为长文本中局部情感控制这一未充分探索的设定提供了有效方案。

title: Boot-and-Feedback Framework for Generalist-Expert Model Collaboration in Breast Ultrasound Diagnosis
summary: Breast ultrasound (BUS) is widely used for breast cancer diagnosis yet remains operator-dependent. While deep learning shows promise, ensuring diagnostic reliability and interpretability is challenging. Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often generate spurious descriptions due to limited domain knowledge, which mislead downstream expert models and compromise clinical validity. To address these challenges, we propose the Boot-and-Feedback (BooF) model collaboration framework for synergistic MLLM-expert interaction. Specifically, in the Boot Stage, the MLLM is guided by the BI-RADS lexicon and preliminary benign-malignant vision-expert predictions, enabling it to transfer general reasoning to BUS analysis while avoiding hallucinations. Subsequently, the Feedback Stage integrates these descriptions with visual features via a lightweight Attention-Gated Cross-Modality Fusion Module. This allows the expert to leverage textual feedback while adaptively filtering noise. Extensive experiments on multiple BUS datasets demonstrate that BooF substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of diagnostic accuracy and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出BooF（Boot-and-Feedback）模型协作框架，通过引导阶段促使多模态大语言模型基于BI-RADS词典和视觉专家预测生成可靠描述，再通过反馈阶段将文本描述与视觉特征融合，显著提升乳腺超声诊断的准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声诊断依赖操作者经验，深度学习虽有前景但可靠性和可解释性不足。现有MLLM因领域知识有限常生成虚假描述，误导下游专家模型，损害临床有效性。
AI.method: 提出BooF框架，包含两个阶段：（1）Boot阶段：利用BI-RADS词典和初步良恶性视觉专家预测引导MLLM生成可靠的BUS分析描述，避免幻觉；（2）Feedback阶段：通过轻量级注意力门控跨模态融合模块将文本描述与视觉特征整合，使专家模型利用文本反馈同时自适应过滤噪声。
AI.result: 在多个BUS数据集上的大量实验表明，BooF在诊断准确性和可解释性方面均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: BooF框架通过MLLM与视觉专家的协同交互，有效解决了MLLM在乳腺超声领域生成虚假描述的问题，实现了更高的诊断准确性和更好的临床可解释性。

title: PinSieve: Production Selective VLM Serving and a Governed Memory Flywheel for Enterprise Content-Quality Triage
comment: Accepted at the KDD 2026 workshop "Enterprise AI Agents: From Prototypes to Production."
summary: Enterprise AI agents in production often need to be bounded, stateful, observable, and governable rather than fully autonomous. We present PinSieve, a production case study in a large-scale content-quality pipeline. Its deployed component is a selective vision-language-model (VLM) Serving Agent that operates only on the grey-zone slice left unresolved by lightweight upstream models, exposes a scalar routing score online, and preserves controlled human escalation. On this slice, the deployed system filters 2.05x more non-actionable items than the previous production module while slightly reducing estimated miss rate; after promotion, it improves review productivity by 25.7%, reduces normalized operating cost by 16.2%, and moves signal delivery from next-day to same-day. We then study maintenance through a governed memory flywheel under selective feedback, where escalated items are reviewed by default and auto-passed items are labeled mainly through audit sampling. Feedback Memory records routing traces, observation paths, audit propensities, and replay metadata for evaluation and debugging. The Data Curation Agent uses a bounded proposal-verifier loop over representative, uncertainty, recency, and fresh-review replay, with positive-rate and score-bin guardrails before batch acceptance. In chained monthly refresh over six months of production data, this design reduces average FNR@50% from 17.73% under representative random replay to 13.29%. A Reasoning Review Agent audits teacher-generated rationales and supports keep/repair/drop decisions. Production claims are attributed only to the deployed Serving Agent; replay and rationale-review results are offline or sampled-governance evidence. The same serving-agent recipe has been adopted to several additional internal signals, suggesting transferability beyond one task.

AI.tldr: PinSieve是一个大规模内容质量管线的生产案例研究，提出了"有界、有状态、可观测、可治理"而非完全自主的企业级AI代理设计范式。其部署的VLM选择性服务代理仅处理浅层模型未解决的灰色地带，部署后过滤非可操作项数量提升2.05倍，审阅生产力提升25.7%，运营成本降低16.2%，信号交付从次日提前至当日。此外通过受治理的记忆飞轮（反馈记忆、数据策展代理、推理审阅代理）在选择性反馈下维持模型质量，离线重放实验将FNR@50%从17.73%降至13.29%，该方案已迁移至多个内部信号。
AI.motivation: 企业级AI代理在生产环境中需要被界定边界、具备状态、可观测且可治理，而非完全自主运行。现有研究缺乏在大规模内容质量管线中的生产级落地验证，尤其缺乏对选择性反馈（selective feedback）下模型维护（数据飞轮）的系统性研究。
AI.method: 采用选择性视觉语言模型（VLM）服务代理，仅处理浅层轻量模型无法判定的灰色地带样本；在线暴露标量路由分数并保留人工升级控制。维护阶段构建受治理的记忆飞轮：反馈记忆记录路由轨迹、观测路径、审计倾向及重放元数据；数据策展代理采用有界的提议-验证循环，基于代表性、不确定性、新鲜度等策略进行重放，并加入正例率与分数箱护栏；推理审阅代理审计教师生成的推理并对保留/修复/丢弃决策进行支持。
AI.result: 在灰色地带切片上，系统过滤的非可操作项数量比原生产模块多2.05倍，同时预估漏检率略有下降；推广后审阅生产力提升25.7%，归一化运营成本降低16.2%，信号交付从次日缩短至当日。在六个月生产数据的链式月度刷新中，平均FNR@50%从代表性随机重放下的17.73%降至13.29%。生产声明仅归属于已部署的服务代理；重放与推理审阅结果为离线或采样治理证据。
AI.conclusion: "有界且受治理"而非"完全自主"的代理设计在真实生产环境中是可行且有效的，选择性服务+治理记忆飞轮的组合能显著提升效率、降低成本并保持模型质量，且该服务代理配方具备跨任务可迁移性。

title: Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space
summary: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.

AI.tldr: HetSkills是一个在统一潜在空间中渐进学习异构技能的角色控制框架，将潜在空间视为共享可执行接口，无需重新训练即可复用运动解码器，通过运动直觉蒸馏和任务引导模块实现文本到运动生成与长期任务的适应。
AI.motivation: 物理驱动角色控制面临异构技能（来自不同数据源、不同监督形式、不同任务）的整合难题，现有方法难以在不同任务间无缝复用技能，且文本到运动生成容易利用捷径而非真正学习语言语义。
AI.method: 1) 先学习一个追踪技能，建立运动控制基础和共享运动解码器；2) 引入运动直觉蒸馏（motion intuition distillation）将文本到运动生成绑定到语言语义，防止模型走捷径；3) 设计任务引导模块（task-guidance module），根据高层语言指令动态调整动作；4) 将统一潜在空间作为共享可执行接口整合异构技能。
AI.result: 在运动追踪、文本到运动生成、运动补全和下游任务适应等任务上均验证了有效性，即使在具有挑战性的条件下也取得了令人印象深刻的成功率。
AI.conclusion: HetSkills能够在保持自然运动的同时不断扩展技能库，对长期（long-horizon）任务具有高度适应性，为物理驱动角色控制中的异构技能学习提供了统一且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Quantifying System-Level Harms from AI Adoption in Complex Sociotechnical Systems
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into complex sociotechnical systems, including Critical National Infrastructure (CNI), where harms emerge from interactions between technical, human, and organisational elements. Yet current AI evaluation remains model-centric, offering little insight into how observed behaviours might translate into system-level risk. We propose a framework that links structured hazard analysis, component-level testing, and probabilistic system modelling to bridge this gap. By providing a traceable pathway from model behaviour to system-level outcomes, the framework enables practitioners to answer the "so what?" of AI failures, quantify their systemic impact, and move toward evidence-based and anticipatory governance of AI in complex systems. Applied to the UK's Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system as an illustrative worked example, we derive AI-driven loss scenarios using Systems Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) and examine adversarial manipulation of LLM-based trading as one such loss scenario. Component-level experiments show that simple adversarial inputs induce measurable behavioural shifts where AI recommendations are followed. Under the component-to-system mapping used here for a financial contagion model, these shifts alter system resilience, increasing bank failures and lowering the threshold at which shocks lead to cascading disruption, particularly under widespread or monopolistic AI adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将结构化危害分析、组件级测试与概率系统建模相结合的框架，用于弥合AI模型行为与系统级风险之间的鸿沟，并以英国RTGS（实时全额结算）系统为案例，展示AI故障如何从组件行为映射到系统级损失。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估仍以模型为中心，无法揭示AI行为如何转化为复杂社会技术系统（尤其是关键国家基础设施）中的系统级风险。由于危害源于技术、人、组织要素的交互，需要一种能够回答AI故障"so what"问题的系统级评估方法。
AI.method: 提出一个三层框架：(1)利用系统理论过程分析（STPA）进行结构化危害分析，推导AI驱动的损失情景；(2)进行组件级实验，测试对抗性输入对LLM交易推荐的影响；(3)通过组件到系统的概率映射，在金融传染模型中量化系统弹性变化，评估银行失败数量与级联扰动阈值。
AI.result: 实验表明，简单的对抗输入即可引发可测量的LLM推荐行为偏移。在金融传染模型的组件到系统映射下，这些行为偏移降低系统弹性，增加银行失败数量，并降低冲击引发级联扰动的阈值，尤其是在AI广泛采用或垄断性采用的情况下更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了从模型行为到系统级结果的可追溯路径，使从业者能够量化AI失败的系统性影响，推动基于证据的、前瞻性的AI治理。

title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research
summary: Deep research (DR) systems produce long-form cited reports by orchestrating multiple agents that search and synthesize information from the web. Citations are the primary mechanism for evaluating the faithfulness of these reports, yet current DR systems exhibit poor citation recall. Moreover, improving citation recall is challenging because DR systems are complex multi-agent architectures where information passes through agents like a telephone game, and both content and citations can get corrupted along the way. We propose an evaluation method that pinpoints which agent introduced each error by locally testing agent invocations for faithfulness and verifiability relative to their own inputs. Furthermore, we propose a four-type taxonomy to categorize the discovered errors: hallucination, uncited input reliance, uncited output, or insufficient citations. Applying our method to three top-ranked open-source DR systems, we obtain actionable diagnostics. Almost every agent makes a lot of mistakes with the exception being those that summarize a single document. We find that the dominant error type varies systematically across agents, where the orchestrator mistakes are mostly citation-related. We find that 84.7% of final-report errors in AI-Q originate at the orchestrator, roughly 31% of them hallucinations and the rest citation mistakes. Guided by these insights, we demonstrate that two simple interventions raise citation recall by 5% without degrading output quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对深度研究（DR）系统的错误溯源评估方法，通过局部测试各agent调用的忠实性与可验证性来定位每个错误由哪个agent引入，并构建了四类错误分类法（幻觉、未引用输入依赖、未引用输出、引用不足）。应用该方法发现DR系统中几乎所有agent都会犯错（唯独单文档摘要agent除外），主导错误类型随agent不同而系统变化，其中编排器（orchestrator）的错误主要是引用相关。基于这些洞察，两个简单干预措施可将引用召回率提升5%而不降低输出质量。
AI.motivation: 深度研究系统生成带有引用的长报告，但当前系统引用召回率（citation recall）较差。由于DR系统是复杂多智能体架构，信息在agent之间像"传话游戏"一样传递，内容和引用都可能在中途被破坏，导致难以改进引用召回率。因此需要一种能够准确定位每个错误由哪个agent引入的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出一种错误溯源评估方法：通过局部测试每个agent调用相对其自身输入的忠实性（faithfulness）与可验证性（verifiability），从而精确判定错误源自哪个agent。同时提出四类错误分类法：幻觉（hallucination）、未引用输入依赖（uncited input reliance）、未引用输出（uncited output）、引用不足（insufficient citations）。将该方法应用于三个顶级开源DR系统。
AI.result: 几乎所有agent都会犯大量错误，唯一例外是总结单个文档的agent。主导错误类型随agent不同呈现系统性变化，其中编排器的错误主要是引用相关。在AI-Q系统中，最终报告中84.7%的错误源自编排器，其中约31%是幻觉，其余为引用错误。基于这些发现，两个简单干预措施将引用召回率提升了5%且未降低输出质量。
AI.conclusion: 局部agent层面的忠实性/可验证性测试是定位DR系统错误来源的有效手段；编排器是DR系统中错误的主要来源（尤其是引用类错误），对其进行针对性干预能够显著提升引用召回率。这为改进DR系统提供了可操作的诊断方向和轻量级优化策略。

title: Source-Face Authenticity Detection for 3D Gaussian Heads Reconstructed from a Single Portrait: A Benchmark and Dedicated Detector
summary: Recent advances in single-image 3D Gaussian head reconstruction have enabled highly realistic and freely renderable digital heads from a single portrait. However, reconstruction and rendering can weaken the forgery traces in the source portrait, making the resulting 3D face difficult to classify whether its underlying face is real or fake, and thereby posing risks to identity authentication and face privacy. To study this problem, we introduce the first large-scale benchmark for this task by collecting real portraits and fake portraits from multiple sources and evaluate representative existing detectors on this benchmark, revealing their lack of explicit mechanisms for retaining fine-grained information and maintaining feature consistency across rendered views. To directly address these two limitations, we propose a detector trained with a two-stage strategy. In Stage I, masked autoencoding encourages the visual backbone to retain the fine-grained appearance information required for local reconstruction, while multi-view contrastive learning enforces feature consistency across rendered views of the same head. Since CLS tokens at different depths exhibit complementary spatial attention patterns, Stage II freezes the adapted backbone and concatenates low-, middle-, and high-level CLS tokens for classification. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest accuracy and ranks first across all reported metrics among the evaluated detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向单图像3D高斯头重建的人脸伪造检测基准，并设计了一种两阶段训练的检测器，通过掩码自编码和多视角对比学习分别保留细节信息并维持跨视角特征一致性，在实验中取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 单图像3D高斯头重建技术可以从单张肖像生成高度真实且可自由渲染的数字头像，但这一过程会削弱源图像中的伪造痕迹，使得重建后的3D人脸难以判别其底层人脸的真实性，对身份认证和人脸隐私构成威胁。现有检测器缺乏显式的细粒度信息保留机制和跨渲染视角的特征一致性保持能力。
AI.method: 方法包含两个阶段：(1) 第一阶段中，通过掩码自编码（Masked Autoencoding）促使视觉骨干网络保留局部重建所需的细粒度外观信息，同时利用多视角对比学习（Multi-view Contrastive Learning）强化同一头部不同渲染视角之间的特征一致性；(2) 第二阶段冻结适配后的骨干网络，将低层、中层和高层的CLS token拼接用于分类，因为不同深度的CLS token表现出互补的空间注意力模式。
AI.result: 实验表明所提方法在所有评估指标上均排名第一，取得了最高准确率，性能优于已有的代表性检测器。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统研究单图像3D高斯头重建场景下的人脸伪造检测问题，提出的两阶段检测框架有效解决了细粒度信息保留和跨视角特征一致性两大挑战，为该方向提供了基准和方法基础。

title: XP-JEPA: Cross-Predictive Physics Grounding for Forecastable Latent Dynamics
summary: Latent world models plan by predicting how candidate actions transform learned representations. In self-predictive models, however, the encoder and predictor are optimized jointly and can co-adapt to latent transitions that are easy to predict but only weakly constrained by the physical evolution of the scene. We introduce the cross-predictive JEPA (XP-JEPA), which grounds visual latent dynamics in privileged physical trajectories. XP-JEPA separately encodes visual observations and physical states, advances both through a shared action-conditioned predictor, and matches each prediction to both future representations. This objective encourages unified latent dynamics across the two modalities, grounded in the underlying physical transitions. The physical branch is discarded after training, leaving a visual-only model at deployment. On a multi-task suite spanning six evaluation subfamilies, XP-JEPA reduces rollout drift of a newly fitted predictor from $0.361$ to $0.104$ and increases mean control success from $53.6\%$ to $78.2\%$. Direct physical-state regression raises position decodability but leaves forecastability and control near the visual-only baseline. Cross-predictive physical grounding can therefore produce more forecastable latent dynamics for rollout-based control without privileged inputs at test time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XP-JEPA（跨预测联合嵌入预测架构），通过将视觉潜变量动力学与特权物理轨迹相结合，解决自预测模型中编码器与预测器共同适应导致潜在转移预测易但物理约束弱的问题。训练时分别编码视觉观测和物理状态，共享动作条件预测器同时对两者进行预测并匹配，部署时丢弃物理分支仅保留视觉模型。在六个子评估家族的多任务套件上，滚动漂移从0.361降至0.104，平均控制成功率从53.6%提升至78.2%。
AI.motivation: 自预测潜世界模型（如JEPA）中，编码器和预测器联合优化时可能共同适应出容易预测但仅受场景物理演化弱约束的潜在转移，导致预测不够稳健，影响基于rollout的控制性能。
AI.method: XP-JEPA分别编码视觉观测和物理状态两种模态，通过共享的动作条件预测器同时推进两种表示的未来预测，并将预测结果同时匹配到两种模态的未来表征上。该联合目标迫使两种模态共享统一的潜在动力学，使其锚定在底层物理转移上。训练完成后丢弃物理分支，部署时仅使用视觉模型。
AI.result: 在涵盖六个评估子家族的多任务套件上，XP-JEPA将新拟合预测器的rollout漂移从0.361降至0.104，平均控制成功率从53.6%提高到78.2%。直接物理状态回归虽提升了位置可解码性，但预测能力和控制性能仍接近视觉基线，说明跨预测式物理锚定优于直接回归。
AI.conclusion: 跨预测式物理锚定能够在不依赖测试时特权输入的前提下，产生更可预测的潜在动力学，从而显著改善基于rollout的视觉控制性能。

title: Retrieval-augmented generation vs. deterministic tax computation in multi-agent financial advisory: A 2x2 factorial experiment
summary: Tax-loss harvesting demonstrates consistent benefits to long-term portfolio growth; yet implementing it efficiently often involves complex considerations that are specific to the holdings within that portfolio and the individual who owns it. We introduce a custom capital gains calculation engine and a RAG-retrieved vector store of market advisory reports to provide context for a multi-agent trade recommendation system. We investigate the effects of each context provider on the quality of recommendations, measured by relative capital gains incurred during portfolio liquidation. A 2x2 repeated-measures ANOVA revealed a significant main effect of the tax optimization engine ($F(1,29) = 9.17$, $p = .005$, $η^2_p = .240$): enabling the engine reduced tax savings by approximately 55 percentage points relative to the no-engine conditions. The RAG main effect was not significant ($p = .841$), nor was the interaction ($p = .553$). The RAG-only condition achieved the highest descriptive mean tax savings (47.7%), and the baseline condition performed second-best (30.6%), suggesting that the pre-trained language model's internalized financial knowledge may be sufficient for competent tax-loss harvesting recommendations without explicit tooling. These results indicate that augmenting LLM agents with domain-specific computation engines does not guarantee improved performance and may introduce conflicting optimization signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在大型语言模型（LLM）多智能体交易推荐系统中，引入定制的资本利得计算引擎和基于RAG检索的市场咨询报告向量库对税损收割（tax-loss harvesting）建议质量的影响。通过2x2重复测量方差分析发现：税务优化引擎虽然具有显著主效应，但启用后反而使税收节省降低了约55个百分点；RAG主效应和交互效应均不显著。RAG-only条件获得最高的税收节省（47.7%），表明LLM内化的金融知识可能足以胜任税损收割建议，而额外领域计算引擎可能引入冲突的优化信号。
AI.motivation: 税损收割对长期投资组合增长具有稳定的益处，但高效实施涉及复杂的组合持有和个体特征。作者希望通过将定制资本利得计算引擎与RAG检索到的市场咨询报告作为上下文，增强多智能体LLM交易推荐系统的建议质量，并探究各上下文提供者对推荐质量的影响。
AI.method: 设计了一个包含定制资本利得计算引擎和RAG检索向量库作为上下文提供方的多智能体交易推荐系统。采用2x2重复测量方差分析（ANOVA），以组合清算时产生的相对资本利得为因变量，评估税务优化引擎（开/关）和RAG（开/关）两个因素的主效应及交互效应。
AI.result: 税务优化引擎有显著主效应（F(1,29)=9.17, p=.005, η²p=.240），但启用引擎反而使税收节省约降低55个百分点。RAG主效应（p=.841）和交互效应（p=.553）均不显著。RAG-only条件获得最高描述性税收节省（47.7%），基线条件次之（30.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 用特定领域的计算引擎增强LLM智能体并不保证提升性能，反而可能引入相互冲突的优化信号。预训练语言模型内化的金融知识可能足以在无显式工具的情况下提供胜任的税损收割建议。

title: Speech-to-SOAP: End-to-End Summarization of Medical Dialogues: KIT@BeTraC 2026
summary: With the advent of Large Language Models and its instruction following capabilities a promising application is the task of summarization. Within this domain of task the extractive sub-task of clinical protocolling has emerged as a topic of particular interest as it can significantly reduce the downtime and protocolling burden of health-care workers thus enabling them to focus on their core work helping humans. A further step towards automation is the direct generation of clinical notes from speech without intermediate transcripts, reducing processing time while preserving information such as coughing or other paralinguistic cues that may be lost in transcript-based systems. To this end, we present KIT's submission to this years BeTraC challenge in the lightweight track. Our main contribution is a scalable data augmentation pipeline that unifies heterogeneous medical dialogue datasets through synthetic speech generation and automatically generated SOAP supervision, enabling robust adaptation of a speech foundation model for end-to-end speech-to-SOAP generation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了KIT团队在BeTraC挑战赛轻量级赛道中的提交方案，提出了一种可扩展的数据增强管道，通过合成语音生成和自动生成的SOAP监督来统一异构医学对话数据集，从而实现语音基础模型的端到端语音到SOAP笔记生成。
AI.motivation: 临床摘要是大语言模型指令遵循能力的一个重要应用场景，其中抽取式临床协议记录子任务可以显著减少医护人员的协议记录负担。进一步地，直接从语音生成临床笔记（而非通过中间转录文本）可以减少处理时间并保留咳嗽等副语言线索，这些线索在基于转录的系统中可能丢失。
AI.method: 提出一个可扩展的数据增强管道，该管道通过合成语音生成技术统一异构的医学对话数据集，并利用自动生成的SOAP监督信号，使语音基础模型能够稳健地适应端到端语音到SOAP笔记的生成任务。
AI.result: 本文是KIT团队对BeTraC挑战赛轻量级赛道的提交，其核心贡献在于所提出的数据增强管道，论文未在摘要中给出具体的定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一异构医学对话数据并采用端到端的语音到SOAP生成方式，该方法有望减少处理时间、保留副语言信息，并降低医疗工作者的协议记录负担。

title: Absorbing Gradient Conflicts: Modeling Semantic Variance via Kent Distributions for Cross-Modal Hashing
summary: Supervised proxy-based deep cross-modal hashing has become the dominant paradigm for large-scale retrieval. However, prevalent methods model class proxies as deterministic points in the embedding space. This rigid assumption causes severe gradient conflicts in multi-label scenarios, where gradient conflicts arising from label co-occurrence lead to severe gradient contention and optimization collapse. To resolve this, we propose Kent-based Distributional Proxy Hashing (KDPH), a novel framework that shifts proxy representation from static points to flexible anisotropic Kent distributions on the hypersphere. Unlike point proxies that must shift their positions to accommodate conflicting gradients, KDPH absorbs these conflicts by dynamically adjusting its directional variance. This allows the proxy to maintain a stable semantic mean direction while stretching to cover diverse label correlations. Furthermore, to ensure stable training of these geometric parameters, we derive a tailored loss function incorporating the Cayley transform to enforce strict orthogonality. To the best of our knowledge, KDPH is the first framework to successfully introduce the Kent distributions into cross-modal hashing. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that KDPH mitigates proxy collapse and chaotic oscillation, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Senmo996/KDPH-official-code.

AI.tldr: KDPH是一种基于Kent分布的概率代理哈希框架，将跨模态哈希中的类别代理从静态点扩展为超球面上的各向异性Kent分布，通过动态调整方向方差来吸收多标签场景下的梯度冲突，从而缓解代理坍塌和优化崩溃，在三个基准数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的监督代理式跨模态深度哈希方法将类别代理建模为嵌入空间中的确定性点，这种刚性假设在多标签场景下会因标签共现导致严重的梯度冲突和梯度竞争，进而引发优化崩溃。需要一种更灵活的代理表示方式来吸收这些冲突，而不是让代理被迫移动位置去迎合冲突梯度。
AI.method: 提出KDPH框架，将代理表示从静态点转变为超球面上的各向异性Kent分布。Kent分布通过动态调整方向方差来吸收梯度冲突，同时保持稳定的语义均值方向以适应多样化的标签相关性。此外，设计了结合Cayley变换的定制损失函数，以严格保证几何参数的正交性，确保训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，KDPH能够有效缓解代理坍塌（proxy collapse）和混沌振荡（chaotic oscillation），并显著优于现有最先进的方法。这是首个将Kent分布成功引入跨模态哈希的框架。
AI.conclusion: KDPH通过概率分布代理替代确定性点代理，为多标签跨模态哈希中的梯度冲突问题提供了一种优雅的解决方案。该方法不仅提升了检索性能，还为跨模态哈希中代理建模提供了新的研究视角。

title: Physics-Integrated Operator Learning via Gaussian Splatting Representations
summary: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for spatiotemporal PDE systems, but purely data-driven formulations often accumulate substantial errors during long-horizon autoregressive prediction and may fail to exploit available governing-equation structure. Existing approaches incorporate physics primarily through residual-based training objectives or PDE-specific architectural constraints, which can introduce optimization difficulties or limit architectural generality. In this work, we introduce a representation-level approach to physics integration in which a feed-forward Gaussian splatting (FFGS) representation serves as a continuous interface between discretized solution fields and governing operators. The FFGS representation reconstructs the state as a continuous Gaussian field with closed-form spatial derivatives, allowing available physical PDE operators to be integrated directly within the learned evolution map without introducing a physics-residual loss. We evaluate the framework across two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, including advection, diffusion, nonlinear self-advection, and reaction dynamics.
