The same inter-agent communication that makes them effective also exposes them: a corrupted signal can propagate to the final decision and translate into realized financial loss. Unlike prior attacks that presume privileged access to system internals, we restrict the adversary to what is practically reachable---the source data and prompts agents consume---yielding a low-barrier, and thus democratized threat model instantiated as role-specific adversaries.
  We present the first systematic empirical study in the financial domain to characterize how an adversarial signal enters a multi-agent trading system and how far it survives toward the decision. Along the role axis, we decompose a widely-used trading pipeline into four functional roles---Analyst, Researcher, Trader, and Risk Manager---and pair each with an attack matched to its interface. Along the structural axis, we evaluate four communication topologies under data- and agent-level attacks, using the Adversarial Signal Preservation Score (APS) as a post-hoc lens on why some designs are more robust than others. We conduct experiments across five assets, two backbones, and two target directions. A central finding is that no architecture is inherently robust. These findings provide insights for the future design of safer and more robust agentic trading systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了基于LLM的多智能体交易系统中对抗性信号如何注入并传播至最终决策的问题。不同于以往假设攻击者拥有系统内部权限的攻击模型，本文提出了仅需接触源数据和提示的低门槛威胁模型，并通过对交易流水线中四个功能角色（分析师、研究员、交易员、风险管理）及四种通信拓扑的系统性实验，揭示了没有架构天然具备鲁棒性这一核心发现。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体交易系统正在从研究原型快速部署到真实资产生交易中，智能体间通信使系统有效的同时也暴露了脆弱性——一个被污染的信号可能传播到最终决策并造成实际财务损失。现有攻击研究大多假设攻击者拥有系统内部的特权访问，这与实际威胁模型不符。因此需要一个更贴近实战的低门槛威胁模型来理解系统如何被攻击。
AI.method: 本文将交易流水线分解为四个功能角色（分析师、研究员、交易员、风险管理），并为每个角色匹配与其接口对应的攻击方式；同时在数据层面和智能体层面评估四种通信拓扑下的攻击效果。使用对抗信号保留分数（APS）作为事后诊断工具，解释不同设计的鲁棒性差异。实验覆盖五个资产、两个骨干模型和两个目标方向。
AI.result: 实验表明没有一种架构天然具有鲁棒性。攻击可以从任何角色注入的对抗信号存活到最终交易决策。通过角色轴和结构轴的分解分析，以及APS指标的诊断，揭示了不同通信拓扑在设计鲁棒性上的差异及其原因。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为未来设计更安全、更鲁棒的智能体交易系统提供了关键洞察，强调了在架构设计层面需要将安全性和鲁棒性作为核心考量而非事后补丁。

title: ExpConCAD: Experience-Guided Text-to-CAD Generation from Shape Descriptions with Implicit Spatial Constraints
summary: Text-to-CAD aims to generate executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, real-world descriptions are often underspecified and omit critical spatial constraints required for valid CAD construction, a challenge that has been largely overlooked by existing methods. In this paper, we argue that missing spatial constraints should be inferred with respect to the underlying construction structure and informed by reusable design experience. Based on this insight, we propose ExpConCAD, an experience-enhanced framework for implicit spatial constraint completion. ExpConCAD first recovers the intended construction structure and constraint scopes, then retrieves relevant constraint-completion experience for similar scopes to complete the missing spatial constraints, and finally generates executable CadQuery programs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpConCAD and provide insights into the role of construction structure understanding and experience memory in spatial constraint completion. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Hotjiashell/ExpConCAD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExpConCAD框架，用于解决文本到CAD任务中自然语言描述缺失关键空间约束的问题。该框架首先恢复预期的构造结构和约束作用域，然后检索相似作用域的约束补全经验来补全缺失的空间约束，最后生成可执行的CadQuery程序。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到CAD方法忽略了一个关键挑战：真实世界的自然语言描述往往缺乏明确的规范，遗漏了CAD有效构建所必需的关键空间约束。
AI.method: ExpConCAD是一个基于经验增强的隐式空间约束补全框架，包含三个步骤：(1) 恢复预期的构造结构和约束作用域；(2) 针对相似作用域检索相关的约束补全经验以补全缺失的空间约束；(3) 生成可执行的CadQuery程序。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了ExpConCAD的有效性，并揭示了构造结构理解和经验记忆在空间约束补全中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 缺失的空间约束应基于底层构造结构并参考可复用的设计经验来推断，ExpConCAD通过结构理解与经验检索相结合的方式有效解决了该问题。

title: Rethinking Pre-Training and Augmentation for Zero-Shot Cross-City Object Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted by the AI City Challenge Workshop of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
summary: Real-world deployment of traffic surveillance systems is bottlenecked by geographic domain shift, in which models trained in one city underperform when applied to an unseen target city. Conventional domain adaptation relies on hyperparameter-sensitive architectures or direct profiling of target data. Both are fundamentally precluded in privacy-conscious ecosystems that require completely blind training and evaluation loops. In this setting, we explore the effects of pre-training and augmentation in addressing the domain shift problem. Specifically, we propose a new modular training pipeline for object detection structured around two core orthogonal pillars: (1) a multi-dataset pre-training strategy featuring a class-agnostic objectness distillation to decouple structural vehicle geometry from semantic taxonomies, and (2) a domain-resilient augmentation stream featuring a novel Grayworld transformation that forces global attention heads to strip volatile chromatic shortcuts in favor of robust shape priors. When evaluated with the real-time transformer-based detector RF-DETR, our framework bridges cross-city distribution gaps while using limited GPU memory (16GB). Our optimized variants, RF-DETR-HR and RF-DETR-Grayworld, deliver a substantial empirical gain of +24.29 over the baseline, achieving 1st place (47.53 mAP) on the AI City Challenge Track 6 leaderboard. Code and data are available at: \href{https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city}{SKKUAutoLab/aic26\_cross\_city}.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对交通监控系统中跨城市地理域偏移导致的模型性能下降问题，提出了一种模块化训练流水线，包括多数据集预训练策略（含类无关的物体性蒸馏）和域鲁棒增强流（含新颖的Grayworld变换），在AI City Challenge Track 6上以47.53 mAP获得第一名，较基线提升+24.29，且仅需16GB GPU内存。
AI.motivation: 交通监控系统在实际部署中面临地理域偏移问题——在一个城市训练的模型在未见过的目标城市中性能下降严重。传统域适应方法依赖超参数敏感的架构或直接剖析目标数据，但在注重隐私的生态系统中，完全盲训练和盲评估的循环从根本上排除了这些方法的适用性。因此需要在不能接触目标数据的前提下解决域偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出模块化训练流水线，围绕两个正交核心支柱：(1) 多数据集预训练策略，通过类无关的物体性蒸馏，将结构性车辆几何信息与语义类别学解耦；(2) 域鲁棒增强流，引入新颖的Grayworld变换，迫使全局注意力头剥离易变的颜色捷径，转而依赖于稳健的形状先验。采用实时基于Transformer的检测器RF-DETR作为基础架构。
AI.result: 优化变体RF-DETR-HR和RF-DETR-Grayworld相对于基线获得+24.29的显著经验增益，在AI City Challenge Track 6排行榜上以47.53 mAP取得第一名，且运行在16GB GPU内存限制下。
AI.conclusion: 通过预训练与增强两个正交方向的组合，可以在完全无法接触目标域数据的盲训练/盲评估设置下有效弥合跨城市分布差距，为隐私敏感场景下的交通监控域适应提供了可行方案。

title: When Does Self-Supervised Pretraining Help Tabular Models? A Study of Label Scarcity and Missing Data
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach for tabular data, yet its efficacy under extreme label scarcity and test-time missingness remains under-explored. In this paper, we evaluate a mask-and-recover SSL pretraining objective against training from scratch and classical baselines across 14 diverse classification tasks. First, while SSL outperforms training from scratch on average and remains competitive with state-of-the-art tree ensembles (achieving ~0.8954 AUC vs. Random Forest's 0.9015 at 10% labels), the SSL-vs-scratch gains exhibit high inter-task variance and lack significance (p = 0.626 at both 5% and 10% labels). Second, contrary to the hypothesis that missing-value imputation objectives universally benefit datasets with native missingness, SSL yields the most reliable improvements on clean datasets, while frequently degrading performance on datasets with high inherent missingness. Third, despite this training variance, SSL-pretrained models achieve a higher average AUC than scratch-trained models under both test-time missingness completely at random (MCAR) injection (+0.0245 AUC, positive on 11 of 14 tasks) and structured missingness shifts (MNAR, +0.0418 AUC, positive on 8 of 14 tasks), though neither difference remains statistically significant after Holm-Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons (adjusted p = 0.118 and p = 0.518, respectively). Fourth, comparing our mask-and-recover objective against three established tabular SSL baselines (VIME, SCARF, SubTab) under an identical encoder architecture, we find no significant difference from any of them (adjusted p = 0.459, p = 1.000, p = 1.000), indicating our findings reflect general properties of tabular SSL rather than idiosyncrasies of one particular pretext task.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了掩码-恢复自监督学习（SSL）预训练目标在表格数据上的表现，涵盖14个分类任务。研究发现：SSL在平均性能上优于从零训练，但与随机森林等传统树集成方法相比仅勉强持平；SSL与从零训练的收益差异具高度任务间方差且缺乏统计显著性；SSL在干净数据集上改进最可靠，而在高缺失率数据上反而常退化；尽管SSL在两种测试时缺失场景下平均AUC更高，但经过多重比较校正后均不显著；且与VIME、SCARF、SubTab三个既有表格SSL基线相比无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 尽管自监督学习在表格数据上被广泛认为有潜力，但其在极端标签稀缺和测试时缺失场景下的有效性尚未被充分探索。现有研究往往缺少严格的统计检验和跨任务泛化性的评估，因此需要对掩码-恢复SSL预训练目标进行系统、严谨的实证验证。
AI.method: 在14个多样化分类任务上，将掩码-恢复SSL预训练目标与从零训练和经典基线对比；在10%和5%标签条件下比较SSL与传统树集成（如随机森林）；分别评估数据集原生缺失、MCAR（完全随机缺失）和MNAR（结构化缺失）场景；并与VIME、SCARF、SubTab三个表格SSL基线在相同编码器架构下进行对比，使用Holm-Bonferroni校正进行多重比较。
AI.result: SSL平均优于从零训练，但在10%标签时AUC约0.8954 vs 随机森林0.9015，仅勉强持平；SSL与从零训练的差异p=0.626（5%和10%标签均不显著）；SSL在干净数据集上最可靠，在高缺失率数据上反而退化；MCAR场景+0.0245 AUC（11/14任务为正），MNAR场景+0.0418 AUC（8/14任务为正），但校正后均不显著（p=0.118和p=0.518）；与三个既有SSL基线相比均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 掩码-恢复SSL在表格数据上的收益缺乏统计显著性，其提升具有高度任务间方差且对数据集特征敏感。这些发现反映了表格数据SSL的一般属性而非特定预训练任务的特性，暗示需要重新审视表格SSL的实际收益与其适用条件。

title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text
summary: Distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written text (HWT) becomes increasingly important due to potential misuse. However, most supervised detectors often degrade out-of-domain (OOD) and require large, diverse training sets. In this work, we analyze the linearity and quality of MGT representations and show that simple linear probes outperform a wide range of detectors while being substantially more sample-efficient. We first show that MGT and HWT latent representations are linearly separable in low-dimensional space, and provide a plausible explanation for this separability through systematic differences in their representation quality. Motivated by these insights, we train two variants of simple linear probes and evaluate them across 4 benchmarks against 16 baselines. Probes consistently improve OOD detection (+11 AUC), requiring solely ${<}100$ samples to reach near-peak performance. We show that this transferability arises because probes recover a shared latent MGT direction that generalizes across diverse settings. Finally, we demonstrate that probing vectors capture a continuous spectrum of ``machineness'', highlighting their potential for fine-grained estimation of AI-edited text. Overall, our work provides insights into latent-space differences between MGT and HWT and demonstrates the potential of linear probes as as robust and sample-efficient MGT detectors. We release our code on~\href{https://github.com/gerritq/mgt_probes}{github}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用线性探针（linear probes）检测机器生成文本（MGT）。作者发现MGT与人类书写文本（HWT）在低维潜在空间中线性可分，且这种可分性源于两者表示质量的系统性差异。基于此，他们训练了两种线性探针变体，在4个基准、16个基线的评估中，线性探针在跨域（OOD）检测上一致提升（+11 AUC），且仅需不到100个样本即可达到接近峰值性能。这种可迁移性源于探针能够恢复一个共享的潜在MGT方向，该方向在多种设置下泛化。此外，探针向量捕捉了连续的"机器性"光谱，可用于细粒度估计AI编辑文本。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型生成文本的滥用风险增加，区分机器生成文本（MGT）与人类书写文本（HWT）变得至关重要。然而，大多数监督式检测器在跨域（out-of-domain）场景下性能退化严重，且需要大量、多样化的训练数据。因此，需要一种更鲁棒且样本高效的检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 分析MGT和HWT在潜在空间中的线性可分性及其背后原因（表示质量的系统性差异）。2) 基于该洞察，训练两种简单线性探针变体（linear probes），在低维空间中对隐层表示进行线性分类。3) 在4个基准上对比16个基线，评估跨域性能与样本效率。4) 分析探针向量的可迁移性机制（共享的潜在MGT方向），并展示其捕捉连续"机器性"光谱的能力。
AI.result: 线性探针在跨域检测上一致优于广泛检测器（+11 AUC），且仅需不到100个样本即可达到接近峰值性能。探针的可迁移性源于其恢复了共享的潜在MGT方向，该方向跨多种设置泛化。此外，探针向量可捕捉连续"机器性"光谱，支持AI编辑文本的细粒度估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了MGT与HWT在潜在空间中的本质差异，证明了线性探针作为鲁棒且样本高效的MGT检测器的巨大潜力，并为AI编辑文本的细粒度评估提供了新思路。

title: ViSculpt: Visual-Centric Agentic Geometry Editing
summary: 3D geometry editing is a critical yet labor-intensive part of the graphics pipeline, requiring artists to translate creative intent into precise operations in complex professional software. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for script-based 3D creation, but script generation is less suited to perception-driven editing of arbitrary existing meshes, where execution must remain visually grounded and untouched regions should be preserved. We present a \emph{visual-centric}, training-free multi-agent system that edits existing 3D meshes directly in Blender by emulating the iterative workflow of human artists. Rather than generating scripts or regenerating geometry, our system operates through the Blender GUI: multimodal LLM agents observe the viewport, reason about the current mesh state, and execute localized edits through simulated user interactions. Experiments on a curated benchmark provide initial evidence that this agentic approach can follow natural language instructions, perform representative localized mesh edits, and preserve the overall identity of the input asset. Our results highlight a complementary regime for language-driven 3D editing: direct in-place modification of existing meshes within the native 3D editing workflow. We view this work as an exploratory step toward visual-centric agentic geometry editing in professional graphics software.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以视觉为中心、训练免费的多智能体系统，通过模拟人类艺术家的迭代工作流程，直接在Blender GUI中编辑现有3D网格，避免了脚本生成或几何重建，实验表明该方法能遵循自然语言指令执行局部网格编辑并保持输入资产的整体身份。
AI.motivation: 3D几何编辑是图形管线中劳动密集的关键环节，需要艺术家将创作意图转化为复杂专业软件中的精确操作。尽管大语言模型在基于脚本的3D创建中展现出潜力，但脚本生成不适合对任意现有网格进行感知驱动的编辑，因为执行必须保持视觉接地且未被修改的区域应得到保留。
AI.method: 提出一个视觉中心、训练免费的多智能体系统。系统不生成脚本或重建几何，而是通过Blender GUI操作：多模态LLM智能体观察视口，推理当前网格状态，并通过模拟用户交互执行局部编辑，模拟人类艺术家的迭代工作流程。
AI.result: 在策划的基准测试上的实验提供了初步证据，表明该方法能遵循自然语言指令，执行代表性的局部网格编辑，并保持输入资产的整体身份。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作展示了语言驱动3D编辑的一个互补范式：在原生3D编辑工作流中对现有网格进行直接原位修改，为专业图形软件中视觉中心智能体几何编辑迈出了探索性的一步。

title: Equivariant Covariance Tensors: Guaranteed SPD Uncertainty for Tensor-Valued Geometric Learning
summary: Tensor-valued prediction is fundamental to geometric deep learning, yet uncertainty quantification (UQ) for such outputs remains an open challenge. While E(3)-equivariant neural networks excel at point estimates, they lack rigorous confidence measures. We focus on symmetric rank-2 tensor prediction, where the target has six Kelvin--Mandel coordinates and full uncertainty is represented by a $6\times6$ covariance matrix. We introduce a framework for E(3)-equivariant UQ, modeling the full predictive distribution where both mean and covariance preserve rotational symmetry. Our approach decomposes the covariance into irreducible representations $\mathrm{Sym}^2(ρ_c) \cong 2\times(l=0) \oplus 2\times(l=2) \oplus 1\times(l=4)$. By mapping from the flat Lie algebra $\mathfrak{sym}(6)$ to the curved SPD manifold via matrix exponentiation, we strictly ensure positive-definite covariances while maintaining exact equivariance. Furthermore, we formulate a Log-Euclidean Equivariant Scoring Objective (LE-ESO)---a robust surrogate loss based on the Multivariate Laplace distribution---providing robustness to heavy-tailed errors and stable optimization. Validation on ModelNet40 inertia tensors and Materials Project dielectric tensors demonstrates that our method achieves competitive performance and provides physically consistent, symmetry-preserving uncertainty estimates with useful risk and OOD sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于对称秩-2张量预测的E(3)等变不确定性量化框架，通过不可约表示分解协方差矩阵，并利用矩阵指数映射从李代数到SPD流形来确保正定性，同时引入基于多元Laplace分布的Log-Euclidean等变评分目标（LE-ESO）作为稳健替代损失。在ModelNet40惯性张量和Materials Project介电张量上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 几何深度学习中的张量值预测缺乏严格的不确定性量化手段。E(3)等变神经网络虽然擅长点估计，但无法提供置信度度量。对于对称秩-2张量（如惯性张量、介电张量），完整的预测分布需要6维均值加6×6协方差矩阵，这带来了对称性与结构保持的双重挑战。
AI.method: 该方法将协方差分解为不可约表示Sym²(ρc) ≅ 2×(l=0) ⊕ 2×(l=2) ⊕ 1×(l=4)，确保协方差在旋转下保持恰当地等变性。通过从平坦李代数sym(6)到弯曲SPD流形的矩阵指数映射，严格保证协方差的正定性。此外，提出Log-Euclidean等变评分目标（LE-ESO），基于多元Laplace分布构建稳健的替代损失函数，以应对重尾误差并保证优化稳定性。
AI.result: 在ModelNet40惯性张量和Materials Project介电张量数据集上的实验表明，该方法在预测精度上与现有方法竞争，同时提供了物理一致、保持对称性的不确定性估计，并展示了在风险和OOD（分布外）检测方面的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为E(3)等变张量预测提供了首个系统性的不确定性量化框架，通过严格的结构保持机制（不可约分解+流形映射）和稳健的损失设计，在保证等变性的同时获得了物理自洽的不确定性度量，为张量值预测中的风险和OOD感知提供了新工具。

title: AgentWorld: Personality-Aware Reliability Evaluation for Agentic Information Retrieval
summary: Evaluation of agentic information retrieval remains limited to scripted interactions with uniform users, missing both natural personality diversity and adversarial brittleness. We present AgentWorld, a simulation framework combining (i)Big Five (OCEAN) personality-driven user populations with stateful tool-use environments; (ii)the pass$^k$ consistency metric with structured fault classification, partial-credit scoring, and dual-control handoff verification; (iii)score-thresholded training-data export in six fine-tuning formats; and (iv)an adversarial Risk Analyser that snapshots required-intermediate-state spines, branches Monte-Carlo rollouts under four task-aware perturbation types, and quantifies risk via $ΔP / ΔT$ scoring, Dempster--Shafer evidence fusion, and Shapley attack-category attribution. Three experiments demonstrate the framework: a conversational analytics agent across 10 OCEAN personas (240 evaluator judgments); a customer-support agent across 5 tasks $\times$ 4 persona variants; and adversarial stress-testing of 5 tasks revealing pre-existing trajectory brittleness ($V_{\min}=0.375$ without perturbation) and tool/infrastructure-layer attack dominance (Shapley: 46% system, 38% action). Personality variation surfaces failure modes uniform testing cannot expose---cross-domain leakage, contextual drift, a 0.27-point quality gap, and 50% vs. 100% pass-rate across personas on the same task---while the Risk Analyser quantifies trajectory-level brittleness that pass$^k$ alone cannot measure.

AI.tldr: AgentWorld是一个智能体信息检索仿真框架，整合了Ocean（大五）人格驱动的用户群体、pass^k一致性指标与结构化故障分类、分阈值训练数据导出以及对抗性风险分析器，并通过三个实验证明其能揭示统一测试无法暴露的失败模式与轨迹级脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体信息检索评估仅限于与统一用户的脚本化交互，既忽视了自然的个性多样性，也无法捕捉对抗性脆弱性，导致评估结果与实际部署场景存在差距。
AI.method: 该框架包含四个核心组件：（i）基于Big Five（OCEAN）人格驱动的有状态工具使用环境的用户群体模拟；（ii）pass^k一致性指标配合结构化故障分类、部分信用评分和双控制交接验证；（iii）基于分数阈值的数据导出，支持六种微调格式；（iv）对抗性风险分析器，通过快照必需的中间状态脊柱、在四种任务感知扰动类型下分支蒙特卡洛rollout，并通过ΔP/ΔT评分、Dempster-Shafer证据融合和Shapley攻击类别归因来量化风险。
AI.result: 三个实验表明：对话分析智能体在10个OCEAN人格（240个评估者判断）、客户支持智能体在5个任务×4个人格变体上，以及对抗性压力测试（5个任务）揭示了预先存在的轨迹脆弱性（无扰动时V_min=0.375），且工具/基础设施层攻击占主导（Shapley归因：系统层46%，动作层38%）。人格变化暴露了统一测试无法发现的失败模式——跨域泄漏、上下文漂移、0.27分的质量差距，以及同一任务上50%对100%的通过率差异。
AI.conclusion: AgentWorld表明，仅靠pass^k等单一指标无法充分度量智能体系统的鲁棒性，而人格多样性结合对抗性风险分析能够量化轨迹级脆弱性，为智能体评估提供了更全面的方法论。

title: Structurally-bounded Agentic Graph Exploration for Evidence-Grounded Scholarly DeepSearch
summary: We present Crase, a bounded and inspectable alternative to deep research agents for scholarly search. Instead of an open-ended search loop, Crase queries a search engine once for seed papers, expands them along their 1.5-hop citation neighborhood, prunes citation edges whose claims lack entailment support, and ranks the remaining papers with a recency-aware random walk. This makes the candidate set, the reason each paper is kept, and the stopping condition explicit and fixed before inference. On LitSearch and one further benchmarks over a 500K-paper arXiv corpus, Crase outperforms deep research agents built on proprietary models by up to 3$\times$ recall@50 at roughly a third of the cost.

AI.tldr: Crase是一个有界且可审查的学术搜索替代方案，通过单次查询种子论文、沿1.5跳引用邻域扩展、基于蕴含支持剪枝引用边并进行时效感知随机游走排序，在LitSearch等基准上以约三分之一成本将recall@50提升至专有深度研究智能体的3倍。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体（deep research agents）采用开放式搜索循环，候选集、论文保留原因和停止条件在推理前不可知，缺乏可审查性并且成本高昂。本文旨在提供一个有界（bounded）、可检查（inspectable）的替代方案，使整个检索过程在推理前显式且固定。
AI.method: Crase采用四阶段流水线：(1) 对搜索引擎进行单次查询以获取种子论文；(2) 沿种子论文的1.5跳引用邻域进行扩展（即直接引用及其被引关系）；(3) 对引用边进行剪枝，仅保留在声明层面具有蕴含支持（entailment support）的边；(4) 使用时序感知的随机游走（recency-aware random walk）对剩余论文进行排序。
AI.result: 在LitSearch及另一个基准上，基于50万篇arXiv论文语料库，Crase相比基于专有模型的深度研究智能体在recall@50上最高提升3倍，且成本仅为后者的约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: Crase证明了将检索过程设计为有界、可审查的固定流水线，能够在提升检索质量（recall@50提升3倍）的同时大幅降低计算成本（约1/3），为学术搜索提供了一个比开放式深度研究智能体更高效、更透明的范式。

title: SandwichQuant: Which Parameters Matter Before and After Quantization?
summary: Quantization correction methods usually optimize weights, quantization parameters, or reconstruction objectives, while the underlying parameter subspaces responsible for effective correction remain unclear. In this work, we study quantization correction from a parameter subspace perspective and reveal that correction capability is highly non-uniform across parameter groups. By decomposing trainable parameters into backbone weights, normalization-affine parameters, and quantization parameters, we show that the low-dimensional normalization-affine subspace provides a highly efficient correction direction under matched budgets. Based on this finding, we propose SandwichQuant, a two-stage normalization-affine correction framework that performs adaptation before and after quantization. The pre-stage improves quantization robustness, while the post-stage compensates residual errors after the quantized graph is fixed. Extensive experiments on vision models and large language models demonstrate consistent improvements under various low-bit quantization settings, validating the effectiveness of subspace-aligned correction.

AI.tldr: 本文从参数子空间视角研究量化校正问题，发现校正能力在不同参数组间高度不均匀，提出SandwichQuant两阶段归一化仿射校正框架，在量化前后分别进行适配以提升量化鲁棒性并补偿残差误差，在视觉模型和大型语言模型上证明了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有量化校正方法主要优化权重、量化参数或重构目标，但并未搞清楚有效校正背后的参数子空间到底是什么。作者希望从参数子空间的角度揭示哪些参数组对量化校正起决定性作用。
AI.method: 将可训练参数分解为骨干权重、归一化仿射参数和量化参数三类，研究发现低维的归一化仿射子空间在同等预算下提供了高效的校正方向。基于此提出SandwichQuant两阶段框架：预处理阶段在量化前适配参数以提升量化鲁棒性，后处理阶段在量化图固定后补偿残差误差。
AI.result: 在视觉模型和大型语言模型上，多种低比特量化设置下均获得一致的性能提升，验证了子空间对齐校正的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 校正能力在参数组间高度非均匀，归一化仿射子空间是高效校正的关键方向；SandwichQuant通过量化前后的两阶段适配，在低比特量化场景下取得了优于现有方法的性能。

title: Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation
summary: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been widely concerned in the fields of machine learning, pattern recognition, and computer vision. Traditional UDA learning usually assumes that the label spaces of the source and target domains are exactly the same and only needs to solve the problem of sample distribution drift existing between two domains. However, in real world applications, the label spaces between two domains may be different. In this case, there are both sample distribution drift and class spatial difference between domains, namely Universal Domain Adaptation (UniDA) learning scenario. At present, existing works rarely offer theoretical analysis for universal domain adaptation. In this paper, we provide an upper bound of the generalization error for universal domain adaptation. According to the proposed generalization error bound, we propose a novel UniDA algorithm called Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation (JAUA), which aligns the joint distributions by minimizing the distribution discrepancy calculated by Chi-Square divergence. Furthermore, we propose a progressive pseudo-labeling method to assign the pseudo labels to unlabeled target samples. The experiment results on six public image datasets demonstrate the superiority of JAUA in handling the UniDA problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了通用域自适应（UniDA）的泛化误差上界，并据此设计了一个名为JAUA的算法。JAUA通过Chi-Square散度对齐源域和目标域的联合分布，并结合渐进式伪标签方法处理目标域无标签样本。在六个公开图像数据集上的实验验证了算法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督域自适应（UDA）假设源域与目标域的标签空间完全相同，仅解决样本分布漂移问题。但在真实应用中，两域之间可能存在标签空间差异，即通用域自适应（UniDA）场景。现有工作缺乏对UniDA的理论分析，因此需要提供泛化误差的理论上界，并据此设计有效的UniDA算法。
AI.method: 1) 推导通用域自适应的泛化误差上界；2) 提出JAUA算法，通过最小化Chi-Square散度计算分布差异来对齐源域与目标域的联合分布；3) 设计渐进式伪标签方法为目标域无标签样本分配伪标签。
AI.result: 在六个公开图像数据集上的实验结果表明，JAUA在解决UniDA问题上具有优越性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次为通用域自适应提供了理论上的泛化误差上界分析，并基于该理论提出了联合分布对齐算法JAUA。理论分析和实验验证共同证明了该方法的有效性，为UniDA问题提供了新的解决思路。

title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as code agents for scientific and engineering analysis, but their ability to analyze raw physical-layer measurements remains untested. We introduce \textbf{EMRB} (\textbf{E}lectro\textbf{m}agnetic \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{B}enchmark), which evaluates whether LLMs can analyze raw I/Q data by writing and running code. EMRB contains 200 problems across five difficulty levels and 27 question types, from signal detection to OFDM design, generated from 11 signal types with verified ground truth. Unlike benchmarks built on preprocessed features or structured tables, EMRB provides only the raw capture; the quantities each question refers to must first be discovered through code. We evaluate 14 LLMs spanning proprietary, open-weight, and reasoning-oriented families. Scores range from 24.1\% to 78.9\%, with the mean dropping from 84.9\% on basic measurement to 21.2\% on system design. We also propose \textbf{ReconPilot}, a structured method that separates signal reconnaissance, targeted analysis, and self-verification. Across three backbones, ReconPilot raises the overall score by 3.8 to 17.6 points and improves 13 of 15 backbone-level combinations tested. All data and code are publicly released in \href{https://github.com/mingxuZhang2/EMRB}{\textcolor{blue}{our GitHub repository}}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMRB基准，首个测试LLM基于原始I/Q数据（物理层电磁信号）进行分析与代码执行能力的基准，包含200个问题、5个难度层级和27种题型。评估14个LLM后得分范围24.1%-78.9%，并提出ReconPilot方法，通过将信号侦察、定向分析和自验证分离，在三类骨干模型上将得分提升3.8-17.6分。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作科学和工程分析的代码智能体，但其对原始物理层测量数据（如I/Q信号）的分析能力尚未被测试。现有基准多基于预处理特征或结构化表格构建，无法反映LLM从原始数据中自主发现信息并进行推理的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建EMRB基准：包含200个问题，涵盖5个难度等级和27个问题类型（从信号检测到OFDM设计），基于11种信号类型生成并有验证过的ground truth；仅提供原始I/Q数据捕获，所有问题对应量需通过代码自主发现。同时提出ReconPilot方法，将分析流程结构化为信号侦察、定向分析和自验证三个分离阶段。
AI.result: 评估14个LLM（涵盖专有、开源权重和推理导向系列）后，得分范围24.1%至78.9%；平均值从基础测量的84.9%降至系统设计的21.2%。ReconPilot在三个骨干模型上将整体得分提升3.8至17.6分，在测试的15个骨干-层组合中改善了13个。
AI.conclusion: EMRB揭示了当前LLM在原始物理层数据分析上的显著能力差距，尤其是在系统级设计任务上表现薄弱；ReconPilot的结构化方法能有效提升LLM在该领域的分析性能。所有数据和代码已公开。

title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. Causal memory interventions show that compressed summaries and source-text lookup jointly transmit disclosures into judgments. Workflow architecture determines whether this transmission succeeds: chunk-and-summarize pipelines evict relevant information, whereas a targeted, structured restatement adjacent to the decision restores its influence. AI analyst performance is therefore jointly determined by model capability and workflow architecture. Retrieval-based evaluations can certify systems whose investment judgments ignore information they demonstrably retrieved.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM在长上下文金融分析中存在的"检索-整合鸿沟"：模型虽能准确检索相关信息，但检索到的信息却无法影响其投资判断。研究发现该模式在多个模型家族和任务中复现，且更强大的模型只是推迟而非消除这一鸿沟。通过因果记忆干预和工作流架构分析，提出结构化重述等针对性方案可恢复信息对判断的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM金融分析系统的评估通常只关注信息检索能力，而忽略了检索到的信息是否真正影响模型的判断决策。这种评估方式可能认证出那些虽然检索到信息但在投资判断中完全忽略这些信息的系统，构成安全隐患。因此需要识别并理解这一"检索-整合鸿沟"。
AI.method: 设计对照实验：固定焦点公司信息不变，仅将无关上下文从2,000变化到128,000 token，测量风险披露对投资判断的影响变化；在多个模型家族和判断任务上复现；使用真实10-K文件删除实验验证；通过因果记忆干预（压缩摘要与源文本查找）分析信息传导机制；比较不同工作流架构（chunk-and-summarize管线 vs 结构化重述）对信息传导的影响。
AI.result: 在长上下文中，风险披露对投资判断的影响降至实验噪声水平，尽管直接检索仍然准确；该模式在模型家族和任务间复现；更强模型推迟但不消除该鸿沟；压缩摘要和源文本查找共同传导信息进入判断；chunk-and-summarize管线会驱逐相关信息，而目标化的结构化重述可恢复其影响。
AI.conclusion: AI分析师的表现由模型能力和工作流架构共同决定。仅基于检索的评估可能认证那些在投资判断中忽略已检索信息的系统。工作流架构（如结构化重述）是弥合检索-整合鸿沟的关键，评估体系需要超越纯检索指标，纳入信息对判断的实际影响考量。

title: Amortized Set Prediction for Inverse IFS Reconstruction from Density Maps
summary: Iterated Function Systems (IFS) generate self-similar fractals from a few contractive affine maps. The forward map from parameters to images is computationally inexpensive and well understood, whereas the inverse problem of estimating maps from an image is difficult and is typically handled by per-image optimization. We replace this loop with a single forward pass of a learned estimator that predicts the affine-map set directly from a visit-frequency density map, thereby amortizing the inverse problem. The design follows two constraints. First, density maps do not uniquely identify IFS parameters, so evaluation is based on reconstruction rather than parameter recovery; unordered map sets are handled by Hungarian matching, and ground-truth parameters provide a stable training surrogate. Second, the fully known forward model lets us generate exact synthetic training pairs and also supports image-only test-time refinement. On in-distribution tests, amortized initialization plus a few refinement steps lies on a better quality--speed frontier than equal-budget random-initialized per-image optimization, and a 30-step refinement (about $0.56$ s per sample) remains better than a doubled-budget baseline. Extending optimization to 1000 steps shows that the benefit is not only speed: amortized initialization reaches high-quality reconstructions more frequently than random starts. On real images (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST), it improves density metrics on average over a published per-image optimizer while being roughly 12 to 2600 times faster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用单个前向传播的神经网络来替代逐图像优化，直接预测迭代函数系统（IFS）的仿射映射参数，从而摊销IFS逆问题的求解。
AI.motivation: IFS的正向映射（参数到图像）简单且高效，但逆问题（从图像估计映射参数）很难，传统方法依赖逐图像优化，计算开销大且速度慢。
AI.method: 设计一个学习型估计器，直接从访问频率密度图预测仿射映射集。利用已知的正向模型生成精确的合成训练对；采用匈牙利匹配处理无序映射集，以重构质量而非参数恢复作为评估标准；地面真值参数作为稳定的训练代理；支持图像驱动的测试时微调。
AI.result: 在分布内测试中，摊销初始化加少量微调步骤优于等预算的随机初始化优化；30步微调（约0.56秒/样本）优于双倍预算基线；扩展到1000步优化后，摊销初始化更频繁地达到高质量重构。在真实图像（MNIST和Fashion-MNIST）上，密度指标平均优于已发表的逐图像优化器，速度快约12到2600倍。
AI.conclusion: 摊销式初始化不仅加速了求解，还提升了重构质量，在速度-质量前沿上全面优于传统的随机初始化逐图像优化方法。

title: Evaluating Deep Multivariate Imputation Models on Wearable Device Data
summary: Wearable device data enables continuous health monitoring, but suffers from structured missingness: features sharing a physical sensor drop out together. Deep imputation methods such as BRITS and SAITS have seen limited evaluation on multimodal physiological data under realistic missingness, and existing benchmarks use random-point holdout protocols that incorrectly assume missingness is independent across features and time. Using data from a person with epilepsy recorded on a Garmin smartwatch, we develop an evaluation protocol that mines contiguous missing-run templates from training data, stratifies them by per-feature gap-length quantiles, and injects them as block masks with preserved co-missingness structure. A matched training protocol exposing models to the same missingness distribution reduces BRITS's severe-gap MAE by 43%, demonstrating the potential benefit of the proposed evaluation and training protocol within this single-participant dataset. We further extend BRITS with time-of-day encoding and a circadian harmonic channel. No single model dominates: linear interpolation is optimal for slow-moving features over short gaps; extended BRITS achieves lower MAE on dynamic cardiac features in moderate and severe gaps; and SAITS better preserves the ground-truth distribution by Jensen-Shannon distance despite higher MAE. Ultimately, model rankings strongly depend on evaluation designs. By exposing how traditional evaluation methods obscure true model capabilities, our transferable protocol establishes critical steps towards developing better imputation strategies for future multi-sensor wearable datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对可穿戴设备多模态生理数据的真实缺失模式评估协议，通过从训练数据中挖掘连续缺失模板并注入为块状掩码来保留特征间的共缺失结构；同时设计匹配的训练协议，使BRITS在严重缺失gap上的MAE降低43%，并扩展了BRITS加入时间编码和昼夜谐波通道。研究发现不同模型在不同缺失场景下各有优势，模型排名强烈依赖评估设计。
AI.motivation: 现有深度插补方法（如BRITS、SAITS）在真实多模态生理数据上的评估不足，传统基准采用随机点保留协议，错误地假设缺失跨特征和时间独立，而可穿戴设备数据具有结构化缺失——共享物理传感器的特征会同时丢失。这种不匹配的评估协议掩盖了模型的真实能力。
AI.method: 提出一个可迁移的评估协议：(1)从训练数据中挖掘连续的缺失运行模板；(2)按每个特征的gap长度分位数分层；(3)注入为保留共缺失结构的块状掩码。同时设计匹配的训练协议，使模型暴露于相同的缺失分布。此外扩展BRITS，加入时间编码特征和昼夜谐波通道（circadian harmonic channel）。
AI.result: 匹配训练协议使BRITS在严重gap上的MAE降低43%。性能对比显示：线性插补在慢变特征的短gap上最优；扩展BRITS在动态心脏特征的中度和严重gap上MAE更低；SAITS虽MAE较高但通过Jensen-Shannon距离更好地保持真实分布。模型排名强烈依赖评估设计。
AI.conclusion: 传统随机点保留评估方法掩盖了模型的真实能力，本文提出的可迁移协议为未来多传感器可穿戴数据集上的插补策略开发奠定了关键基础，是迈向更好插补策略的重要一步。

title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
summary: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a construction pipeline that preserves task solvability while introducing realistic adversarial conditions. Evaluating 16 leading GUI models, we reveal universal vulnerability to dynamic anomalies, with even the strongest models suffering significant performance degradation. Furthermore, we conduct GRPO training in both original and adversarial environments to validate our benchmark, separating environment-learnable anomalies from reasoning-bottlenecked ones. Our findings show that while single-step traps at state and action layers are largely addressable through adversarial reinforcement learning, deep contextual traps, like state deadlock, expose intrinsic limitations that cannot be resolved by training in environments with traps alone.

AI.tldr: AnTrap是一个针对Android GUI代理在运行时动态异常下鲁棒性的综合基准测试，通过注入动态扰动构建了四层十类的异常分类体系，评估16个主流GUI模型后发现普遍脆弱性，并利用GRPO训练区分了环境可学习异常与推理瓶颈异常。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI代理基准测试缺乏对运行时动态异常（如弹窗、动作误用等）的系统性评估，无法全面衡量代理在实际设备部署中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出四层（State、Thinking、Action、Round）十细分类别的异常分类体系；构建保持任务可解性同时引入真实对抗条件的扰动注入流水线；对16个GUI模型进行评估，并在原始与对抗两种环境中进行GRPO训练来区分不同异常的可学习性。
AI.result: 所有模型在动态异常下普遍性能显著下降，即使最强模型也不例外；单步陷阱（state和action层）可通过对抗强化学习大幅缓解，但深度上下文陷阱（如state deadlock）暴露了仅靠含陷阱环境训练无法解决的本质局限。
AI.conclusion: AnTrap揭示了GUI代理对动态异常的普遍脆弱性，并指出当前训练策略仅能解决浅层异常，深层上下文推理瓶颈需要新的训练范式或架构改进。

title: BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
summary: Web agents that act from rendered pixels avoid the fragility and heavy token cost of reading a page's HTML or accessibility tree, but training them depends on large amounts of high-quality interaction trajectories, and how to produce such data at scale remains an open problem. Public datasets typically contain only a few thousand trajectories drawn from a fixed and narrow set of websites, and even recent automated synthesis pipelines stay bound to predefined site lists or tutorial sources, so the number of distinct websites the agent ever sees barely grows. We present BrowserForge, a framework that generates web interaction data at scale by driving many browser sandboxes in parallel over the open web. BrowserForge couples three components: an open-web sourcing stage that exposes the agent to hundreds of thousands of real, openly reachable websites; a sandbox cluster manager that schedules hundreds of concurrent browsers with high utilization; and a Proposer-Solver dual-agent loop that turns a raw page into an executable task and then collects a verified trajectory for it. A rule-plus-model cleaning pipeline removes failed runs and rewrites the surviving reasoning into a single unified chain-of-thought style. Page structure such as the accessibility tree is used only as a synthesis-time signal; the agent we train and release acts purely from the screenshot. The resulting corpus contains 203,238 trajectories, each collected from a distinct website, larger and more diverse than prior trajectory datasets. Fine-tuning a compact multimodal model on this corpus raises its success rate on the live Online-Mind2Web from 25.66% to 33.33% and consistently improves step accuracy on the static Multimodal-Mind2Web, with the gain growing as the corpus scales. Controlled analyses further confirm that open-web sourcing and broad website coverage are key contributors to the observed improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BrowserForge框架，通过在开放网络上大规模并行驱动浏览器沙箱，生成包含203,238条来自不同网站的web交互轨迹，用于训练纯像素输入的web代理，使紧凑多模态模型在Online-Mind2Web上的成功率从25.66%提升至33.33%。
AI.motivation: 基于像素的web代理能避免解析HTML或可访问性树的脆弱性和高token成本，但其训练依赖大规模高质量交互轨迹。现有公开数据集仅包含数千条来自固定网站的轨迹，自动化合成管线也被局限于预定义网站列表，导致代理所见网站多样性不足，无法规模化产出训练数据。
AI.method: BrowserForge框架包含三部分：(1)开放网络数据采集阶段，使代理接触数十万真实可公开访问的网站；(2)沙箱集群管理器，调度数百个并发浏览器并保持高利用率；(3)Proposer-Solver双智能体循环，将原始页面转化为可执行任务并收集经过验证的轨迹。通过规则加模型的清洗管线移除失败运行，并将推理过程重写为统一的思维链格式。可访问性树等页面结构仅作为合成阶段的信号使用，训练的代理完全基于截图执行。
AI.result: 生成的语料包含203,238条轨迹，每条来自不同网站，在规模和多样性上超越之前的数据集。在紧凑多模态模型上进行微调后，在实时的Online-Mind2Web上成功率从25.66%提升到33.33%，在静态Multimodal-Mind2Web上逐步准确率持续提升，且收益随语料规模增长。对照分析确认开放网络数据源和广泛网站覆盖是关键贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: BrowserForge证明通过开放网络大规模并行驱动浏览器的方式可以产生比现有数据集更大、更多样的web交互数据，且该数据能有效提升纯像素web代理的性能。开放网络数据源和网站覆盖率是性能提升的核心因素。

title: NeoWorld-Pro: Programming Interactive Scenes from Monocular Images for Embodied Simulation
summary: The advancement of Embodied AI necessitates high-quality simulation assets that faithfully mirror the real world. However, transforming raw visual observations into simulation-ready scenes remains challenging due to the lack of physical grounding and scene-level interactivity in current image-to-URDF methods. We propose NeoWorld-Pro, a framework that reformulates monocular scene reconstruction as procedural programming for interactive 3D environments. Leveraging the zero-shot reasoning and code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs, NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into executable programs specifying object geometry, articulation, and physical properties. A physics-in-the-loop mechanism then iteratively refines the generated programs by validating their execution in a physics engine, enforcing physically plausible articulations, valid object compositions and interactions, and accurate spatial relationships. Experiments show that NeoWorld-Pro outperforms open-loop and prior monocular reconstruction methods, while enabling complex downstream tasks such as stable stacking and fine-grained manipulation.

AI.tldr: NeoWorld-Pro提出一个将单目场景重建重新定义为程序化编程的框架，利用多模态大语言模型的零样本推理和代码生成能力，将单张RGB图像转换为可执行程序，并通过物理在环机制迭代精化，生成具有物理合理交互性的仿真场景。
AI.motivation: 具身智能发展需要高质量的仿真资产真实反映物理世界，但现有image-to-URDF方法缺乏物理接地和场景级交互性，难以从原始视觉观测生成仿真就绪的场景。
AI.method: NeoWorld-Pro包含两个核心组件：1) 利用MLLM的零样本推理与代码合成能力，将单张RGB图像转化为可执行程序，程序指定物体几何、关节和物理属性；2) 物理在环(pedagogy-in-the-loop)机制，通过在物理引擎中验证程序执行结果来迭代精化生成的程序，确保物理可行的关节、有效的物体组合与交互，以及准确的空间关系。
AI.result: 实验表明NeoWorld-Pro在开放回环和先前单目重建方法上均表现更优，并能够支持复杂下游任务，如稳定堆叠和精细操作。
AI.conclusion: 将单目场景重建转化为程序化生成并结合物理引擎验证，是弥合真实世界与仿真环境之间差距的有效途径，为具身智能提供更高质量的交互式仿真资产。

title: WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
summary:
Massively parallel simulation changes the data regime in which off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is trained, challenging stabilizers designed for data-limited replay. Through controlled experiments across eight benchmark families, we show that these stabilizers are data-regime-dependent: parameter normalization helps with narrow replay coverage but restricts value fitting when data are abundant, while clipped double-Q can be relaxed in high-throughput manipulation. Age-biased replay weighting improves learning efficiency across regimes, especially with limited network capacity.
  Based on these findings, we propose WarpSAC, a regime-aware family of off-policy RL algorithms. WarpSAC uses Sample Weight Decay for efficient exploitation and provides two variants: WarpSAC-L (Norm ON, clipped double-Q) for data-limited CPU-scale training, and WarpSAC-A (Norm OFF, single-Q) for data-abundant GPU-parallel training. WarpSAC improves normalized score--step AUC over FlashSAC by 4.5% across nine CPU-scale environments and 23.1% across fourteen GPU-parallel environments. It increases UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 success rate from 19.8% to 96.4%, improves mean normalized wall-time AUC on MuJoCo Playground by 19.1%, and achieves 36.4% faster sim-to-real deployment on Unitree G1 than FlashSAC. These results show that scalable off-policy RL should adapt its stabilizers to the available data regime.

AI.tldr: 本文发现强化学习中的稳定器（stabilizers）对数据规模具有依赖性，并提出了一套数据规模感知的离策略强化学习算法族 WarpSAC。该算法在数据受限的 CPU 场景使用参数归一化和 clipped double-Q，在数据充裕的 GPU 并行场景关闭这些稳定器，在多个基准和真实机器人任务上显著优于 FlashSAC。
AI.motivation: 大规模并行仿真改变了离策略强化学习训练的数据规模，但现有的稳定器（如参数归一化和 clipped double-Q）是为数据有限的回放缓冲区设计的。作者希望系统探究这些稳定器在不同数据规模下的适用性，并据此设计自适应数据规模的高效算法。
AI.method: 作者首先在八个基准家族上进行受控实验，分析参数归一化、clipped double-Q 和年龄偏置回放加权等稳定器在不同数据规模下的表现。基于实验结果，提出 WarpSAC 算法族：包含 Sample Weight Decay 用于高效利用，提供两个变体——WarpSAC-L（Norm ON + clipped double-Q，面向数据有限的 CPU 训练）和 WarpSAC-A（Norm OFF + single-Q，面向数据充裕的 GPU 并行训练）。
AI.result: WarpSAC 在九个 CPU 场景下相对于 FlashSAC 提升了 4.5% 的归一化得分-步数 AUC，在十四个 GPU 并行环境中提升了 23.1%。UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 任务成功率从 19.8% 提升至 96.4%，MuJoCo Playground 的平均归一化墙钟时间 AUC 提升 19.1%，Unitree G1 的 sim-to-real 部署速度比 FlashSAC 快 36.4%。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的离策略强化学习应根据可用数据规模自适应地调整其稳定器配置。固定使用同一套稳定器无法同时兼顾数据受限和数据充裕两种训练场景，数据规模感知的算法设计是提升大规模并行 RL 性能的关键。

title: ACE: A Self-Correcting Agentic Canvas Editor for Multi-Slide Presentation Automation
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, EMNLP 2026 Industry Track (Main paper)
summary: Commercial design platforms increasingly edit documents through large language model (LLM) agents, but two practical problems block reliable deployment: legacy document formats expose only \emph{flat}, absolutely positioned elements, so agents must recompute coordinates and routinely break layouts; and design has no unique ground truth, so diff-against-reference metrics penalize valid-but-different outputs. We present \textbf{ACE}, an agentic canvas editor over a \emph{hierarchical scene-graph} with a presentation-specialized action space (98 tools), paired with \textbf{CARE}, a content-aware router that feeds the agent only the relevant slice of each deck (avg.\ $\sim$89\% input-token reduction), and a \emph{self-correction} loop driven by a \emph{ground-truth-free} instruction-following (IF) judge whose natural-language critique is fed back as the next-turn instruction. With a fixed backbone, a scene-graph editor in a \emph{single turn} already matches a same-backbone \emph{agentic} HTML pipeline that iterates internally; adding self-correction lifts ACE significantly above it on instruction following (IF 4.23 vs.\ 3.81 on the full 94-task benchmark, paired $p{=}.010$, replicated by an out-of-loop judge) at 1.75$\times$ the speed and $\sim$44\% lower cost. VQ means are statistically indistinguishable, but 26 blind raters prefer ACE overall (58.7\% decisive win-rate) and prefer the self-corrected output 81\% of the time; the ranking is invariant across three judge families, and out-of-loop judges retain two-thirds of the self-correction gain, bounding circularity. 66\% of cases halt after one pass, and a strict-peak rollback removes every observed regression.

AI.tldr: ACE是一个基于层级场景图的智能画布编辑器，配以内容感知路由器（CARE）和基于无真值指令遵循评判器的自校正循环，以1.75倍速度和44%更低成本在指令遵循上显著超越同骨干的HTML智能体管线。
AI.motivation: 商业设计平台通过LLM智能体编辑文档时面临两大实际问题：传统文档格式仅暴露扁平、绝对定位的元素，智能体需重新计算坐标并常破坏布局；设计没有唯一真值，基于差额参照的评测指标惩罚正确但不同的输出。
AI.method: 提出ACE智能体画布编辑器，基于层级场景图，配备98个工具的演示专用动作空间；搭配CARE内容感知路由器，仅向智能体提供每个演示文稿的相关切片（平均减少约89%输入token）；以及由无真值指令遵循（IF）评判器驱动的自校正循环，其自然语言批评作为下一轮指令反馈。
AI.result: 使用固定骨干时，ACE单轮场景图编辑器已匹配同骨干内部迭代的HTML智能体管线；加自校正后IF从3.81提升至4.23（配对p=.010，由循环外评判器复现），速度1.75倍、成本降低44%。VQ均值统计上不可区分，但26名盲评者中58.7%决定性胜率偏好ACE，81%偏好自校正输出；66%案例一轮即止，严格峰值回滚消除了所有观测到的回归。
AI.conclusion: 层级场景图表示加无真值自校正机制是LLM驱动设计编辑中更可靠、更快、更经济的方案；排序在三个评判器族中不变，循环外评判器保留三分之二的自校正增益，排除了循环性偏差。

title: Beyond Static Interpretability: Anticipating Post-SFT Mechanisms from Pre-SFT Parameters for Better Tuning
summary: Mechanistic Localization bridges mechanistic interpretability and post-training optimization by isolating critical parameters via interpretative approaches and then guiding parameter-efficient Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) in a ``locating-then-tuning'' paradigm. However, due to the retrospective nature of mechanistic interpretability, directly interpreting pre-SFT models introduces misleading conclusions. Specifically for novel tasks, initially identified neurons differ drastically from those governing the final model, introducing biases that actively disrupt SFT. To address this, we propose a forward-looking localization framework that accurately estimates the post-SFT interpretability state using only pre-SFT parameters and the target dataset. Theoretically, we model SFT as a continuous parameter evolution, leveraging Taylor expansion to rigorously bridge the post-tuning mechanistic objective with the pre-SFT model's dynamic gradients. Practically, we design dual-granularity (neuron- and component-level) localization pipelines. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only provides superior SFT guidance but also exhibits robust performance and temporal scalability across increasing model sizes. This work transcends the fundamental limitation of traditional interpretability-its inability to identify task-critical mechanisms before they are trained-pioneering a predictive frontier that unites mechanistic interpretability with targeted optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"前向定位"框架（Mechanistic Localization），利用预训练参数和目标数据集准确估计SFT后的可解释状态，避免传统可解释性方法因回顾性导致的误导性定位，从而指导参数高效微调。
AI.motivation: 传统机制可解释性本质上是回顾性的，直接对SFT前的模型进行解释会产生误导性结论：对于新任务，初始识别的关键神经元与最终模型实际支配任务的神经元差异巨大，这种偏差会主动干扰SFT过程。
AI.method: 1) 理论层面：将SFT建模为连续参数演化过程，利用泰勒展开严格桥接微调后的机制目标和SFT前模型的动态梯度。2) 实践层面：设计双粒度（神经元级和组件级）定位管线，仅使用预训练参数和目标数据集进行前向定位。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法不仅提供更优的SFT指导，而且在模型规模增大时表现出稳健的性能和时间可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作超越了传统可解释性的根本局限——无法在任务关键机制训练之前识别它们，开创了将机制可解释性与定向优化结合的预测性前沿。

title: Scalable Question-Centric Text-to-Image Evaluation: Reliable Ranking, Fine-Grained Diagnosis, and Cost-Aware Routing
summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models often have similar total scores but different strengths, making practical selection difficult. Fine-grained benchmarks decompose prompts into questions, yet often return them to prompt scores and fixed categories, weakening attribution and ignoring complexity. Related requirements are also scored separately or as one total, obscuring basic versus compositional failure. We present QC-T2I-Bench, a question-centric framework that converts open prompts into attributed atomic questions and organizes their dependencies with Davidsonian Scene Graphs (DSGs). We use hierarchy-constrained question aggregation to exclude downstream questions after a prerequisite fails and to prevent simple and complex prompts from receiving the same total weight. We then use the DSG structure to measure joint success within prompts and compare repeated entities across prompts, separating basic realization failures from failures under additional requirements. We evaluate multiple open-source T2I models on English and Chinese prompts. The resulting question-level evidence supports reliable ranking and fine-grained diagnosis: joint completion falls from 80.7\% for components with two capabilities to 37.2\% for those with seven or more. Finally, we reuse the same records for training-free routing; our cost-aware router matches ERNIE's 89.51-point estimate with 21.3\% less GPU-s/MP.

AI.tldr: 提出QC-T2I-Bench，一个以问题为中心的文本到图像（T2I）模型评测基准，通过Davidsonian Scene Graphs（DSGs）将开放提示词分解为带属性的原子问题，并组织其依赖关系，实现层次约束的问题聚合和细粒度诊断，同时支持训练无关的成本感知路由。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型总分相近但优势各异，实际选择困难。细粒度基准虽将提示词分解为问题，但往往又聚合回提示词分数和固定类别，削弱归因能力且忽略复杂度；相关需求被单独或整体打分，无法区分基础失败与组合失败。
AI.method: （1）将开放提示词转换为带属性的原子问题，并用Davidsonian Scene Graphs（DSGs）组织问题间的依赖关系；（2）采用层次约束的问题聚合，在前置问题失败后排除下游问题，并防止简单与复杂提示获得相同总权重；（3）利用DSG结构衡量提示词内的联合成功率和跨提示词的重复实体比较，区分基础实现失败与附加需求下的失败；（4）复用相同记录实现训练无关的成本感知路由。
AI.result: 在英文和中文提示词上评估多个开源T2I模型。联合完成率从2个能力的80.7%下降到7个及以上能力的37.2%。成本感知路由器在GPU-s/MP上减少21.3%开销的同时，达到了与ERNIE 89.51点估计相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: QC-T2I-Bench通过问题级证据支持可靠的模型排名与细粒度诊断，并实现了训练无关的高效模型路由，兼顾评测准确性与推理成本。

title: Where Entropy Is Measured Matters: Policy Geometry in Bounded Continuous-Control PPO
summary: Many continuous-control policies are optimized as unbounded Gaussians and then mapped into bounded actions. We show that where entropy is measured changes the policy geometry learned by proximal policy optimization (PPO). In an 80-muscle MyoLeg task, a clipped Gaussian executes 89.07% of actions within 5% of a bound. A same-state decomposition shows that this is not due to variance alone: setting variance to zero still leaves 83.83% of actions near a bound, while 82.12% of state-conditioned means lie outside the executable interval. Replacing clipping with a tanh map does not remove the high-variance regime. For latent Gaussian entropy H(u), the entropy loss has zero gradient with respect to the mean and a constant variance-increasing gradient. For executed-action entropy H(a), the transform Jacobian adds an inward gradient on the mean. Across three matched MyoLeg seeds, near-boundary occupancy is 71.42%, 29.76%, and 18.83% under latent entropy, no entropy, and executed-action entropy. A 38-dimensional Dog-Stand replication with an independent CleanRL-based PPO implementation reproduces the ordering in mean geometry, which also survives shared-state evaluation and boundary margins from 1% to 10%. Direct mean penalties can match or exceed the centering produced by H(a), showing that interior means are not unique to executed entropy. However, matched mean geometry can coexist with substantially different variance and return. Entropy measurement space is therefore a coupled mean-variance design choice, and task return alone does not characterize bounded-policy geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在PPO中，熵的测量空间（隐变量熵H(u) vs. 执行动作熵H(a)）会显著改变有界策略的几何形态。在MyoLeg等连续控制任务中，隐变量熵导致大量动作落在边界附近，而执行动作熵能使均值更居中。熵测量空间是均值-方差的耦合设计选择，仅靠任务回报无法刻画有界策略的几何特性。
AI.motivation: 许多连续控制策略将无界高斯分布映射到有界动作空间，但熵测量位置对策略几何（均值与方差的行为）的影响长期被忽视。作者试图揭示熵测量空间如何影响PPO学习到的有界策略的分布形状。
AI.method: 在80肌肉的MyoLeg任务及38维Dog-Stand任务上，对比隐变量熵H(u)与执行动作熵H(a)两种熵测量方式，通过同状态分解、方差归零实验、tanh映射对比、追踪变换Jacobian对均值的梯度影响，以及独立CleanRL实现的PPO验证，系统性分析有界策略的均值-方差几何。
AI.result: MyoLeg中，裁剪高斯89.07%动作落在边界5%以内；方差归零后仍有83.83%接近边界，82.12%的状态条件均值在执行区间外。隐变量熵下边界附近占用率为71.42%，无熵为29.76%，执行动作熵仅为18.83%。Dog-Stand复现了相同的均值几何排序，且直接均值惩罚可匹配或超过H(a)的居中度。
AI.conclusion: 熵测量空间是PPO中一个耦合的均值-方差设计选择：隐变量熵对均值无梯度而持续增大方差，执行动作熵通过变换Jacobian提供内向均值梯度。任务回报不足以表征有界策略的几何特性，匹配的均值几何也可能伴随显著不同的方差与回报。

title: AHEAD: Adaptive Hindsight with Environment-Augmented Distillation for Agentic RL
summary: Training multi-turn LLM agents with reinforcement learning typically relies on trajectory-level rewards, which assign a uniform advantage to every step and cannot identify which decisions led to success or failure. Self-distillation methods can provide finer-grained supervision by augmenting RL with privileged information. However, existing approaches usually apply the same type of privileged information to every step in an indistinguishable manner, ignoring a key asymmetry: routine steps need little additional guidance, while critical error steps require corrective direction that environment feedback alone cannot provide. We propose AHEAD, a step-aware framework that matches different supervision sources to different step types. The teacher receives environment feedback on all steps as a grounded dense signal, and additionally receives LLM-generated corrective hints on error steps to supply the direction that environment feedback lacks. The method introduces minimal changes to the standard GRPO algorithm. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, and across three model scales, AHEAD raises task success (+13.3 points on ALFWorld and +11.0 on WebShop at 7B over GRPO), reaches a given success rate in fewer training steps, and solves tasks within tighter interaction budgets than outcome-only RL and prior self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出AHEAD框架，通过区分"常规步骤"与"错误关键步骤"来匹配不同的监督来源，在标准GRPO算法基础上引入最小改动，为多轮LLM智能体的RL训练提供逐步、细颗粒度的监督信号，在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-based QA三个基准上显著超越baseline。
AI.motivation: 多轮LLM智能体的强化学习依赖轨迹级奖励，无法识别具体哪一步导致成功或失败；现有的自蒸馏方法对所有步骤施加同一种特权信息，忽略了不同步骤所需的监督强度不同——常规步骤几乎不需额外指导，而关键错误步骤需要环境反馈无法提供的纠正方向。
AI.method: 提出AHEAD（Step-Aware框架）：教师模型在所有步骤上接收环境反馈作为有根据的稠密信号，同时在错误步骤上额外接收LLM生成的正向纠正提示来补充环境反馈缺乏的方向信息。将不同监督来源匹配到不同步骤类型，且对标准GRPO算法仅做最小改动。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-based QA三个基准及三种模型规模下，AHEAD相比GRPO在7B模型上任务成功率提升+13.3点（ALFWorld）和+11.0点（WebShop）；在更少的训练步骤达到给定的成功率，并在更紧的交互预算内解决问题，优于仅结果导向的RL和先前的自蒸馏baseline。
AI.conclusion: AHEAD验证了步骤感知的监督分配策略显著优于对所有步骤不加区分地施加统一特权信息的做法，证明了向关键错误步骤提供纠正性提示、向常规步骤提供环境反馈的异构监督设计能有效提升多轮LLM智能体的RL训练效率和最终性能。

title: Example-based Robust Abnormality Detection with Minimal Annotations using Exemplar Med-DETR
summary: Reducing annotation requirements remains a key challenge in developing robust medical object detectors. To address this, Vision-Language (VL) object detection methods leverage grounding text information to enable powerful zero-shot and few-shot object detectors in the natural image domain [1, 2, 3, 4]. However, transferring these methods to the medical domain is challenging due to the absence of comparable quality and quantity of the grounding data. Regardless, significant contextual and non-imaging information exists in medical images that remains underutilized. Few-shot learning (FSL) techniques partially address this limitation but struggle to general ize to unseen medical findings and require extensive retraining when new findings are introduced [5, 6]. To overcome these challenges, we extend our prior EM-DETR framework [7] and introduce a scalable FS detection approach designed for efficient abnormality detection in Chest X-Ray (CXR) images under minimal supervision. The proposed architecture incorporates exemplar-based feature generation and domain-aware contrastive optimization, enabling effective adaptation to novel disease findings without exhaustive retraining. Our method achieves near state-of-the-art (SOTA) detection performance using less than 10% of the annotated data, demonstrating its potential for practical, annotation-efficient clinical deployment across both proprietary and public CXR datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于EM-DETR框架扩展的可扩展少样本医学目标检测方法，通过示例特征生成和领域感知对比优化，在胸部X光图像上仅使用不到10%的标注数据即可达到接近SOTA的异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 减少标注需求是开发鲁棒医学目标检测器的关键挑战。视觉-语言目标检测方法在自然图像领域表现优异，但由于医学领域缺乏同等质量和数量的grounding数据而难以迁移。现有少样本学习技术难以泛化到未见医学发现，且引入新发现时需要大量重训练。
AI.method: 在EM-DETR框架基础上进行扩展，提出可扩展的少样本检测方法。架构包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于示例（exemplar-based）的特征生成模块；(2) 领域感知（domain-aware）对比优化策略。该方法无需穷举重训练即可适应新发现的疾病类别。
AI.result: 该方法在专有和公开的胸部X光数据集上，仅使用不到10%的标注数据即可达到接近当前最优（SOTA）的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了在最小监督条件下实现高效、标注节约型临床部署的潜力，为医学图像中异常检测的少样本学习提供了实用解决方案。

title: When Do Supervised UQ Ensembles Improve LLM Hallucination Detection? A Robustness Study
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods are widely used for hallucination detection in large language models (LLMs) in closed-book settings where ground-truth evidence is unavailable at inference time. Prior work has proposed combining UQ signals via learned ensembles, but empirical investigations into the robustness of these ensembles are limited. We study a supervised ensembling framework that trains a classifier over heterogeneous UQ-based scorer outputs on a small, domain-specific dataset of labeled LLM responses, then applies it to out-of-sample hallucination classification without retrieval, tools, or reference documents. Across four LLMs, nine datasets, and three generation regimes (short-form QA, long-form generation, and code generation), we provide a systematic robustness analysis along three axes: sample efficiency, in-domain dataset transfer, and generation regime dependence. We find that supervised ensembles outperform the best individual scorer in 30 of 32 settings, with gains realized from as few as 100 labeled instances. Ensembles retain most of their advantage in cases of in-domain transfer under distribution shift, outperforming the best non-ensemble scorer in 23 of 28 transfer settings. Sampling-based black-box ensembles are nearly as effective as full ensembles, while single-generation white-box ensembles offer limited benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于监督式集成的幻觉检测方法在大型语言模型中的鲁棒性，涵盖四个LLM、九个数据集和三种生成场景，发现监督式集成在32个设置中的30个优于最佳单一评分器，最少仅需100个标注样本即可获得提升，且在分布偏移下的域内迁移中仍保持优势。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽已提出通过学习式集成组合不确定性量化信号用于LLM幻觉检测，但缺乏对这些集成方法鲁棒性的系统实证研究。作者希望在多种条件下（样本效率、数据集迁移、生成场景）验证监督式集成的泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用监督式集成框架：在小型域特定标注数据集上训练分类器，组合异构UQ评分器输出，随后在无检索、工具或参考文档的情况下应用于样本外幻觉分类。系统性地沿三个维度进行鲁棒性分析：样本效率（标注样本量）、域内数据集迁移（分布偏移条件下的迁移）、生成场景依赖（短问答、长文本生成、代码生成）。同时对比采样式黑盒集成与单生成白盒集成。
AI.result: 监督式集成在32个设置中的30个优于最佳单一评分器，且仅需100个标注实例即可获得性能提升。在28个域内迁移设置中，23个优于最佳非集成评分器。采样式黑盒集成几乎与完整集成效果相当，而单生成白盒集成收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 监督式UQ集成为幻觉检测提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方案：即使面对分布偏移和少量标注数据，集成方法仍能保持显著优势；在实践部署中，采样式黑盒集成可作为全集成的有效替代方案。

title: Robust Code RL via Faulty-Code-Driven Test case Synthesis and Dense Reward Shaping
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a pivotal technique for enhancing the code generation capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the efficacy of RLVR in coding implementations is fundamentally limited by the comprehensiveness of test cases, because insufficient test coverage in code validation often causes false positives, further leading to reward hacking and policy degradation. To mitigate the reward bias stemming from the suboptimal quality of current automated generation methods, we propose the RobustTests framework, which introduces a faulty-code-driven test case synthesis strategy that leverages "near correct" faulty codes to guide the model in precisely capturing latent logical discrepancies and further integrates validator agents with behavioral feature clustering to facilitate the granular filtering of invalid and redundant test cases. To address false negatives caused by inherent hallucination noise in synthetic test cases, RobustTests also incorporates a stepwise dense reward function based on pass rates, bolstering training robustness through fine-grained feedback. By employing this pipeline, we construct a high-quality dataset that augmented the test cases in CodeContests, encompassing a broader spectrum of faulty code scenarios and significantly enhances diagnostic utility. Experimental results demonstrate that, by leveraging a moderately challenging subset of problems from CodeContests for training, RL fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B via RobustTests achieves an absolute 3% performance gain on the LiveCodeBench benchmark compared to baseline methods, confirming the effectiveness of the RobustTests framework in advancing the code generation proficiency of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RobustTests框架，通过"近正确"错误代码驱动的测试用例合成策略、行为特征聚类的验证智能体，以及基于通过率的逐步稠密奖励函数，解决RLVR中测试用例不全面导致的奖励偏差和幻觉噪声问题，在LiveCodeBench上实现绝对3%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: RLVR在代码生成中的效果受限于测试用例的全面性。不充分的测试覆盖率会导致虚假通过（假阳性），进而引发奖励黑客和策略退化；同时自动化生成的测试用例存在幻觉噪声，造成假阴性问题。这两类偏差严重制约了LLM代码生成能力的提升。
AI.method: RobustTests框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 错误代码驱动的测试用例合成策略，利用"近正确"的错误代码引导模型精确捕捉潜在逻辑偏差；(2) 集成行为特征聚类的验证智能体，对无效和冗余测试用例进行细粒度过滤；(3) 基于通过率的逐步稠密奖励函数，通过细粒度反馈增强训练鲁棒性以缓解假阴性问题。
AI.result: 通过RobustTests在CodeContests数据集的适中难度子集上增强测试用例并用于训练，Qwen3-32B在LiveCodeBench基准上相比基线方法取得绝对3%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: RobustTests通过系统性地缓解测试用例质量问题带来的奖励偏差，有效提升了RLVR在代码生成任务中的训练效果，验证了高质量测试用例构建和精细奖励设计对增强LLM代码生成能力的关键作用。

title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. 42 pages, 14 figures, 10 tables. https://openreview.net/forum?id=zw5EuUnBny
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) plays a vital role in enhancing the reliability of deep learning model predictions, especially in scenarios with high-dimensional output spaces. This paper addresses the dual nature of uncertainty -- aleatoric and epistemic -- focusing on their joint integration in high-dimensional regression tasks. For example, in applications like medical image segmentation or restoration, aleatoric uncertainty captures inherent data noise, while epistemic uncertainty quantifies the model's confidence in unfamiliar conditions. Modeling both jointly enables more reliable predictions by reflecting both unavoidable variability and knowledge gaps, whereas modeling only one limits transparency and robustness. We propose a novel approach that approximates the resulting joint uncertainty using a low-rank plus diagonal covariance structure, capturing essential output correlations while avoiding the computational burdens of full covariance matrices. Unlike prior work, our method explicitly combines aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties into a unified second-order distribution that supports robust downstream analyses like sampling and log-likelihood evaluation. We further introduce stabilization strategies for efficient training and inference, achieving superior UQ in the tasks of image inpainting, colorization, optical flow, and depth estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在高维回归任务中联合建模随机（aleatoric）与认知（epistemic）不确定性的新方法，通过低秩加对角协方差结构近似联合不确定性，并引入稳定化训练与推理策略，在图像修复、着色、光流和深度估计等任务中取得了优越的不确定性量化性能。
AI.motivation: 不确定性量化（UQ）对提升深度学习模型预测可靠性至关重要，尤其是在高维输出空间场景下。现有方法往往只单独建模随机不确定性或认知不确定性，而联合建模两者能够同时反映数据的固有噪声和模型的认知盲区，从而提高预测的透明度与鲁棒性。然而，联合建模在高维任务中面临计算开销大的挑战，且缺乏统一的二阶分布框架来支持采样和对数似然评估等下游分析。
AI.method: 提出一种全新的联合不确定性建模方法，采用"低秩加对角"协方差结构来近似随机与认知不确定性融合后的联合分布，在捕捉输出相关性核心信息的同时避免全协方差矩阵的高计算负担。与以往工作不同，该方法将两类不确定性显式统一到一个二阶分布中，并引入了稳定化策略以支持高效的训练与推理过程。
AI.result: 在图像修复（inpainting）、图像着色（colorization）、光流估计（optical flow）和深度估计（depth estimation）四个高维回归任务上验证了方法的有效性，取得了超越现有方法的不确定性量化性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过低秩加对角协方差结构的创新设计，实现了高维回归任务中随机与认知不确定性的高效联合建模，既保证了计算可行性，又提供了统一的二阶分布表示来支撑稳健的下游分析，为高维场景下的不确定性量化提供了新的有效路径。

title: OmniJudge or OmniBias? Diagnosing Multimodal Judges through Balanced, Decoupled Lenses
summary: Multimodal understanding models that can jointly judge text-to-image (T2I), text-to-video (T2V) and text-to-speech (TTS) generation are increasingly used as "OmniJudges" for evaluation and automatic annotation. How reliably they understand what they score remains unclear, since existing benchmarks and training data tend to overemphasize positive examples and to conflate distinct failure modes, so a judge may score well without recognizing failures while its capability gaps stay hidden. Motivated by this, we introduce D3-Omni, a balanced and decoupled benchmark for diagnosing fine-grained multimodal understanding, covering 53 orthogonal binary dimensions (17/22/14) and 10,671 samples (3,526/1,998/5,147) across the three tasks. Rather than re-generating outputs, which may leak information across dimensions, we fix verified fully positive seeds and derive negatives through controlled prompt rewriting and atomic, dimension-isolating perturbations. The resulting D3 design is Dual-balanced, which helps alleviate negative-sample scarcity and per-dimension label imbalance; Decoupled, so that each error is attributable to a single capability; and Dynamic, steering construction toward under-represented regions of the label distribution as generative models improve.The suite reaches near 1:1 per-dimension parity and a uniform distribution over all total-score levels. Under this balanced view, even strong OmniJudges tend to struggle on modality-related dimensions, to confirm satisfied requirements far more reliably than they detect violated ones, and to treat nominally distinct attributes as largely a single decision, suggesting that aggregate accuracy may hide systematic blind spots that a balanced and decoupled lens can help expose and, in turn, address.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D3-Omni，一个平衡且解耦的基准，用于诊断多模态理解模型（OmniJudge）的细粒度能力缺陷。它覆盖53个正交二值维度、10,671个样本，通过受控提示改写和原子化维度隔离扰动生成负样本，解决了现有基准中正样本过剩、失败模式混淆、数据不平衡等问题。实验揭示即使强的OmniJudge也在模态相关维度上表现挣扎，对已满足需求的确认远比对违反需求的检测可靠，且将名义上不同的属性视为单一决策。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态理解模型常被用作"OmniJudge"来评估T2I、T2V和TTS生成，但现有基准和训练数据过度强调正例、混淆不同失败模式，导致模型评分看似良好却隐藏着能力缺陷。需要一个平衡且解耦的基准来暴露这些系统性盲点。
AI.method: D3-Omni基准采用三重设计原则：（1）Dual-balanced（双平衡）：通过固定已验证的全正种子，使用受控提示改写和原子化维度隔离扰动生成负样本，缓解负样本稀缺和每维度标签不平衡；（2）Decoupled（解耦）：每个错误可归因于单一能力，避免维度间信息泄露；（3）Dynamic（动态）：随生成模型提升，引导构造向标签分布的欠表示区域靠拢。覆盖53个正交二值维度（T2I 17个，T2V 22个，TTS 14个），10,671个样本。
AI.result: D3-Omni达到接近每维度1:1的正负样本比例，且统一覆盖所有总分数水平。在该平衡视角下，即使强OmniJudge也在模态相关维度上表现挣扎；它们确认已满足需求的可靠度远高于检测违反需求的能力；且将名义上不同的属性视为大致单一决策——表明聚合准确性可能掩盖系统性盲点。
AI.conclusion: 平衡且解耦的基准视角能够暴露和定位多模态理解模型（OmniJudge）的系统性盲点，为解决这些能力缺陷提供方向。聚合评估指标可能具有误导性，细分维度的诊断对模型评估和改进至关重要。

title: Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation
summary: Latent diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for high-fidelity image and video synthesis, operating in compact latent spaces with variational autoencoders (VAEs) to enhance computational efficiency without compromising visual quality. However, conventional VAEs are suboptimal for video data as they employ fixed compression ratios that cannot adapt to the varying complexity of spatio-temporal content. We present KATok (Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation), a transformer-based VAE that incorporates an adaptive token selector which is jointly learned with latent tokens. By evaluating each token's content-richness as keep-or-drop probability, the token selector effectively discards uninformative tokens, naturally allowing data-dependent compression. Applying adaptive tokenization to diffusion models may cause spatial misalignment, as token dropping can disturb the original spatio-temporal structure. To alleviate this issue, we propose two position-prediction strategies: cascaded and joint generation, to ensure spatial consistency. We empirically show that our model achieves strong reconstruction and generation quality at a state-of-the-art compression ratio. Further analysis on video data reveals that this improvement is primarily achieved by reducing spatio-temporal redundancy and removing uninformative tokens, as supported by both quantitative and qualitative results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KATok，一种基于Transformer的变分自编码器，通过自适应token选择器实现数据依赖的视频压缩，在扩散模型中实现高压缩比的同时保持重建和生成质量。
AI.motivation: 传统VAE在视频数据中使用固定压缩比，无法适应不同时空内容复杂度的变化，导致压缩效率低下或视觉质量受损。需要一种能够自适应调整压缩策略的tokenizer来优化视频表示。
AI.method: 提出KATok：一个Transformer-based VAE，包含与潜在token联合学习的自适应token选择器。该选择器评估每个token的内容丰富度并给出保留或丢弃的概率，从而动态丢弃无信息量的token。为解决token丢弃导致的空间错位问题，提出级联和联合生成两种位置预测策略来保证空间一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明KATok在先进压缩比下实现了强大的重建和生成质量。进一步的视频数据分析显示，其性能提升主要源于减少时空冗余和去除无信息token，定量和定性结果均予以支持。
AI.conclusion: KATok验证了自适应、数据依赖的压缩范式在视频潜在扩散模型中的有效性，为高效视频表示学习提供了新思路。

title: From Numerical Simulators of PDEs to Neural Emulators and Back
summary: Simulation is central to modern engineering and science, but the cost of numerical solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a bottleneck whenever fast or many-query evaluations are required. Neural emulators trained on solver-generated data promise significant speedups, yet they are usually framed as opaque alternatives to the very methods that produce their training signal. This thesis argues the two paradigms are more alike than different: neural architectures mirror classical discretizations, their errors are amenable to the same spectral analysis, and insight flows profitably in both directions. We approach the relationship by disentangling the multiple roles a solver plays in the emulator learning pipeline. Mode-wise Fourier analysis then provides a common language in which solver errors, architectural inductive biases, and training objectives can all be read off simultaneously. Taken together, this allows synthesizing three contributions. (1) APEBench, a comprehensive benchmarking suite for autoregressive neural emulators of PDEs that uses fast differentiable pseudo-spectral solvers in JAX. (2) Progressively Refined Differentiable Physics, an investigation of the effect of unconverged solvers on surrogate training. (3) Neural Emulator Superiority, an analysis of the influence of numerical errors and architectural inductive biases.

AI.tldr: 本论文主张神经模拟器与经典数值求解器并非对立，而是高度相似：神经架构映照经典离散化，其误差可通过相同的频谱分析来理解。论文通过解耦求解器在模拟器学习流程中的多重角色，用模态傅里叶分析作为共同语言，提出三大贡献：APEBench基准测试套件、渐进细化可微物理研究以及神经模拟器优越性分析。
AI.motivation: 偏微分方程数值求解器在需要快速或多查询评估时计算成本过高，神经模拟器虽能加速但通常被视为不透明黑箱，论文旨在揭示神经模拟器与经典求解器之间的深层关联，使两个范式之间能双向流动有益见解。
AI.method: 论文通过解耦求解器在模拟器学习流程中的多重角色（如数据生成、监督信号、评估基准等），采用模态傅里叶分析作为统一语言，同时解读求解器误差、架构归纳偏置和训练目标。基于此提出三项工作：基于JAX快速可微伪谱求解器的APEBench基准套件，研究未收敛求解器对代理训练影响的渐进细化可微物理实验，以及分析数值误差与架构归纳偏置作用的神经模拟器优越性研究。
AI.result: 论文产生三项贡献：(1) APEBench——用于自回归神经PDE模拟器的综合基准测试套件，基于JAX中的快速可微伪谱求解器；(2) 渐进细化可微物理——关于未收敛求解器对代理训练影响的研究；(3) 神经模拟器优越性——对数值误差与架构归纳偏置影响的分析。
AI.conclusion: 神经模拟器和经典求解器之间的界线比通常认为的更模糊，二者可以通过统一的频谱分析框架互相借鉴——神经架构能够反映经典离散化结构，经典数值分析工具也能用于理解和改进神经模拟器，这种双向洞察流动有利于推动更快、更可靠的科学计算。

title: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for GUI Reward Modeling
summary: Recent studies on GUI agents have increasingly focused on outcome reward modeling, which assigns outcome rewards by judging whether an executed trajectory satisfies the success criteria implied by the user instruction. Existing GUI reward verifiers, however, often under-specify how these criteria should be constructed for each task instance. Whether using generic rubric structures or implicit model reasoning, their judging criteria are not sufficiently task-adaptive: they can transfer checks across tasks, overlook concrete constraints in the current instruction, or become overly strict by enforcing unstated requirements. To address this limitation, we propose AdaptRubric, a Coarse-to-Fine Rubrics Framework that constructs task-adaptive judging criteria through a category-level coarse stage and an instance-level fine stage. AdaptRubric performs category-level coarse rubric retrieval by routing the instruction to a GUI task family and retrieving reusable task-family criteria, then conducts instance-level fine rubric generation to surface compact cues for concrete values, scopes, and constraints in the current instruction. Across offline reward evaluation and online reinforcement learning optimization, AdaptRubric consistently outperforms prior reward agents, improving F1 by 3.6 points over the baseline average under a matched image budget and yielding a 4.23-point task-success gain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaptRubric，一个粗到细的评分标准框架（Coarse-to-Fine Rubrics Framework），用于为GUI智能体构建任务自适应的评判标准。该框架通过类别级粗粒度评分标准检索和实例级细粒度评分标准生成两个阶段，解决了现有GUI奖励验证器评判标准不够任务自适应的问题。实验表明，AdaptRubric在离线奖励评估和在线强化学习优化中均优于现有奖励智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI奖励验证器在构建每个任务实例的成功评判标准时存在不足：通用评分结构或隐式模型推理产生的前置条件不够任务自适应，可能跨任务转移检查项、忽略当前指令中的具体约束，或因强制执行未言明的要求而过于严格。
AI.method: AdaptRubric包含两个阶段：1）类别级粗粒度阶段，将指令路由到对应的GUI任务族，并检索可复用的任务族评分标准；2）实例级细粒度阶段，生成紧凑线索以凸显当前指令中的具体数值、范围和约束条件。
AI.result: 在离线奖励评估和在线强化学习优化中，AdaptRubric一致优于先前的奖励智能体：在匹配图像预算下，比基线平均F1值提升3.6个百分点；任务成功率提升4.23个百分点。
AI.conclusion: AdaptRubric通过粗到细的两阶段评分标准构建框架，有效提升了GUI智能体奖励模型的评判标准任务自适应性，在离线评估和在线优化场景中均取得了显著的性能提升。

title: SeMoCo: A Semantic-First Motion Codec for Motion Language Modeling
summary: Discrete motion representations have substantially advanced autoregressive text-to-motion generation. However, most motion tokenizers are optimized for reconstruction and do not explicitly allocate capacity according to semantic role. Action-level meaning and fine-grained kinematic detail must therefore be encoded through the same reconstruction-driven hierarchy. We introduce SeMoCo, a semantic-first motion codec, together with a dual-axis motion generator for language-conditioned motion generation. Each motion token contains one semantic token and a residual sequence of kinematic tokens. The generator models semantic progression across time and autoregressively refines the residual entries. We also construct $Ω$-MotionVerse, a large-scale, multi-source human-motion dataset unified under the SOMA representation. Across the reported comparisons, SeMoCo achieves the best reconstruction accuracy among the compared codecs, while strong text-to-motion results demonstrate the effectiveness of its motion tokens for downstream generation.

AI.tldr: SeMoCo是一种语义优先的运动编解码器，将每个运动token拆分为语义token和残差运动学token，配合双轴运动生成器实现文本驱动的运动生成，并在大规模多源数据集Ω-MotionVerse上进行验证，取得了最优的重构精度和强的文本到运动生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的离散运动表示方法（tokenizer）大多仅针对重建进行优化，没有根据语义角色显式分配编码容量，导致动作级别的语义信息与细粒度运动学细节混淆在同一个重建驱动的层级结构中，难以在自回归文本到运动生成中获得理想的语义一致性和细节保真度。
AI.method: 提出SeMoCo（semantic-first motion codec），每个运动token包含一个语义token加一个残差运动学token序列；同时设计双轴（dual-axis）运动生成器，一个轴建模时间维度上的语义进展，另一个轴自回归地细化残差运动学条目；并构建Ω-MotionVerse，一个基于SOMA表示的、大规模多源人体运动数据集。
AI.result: 在重构精度上，SeMoCo在所有对比的编解码器中取得最佳效果；在文本到运动生成下游任务上也展现了强有力的结果，验证了其运动token的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 语义优先的token设计与双轴生成策略能够有效解耦动作语义与运动学细节，从而同时提升运动重构精度与文本条件运动生成能力。

title: Persistent Cross Entropy
summary: Persistent entropy is the Shannon entropy of a persistence-based probability measure defined on a persistence diagram. However, its cross-entropy version is not naturally defined because two persistence diagrams generally have different event spaces. To bridge these event spaces, we combine a similarity function with persistence weighting to define an induced probability. The induced probability reflects information from one diagram on the event space of the other diagram and assigns unexplained probability mass to the unexplained event. Using the induced probability, we extend cross entropy to persistence diagrams, called persistent cross entropy (PCE). We establish the main properties of both the induced probability and PCE and prove stability theorems for both. Through three numerical studies, we show that PCE distinguishes diagrams with the same persistent entropy, separates causal directions in dynamical systems without constructing a joint persistent diagram, and can be used as a directional topology loss for knowledge distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持久交叉熵（PCE），将香农交叉熵推广到持久图场景。通过组合相似函数和持久权重定义诱导概率，在不同事件空间的持久图之间架起桥梁，并将无法解释的概率质量分配给未解释事件。文章证明了诱导概率和PCE的主要性质及稳定性定理，并通过三个数值实验展示其应用价值。
AI.motivation: 持久熵是持久图的Shannon熵，但其交叉熵版本无法自然定义，因为两个持久图通常具有不同的事件空间。需要一种方法在不同事件空间之间建立联系，以便比较两个持久图并度量它们之间的"距离"。
AI.method: 将相似函数与持久权重结合，定义一个诱导概率，使一个图的信息能在另一个图的事件空间上反映，并将无法解释的概率质量分配给未解释事件。基于该诱导概率，将交叉熵推广到持久图场景，定义为持久交叉熵（PCE），并证明其主要性质和稳定性定理。
AI.result: 通过三个数值实验表明：PCE能够区分具有相同持久熵的不同图；无需构建联合持久图即可在动力系统中分离因果方向；可作为知识蒸馏的方向性拓扑损失函数。
AI.conclusion: 持久交叉熵为在持久图之间比较信息提供了一种理论基础坚实且实用的工具，解决了持久熵无法比较不同事件空间图的问题，并在因果推断和知识蒸馏等领域具有实际应用潜力。

title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents re-send large file reads and tool outputs to a frontier LLM every turn, and this context dominates their token bill. General-purpose prompt compressors are trained on prose and suit code poorly: they paraphrase identifiers and drop the exact spans an agent needs to edit. We present Paritok-4B, a 4B LoRA compressor for coding-agent trajectories built on two commitments. It is extractive: it selects spans rather than rewriting them, and 96.0% of the identifiers, paths, and numbers it emits already appear in its input, holding at 96.2% on held-out SWE-bench Lite output. It is intent-conditioned: told the agent's current task, it acts chiefly inside a retained segment, selecting which lines survive (retained lines are +0.067 more intent-relevant than removed ones, paired 95% CI [+0.056, +0.078]) rather than changing how much is retained. We distil a gpt-4.1-mini teacher over 67,074 real OpenHands trajectories into 40,606 validated examples and fine-tune Qwen3-4B. On all 300 SWE-bench Lite instances, Paritok-4B compresses agent context to 25.7% of its size, 2.0x harder than a gpt-4.1-mini compressor (50.2%) and 2.4x harder than gpt-5 (61.9%), while retaining 86.5% of uncompressed single-shot solve quality. Fed the cat -n line-numbered input real agents produce, it compresses slightly less (27.8%) and retains more (89.3%); there the paired test is informative, with 30 instances solved only uncompressed and 17 only compressed, an exact McNemar p=0.079, so at this sample size compressing context to roughly a quarter of its size does not significantly reduce the solve rate. The model is a 264 MB adapter that self-hosts on one 24 GB GPU with no per-token compressor fee, which at list prices decides the economics: gpt-5 as a compressor is net-negative, costing more than the downstream tokens it saves. Weights, data, and evaluation scripts are open (Apache 2.0).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Paritok-4B，一个 4B 参数的 LoRA 压缩器，专为编码智能体轨迹设计。它采用抽取式策略（保留原文片段而非改写），并以智能体的当前意图为条件进行压缩。在全部 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 实例上，可将智能体上下文压缩至原始大小的 25.7%，同时保留 86.5% 的无压缩单次求解质量。模型为 264 MB 适配器，可自托管于单张 24 GB GPU，无需按 token 付费。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体每一轮都会向前沿 LLM 重新发送大文件读取内容和工具输出，导致上下文 token 占据主导地位的账单。现有的通用提示压缩器在散文上训练，对代码适配不佳：它们会改写标识符并丢失智能体编辑所需的确切跨度，因此需要一个专为编码智能体轨迹设计的压缩器。
AI.method: Paritok-4B 基于两个核心设计承诺：(1) 抽取式——选择原文中的片段而非重写，其输出的 96.0% 标识符、路径和数字已出现在输入中（在留出集 SWE-bench Lite 上为 96.2%）；(2) 意图条件化——告知智能体当前任务后，模型主要在保留段内操作，选择哪些行保留（保留行比移除行的意图相关性高 +0.067），而非改变保留量。方法上：使用 gpt-4.1-mini 教师模型在 67,074 条真实 OpenHands 轨迹上蒸馏，生成 40,606 条验证过的示例，微调 Qwen3-4B。
AI.result: 在全部 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 实例上，Paritok-4B 将智能体上下文压缩到原始大小的 25.7%，压缩强度是 gpt-4.1-mini 压缩器（50.2%）的 2.0 倍、gpt-5（61.9%）的 2.4 倍，同时保留 86.5% 的无压缩单次求解质量。对带 cat -n 行号输入时压缩略少（27.8%）、保留更多（89.3%）；配对检验显示 30 个实例仅无压缩可解、17 个仅压缩可解，精确 McNemar p=0.079，说明在该样本量下压缩至约四分之一不显著降低求解率。模型为 264 MB 适配器，可自托管于一张 24 GB GPU，无 per-token 压缩费用，在列表价格下 gpt-5 压缩器净收益为负。
AI.conclusion: Paritok-4B 表明针对编码智能体轨迹专门训练的小规模抽取式、意图条件化的压缩器，能在不显著损害求解质量的前提下大幅压缩上下文，并且在成本上优于 API 压缩方案。

title: Mind the Student: Behavioral and Contextual Cues for Automated Engagement Prediction in Online Learning
comment: Accepted to ICMI 2026 (International Conference on Multimodal Interaction), October 5-9, 2026, Napoli, Italy. 5 pages, 1 figures
summary: The prediction of student engagement from the online tutoring videos is difficult because engagement is a multidimensional construct comprising distinct behavioral, emotional, and cognitive states. A reliable prediction requires bringing together different types of behavioral signals as well as expressive cues. Through our analysis of the CASED dataset, it is clear that engagement prediction gets even harder due to the high inter-person variability as well as the subjectivity of the engagement annotation. To tackle these challenges, we develop a multimodal framework that integrates the implicit spatiotemporal features extracted from pretrained video, audio, and image encoders along with structured behavioral modalities like head pose, gaze, facial action units, emotion, and wavelet-based audio features. We integrate these modalities via a Perceiver IO latent bottleneck. Moreover, student and instructor personalities are modeled as variational posteriors over learnable embeddings to enable partial pooling across participants. We employ evidential regression and spectral-normalized Gaussian process classification heads for uncertainty-aware prediction to further improve robustness and calibration. Benchmark on the CASED challenge test set shows that all participating methods converge near random-chance performance, revealing the difficulty of the dataset. In this highly ambiguous regime, our framework achieves competitive performance while uniquely offering well-calibrated uncertainty metrics, demonstrating that reliable risk-quantification is an essential prerequisite for deploying engagement models in real-world educational tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多模态融合框架用于在线教学视频中的学生参与度预测。该框架整合视频、音频、图像编码器的隐式时空特征与头姿、视线、面部动作单元、情绪和小波音频特征等结构化行为模态，通过Perceiver IO潜在瓶颈整合，并对学生和教师个性进行变分后验建模实现部分池化。同时采用证据回归和谱归一化高斯过程分类头进行不确定性感知预测。在CASED数据集的基准测试中，所有方法均接近随机水平，而该框架在此高模糊场景下取得竞争力表现并提供良好校准的不确定性度量。
AI.motivation: 学生参与度是多维构念，包含行为、情感和认知状态，从在线教学视频中预测十分困难。CASED数据集存在高人际变异性和标注主观性，使预测更加复杂。现有方法在CASED测试集上均接近随机水平，说明需要新的方法应对这一高度模糊的预测场景。
AI.method: 构建多模态框架：(1)提取预训练视频、音频、图像编码器的隐式时空特征；(2)提取头姿、视线、面部动作单元、情绪和小波音频特征等结构化行为模态；(3)通过Perceiver IO潜在瓶颈整合所有模态；(4)将学生和教师个性建模为可学习嵌入上的变分后验，实现跨参与者的部分池化；(5)使用证据回归和谱归一化高斯过程分类头实现不确定性感知预测。
AI.result: 在CASED挑战测试集基准上，所有参与方法均收敛于接近随机水平，揭示了数据集的高难度。在此高度模糊的情境下，该框架取得与最优方法相当的性能，同时提供了良好校准的不确定性度量，表现出对可靠风险量化的独特优势。
AI.conclusion: 在高度模糊和主观的参与度预测场景中，仅追求准确率是不够的。可靠的模型应具备良好的不确定性量化能力，这是在真实教育工具中部署参与度预测模型的必要前提。所提出的多模态融合与不确定性感知框架为这类挑战提供了可行方案。

title: FraudBench: Protocol-Sensitive Benchmarking of Adversarial Robustness for Financial Risk Assessment
