summary: Machine learning models are widely used in financial fraud and credit-risk detection, yet their adversarial robustness remains difficult to evaluate because financial tabular data involve domain-specific constraints, severe class imbalance, and asymmetric attacker capability. We argue that, in this setting, robustness is not only an attribute of the model, but also an attribute of the evaluation protocol. Different ways of enforcing constraints and capability can lead to substantially different robustness conclusions. This paper presents FraudBench, a protocol-sensitive benchmark for adversarial robustness evaluation in financial fraud and credit-risk detection. Rather than treating domain constraints as post-hoc validity checks, FraudBench evaluates the same dataset--model--attack--defence setting under three matched protocols: unconstrained attacks, post-hoc feasibility filtering, and deployment-aware constraint-integrated attacks. FraudBench covers four public financial datasets, and evaluates neural, tree-based, and ensemble models using three attack settings. Our results show that robustness conclusions are highly protocol-sensitive. On Lending Club Loan Data under the white-box setting, post-hoc filtering leaves only 3.7 feasible-flipped examples on average, whereas in-attack projection with attacker mutability masking produces 2,832.3 feasible-flipped examples under the same perturbation budget. The results on IEEE-CIS further show that feasibility and attacker capability are separate axes, while black-box evaluation shows that protocol choice can alter model-family rankings. These findings suggest that fraud robustness evaluation should report predictive degradation and attack feasibility jointly, and should incorporate domain constraints into attack generation rather than treating them as post-processing checks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FraudBench，一个协议敏感（protocol-sensitive）的对抗鲁棒性基准测试框架，用于金融欺诈检测和信用风险评估场景。核心观点是：在金融表格数据中，鲁棒性不仅是模型属性，更是评估协议属性——约束和攻击者能力的施加方式会显著影响鲁棒性结论。FraudBench 在相同数据-模型-攻击-防御设置下比较三种协议（无约束攻击、事后可行性过滤、部署感知的约束集成攻击），结果显示鲁棒性结论高度依赖协议选择，事后过滤仅产生 3.7 个可行翻转样本，而攻击内投影配合攻击者变异掩码可产生 2,832.3 个可行翻转样本。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在金融欺诈和信贷风险检测中广泛应用，但其对抗鲁棒性难以评估，因为金融表格数据涉及领域特定约束、严重类别不平衡和不对称攻击者能力。现有评估方法将领域约束作为事后有效性检查，导致鲁棒性结论可能失真。作者认为评估协议本身是影响鲁棒性判断的关键因素，需要系统化比较不同协议下的鲁棒性表现。
AI.method: 作者提出 FraudBench 基准框架，在相同的数据-模型-攻击-防御设定下，配对比较三种评估协议：(1) 无约束攻击（不考虑领域约束）；(2) 事后可行性过滤（攻击后检查结果是否可行）；(3) 部署感知的约束集成攻击（在攻击生成过程中嵌入约束，包括攻击者变异能力掩码）。覆盖四个公开金融数据集，评估神经网络、树模型和集成模型，使用三种攻击设置（包括白盒和黑盒）。
AI.result: 鲁棒性结论高度协议敏感。在 Lending Club Loan 数据白盒场景下，事后过滤平均仅留下 3.7 个可行翻转样本，而攻击内投影配合攻击者变异掩码在相同扰动预算下产生 2,832.3 个可行翻转样本。IEEE-CIS 数据集的结果表明可行性与攻击者能力是两个独立维度；黑盒评估显示协议选择可改变模型族排名。
AI.conclusion: 金融欺诈鲁棒性评估应联合报告预测性能退化与攻击可行性两个指标，并且在攻击生成过程中即纳入领域约束，而非将其作为事后后处理检查。该工作强调鲁棒性评估协议本身的标准化和设计对得出正确鲁棒性结论至关重要。

title: Preference Data Selection for Mitigating the Alignment Tax in Large Language Models
summary: Aligning large language models to human preferences is crucial for real-world deployment but frequently incurs an alignment tax, leading to the catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained general capabilities. While previous works primarily frame this problem as an optimization or architectural challenge, the inherent characteristics of preference data that drive this degradation remain largely underexplored. In this paper, we propose BALIGN, a balanced data selection strategy that explicitly mitigates catastrophic forgetting while optimizing alignment efficacy. Through theoretical and empirical analyses of the preference optimization gradient, we identify three key data-centric features that dictate parameter drift: the reference model's log-probability margin, the token length difference between chosen and rejected responses, and the TF-IDF similarity to general capability corpora. By aggregating these orthogonal features into a unified composite risk score, BALIGN systematically filters out high-risk preference samples that disrupt intrinsic model parameters or provide minimal alignment utility. Extensive experiments on standard human preference datasets demonstrate that BALIGN strongly preserves foundational capabilities without compromising alignment gains, consistently achieving the optimal Pareto frontier with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出BALIGN，一种基于数据选择的平衡策略，通过识别和过滤高风险偏好样本，在保持对齐效果的同时缓解灾难性遗忘，实现最优帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型与人类偏好对齐过程中存在"对齐税"问题，即训练会灾难性遗忘预训练通用能力。以往工作主要从优化或架构角度解决，但偏好数据本身驱动参数漂移的内在特征尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 通过对偏好优化梯度的理论和实证分析，识别出三个决定参数漂移的数据中心特征：参考模型的log-probability边际、选定与拒绝响应之间的token长度差异、以及与通用能力语料库的TF-IDF相似度。将这三个正交特征聚合为统一的复合风险分数，系统性地过滤掉会破坏内在模型参数或提供极少对齐效用的高风险偏好样本。
AI.result: 在标准人类偏好数据集上的大量实验表明，BALIGN在保持对齐收益的同时强有力地保留了基础能力，以最小计算开销持续达到最优帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 数据选择是缓解对齐税的有效且轻量级的手段；通过关注偏好数据的内在特征而非仅优化或架构层面，可以在对齐效果与通用能力保持之间取得更好的平衡。

title: Metadata-Aware Adaptation of a Generative Foundation Model for Conditional CMR Synthesis
summary: Synthetic image generation is a promising strategy to address data scarcity and the underrepresentation of clinically important phenotypes in medical imaging, yet generating images that faithfully reflect meaningful patient characteristics remains challenging. In this work, we investigate metadata-conditioned cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) synthesis using a pretrained latent diffusion model, encoding structured clinical metadata and slice position as textual prompts to guide CMR generation. To improve metadata adherence and address the imbalance of clinical attributes, we integrate three strategies: Metadata-Free Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), Contrastive Batching, and Inverse-Frequency Sampling. The framework was fine-tuned and evaluated on 59,058 short-axis CMR from the UK Biobank using paired image similarity, distributional fidelity, and subgroup-level analyses. The combined approach achieved a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 37.47, improving by 57.04\% over the same model fine-tuned without these strategies and by 28.68\% over a previous text-conditioned CMR diffusion baseline requiring cardiac geometry as additional input, while relying solely on patient metadata. This distributional gain, driven mainly by Metadata-Free CFG, came with a modest reduction in paired similarity, suggesting that the model prioritizes population-level realism over exact image reproduction. Subgroup analyses demonstrated improved alignment across demographic and acquisition-related metadata, with disease-specific conditioning being the most challenging task. These findings demonstrate the potential of generative foundation models for clinically meaningful CMR synthesis while highlighting the need for more effective metadata-aware conditioning strategies. Our code is available at https://github.com/rodriguezmarc/conditional-cmr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预训练潜在扩散模型的元数据条件心脏磁共振（CMR）图像合成方法，通过将结构化临床元数据和切片位置编码为文本提示来引导生成，并整合了三种策略（无元数据分类器自由引导、对比批量采样、逆频率采样）以改善元数据遵从性和类别不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 医学影像中临床重要表型的数据稀缺和代表性不足问题，现有合成方法难以生成忠实反映有意义患者特征的图像。
AI.method: 使用预训练潜在扩散模型，将临床元数据和切片位置编码为文本提示；整合三种策略：Metadata-Free Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG)、Contrastive Batching和Inverse-Frequency Sampling，在UK Biobank的59,058例短轴CMR图像上微调并评估。
AI.result: 组合方法达到FID为37.47，比未使用这些策略的模型提高57.04%，比需要额外心脏几何输入的基线提高28.68%。分布增益主要由Metadata-Free CFG驱动，但以轻微配对相似性降低为代价；亚组分析显示人口统计和采集相关元数据的对齐改善，疾病条件性生成最具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式基础模型在临床意义的CMR合成方面具有潜力，但需要更有效的元数据感知条件化策略来进一步提升疾病相关的生成质量。

title: SeisMamba: Low-Latency Single-Station Seismic Magnitude Estimation for Spatially Distributed Earthquake Early Warning
summary: Rapid earthquake magnitude estimation is central to earthquake early warning, yet many operational systems depend on dense regional seismic networks and region-specific calibration. This creates a spatial coverage barrier for high-risk areas with sparse sensing infrastructure. Single-station learning offers a lower-cost alternative, but existing models often face an accuracy--latency trade-off and may degrade under regional distribution shift. We present SeisMamba, a lightweight Mamba-based architecture for low-latency magnitude estimation from minimally processed three-component seismic waveforms recorded at a single station. SeisMamba combines hierarchical convolutional encoding, sparse selective state-space modelling, multi-scale feature fusion, and an auxiliary temporal prediction head to support efficient long-sequence waveform analysis. On the STEAD benchmark, SeisMamba achieves the best MSE, RMSE, and $R^2$ among tested baselines while requiring only 0.55 ms for a batch of 32 waveforms on an NVIDIA T4 GPU, making it about three times faster than transformer-based baselines. We further conduct a Chile--Taiwan regional hold-out experiment as a diagnostic test of cross-region deployment, where SeisMamba retains useful performance on geographically unseen seismic regions. These results suggest that selective state-space waveform modelling provides a promising accuracy--latency backbone for spatially distributed, low-cost earthquake early warning.

AI.tldr: SeisMamba是一种基于Mamba架构的轻量级单台站地震震级快速估计模型，通过层级卷积编码、稀疏选择性状态空间建模、多尺度特征融合和辅助时间预测头，在STEAD基准上取得最优精度，推理速度快于Transformer基线约3倍，并在跨区域（智利-台湾）泛化测试中保持有效性能，为低成本的分布式地震预警提供了精度-延迟兼顾的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有地震预警系统依赖密集区域地震台网和区域定制校准，导致高烈度但传感基础设施稀疏的区域存在空间覆盖盲区。单台站学习方法虽成本更低，但现有模型常面临精度与延迟的权衡，且可能因区域分布偏移而性能退化。
AI.method: 提出SeisMamba架构，融合四大部分：1) 层级卷积编码；2) 稀疏选择性状态空间建模（Mamba核心）；3) 多尺度特征融合；4) 辅助时间预测头，以支持高效的长序列三分量波形分析。在STEAD基准上进行评估，并设计智利-台湾区域留出实验作为跨区域部署的诊断测试。
AI.result: 在STEAD基准上，SeisMamba在MSE、RMSE和R²指标上均优于所有对比基线；在NVIDIA T4 GPU上处理32条波形的批次仅需0.55 ms，比Transformer基线快约3倍；在智利-台湾跨区域hold-out实验中，对地理上未见过的地震区域仍保持有效性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择性状态空间波形建模为空间分布式、低成本的地震预警提供了有前景的精度-延迟骨干架构，有效缓解了稀疏传感区域的覆盖问题和单台站模型在区域分布偏移下的退化问题。

title: MetaRAG: Belief-Action Aligned Policy Optimization for Agentic RAG
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires language models to decide when to continue searching and when to answer. Existing RL-based methods rely on external supervision and overlook the agent's internal belief about whether the current evidence is sufficient. To address this problem, we reformulate the search decision quality as belief-action alignment and propose MetaRAG, a belief-action aligned policy optimization framework for agentic RAG. MetaRAG uses Verify-first Action Generation to elicit an explicit verification process before each actual action, and Internal Belief Probing to estimate the policy model's own answerability belief from the same question-history context. Based on these, MetaRAG derives a consistency reward that is further gated by answer correctness, avoiding reinforcement of internally consistent but incorrect trajectories. The belief probe is used only during training and introduces no inference-time overhead. Experiments on seven public QA benchmarks show that MetaRAG consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over strong RL-based agentic RAG baselines, with gains that transfer to deep research settings, different optimizers, and multiple model backbones.

AI.tldr: MetaRAG提出一种信念-行动对齐的策略优化框架，用于智能体检索增强生成（Agentic RAG）。它通过"先验证再行动"的动作生成和内部信念探测来估计策略模型自身的可回答性信念，并基于信念与动作的一致性构建由答案正确性门控的奖励信号，从而在不引入推理时开销的情况下提升检索决策质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的智能体RAG方法依赖外部监督信号（如答案正确性），忽视了智能体关于当前证据是否充分的内部信念，导致搜索决策质量不佳。作者旨在利用模型自身的信念来更好地指导"继续搜索还是回答"的决策。
AI.method: 1）Verify-first Action Generation：在每个实际动作之前引出一个显式的验证过程；2）Internal Belief Probing：从相同问题-历史上下文中估计策略模型自身的可回答性信念；3）基于信念与动作的 alignment 构建一致性奖励，并用答案正确性进行门控，避免强化内部一致但错误的轨迹；信念探针仅用于训练，推理时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在七个公开QA基准上的实验表明，MetaRAG在准确率-效率权衡上持续优于强力的基于RL的智能体RAG基线，且收益可迁移到深度研究场景、不同优化器及多种模型主干。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索决策质量重构为信念-动作对齐问题是提升智能体RAG检索决策的有效途径；利用模型内部信念进行策略优化可在不增加推理开销的前提下显著改善准确率与效率的平衡。

title: B-MIM: Biased Masked Image Modeling for Generalizable Segmentation of Fine-Grained Anatomical Structures
summary: Self-supervised pretraining enables transferable representations for medical imaging, yet most CT encoders remain biased toward coarse semantic understanding, limiting their sensitivity to fine-grained anatomical structures such as vessels or small tumors. In this paper, we introduce Biased Masked Image Modeling (B-MIM), a modification of the iBOT objective that stochastically reduces global semantic alignment to prioritize local patch reconstruction. This bias encourages the encoder to capture high-frequency morphological details and structural continuity. We curate a multi-institutional CT abdominal dataset of 9,955 filtered studies from 17 public sources and pretrain a 3D Swin Transformer backbone using B-MIM. Across inter-dataset experiments on liver vessel segmentation, the proposed encoder improves topological fidelity (clDice) and achieves competitive Dice scores in tumor segmentation, compared to fully fine-tuned baselines, despite updating only a fraction of the parameters. Our results suggest that reducing global semantic pressure during pretraining enhances generalization to intricate anatomical structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出偏置掩码图像建模（B-MIM），通过对iBOT目标进行随机化全局语义对齐来优先局部块重建，使3D Swin Transformer编码器更关注高频形态细节。在17个公开数据源构建的9,955例CT腹部数据集上预训练后，B-MIM在肝脏血管分割任务上显著提升了拓扑保真度（clDice），在肿瘤分割上取得有竞争力的Dice分数，且仅需微调少量参数即可超越完全微调的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有医学影像CT编码器在自监督预训练后偏向粗粒度语义理解，对血管、小肿瘤等细粒度解剖结构的敏感性不足，限制了其在精细结构任务上的表征能力。
AI.method: 提出B-MIM方法，对iBOT目标函数进行修改，随机降低全局语义对齐（global semantic alignment）的权重，转而优先进行局部块重建（local patch reconstruction）。在17个公共数据源筛选的9,955例CT腹部影像上，使用3D Swin Transformer作为骨干网络进行预训练。
AI.result: 跨数据集实验中，B-MIM在肝脏血管分割上提升拓扑保真度（clDice），在肿瘤分割上取得与完全微调基线相当甚至更优的Dice分数，同时仅更新少量参数。
AI.conclusion: 预训练阶段降低全局语义压力可增强编码器对复杂精细解剖结构的泛化能力，为医学影像自监督预训练中语义-细节平衡提供了新的设计思路。

title: Across the Loss Landscape with Progressive Growth
summary: Deep neural networks generalize well despite their highly nonconvex, overparameterized loss landscapes, a phenomenon often associated with the geometry of the minima found by stochastic optimization. We study how incremental grow-and-optimize strategies bias training toward flatter regions by viewing growth as progressive constraint relaxation. Starting from a low-dimensional submodel, we iteratively expand the trainable parameters by unlocking nested random subspaces while freezing the orthogonal complement at the network initialization, re-optimizing after each expansion until the full architecture is reached. Under standard local regularity conditions around non-degenerate minima, we prove that local sublevel sets are well approximated by ellipsoids and that basin accessibility under frozen constraints can be characterized by an explicit effective curvature in the frozen directions. This leads to an explanation of the bias: progressive growth increases the relative weight of wide basins and suppresses sharp ones through a volume effect induced by the frozen constraints. We empirically validate these predictions in controlled toy landscapes and in a realistic ResNet/CIFAR-100 setting and confirm that although progressive subspace growth reliably produces flatter solutions, curvature reductions do not universally translate into improved test performance, highlighting subtleties in the flatness-generalization connection. The code is available at https://github.com/p0lcAi/Across-the-Loss-Landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将渐进式增长（grow-and-optimize）策略建模为渐进约束松弛，证明了该策略通过冻结方向上的有效曲率体积效应偏向更平坦的极小值区域，并在玩具模型和ResNet/CIFAR-100上验证了这一推断。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在高度非凸、过参数化的损失景观中仍能良好泛化，这一现象常与随机优化找到的极小值的几何性质相关。作者希望理解增量式“生长-优化”策略如何将训练偏向更平坦的区域，从而揭示平坦度与泛化之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 作者将增长视为渐进约束松弛：从低维子模型开始，通过解锁嵌套的随机子空间逐步扩展可训练参数，同时将正交补空间冻结在初始化值，每次扩展后重新优化直至完整架构。在非退化极小值附近的标准局部正则条件下，证明局部子水平集可被椭球良好近似，且冻结约束下的盆地可达性可由冻结方向上的有效曲率显式刻画。
AI.result: 理论结果表明渐进增长通过冻结约束诱导的体积效应增加宽盆地的相对权重并抑制尖锐盆地。在受控玩具景观和ResNet/CIFAR-100设定中验证了预测：渐进子空间增长确实可靠地产生更平坦的解，但曲率的降低并不普遍转化为测试性能的提升，说明平坦度-泛化关系存在细微性。
AI.conclusion: 渐进增长策略在理论上和实验上均能偏向更平坦的极小值，但平坦度的改善与测试性能之间并非简单的正相关，这揭示了平坦度-泛化联结中未被充分理解的复杂性。

title: Constraint-Guided Enterprise Data Mapping with Large Language Models
comment: 20th International Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning. NeSy 2026
summary:
Enterprise entity alignment must handle semi-structured records, implicit attributes, and unit or granularity mismatches. Manual matching is still common in practice, but does not scale as schemas and providers evolve. LLM-only matching improves semantic recall, yet can violate structural and physical invariants, producing fluent yet operationally invalid correspondences.
  We propose constraint-guided mapping (CGM), a neuro-symbolic method with three stages: (i) schema-grounded admissibility constraints with metadata mc = <tau_c, delta_c>, where tau_c denotes the constraint type and delta_c provides executable relation and normalization logic; (ii) constraint-restricted candidate generation with cascade relaxation to guarantee a nonempty feasible set under noise; and (iii) neural ranking with bounded LLM disambiguation restricted to that feasible set.
  Methodologically, constraints operate as hypothesis-space operators rather than post-hoc validators, enabling controlled degradation under relaxation and auditable, human-guidable decisions. On a controlled structural-decoy benchmark, hard admissibility shrinks the candidate space by ~480x without dropping the GT, and a layer-by-layer ablation shows this gate, not the LLM, is the decisive lift (F1 0.08 to 0.66). The benefit is model-independent and adds no extra inference cost: a small model with constraints matches a frontier LLM used without them at ~28x lower cost. The method, not a single tuned configuration, transfers across seven enterprise makes (macro F1 0.70), each under its own automatically discovered, expert-refinable constraints, and lowers expert effort by ~7x versus spreadsheet workflows. Public Valentine results add an external ranking sanity check and mark the boundary: constraints should be hard only where structural invariants are match-determining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出约束引导映射（CGM），一种面向企业实体对齐的神经符号方法，通过将模式级约束作为假设空间算子（而非事后校验器），结合限制性候选生成、级联松弛和受限LLM消歧，在保持可审计性与可引导性的同时，显著缩小候选空间（约480倍）并大幅提升F1（0.08到0.66），且不增加额外推理成本。
AI.motivation: 企业实体对齐面临半结构化记录、隐式属性和单位/粒度不匹配等挑战。人工匹配虽准确但不具备可扩展性；纯LLM匹配虽提升语义召回率，却可能违反结构和物理约束，产生语义流畅但在操作上无效的对应关系。因此需要一种既能利用LLM语义能力、又能保证结构约束成立的方法。
AI.method: CGM包含三个阶段：(i) 基于模式的许可性约束，使用元数据mc=<tau_c, delta_c>表示，tau_c为约束类型，delta_c提供可执行的关系和归一化逻辑；(ii) 带级联松弛的约束受限候选生成，确保在噪声条件下仍有非空可行集；(iii) 在可行集内进行有界LLM消歧的神经排序。约束作为假设空间算子而非事后验证器，支持松弛下的受控退化，并实现可审计、可人工引导的决策。
AI.result: 在受控结构诱饵基准上，硬许可性将候选空间缩小约480倍且不丢失真实对应关系；逐层消融表明该门控机制（而非LLM）是决定性提升因素（F1从0.08到0.66）。该方法的收益与模型无关，且不增加额外推理成本：带约束的小模型在约28倍更低的成本下达到无约束使用的先进LLM的性能。方法在七个企业数据源上可迁移（宏平均F1为0.70），专家工作量相比电子表格工作流降低约7倍。公共Valentine数据集结果提供了外部排序验证并界定了方法边界：仅当结构不变量对匹配具有决定性作用时，约束才应设为硬约束。
AI.conclusion: CGM通过将约束置于假设空间构建阶段而非事后校验阶段，实现了一种模型无关、成本高效的神经符号实体对齐方案。该方法的关键洞察是：结构性门控是决定性因素，LLM仅用于可行集内的消歧。方法具有良好的可迁移性、可审计性和专家可引导性，同时明确了硬约束适用的边界条件。

title: MaST: Motion-aware Sparse Pipeline for Lightweight Object Tracking
summary:
Transformer-based object trackers are renowned for their strong performance, yet dense token processing often leads to prohibitive computational cost, limiting real-time deployment on edge devices. While recent works explore token pruning to reduce computation, they often stop short of an end-to-end sparse pipeline, as early-layer token scores can be noisy without a motion prior, and many trackers ultimately fall back to dense reshaping to feed the dense prediction head that partially negates the savings.
  We introduce Motion-aware Sparse Tracker (MaST), a sparse tracking framework that makes sparsity effective from tokens to boxes. First, MaST injects a lightweight motion prior to refine cross-attention-based importance scores, enabling earlier and more stable token reduction in the search region. Second, we introduce a natively sparse prediction head that operates directly on the retained unstructured tokens with a score-first, regress-once design, eliminating dense padding/reshaping and reducing redundant computation.
  Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that MaST establishes new state of the art among lightweight trackers, where MaST-tiny attains 63.8 AUC on LaSOT and 80.1 SUC on TrackingNet, surpassing the prior best AsymTrack-S by +1.0 AUC and +2.2 SUC
  while running at 152 FPS on Jetson Nano, nearly twice as fast as AsymTrack-S at 88 FPS. Code is available at https://github.com/TsingWei/MaST.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MaST（运动感知稀疏跟踪器），一种端到端稀疏目标跟踪框架，通过注入轻量级运动先验细化注意力重要度分数，实现更早、更稳定的token剪枝，并引入原生稀疏预测头直接作用于保留的非结构化token，消除了稠密padding/reshaping开销。在多个基准上达到轻量级跟踪器SOTA，MaST-tiny在LaSOT上达63.8 AUC、TrackingNet上达80.1 SUC，在Jetson Nano上以152 FPS运行，速度近乎是之前最佳方案AsymTrack-S的两倍。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的目标跟踪器性能优异，但稠密token处理导致计算成本过高，难以在边缘设备实时部署。现有的token剪枝工作未实现端到端稀疏流水线：早期层token分数因缺乏运动先验而噪声大，且最终仍需稠密reshape以适配稠密预测头，部分抵消了剪枝带来的计算节省。
AI.method: MaST包含两个核心设计：（1）注入轻量级运动先验以细化基于交叉注意力的重要性分数，使搜索区域的token缩减更早且更稳定；（2）提出原生稀疏预测头，采用"分数优先、回归一次"（score-first, regress-once）的设计，直接在保留的非结构化token上操作，免去稠密padding/reshape并减少冗余计算。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，MaST建立了轻量级跟踪器的新SOTA：MaST-tiny在LaSOT上达到63.8 AUC，在TrackingNet上达到80.1 SUC，分别超越先前最佳AsymTrack-S +1.0 AUC和+2.2 SUC；同时在Jetson Nano上以152 FPS运行，几乎是AsymTrack-S（88 FPS）速度的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过运动先验与原生稀疏预测头的结合，MaST实现了从token到box全流程的端到端稀疏化，在不牺牲精度的情况下大幅提升推理效率，验证了稀疏追踪在边缘设备上实时部署的可行性与有效性。

title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-turn interactions with users and external tools. In these settings, relevant task information often unfolds over time rather than being fully specified at the initial prompt. Service agents make this challenge especially concrete: users may clarify or revise their goals, while tool responses provide information needed for subsequent decisions. Thus, a final reward alone cannot indicate which actions contributed to resolving the task. Recent methods rely on comparative evidence from other trajectories or resampled continuations, or on separately constructed step-level learning signals, to refine credit. However, a completed rollout already records how information and errors flow between agent actions. We introduce Influence-Aware Policy Optimization (IAPO), which represents each rollout as a typed influence-dependency graph over trainable agent actions, with user and tool observations serving as evidence. IAPO converts support-use and failed-use structure into routing weights that redistribute the same trajectory-level advantage. Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B demonstrate superior performance over multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) baselines across three service-agent benchmarks: {τ^2}-Bench, UserBench, and AgentChangeBench. BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn further shows that these gains do not compromise multi-turn function-calling performance. This work advances the understanding of credit assignment in multi-turn user interactions and provides a principled approach to training service agents from sparse outcome feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出影响感知策略优化（IAPO），通过将每个rollout表示为带类型的依赖图（覆盖可训练智能体动作、用户与工具观测），利用支持-使用和失败-使用结构将轨迹级优势重分配为路由权重，从而在多轮用户交互中实现细粒度信用分配的LLM智能体训练方法。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在多轮与用户和外部工具的交互中解决长时程任务，相关信息随时间逐步展开而非在初始提示中完全给定。最终奖励无法指示哪些动作真正贡献于任务解决，而现有方法依赖其他轨迹的对比证据或单独构建的步骤级学习信号来细化信用分配，忽视了已完成rollout中已记录的信息与错误流路径。
AI.method: IAPO将每个rollout表示为带类型的"影响依赖图"，节点为可训练智能体动作，用户与工具观测作为证据边。该方法将支持-使用（support-use）和失败-使用（failed-use）结构转换为路由权重，将相同的轨迹级优势重新分配到各动作上。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B在三个服务智能体基准（τ²-Bench、UserBench、AgentChangeBench）上超越了多轮强化学习基线。BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn进一步表明这些增益不会损害多轮函数调用性能。
AI.conclusion: 本工作推进了多轮用户交互场景下信用分配的理解，为从稀疏结果反馈中训练服务智能体提供了原则性方法。

title: Evaluating Multiple LLM Generations with Validated Task Coverage
summary: Many LLM applications are most useful when they provide several candidate outputs for comparison, validation, or combination. Predominant evaluation settings, however, still focus on individual outputs or reduce multiple samples to a single success or selected answer. This can miss whether the outputs include several genuinely different useful results. We introduce VTC-Bench, a five-domain benchmark for this setting, together with Validated Task Coverage (VTC) as its core evaluation quantity. The benchmark is built from carefully selected real-data tasks where both output quality and task-relevant distinctness can be checked automatically and reproducibly, without model-based judges. VTC measures how many distinct useful results are obtained within $k$ attempts. Across multiple models and inference settings, the benchmark leads to different conclusions from conventional evaluation: configurations that look strongest from single-draw quality are not necessarily those with the best coverage, and simple measures of output variation do not reliably recover task-relevant coverage. These results show that finite candidate sets can be evaluated directly as objects of interest, revealing differences in model behavior that are not apparent from conventional per-output evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VTC-Bench基准和VTC（有效任务覆盖率）评估指标，用于评估LLM在多次采样中是否能产出多个真正不同且有用的候选结果。实验发现，传统单次质量评估与覆盖率评估得出的结论不同，简单输出多样性指标也无法可靠反映任务相关覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 许多LLM应用需要提供多个候选输出供比较、验证或组合，但主流评估仍聚焦于单个输出或仅将多次采样简化为单一结果。这忽略了输出集合中是否包含多个真正不同且有用的结果这一重要维度。
AI.method: 提出VTC-Bench，一个覆盖五个领域的基准测试，以及VTC（Validated Task Coverage）作为核心评估量。基准基于精心筛选的真实数据任务构建，输出质量和任务相关差异性均可自动、可复现地检查，无需基于模型的评判器。VTC衡量在k次尝试内获得的不同有用结果的数量。
AI.result: 跨多种模型和推理设置的实验表明，VTC-Bench得出了与常规评估不同的结论：在单次生成质量上表现最强的配置并不一定具有最佳覆盖率；简单的输出变异度量无法可靠恢复任务相关的覆盖率信息。
AI.conclusion: 有限候选集可以作为评估的直接对象，而非仅评估单个输出。这种方法能揭示传统逐输出评估无法体现的模型行为差异，为多候选输出的LLM应用提供了更全面的评估视角。

title: Delayed Optimizer-State Transport Shapes Short-Horizon Training Decisions
summary: Adaptive optimizers retain gradient history in moment variables, allowing a local change in loss weighting to alter later updates. We examine whether this delayed transport is large enough to change prospective short-horizon decisions. On committed future-minibatch sequences, we differentiate eight-step AdamW trajectories through the complete model--optimizer state and select exposure-matched Math--Code loss schedules before independent evaluation. Across 12 unused 0.3M Transformer histories, full transport lowers token-disjoint loss relative to an optimizer-aware immediate derivative in 10/12 histories (mean benefit $4.71\times10^{-4}$; exact one-sided sign test, $p=0.0193$). The two controllers act equally often but select different schedules in 60/96 windows. Crossed checkpoint--future-path tests attribute this reordering to the interaction between optimizer state and near-future data, while an independent Ising--CNN experiment shows that deleting moment-state transport destroys accurate response prediction. Full-transport scores also concentrate exact-rollout winners in larger candidate libraries, focusing finite-amplitude evaluation on a shortlist. On these committed short paths, optimizer memory and near-future data order are therefore actionable components of the training state, providing a mechanism-based criterion for when finite-horizon rather than one-step intervention is required.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自适应优化器（如AdamW）中动量/矩状态对短期训练决策的影响。通过对8步AdamW轨迹进行完整微分，发现优化器状态对近未来小批次的"延迟传递"效应足以改变12/10个Transformer训练历史中的无损损失（平均获益4.71e-4，p=0.0193），且在Ising-CNN实验中删除矩状态传递会破坏响应预测，表明短视界干预而非单步干预是必要的。
AI.motivation: 自适应优化器在动量变量中保留梯度历史，这使得局部损失加权的变化可能影响后续更新。问题的核心是：这种延迟传递（delayed transport）是否大到足以改变短期（short-horizon）决策？如果优化器记忆足够显著，那么基于单步梯度的干预策略将会失效，需要重新考虑训练过程中的干预机制设计。
AI.method: 1) 在固定的未来小批量序列上，对8步AdamW轨迹通过完整的模型-优化器状态进行微分；2) 选择暴露匹配（exposure-matched）的Math-Code损失调度在独立评估；3) 使用12个未使用的0.3M Transformer训练历史进行测试；4) 对比完整传递（full transport）与优化器感知的即时导数（optimizer-aware immediate derivative）；5) 采用精确单侧符号检验进行统计验证；6) 进行交叉检查点-未来路径测试（crossed checkpoint–future-path tests）；7) 在Ising-CNN独立实验中进行消融——删除矩状态传递验证其对响应预测的破坏效应；8) 在更大的候选库中评估精确回滚（exact-rollout）赢家的集中情况。
AI.result: 1) 在12个训练历史中，完整传递在10/12个历史上优于优化器感知的即时导数（token不相交损失降低），平均获益4.71e-4，精确单侧符号检验p=0.0193；2) 两个控制器作用频率相同，但在96个时间窗口中选择了不同的调度（60/96）；3) 交叉检查点-未来路径测试表明重新排序源于优化器状态与近未来数据的交互；4) Ising-CNN实验确认删除矩状态传递会破坏准确的响应预测；5) 完整传递分数在大候选库中能更集中地识别精确回滚的赢家，将有限幅度评估聚焦到短名单上。
AI.conclusion: 在固定的短期路径上，优化器记忆与近未来数据顺序是训练状态中可操作（actionable）的组成部分。这提供了一个基于机制的标准，用于判断何时应当采用有限视界（finite-horizon）而非单步干预策略。即：当优化器状态对近未来决策产生显著且可检测的延迟影响时，单步干预不再充分，需要引入多步前瞻的干预机制。

title: TRACE: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate intermediate reasoning traces that may contain unsafe content, even when their final responses appear safe. Guardrail models are designed to detect and block unsafe content, yet existing benchmarks for unsafe content detection focus primarily on prompts and final responses, leaving reasoning traces largely unexamined. Moreover, these benchmarks typically provide only binary safety labels, without evidence annotations that justify the judgments. To address these limitations, we introduce TRACE, an evidence-grounded safety evaluation benchmark that covers the entire LRM inference pipeline: prompts, reasoning traces, and final responses. TRACE includes prompts in two languages spanning nine risk categories and ten attack strategies. For each prompt, four LRMs generate reasoning traces and final responses, and we annotate the safety of each component and extract supporting evidence from the corresponding source text. Evaluating 18 guardrail models on TRACE reveals that safety judgment for reasoning traces is substantially more challenging than for prompts or final responses, and that current models struggle to accurately extract supporting evidence. These findings highlight the need for guardrail models that can reliably detect and precisely localize unsafe content across the LRM inference pipeline.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个基于证据的安全评估基准，覆盖大推理模型（LRM）的完整推理管线（提示、推理轨迹、最终响应），包含双语提示、九类风险类别和十种攻击策略，并附有支持证据标注。对18个护栏模型的评估表明，推理轨迹的安全判断远比提示或最终响应更具挑战性，现有模型在精确提取支持证据方面也存在困难。
AI.motivation: 现有安全内容检测基准主要关注提示和最终回复，忽略了深度推理模型中可能包含不安全内容的推理轨迹；同时现有基准仅提供二元安全标签，缺乏能证明判断依据的证据标注。这导致护栏模型在推理管线的安全隐患检测能力未被充分评估。
AI.method: 构建TRACE基准：包含两种语言的提示，覆盖九种风险类别和十种攻击策略；用四个LRM为每个提示生成推理轨迹和最终响应；对每个组件进行安全标注并从相应源文本中提取支持证据；在18个护栏模型上进行系统性评估。
AI.result: 推理轨迹的安全判断比提示或最终响应显著更难；当前护栏模型在精确提取支持证据方面表现不足。
AI.conclusion: 需要开发能够在LRM推理管线中可靠检测并精确定位不安全内容的护栏模型。

title: Bridging Adversarial and Collaborative Learning for AI-Generated Image Quality Assessment
summary: AI-generated image quality assessment (AIGIQA) requires jointly reasoning about perceptual fidelity and prompt alignment, two quality dimensions that are often treated as independent in existing AIGIQA models. However, by re-examining human ratings, we uncover a previously overlooked phenomenon: the two dimensions are interdependent and exhibit both competitive and cooperative interactions during human rating. This observation suggests that a unified model should neither collapse the two dimensions nor rigidly separate them, but rather adaptively negotiate their interplay. Motivated by this insight, we introduce an interaction-aware learning framework that models perception-alignment relations through adversarial and collaborative inference pathways. Instead of designing a rigid dual-branch architecture, our method employs a gated interaction module that dynamically routes features according to the inferred relationship between the two dimensions. Task-aware prompts further modulate the gating behaviour, enabling the model to switch between competition and cooperation when necessary. Experiments across multiple AIGIQA benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy but also yields interpretable interaction patterns, offering a more faithful approximation of human judgment. The codes are available at https://github.com/LQAMEI/ACL-IQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种交互感知的AI生成图像质量评估（AIGIQA）学习框架，通过门控交互模块动态路由特征，以对抗性和协作性推理通路建模感知保真度与提示一致性之间的竞争与合作关系，在多个基准上达到SOTA精度并产生可解释的交互模式。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGIQA模型通常将感知保真度和提示一致性视为两个独立维度分别评估，但重新检视人类评分后发现这两个维度相互依存，存在竞争与合作两种交互关系。这要求统一模型既不能将两维度合并，也不能严格分离，而应自适应地协调它们之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 提出交互感知学习框架，通过对抗性和协作性两条推理通路建模感知-对齐关系；采用门控交互模块根据推断的两维度关系动态路由特征，而非设计刚性双分支架构；使用任务感知提示进一步调节门控行为，使模型能在竞争与合作模式之间切换。
AI.result: 在多个AIGIQA基准数据集上，该方法取得了SOTA精度，同时生成了可解释的交互模式，更接近人类判断的近似。
AI.conclusion: 感知保真度与提示一致性之间的交互关系是可以被显式建模和利用的，交互感知框架比刚性双分支或完全合并的方法更有效地逼近人类质量评估行为。

title: Taming foundation model with invariance-oriented pre-training for broad-spectrum EEG analysis across signal-level, brain-state, and brain-health tasks
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used window into human brain function, but most EEG models remain tied to a one-dataset-one-model supervised paradigm. Recent EEG foundation models offer a route toward reusable representations, but most remain reconstruction-centered, assuming that EEG content predictable from local context is necessarily transferable neural information. Here we present INCEPT, an invariance-oriented EEG foundation model trained on over 11,000 hours of unlabelled clinical EEG. Rather than prioritizing signal recovery alone, INCEPT learns representation-level stability across correlated EEG observations, separating stable neural structure and essential subject-sensitive information from the nuisance variability that dominates scalp recordings while preserving subject-, state- and condition-discriminative information. We evaluate INCEPT on a broad-spectrum benchmark of ten datasets spanning three levels of post-acquisition EEG analysis: signal-level assessment, brain-state decoding, and brain-health evaluation. INCEPT ranks first among recent EEG foundation models on 26 of 30 linear-probing metrics and 24 of 30 fine-tuning metrics, and also surpasses strong task-specific specialist encoders across diverse downstream settings. Objective ablations and representation analyses further show that invariance-oriented pre-training improves transfer and organizes subject-sensitive neural representations beyond reconstruction alone. These results establish invariance learning as a promising principle for building reusable EEG foundation models.

AI.tldr: INCEPT是一个以不变性学习为核心的脑电图（EEG）基础模型，在超过11,000小时的未标注临床EEG数据上训练，通过学习跨相关EEG观测的表征级稳定性来分离稳定的神经结构与受试者敏感信息，在涵盖信号级评估、脑状态解码和脑健康评估三个层次的10个数据集基准上，在26/30线性探测指标和24/30微调指标中排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG模型大多遵循"一个数据集一个模型"的监督学习范式，缺乏可复用表征；而近期提出的EEG基础模型多采用重构中心策略，假设可从局部上下文预测的EEG内容必然是可迁移的神经信息，这一假设忽略了头皮记录中占主导地位的干扰变异性，限制了模型的迁移能力。
AI.method: INCEPT采用不变性导向的预训练策略，在11,000+小时的无标注临床EEG上训练。核心思想不是仅追求信号重建，而是学习跨相关EEG观测之间的表征级稳定性，从而将稳定的神经结构、必要的受试者敏感信息与占主导的干扰变异性分离，同时保留受试者、状态和条件判别性信息。
AI.result: 在涵盖信号级评估、脑状态解码和脑健康评估三个层次的10个数据集基准上，INCEPT在26/30的线性探测指标和24/30的微调指标上排名第一，并超越多种强任务特异性编码器。消融实验和表征分析表明，不变性导向预训练优于纯重构预训练，能改善迁移性能并更好地组织受试者敏感的神经表征。
AI.conclusion: 不变性学习为构建可复用的EEG基础模型提供了一种有前景的新原则，比传统的重构中心方法更有效地利用了无标注临床EEG数据中的神经信息。

title: STRIVE: Multi-Agent Structured Temporal Reasoning with Integrated Verification for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation
summary: Longitudinal radiology report generation (LRRG) requires identifying both current findings and their changes relative to a prior study. Existing methods jointly model diagnosis, attribute estimation, temporal comparison, and language generation within implicit representations, which can cause task interference, obscure the evidence underlying each decision, and limit error traceability. They also model progression states as independent labels, ignoring their ordered structure and thus treating missed changes and direction reversals equally. We present STRIVE, Multi-Agent Structured Temporal Reasoning with Integrated Verification for LRRG, which decomposes clinical reasoning into specialized Diagnosis, Attribute, and Temporal Change Agents that produce explicit intermediate evidence. In particular, the Temporal Change Agent is further post-trained using Progression-Aware GRPO, a verifiable, shaped reward that assigns partial credit to direction-preserving errors while scoring direction reversals lowest. STRIVE performs verification at two stages: a deterministic Consistency Gate reconciles the agent outputs before report generation, and a Validation Agent checks whether the generated report is supported by the aggregated clinical evidence. On Longitudinal-MIMIC, STRIVE attains the best clinical efficacy among recent methods and more than doubles Longitudinal Change Concordance (LCC), a measure of temporal agreement with the reference report, over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: STRIVE是一个用于纵向放射学报告生成（LRRG）的多智能体结构化时序推理框架，将临床推理分解为专门的诊断、属性和时序变化智能体，并采用Progression-Aware GRPO强化学习区分方向保持与方向反转的错误，通过两级验证机制提升生成报告的临床有效性和时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LRRG方法通过隐式表示联合建模诊断、属性估计、时序比较和语言生成，导致任务间相互干扰、决策证据不透明且错误难以追溯；同时将进展状态建模为独立标签，忽略其有序结构，无法区分漏检变化与方向反转等不同严重程度的错误。
AI.method: STRIVE将临床推理分解为三个专门智能体：诊断（Diagnosis）、属性（Attribute）和时序变化（Temporal Change）智能体，各自产生显式的中间证据。时序变化智能体采用Progression-Aware GRPO进行后训练，该奖励函数为方向保持型（direction-preserving）错误分配部分分数，而方向反转错误得分最低。推理阶段设置两级验证：确定性一致性门（Consistency Gate）在报告生成前协调各智能体输出，验证智能体（Validation Agent）检查生成的报告是否由聚合的临床证据支持。
AI.result: 在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上，STRIVE在临床有效性指标上优于近期方法，其纵向变化一致性（LCC）指标（衡量报告与参考报告的时序一致性）相比最强基线提升了超过两倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的多智能体分解与可验证的强化学习奖励设计，STRIVE有效缓解了LRRG中的任务干扰问题，提高了决策的可解释性和错误可追溯性，并在时序变化建模上显著优于现有方法。

title: Markerless Pose Estimation for Resistance Training Technique Assessment
summary: Resistance training can be a high risk activity, and safe form is essential to avoiding injury. Laboratory-based movement analysis provides quantitive technique assessment, yet is not easily accessible. Markerless pose estimation infers body landmarks from images or video without physical markers and could offer a feasible alternative for technique assessment. We present a pose estimation framework to evaluate resistance-training technique from ordinary video footage. Using BlazePose, anatomical landmarks were extracted from squat, bench press, and deadlift videos and converted into joint-angle trajectories, with the squat serving as the primary case study. Trajectories were assessed against a defined reference repetition using root mean square error (RMSE). Results show that the framework recovers meaningful kinematic patterns for the squat and deadlift, enabling quantitative comparison between repetitions and identification of technique variability within a set. Performance depended strongly on camera orientation and visual occlusion, with non-sagittal views distorting 2D joint-angle estimates. The findings demonstrate that markerless pose estimation can support accessible biomechanical assessment outside laboratory environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于无标记姿态估计（BlazePose）的框架，用于从普通视频中评估抗阻训练（深蹲、卧推、硬拉）的动作技术，通过提取关节角度轨迹并与参考重复动作进行RMSE比较，实现对重复动作间技术变异的定量分析。
AI.motivation: 抗阻训练存在受伤风险，安全动作形式至关重要；实验室运动分析虽能提供定量技术评估，但不易获取，需要一种可行且可及的技术评估替代方案。
AI.method: 使用BlazePose从深蹲、卧推和硬拉视频中提取解剖学关键点，转换为关节角度轨迹，以深蹲为主要案例；通过均方根误差（RMSE）将轨迹与定义的参考重复动作进行比较评估。
AI.result: 框架能够恢复深蹲和硬拉的有意义的运动学模式，支持重复动作间的定量比较及组内技术变异的识别；但性能高度依赖摄像机朝向和视觉遮挡，非矢状面视角会扭曲2D关节角度估计。
AI.conclusion: 无标记姿态估计能够在实验室外环境中提供可及的生物力学评估支持，有望作为抗阻训练技术评估的可行替代方案。

title: SA-Bench: Evaluating Semantic Alignment in LLM-Based Paper Reproduction
summary: LLM agents can generate paper reproduction code, yet often produce scientifically unfaithful implementations. We define this failure mode as semantic drift, where generated code silently diverges from the paper's specifications. We introduce SemanticAlign-Bench(SA-Bench), a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 papers from ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS 2025. For each paper, we decompose its specifications into atomic and verifiable implementation claims, which we call Semantic Alignment Units (SAUs) and evaluate repositories along four diagnostic dimensions spanning numerical, methodological, protocol and ordering drift. In total, we construct 1,491 SAUs across five ML domains and evaluate 12 generator configurations (4 models $\times$ 3 scaffolds). Even the strongest configuration (Claude+PaperCoder) achieves a mean SAU score of only 0.301 out of 1.0, with an overall mean of 0.221 across 360 evaluations. A failure taxonomy reveals that agents attempt most requirements but implement them incorrectly, with implementation mismatch and stubs accounting for the majority of zero-scored claims. Our analysis further indicates that scaffolds optimized for executability provide limited leverage for scientific reproduction; narrowing the gap requires scaffolds that prioritize semantic specification verification. The benchmark, annotations and evaluation pipeline are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemanticAlign-Bench（SA-Bench），一个用于诊断LLM智能体生成论文复现代码时发生"语义漂移"的基准测试，覆盖30篇2025年顶会论文、1,491个语义对齐单元（SAU），评估12种生成配置，发现最强配置的平均SAU得分仅为0.301，表明现有智能体在科学复现方面存在严重的语义忠实性问题。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽然能够生成论文复现代码，但常常产生在科学上不忠实的实现。这种"语义漂移"（semantic drift）——生成代码与论文规范静默偏离——缺乏系统性的诊断和量化工具。
AI.method: 作者提出SA-Bench基准，将30篇ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS 2025论文的规范分解为原子化、可验证的实现声明（SAUs），并沿四个诊断维度（数值漂移、方法学漂移、协议漂移、排序漂移）评估代码仓库。共构建1,491个SAU，覆盖五个ML领域，评估4个模型×3种脚手架共12个生成配置。
AI.result: 最强配置（Claude+PaperCoder）的平均SAU得分仅为0.301，360次评估的总体均值为0.221。失败分类学表明智能体尝试了大多数需求但实现不正确，实现不匹配和桩代码（stubs）占据了零分声明的大部分。
AI.conclusion: 为可执行性优化的脚手架对科学复现的提升有限；缩小差距需要优先考虑语义规范验证的脚手架。基准、标注和评估流水线已公开。

title: MRI-based Deep Radiomic Phenotyping of Neuromuscular Disorders: A Topology-driven Characterization
comment: Draft manuscript. Has not yet been peer-reviewed
summary: Quantitative assessment of muscle MRI is crucial for monitoring neuromuscular disorders (NMD). This study introduces an automated radiomic phenotyping framework based on original features engineered across five main architectural domains: quantitative morphometry, spatial distribution, geometric shape, interactions between progressive fat replacement stages, and graph-based topology. Utilizing 1184 MRI scans from the CoMPaSS-NMD project, we map the complex 3D architecture of heterogeneous intramuscular lipodegeneration into objective, morphologically interpretable biomarkers. We introduce a graph-based skeletonization of fat infiltrates to quantify muscle architectural changes, establishing a multi-dimensional extension of traditional, spatially-agnostic volume metrics by mapping topological networks across the entire 3D muscle volume. Statistical screening via non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis analysis confirmed the discriminative power of these novel descriptors across the genetic hierarchy. Notably, topological network metrics (e.g., SF1_Skel_Nodes, $ε^2$ = 0.2656) and interface dynamics metrics (e.g., SF2_To_SF1_Dist_Min, $ε^2$ = 0.2092) demonstrated substantial effect sizes, providing deeper structural insights than classical volumetric assessments. Post-hoc pairwise evaluations and UMAP projections further indicated the capability of these topological and 3D geometric invariants to capture disease-specific macroscopic infiltration patterns. These results demonstrate that global architectural features represent a highly promising class of biomarkers for differential diagnosis, offering new avenues for tracking longitudinal disease dynamics in neuromuscular diagnostics. The developed automated feature extraction pipeline is integrated and available within the MUSCAT (MUSCle fAt Topology) library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于MRI的自动化放射组学表型框架，通过五个架构域（定量形态学、空间分布、几何形状、脂肪替代阶段间交互、图拓扑）对神经肌肉疾病（NMD）的肌肉脂肪浸润3D架构进行量化。利用1184幅CoMPaSS-NMD项目的MRI扫描，引入基于图的脂肪浸润骨架化方法，将传统体积指标扩展为多维拓扑网络描述符。统计筛选证实这些新描述符在遗传层级上具有判别力，拓扑网络指标和界面动态指标表现出显著效应量，为鉴别诊断和纵向疾病追踪提供了新型生物标志物。该流程已集成于MUSCAT库中。
AI.motivation: 神经肌肉疾病的诊断与监测需要定量评估肌肉MRI，但传统方法通常仅使用空间无关的体积指标，无法捕捉肌肉脂肪浸润的复杂3D空间架构。需要开发能够客观、可解释地量化这种复杂结构的新型生物标志物。
AI.method: 基于1184幅MRI扫描，构建了涵盖五个架构域的自动化特征工程框架：定量形态学（容积/体积密度）、空间分布、几何形状、渐进性脂肪替代阶段间的交互作用，以及基于图的拓扑网络分析。引入图骨架化方法对脂肪浸润进行结构化表征，通过非参数Kruskal-Wallis统计检验筛选特征，并采用事后成对比较和UMAP投影进行可视化验证。
AI.result: 拓扑网络指标（如SF1_Skel_Nodes，ε²=0.2656）和界面动态指标（如SF2_To_SF1_Dist_Min，ε²=0.2092）展现出显著效应量，优于传统体积评估。事后成对评估和UMAP投影表明拓扑与3D几何不变量能够捕获疾病特异性的宏观浸润模式。完整特征提取流程已集成并发布于MUSCAT库。
AI.conclusion: 全局架构特征是一类极具前景的差异化诊断生物标志物，能够为神经肌肉疾病的纵向疾病动态追踪提供新的途径，弥补传统体积指标在空间结构信息上的不足。

title: Bandit Submodular Maximization under Matroid Constraints: Learning Compressed Exchange Policy
summary:
We study adversarial bandit maximization of monotone submodular functions under a matroid constraint. For a rank-$k$ matroid on $n$ elements, we give a randomized oracle-polynomial algorithm that makes one feasible value query per round and has expected $(1-1/e)$-regret $\widetilde O(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})$. This is the first sublinear-regret algorithm for adversarial bandit submodular maximization under general matroid constraints.
  Technically, we view the problem as learning an exchange policy for the Poisson base walk. This connects the problem to contextual bandits and gives an information-theoretic sublinear-regret guarantee, but directly learning the exponentially many policies requires exponential time and space. We therefore introduce \emph{balanced fractional exchanges}, which compress the policy mixture into a single fractional base while retaining the exchange information needed by the Poisson analysis. This leads to an polynomial time algorithm with the same regret guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对抗性bandit环境下带拟阵约束的单调子模函数最大化问题，提出首个在一般拟阵约束下具有次线性遗憾的随机化多项式时间算法，遗憾界为Õ(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})。
AI.motivation: 对抗性bandit子模最大化在一般拟阵约束下此前没有次线性遗憾算法，现有方法难以同时满足多项式时间复杂度和信息论意义上的次线性遗憾保证。
AI.method: 将问题视为学习Poisson base walk的交换策略，与上下文bandit建立联系以获得信息论次线性遗憾保证；引入"平衡分数交换"（balanced fractional exchanges）将指数多个策略的混合压缩为单一分数基，在保留Poisson分析所需交换信息的同时实现多项式时间复杂度。
AI.result: 提出了每轮仅需一次可行值查询的随机化oracle多项式算法，取得期望(1-1/e)-遗憾Õ(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})，为一般拟阵约束下首个次线性遗憾算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了对抗性bandit子模最大化在一般拟阵约束下的理论空白，通过平衡分数交换技巧实现了信息论保证与计算效率之间的权衡。

title: Beyond Accuracy: A Dual-Judge Evaluation Protocol for Vision-Language Models in Legally Grounded Tasks
comment: Accepted and presented at the AI for Law Workshop at ICML 2026
summary:
AI systems are increasingly evaluated for legally accountable settings, where correct outputs must also be justifiable against an applicable legal standard. Existing legal-AI benchmarks and LLM-as-judge protocols provide important infrastructure for measuring task performance and open-ended response quality. We contribute one additional evaluation signal: a dual-judge protocol that pairs a standard 0-10 quality judge with a strict binary semantic-equivalence judge against a human-curated reference.
  We study a controlled, visually grounded regulatory task - UK traffic-sign interpretation, whose meaning is a codified question with a known reference for every input - and measure not merely whether the two judges disagree (by construction they must) but how much and where. On 4,680 evaluations under seven visibility levels and two occlusion modes, the two judges are moderately associated (point-biserial r = 0.644), while revealing an asymmetric Type II pattern affecting 8.0% of all evaluations.
  Its distribution is instructive: the marginal rate peaks at high visibility (14.2% at v = 0.8) simply because high-scoring answers are common there, but conditioned on the answer already scoring above 7, the rate is highest under heavy occlusion (54-63% at v <= 0.3), so a high quality score is least trustworthy when the input is most degraded.
  We are explicit that the signal is a property of this judge and reference: a 49-row human check shows the 0-10 judge aligns closely with everyday-reader judgement (Pearson r = 0.81; r = 0.80 with the LLM accuracy sub-score), while the equivalence judge is fairly but one-directionally stricter. The protocol adds one LLM call per evaluation and surfaces a signal single-judge protocols do not report. We release the prompt template, occluded variants, and full evaluation results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双裁判（dual-judge）评估协议，将标准0-10质量评分裁判与严格的二元语义等价裁判配对，用于法律问责场景下的AI系统评估。在4,680个UK交通标志解释任务上验证，发现两裁判中度相关（r=0.644），存在影响8.0%评估的不对称Type II错误模式，且高质量分数在输入严重退化时最不可信。
AI.motivation: 法律问责场景中，AI输出不仅要正确，还必须能依据法律标准进行正当化。现有法律AI基准和LLM-as-judge协议虽然提供了测量任务表现和开放响应质量的基础设施，但缺乏一个信号来捕捉"输出质量分数与语义等价性之间的不一致"，尤其在不一致时输出是否仍然可信。作者希望贡献一个额外的评估信号来弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出双裁判协议：(1) 标准0-10质量裁判；(2) 严格的二元语义等价裁判（对比人工精选参考）。任务设置为UK交通标志解释——一种视觉引导的监管任务，其含义是编码化的问题，每个输入都有已知参考。在7个可见度水平和2种遮挡模式下进行4,680次评估，同时通过49行人工检查验证裁判行为。该协议每次评估仅增加1次LLM调用。
AI.result: 两裁判中度相关（point-biserial r=0.644），揭示不对称Type II模式影响8.0%评估。边际错误率在高可见度下最高（v=0.8时14.2%），因为高分答案在彼处常见；但条件于答案已得分>7时，重遮挡下错误率最高（54-63% at v<=0.3）。人工检查显示0-10裁判与日常读者判断高度一致（Pearson r=0.81），语义等价裁判公平但单向更严格。
AI.conclusion: 双裁判协议为单裁判协议提供了额外的评估信号，能揭示质量分数在输入退化时的高分不可信问题（Type II模式）。该信号是裁判与参考集的属性而非绝对真理。协议高效（额外仅1次LLM调用），并开源了提示模板、遮挡变体及完整评估结果，为法律问责场景的AI评估提供了可复用的基础设施。

title: ZODIAC: Zero-shot Octree-based Diffusion for Anatomical Completion
summary: Recovering the full 3D spine anatomy from intraoperative ultrasound is an ill-posed inverse problem, as the complete structure must be inferred from incomplete and noisy observations. Acoustic occlusions and limited field of view create large unobserved regions, while view-dependent artifacts lead to variability in expert annotations of the visible anatomy. Current supervised ultrasound shape completion methods rely on synthetically generated incomplete-complete paired data to learn conditional mappings under a predefined distribution of simulated occlusions. However, real intraoperative occlusions do not necessarily follow this distribution, which can limit generalization to patient data. As a result, accurate and robust completion from noisy partial observations remains an unsolved problem. We propose a zero-shot shape completion framework that reconstructs the entire lumbar spine from partial ultrasound observations without relying on simulated training data. To accommodate unseen and irregular patterns of missing structures, we introduce blended completion, a mechanism that integrates the learned anatomical prior with incoming partial geometry at inference time. The method learns a generative diffusion prior over full anatomical shapes represented in an adaptive octree structure, enabling efficient modeling of the complete spine in a single forward pass. Validation on phantom and volunteer data shows that decoupling completion from a predefined corruption distribution improves generalisation under real occlusions, outperforming a fully supervised variant by 22% on HD95 completion error. Code and data are available at https://github.com/miruna20/ZODIAC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种零样本脊柱形状补全框架（ZODIAC），无需依赖模拟训练数据即可从术中超声的部分观测中重建完整的腰椎三维解剖结构。该方法通过混合补全机制在推理时将解剖学先验与输入的部分几何信息相结合，并在自适应八叉树结构上学习生成式扩散先验，实现了对完整脊柱的高效单次前向建模。在体模和志愿者数据上的验证表明，该方法相比全监督变体在HD95补全误差上提升了22%。
AI.motivation: 术中超声完整重建腰椎三维解剖结构是一个不适定的逆问题：声学遮挡和有限视野造成大范围不可观测区域，且依赖于视点的伪影导致专家标注的变异性。现有监督方法依赖合成的不完整-完整配对数据学习条件映射，但真实术中的遮挡分布与模拟分布不一致，限制了泛化能力。因此，从含噪部分观测中进行准确且鲁棒的形状补全仍是一个未解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出零样本补全框架，不依赖模拟训练数据。核心包含两个组件：(1) 混合补全机制（blended completion），在推理时将学习到的解剖学先验与输入的局部几何信息融合，以应对未见过的和不规则缺失模式；(2) 在自适应八叉树结构上学习生成式扩散先验，实现完整脊柱单次前向传播的高效建模。
AI.result: 在体模和志愿者数据上验证，零样本方式通过将补全与预定义的损坏分布解耦，改善了真实遮挡下的泛化能力，相比全监督变体在HD95补全误差上降低了22%。
AI.conclusion: 将形状补全与预定义的损坏分布解耦能够提高真实术中场景中的泛化性能，零样本框架有效解决了该不适定逆问题，代码和数据已开源。

title: Data Leakage Inflates Generalizability of Power Outage Prediction Models
summary: Power outage prediction models are increasingly used in assessments of climate-driven infrastructure risk, yet current evaluation practices obscure whether these models generalize to the novel conditions such applications require. We identify three common methodological choices in power outage prediction models that influence their ability to generalize across spatial, temporal, and event-based settings. We compare the predictive performance impacts of different methodological decisions using publicly available data for the U.S. East Coast from 2018 to 2023 and feature sets derived from weather reanalysis and land-cover data, and embeddings from a GeoAI foundation model (Prithvi WxC). Specifically, we assess model performance under multiple test selection strategies, including unfiltered random splits, leave-one-state-out, and leave-one-event-out designs, which increasingly approximate real-world deployment conditions. While random train-test splits yield strong performance, we show that these results are inflated by spatial and temporal autocorrelation. Under spatial and temporal holdout experiments, predictive accuracy degrades substantially, with models often failing to outperform a simple null baseline. Incorporating GeoAI foundation model embeddings yields limited and inconsistent improvements, primarily for spatial generalization, and does not resolve poor event-level transferability. These findings suggest that, given current data availability and evaluation practices, publicly trained outage prediction models offer limited and uncertain operational value. Progress will likely require improved data coverage, more realistic evaluation protocols, and a shift in focus from marginal modeling advances toward addressing structural data constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文发现当前电力中断预测模型的评估实践（如随机分割数据）因空间和时间自相关而虚高模型性能，在更贴近真实部署条件的空间/时间/事件留出验证下，模型性能大幅下降甚至不如简单基线，且GeoAI基础模型嵌入带来的改进有限且不稳定。
AI.motivation: 电力中断预测模型日益用于气候驱动的基础设施风险评估，但现有评估方法掩盖了模型是否能在新条件下泛化的问题。作者识别出三种影响模型跨空间、时间和事件泛化能力的方法学选择，期望通过更现实的评估协议揭示模型的真实价值。
AI.method: 使用美国东海岸2018-2023年的公开数据，结合天气再分析、土地覆盖特征和GeoAI基础模型（Prithvi WxC）嵌入，在多种测试选择策略下（未过滤随机分割、leave-one-state-out、leave-one-event-out）比较不同方法学决策对预测性能的影响，验证模型在空间和时间的留出设置下的表现。
AI.result: 随机训练-测试分割表现良好，但该结果被空间和时间自相关所夸大；在空间和时间留出实验中，预测精度大幅下降，模型常常无法优于简单零基线；GeoAI基础模型嵌入仅主要对空间泛化有有限且不一致的改进，无法解决事件级迁移性差的问题。
AI.conclusion: 基于当前数据可得性和评估实践，公开训练的停电预测模型提供有限且不确定的操作价值。取得进展需要改进数据覆盖、采用更现实的评估协议，并将焦点从边际建模改进转向解决结构性数据约束。

title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing
summary: Change data synthesis provides a cost-effective solution for expanding training data and improving the performance of change detection models. However, existing synthesis methods typically rely on handcrafted rules to simulate changes, where limited coverage of class transitions restricts the diversity of synthesized data, while predefined transition designs limit their flexibility in accommodating varied change types. In this work, we introduce KnowChange, a knowledge-guided change data synthesis framework that leverages pretrained vision-language models as knowledge sources to reason about plausible change locations and class transitions from pre-change scenes and desired change types. By integrating knowledge-guided change simulation with generalizable synthesis models, KnowChange enables flexible synthesis of diverse change types within a unified framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KnowChange-generated data consistently outperforms existing synthetic datasets in both synthetic-to-real transfer and synthetic data augmentation, despite being generated at a compact scale. Further analyses show that the knowledge-guided change simulation can be seamlessly integrated into existing synthesis pipelines and enhance the downstream utility of synthesized data.

AI.tldr: 提出KnowChange框架，利用预训练视觉-语言模型作为知识源，推理可能的变化位置和类别转换，实现知识引导的变化数据合成，在合成到真实迁移和数据增强方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有变化数据合成方法依赖手工规则模拟变化，存在类别转换覆盖有限导致合成数据多样性不足，以及预定义转换设计难以灵活适配多样化变化类型的问题。
AI.method: KnowChange框架利用预训练视觉-语言模型作为知识源，从变化前场景和期望变化类型中推理可能的变化位置与类别转换；将知识引导的变化模拟与可泛化的合成模型集成，在统一框架内灵活合成多样化的变化类型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，KnowChange生成的数据在合成到真实迁移和合成数据增强两方面均持续优于现有合成数据集，尽管生成规模紧凑；进一步分析显示知识引导的变化模拟可无缝集成到现有合成流程中，增强合成数据的下游效用。
AI.conclusion: 知识引导的变化数据合成范式有效克服了手工规则合成方法的局限，为变化检测模型提供了更具多样性和灵活性的训练数据生成途径，且具有良好的可集成性。

title: Vision Language Model Fusion for Explainable Face Recognition
summary:
Responsible deployment of face verification systems requires more than accurate decisions: systems should also provide interpretable and auditable evidence that enables users to understand, assess, and challenge their decisions. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide a promising foundation for explainable face recognition by combining visual analysis with natural-language reasoning. However, relying on a single model may further limit the decision accuracy as well as provided explanations. This work therefore investigates whether multiple VLMs can be combined to improve recognition accuracy, and to enrich the explanations associated with those decisions. This work evaluates four VLMs as standalone face verification systems and subsequently proposes a fusion framework, where two source models provide similarity scores and textual justifications and a third VLM acts as a decider model. Four different fusion scenarios are considered, progressively providing the decider model with scores, justifications, face images, and combinations of these modalities.
  Overall, the findings suggest that the value of multi-VLM fusion extends beyond recognition performance. VLMs can provide complementary justifications and perspectives that enable richer explanations of face recognition decisions, supporting greater transparency, auditability, and error analysis. This is relevant to the development of responsible explainable face verification systems, where users and operators should be able to understand not only the final decision but also the evidence and potential sources underlying it. The proposed multimodal VLM, which combines decision scores, explanations, and face images, achieves higher recognition accuracy than state-of-the-art VLMs and domain-specific face recognition models, while also providing fused explanations that are expected to be more robust than those generated by individual VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了多视觉语言模型（VLM）融合用于人脸验证系统，不仅提升识别精度，还能通过互补的文本解释增强系统的可解释性和可审计性。实验评估了四种VLM，并提出一个三模型融合框架（两个源模型提供相似度分数和文本理由，第三个VLM作为决策者），在四种融合场景下验证，最终的多模态融合方案在识别精度和解释鲁棒性上均优于单个VLM和领域专用人脸识别模型。
AI.motivation: 人脸验证系统的负责任部署不仅需要准确的决策，还需要可解释、可审计的证据，让用户理解和质疑系统决策。虽然视觉语言模型为可解释人脸识别提供了有前景的基础，但依赖单一模型可能同时限制决策准确性和解释质量，因此需要探索多VLM融合的可能性。
AI.method: 评估四种VLM作为独立人脸验证系统的性能，然后提出一个融合框架：两个源模型提供相似度分数和文本理由，第三个VLM作为决策模型。设计了四种融合场景，逐步向决策模型提供分数、理由、人脸图像以及这些模态的组合。
AI.result: 多VLM融合的价值不仅限于识别性能提升。VLM能够提供互补的理由和视角，从而产生更丰富的人脸识别解释。提出的多模态融合方案（结合决策分数、解释和人脸图像）在识别精度上超越了最先进的VLM和领域专用人脸识别模型，同时提供的融合解释比单个VLM生成的解释更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 多VLM融合支持更高透明度、可审计性和错误分析，对负责任的可解释人脸验证系统开发具有重要意义，使用户和操作者不仅理解最终决策，还能理解其背后的证据和潜在来源。

title: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Longitudinal Patient Representation and Scalable Insight Generation in Oncology
summary: Precision oncology necessitates a longitudinal model of patient state that captures cancer evolution and treatment over time, integrating multimodal observations. We introduce the oFM, a foundation model developed on a real-world oncology cohort of 1.67 million cancer patients that integrates clinical trajectories with DNA, RNA, and H&E pathology. Patient-level partitions were reserved for training, validation, and testing, with over one million patients used for training. The oFM encodes daily clinical and molecular episodes and, along with pathology images, integrates them over time to produce a patient state embedding. We evaluate frozen oFM embeddings against expert-curated clinical and molecular baseline features. In prognostic benchmarks, the oFM improved AUC for treatment response, progression-free survival, and overall survival (0.774 vs. 0.563 for overall survival). Across 11 comparative-treatment cohorts, the oFM embeddings achieved a three-fold higher pooled and scale-normalized treatment-benefit AUTOC than baseline features with improved benefit ranking in 9 of 11 cohorts, and provided stronger prognostic discrimination within both treatment arms. We also evaluated a mechanism discovery framework that interprets downstream models built on oFM embeddings by linking their predicted outcomes to clinically and biologically grounded mechanisms through an evidence-grounded temporal graph, enabling evaluation in clinical and drug-development applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出oFM，一个基于167万真实世界癌症患者队列构建的基础模型，整合临床轨迹与DNA、RNA及H&E病理等多模态数据，通过编码每日临床和分子事件并结合病理图像，生成患者状态嵌入表示。在预后基准测试中，oFM在治疗响应、无进展生存期和总生存期方面显著优于专家精选的临床和分子基线特征（总生存期AUC 0.774 vs 0.563），并在11个比较治疗队列中实现了三倍的合并标准化治疗获益AUTOC提升。同时提出的机制发现框架能够将下游模型预测结果通过证据支撑的时间图链接到临床和生物学机制。
AI.motivation: 精准肿瘤学需要能够捕捉癌症演变和治疗过程的纵向患者状态模型，但现有方法难以整合时间维度的临床轨迹与多模态分子/病理数据，也无法为临床和药物开发提供可解释的机制性洞察。
AI.method: 构建oFM基础模型，在167万癌症患者队列上训练，采用患者级划分训练/验证/测试集。模型编码每日临床和分子事件，结合H&E病理图像，随时间整合生成患者状态嵌入。评估采用冻结嵌入与专家精选基线特征对比，并开发了基于证据支撑时间图的机制发现框架用于解释下游模型预测。
AI.result: oFM在预后基准中全面优于基线：治疗响应、无进展生存期和总生存期的AUC显著提升（总生存期0.774 vs 0.563）。在11个比较治疗队列中，oFM嵌入实现了三倍更高的合并标准化治疗获益AUTOC，9/11队列的获益排序改善，两个治疗组内的预后区分更强。
AI.conclusion: oFM展示了整合多模态临床和分子数据的时间维基础模型在精准肿瘤学中的巨大潜力，不仅在预后和比较治疗评估上显著优于传统特征，还通过机制发现框架增强了模型的可解释性，为临床决策和药物开发提供了有力工具。

title: Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization for Candidate-Set Interference in Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding
summary: Continual knowledge graph embedding updates entity and relation representations as a graph grows. Existing methods primarily address catastrophic forgetting, but entity admission also changes the candidate universe of every compatible query. A historical answer can therefore lose rank even when its score and its ordering among old entities are preserved. We formalize this effect as candidate-set interference and introduce Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization (MEOR), a host-level objective that compares smooth answer-relative newcomer pressure with score-blind, structurally matched old references. Its one-sided penalty acts only when newcomer competition exceeds the matched reference, preserving the host learner's signal for legitimate new entities. Across eight paired runs on ENTITY-ComplEx, MEOR improves historical current-universe mean reciprocal rank (MRR) by 0.0057 over replay and reduces candidate-set interference by 0.0055, with one-sided 95% lower bounds of 0.0052 and 0.0051, respectively. It satisfies the preservation criteria for old-universe ranking and newcomer acquisition and improves historical current-universe MRR over persistent calibration, matched maximum regularizer (MMR), and unmatched old regularizer (UOR). Direct ablations support each component of its reference construction and aggregation. Adding MEOR also improves historical ranking in all ten reported FBInc-S and FBInc-L host and backbone settings, with every paired 95% confidence interval excluding zero. These results establish candidate admission as a distinct source of continual rank loss and show that it can be controlled without replacing the underlying embedding architecture or continual learner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出候选集干扰（candidate-set interference）这一新问题，用于描述持续知识图谱嵌入中实体加入导致的排名损失，并提出主机级目标函数MEOR（匹配超出发序正则化）加以控制，在多个数据集和设置下显著提升历史答案的当前候选集MRR。
AI.motivation: 现有持续知识图谱嵌入方法主要关注灾难性遗忘，但忽略了实体加入会改变每条兼容查询的候选集范围：即使旧实体之间的分数与排序保持不变，新增实体的竞争也可能使历史答案的排名下降。这一效应未被正式定义或系统解决。
AI.method: 将候选集干扰形式化定义为旧答案在新增实体加入后因候选集扩展而相对排名下降的现象。提出MEOR（Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization），一种主机级（host-level）目标函数，将平滑的、针对答案的新来者竞争压力，与基于分数盲匹配的、结构匹配的旧参照进行比较。MEOR采用单边惩罚，仅在新来者竞争超过匹配参照时生效，以保留主机学习器对合法新实体的学习信号。
AI.result: 在ENTITY-ComplEx的八组配对运行中，MEOR相比replay使历史当前候选集MRR提升0.0057，候选集干扰降低0.0055，单边95%下限分别为0.0052和0.0051。MEOR满足旧候选集排名保持与新实体获取的保持准则，并优于persistent calibration、MMR和UOR。消融实验验证了参照构建与聚合各组分的作用。在FBInc-S和FBInc-L的十个host和backbone设置中，MEOR均提升历史排名，所有配对95%置信区间均排除零。
AI.conclusion: 候选实体加入是持续排名损失的一个独立来源，可以通过MEOR在不替换底层嵌入架构或持续学习器的情况下加以有效控制。

title: DoublesEval: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Tactical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Professional Doubles Badminton
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) excel at describing visible scene content but struggle to reason about dynamic multi-agent interactions, where action semantics depend on coordinated roles and spatial-temporal dependencies. We formalize this capability as \textbf{multi-agent tactical reasoning} and introduce \textbf{DoublesEval}, a diagnostic evaluation framework that leverages professional doubles badminton as a structurally tractable testbed. DoublesEval employs a key-moment-based protocol that decomposes rallies into tactically salient instants and probes models across four interpretable dimensions: atomic recognition, intra-segment composite understanding, cross-segment causal reasoning, and high-level tactical abstraction. This design isolates \emph{where} reasoning fails, rather than merely measuring answer correctness. To address observed failure modes, we propose \textbf{TacticCheck}, a lightweight constraint-guided test-time consistency checker that reranks candidate answers using the model's own lower-level tactical predictions, requiring no parameter updates or ground-truth labels at inference time. Evaluating four representative open-source VLMs on 60 curated rallies (yielding $\sim$9.6K structured instances) via a zero-shot protocol, we find that models remain weak across all diagnostic levels, with especially clear bottlenecks in spatial state, interaction binding, and terminal evidence. TacticCheck delivers consistent gains across all evaluated models, while still leaving a substantial gap to robust tactical reasoning. These results highlight the need for structured, interaction-aware evaluation paradigms for next-generation VLMs. The source code is available in \href{https://github.com/Chengjt1999/DoublesEval}{\textcolor{blue}{our GitHub repository}}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DoublesEval，一个以专业双打羽毛球为测试平台的多智能体战术推理诊断评估框架，以及TacticCheck，一个无需参数更新的轻量级约束引导测试时一致性检查器。实验发现现有VLM在所有诊断层级上表现薄弱，尤其在空间状态、交互绑定和终结证据方面存在明显瓶颈，TacticCheck虽带来一致提升但仍与稳健战术推理有较大差距。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）擅长描述可见场景内容，但在推理涉及协调角色和时空依赖的动态多智能体交互方面存在困难。现有评估框架仅衡量答案正确性，无法定位推理失败的具体环节，因此需要结构化的诊断评估框架来系统性地剖析这类能力的薄弱点。
AI.method: DoublesEval采用关键时刻（key-moment）协议，将回合分解为战术上显著的瞬间，并从四个可解释维度进行探测：原子识别、段内复合理解、跨段因果推理和高层战术抽象。同时提出TacticCheck，一种约束引导的测试时一致性检查器，利用模型自身的低级战术预测对候选答案进行重排，推理时无需参数更新或真实标签。
AI.result: 在60个精选回合（约9.6K结构化实例）上以零样本协议评估四个代表性开源VLM，模型在所有诊断层级均表现薄弱，尤其在空间状态、交互绑定和终结证据方面存在明确瓶颈。TacticCheck在所有评估模型上带来一致的性能提升，但距离稳健的战术推理仍有实质差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM在多智能体战术推理方面尚不成熟，需要结构化的、面向交互感知的评估范式来引导下一代VLM的发展。DoublesEval和TacticCheck为此提供了诊断框架和轻量级改进手段，源代码已开源。

title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have become two widely adopted paradigms for post-training large language models. However, RLVR suffers from sparse task-level feedback, while OPD provides dense token-level guidance but ignores trajectory correctness, limiting its performance to that of the teacher. Combining them is a promising direction: OPD supplies dense supervisory signals, while RLVR provides task-level correctness. Nevertheless, existing integrations often rely on weighted combination or heuristic switching, introducing extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. We propose On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward (OPDVR), a simple yet effective method that seamlessly combines OPD and RLVR without adding any hyperparameters. We first reformulate the implicit reward of sampled-token OPD based on trajectory correctness, then apply a ReLU gating mechanism to ensure that correct trajectories receive non-negative rewards and incorrect ones receive non-positive rewards---thereby aligning the distillation signal with task success while preserving the teacher's distributional guidance. Furthermore, our modification transforms sampled-token OPD into a proper RLVR method, making it readily combinable with any policy gradient algorithm, such as GRPO. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that OPDVR consistently outperforms standard OPD. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR.

AI.tldr: 提出OPDVR方法，通过基于轨迹正确性重公式化采样token的OPD隐式奖励，并应用ReLU门控机制，无缝融合OPD（稠密token级监督）与RLVR（任务级正确性反馈），无需引入任何额外超参数，在六个推理基准上优于标准OPD。
AI.motivation: RLVR提供稀疏的任务级反馈，而OPD提供稠密的token级指导但忽略了轨迹正确性，其性能受限于教师模型。将两者结合是有前景的方向，但现有集成方法依赖加权组合或启发式切换，引入了额外超参数和权衡。需要一个简单有效的方法无缝融合两者。
AI.method: 1) 基于轨迹正确性对采样token的OPD隐式奖励进行重公式化；2) 应用ReLU门控机制，确保正确轨迹获得非负奖励，错误轨迹获得非正奖励；3) 该修改将采样token的OPD转化为真正的RLVR方法，可直接与任意策略梯度算法（如GRPO）结合。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准上的实验表明，OPDVR一致优于标准OPD方法。
AI.conclusion: OPDVR通过奖励门控机制将轨迹正确性与token级蒸馏信号对齐，在保留教师分布指导的同时实现任务成功信号的注入，无需额外超参数，并兼容现有策略梯度算法，为后训练大语言模型提供了简洁有效的范式。

title: Eating for a Sustainable Planet: Personalized Sustainable Diet Recommendation via Constraint-Aware Decision-Making Modeling
summary: A sustainable diet represents a multi-dimensional synergy among four essential pillars: nutrition adequacy, economic affordability, cultural acceptability, and environmental respect. Despite the prevalence of population-level sustainability modeling, practical implementation relies on effective individual-level adoption. This transition is often hindered by inter-individual heterogeneity, posing a formidable challenge in aligning sustainable diet requirements with individual preferences. To address this issue, we propose a personalized sustainable diet recommendation model based on a constraint-aware decision-making mechanism, where sustainability is incorporated through learnable constraints rather than modeled as user preferences. To systematically evaluate the proposed approach, we construct a sustainable diet dataset named SusDiet with about 150k recipes, characterized by broad coverage of sustainability indicators. Experimental results on this dataset show that our method promotes more sustainable choices without compromising individual preference. This work establishes a framework for aligning individual dietary choices with planetary health, offering quantitative evidence to guide future sustainable diet interventions and policy-making for sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于约束感知决策机制的个人化可持续饮食推荐模型，将可持续性作为可学习约束而非用户偏好进行建模，并构建了包含约15万条食谱的SusDiet数据集，实验证明该方法能在不影响个人偏好的前提下促进更具可持续性的饮食选择。
AI.motivation: 可持续饮食需要同时满足营养充足、经济可负担、文化可接受和环境友好四大支柱，但个体间异质性使得个体层面的可持续饮食采纳面临重大挑战，现有基于人群层面的建模难以指导个体实践。
AI.method: 提出一种基于约束感知决策机制的个人化可持续饮食推荐模型，将可持续性以可学习约束的形式融入推荐过程而非建模为用户偏好；同时构建了包含约15万条食谱、覆盖广泛可持续性指标的SusDiet数据集用于系统评估。
AI.result: 在SusDiet数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法能够在保持用户个人偏好不受损害的前提下，显著促进更加可持续的饮食选择。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了将个体饮食选择与地球健康相协调的框架，为未来可持续饮食干预及可持续发展政策的制定提供了量化证据。

title: Low-Rank Ternary Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Transformers
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. To be published in Volume 17015 of the Lecture Notes in Computer Science series
summary: Ternary transformers offer extreme memory and compute efficiency, but existing low-bit LoRA-based methods cannot directly fine-tune ternary weights. Current approaches either require dequantization, restoring low-bit base weights to higher precision to merge with adaptation weight, or update only quantization parameters, preventing a merged model that remains ternary. We propose ternary multiplicative adaptation, which represents discrete updates of ternary weights such as sign flips or zeroing through a low-rank Kronecker factorization into two small ternary matrices applied element-wise to ternary weights. This design is parameter-efficient and expressive, preserves the ternary domain, and supports direct merging without dequantization. Experiments on six models across language and vision, including ternarized LLaMA-3 1B and 3B and a ternary ViT-B/16, demonstrate that our method recovers much of the performance lost to quantization and outperforms strong low-bit and ternary baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/alexmanoo/ternary_adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出三元乘法自适应（ternary multiplicative adaptation）方法，通过低秩Kronecker分解将三元权重的离散更新（如符号翻转或置零）表示为两个小三元矩阵的元素级乘积，从而在不反量化（dequantization）的情况下直接微调三元Transformer，显著恢复量化损失的性能。
AI.motivation: 三元Transformer具有极致的存储和计算效率，但现有的低比特LoRA方法无法直接微调三元权重。现有方法要么需要反量化将低比特基座权重恢复为高精度以合并自适应权重，要么仅更新量化参数，导致无法获得保持三元量级的合并模型。
AI.method: 提出三元乘法自适应：将三元权重的离散更新（符号翻转或置零）通过低秩Kronecker分解为两个小三元矩阵，以元素级方式作用于三元权重。该方法参数高效、表达力强、保持三元域，并支持无需反量化的直接合并。
AI.result: 在包括ternarized LLaMA-3 1B、3B和三元ViT-B/16在内的6个语言及视觉模型上实验表明，该方法恢复了量化损失的大部分性能，并优于强低比特和三元基线。
AI.conclusion: 三元乘法自适应是一种有效的三元权重微调方案，能在保持三元量化域的前提下直接合并更新权重，兼顾参数效率、表达能力和性能恢复，代码已开源。

title: Single State Update Predictive Coding training for Time Series Forecasting and Anomaly Detection
summary: Predictive Coding (PC) is a neural learning paradigm that enables parallelizable neural network layer updates. However, the main bottleneck of PC Networks (PCN) is the sequential backwards error propagation. To tackle this, we introduce a training technique that pairs a Generative PCN with a support Encoding PCN. The two PCNs are trained in parallel to match their neural activations, without sequential propagation. We apply this to time series anomaly detection and show that our approach results in more stable, continuous, online learning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双预测编码网络（PCN）并行训练技术，通过配对生成式PCN与支持编码PCN并行匹配神经激活，消除时序反向误差传播瓶颈，应用于时间序列异常检测，实现更稳定连续的在线学习。
AI.motivation: 预测编码（PC）虽然能够实现神经网络层更新的并行化，但PCN的主要瓶颈在于顺序的反向误差传播（sequential backwards error propagation），这限制了其训练效率和实时性，尤其是在在线学习场景下。
AI.method: 引入一种训练技术，将生成式PCN与支持编码PCN配对，两个PCN并行训练以匹配彼此的神经激活，从而避免顺序传播。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于时间序列异常检测，实验表明该方法实现了更稳定、连续、在线的学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 配对双PCN并行训练方法有效解决了PCN中顺序反向传播的瓶颈，为时间序列异常检测提供了更稳定且支持在线学习的新型方案。

title: RePolicy: Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Policy Invocation in Agent Safeguards
summary: Safeguarding language model agents requires assessing complete execution trajectories under context-dependent safety policies. Existing policy-aware safeguards mainly rely on prompting or supervised fine-tuning, limiting their ability to adapt to unseen trajectories and changing policy contexts. We propose RePolicy, an agent safeguard that learns safety-policy invocation through reinforcement learning. Given an agent trajectory and a dynamic policy library, RePolicy invokes the applicable policy and uses its content to produce a policy-grounded rationale and safety judgment. We construct PolicyTraj-20K to support supervised initialization, followed by GRPO with verifiable rewards and policy-context perturbation. Experiments across six agent safety benchmarks show that RePolicy achieves strong overall safety-detection performance and robust policy invocation under varying policy contexts.

AI.tldr: RePolicy是一种通过强化学习训练的语言模型智能体安全防护机制，能够根据动态策略库调用适用策略，生成基于策略依据的推理和安全判断，在六个智能体安全基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有策略感知型安全防护主要依赖提示工程或监督微调，难以适应未见过的轨迹和不断变化的策略上下文，缺乏对完整执行轨迹的评估能力和对动态安全策略的自适应能力。
AI.method: 构建PolicyTraj-20K数据集进行监督初始化，随后使用GRPO（带可验证奖励的组相对策略优化）训练，并引入策略上下文扰动增强鲁棒性。模型接收智能体轨迹和动态策略库，调用适用策略并基于策略内容生成推理依据和安全判断。
AI.result: 在六个智能体安全基准上的实验表明，RePolicy取得了良好的整体安全检测性能，并在变化的策略上下文下实现了稳健的策略调用。
AI.conclusion: RePolicy证明了通过强化学习训练策略感知的安全防护机制，相比传统的提示和微调方法，能更好地适应动态策略环境并提升智能体轨迹的安全评估能力。

title: VizAnchor: Decoding Manipulation Intent from Tampering Visualizations via Dual-Anchor Reasoning
summary: Data visualizations are widely used for communicating information, but they are also vulnerable to intentional manipulations that induce misleading interpretations. Existing methods focus on locating tampered regions or recovering hidden information, without explaining how the visualization has been manipulated or why the resulting changes may mislead viewers. We propose \textbf{VizAnchor}, a framework for visualization manipulation understanding through dual-anchor evidence construction and VLM-based reasoning. In the first stage, VizAnchor constructs a semantic anchor to recover authentic chart information and a spatial anchor to localize tampered regions. In the second stage, three specialized agents decode the manipulation. The misleader grounding agent analyzes a four-panel visual prompt to predict the misleader information. The chart narrative reconstruction agent takes the original and tampered charts as inputs and reconstructs their respective visual narratives. Finally, the intent inferring agent integrates the visual evidence and misleader information to infer the misleading intent. We further construct a dataset for tampering localization and a dataset for misleading intent inferring. Evaluation shows that VizAnchor accurately localizes manipulations and produces faithful explanations of their manipulation, misleaders, and misleading intents.

AI.tldr: VizAnchor是一个用于数据可视化操纵理解的框架，通过双锚点证据构建（语义锚点恢复真实图表信息，空间锚点定位篡改区域）和基于VLM的三智能体推理（误导者定位、图表叙事重建、意图推断），来识别篡改内容并解释操纵方式与误导意图。实验表明该框架能准确定位操纵并产生忠实的解释。
AI.motivation: 数据可视化在信息传达中被广泛使用，但容易受到故意操纵而产生误导性解读。现有的方法仅关注定位篡改区域或恢复隐藏信息，无法解释可视化是如何被操纵的，以及由此产生的变化为何会误导观众。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供对操纵方式及其误导意图的深入理解。
AI.method: VizAnchor采用两阶段框架。第一阶段构建双锚点：语义锚点恢复真实的图表信息，空间锚点定位篡改区域。第二阶段使用三个专门的VLM智能体进行推理：1) 误导者定位智能体，分析四面板视觉提示以预测误导者信息；2) 图表叙事重建智能体，以原始和篡改图表为输入，分别重建其视觉叙事；3) 意图推断智能体，整合视觉证据和误导者信息来推断误导意图。此外还构建了用于篡改定位和误导意图推断的两个数据集。
AI.result: 评估结果表明VizAnchor能够准确定位篡改区域，并产生对操纵方式、误导者信息和误导意图的忠实解释。
AI.conclusion: VizAnchor通过双锚点证据构建与VLM多智能体推理的有效结合，实现了对数据可视化操纵的全面理解，不仅识别篡改位置，还能解释操纵机制和误导意图，为可视化安全领域提供了新的研究方向。

title: Parameter-Level Attribution of Symmetry in Trained Networks Though Parameter-Wise Functional Sensitivity
summary: When a network has learned a function with a known symmetry, can that symmetry be moved through the parametrisation---is there a motion in parameter space realising the group action in function space? We formulate this as a lifting problem for the realisation map $Φ:θ\mapsto f_θ$, and show that a smooth parameter-space action exists only if the tangent space to the function's symmetry orbit lies within the image of $\mathrm dΦ_θ$, whose columns are the \emph{functional sensitivities} of individual parameters. This condition is also sufficient for pointwise first-order lifting. Relaxing it in least squares yields two local parameter directions: one following the symmetry orbit, one descending towards the equivariant subspace, with residuals measuring what the parametrisation cannot reach. On a rotationally invariant classifier we find these directions induce their predicted function-space motion, but only locally: recomputed directions track the orbit and reduce the equivariance defect, while directions held fixed depart from both after training. The same holds for Hamiltonian neural networks trained on a rotationally symmetric potential, even though the architecture does not explicitly enforce the symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究网络学习到具有已知对称性的函数时，该对称性能否通过参数化实现"移动"——即在参数空间中是否存在对应函数空间群作用的运动。作者将其形式化为实现映射Φ的提升问题，证明了光滑参数空间作用存在的充要条件，并提出最小二乘松弛下两个局部参数方向（沿对称轨道和朝向等变子空间），在旋转不变分类器和哈密顿神经网络上验证了理论。
AI.motivation: 当网络学习到具有已知对称性的函数时，一个自然的问题是：这种对称性是否可以反映在参数空间中？即是否存在参数空间的运动实现函数空间的群作用。这关乎对已训练网络的对称性操控、解释和微调能力，但目前缺乏系统的理论框架。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为实现映射Φ:θ→f_θ的提升问题（lifting problem）。推导出光滑参数空间作用存在的必要条件：函数对称轨道的切空间需位于dΦ_θ的像内（其列为各参数的功能灵敏度）。证明该条件对逐点一阶提升也是充分的。在最小二乘松弛下推导出两个局部参数方向：一个沿对称轨道移动，一个朝等变子空间下降，残差度量参数化无法达到的部分。
AI.result: 在旋转不变分类器上，这些方向确实诱导了预测的函数空间运动，但仅限局部：重计算的参数方向能跟踪轨道并减少等变缺陷，而固定不变的参数方向在训练后会偏离两者。在哈密顿神经网络（训练于旋转对称势场）上也观察到了相同的现象，尽管该架构并未显式强制对称性。
AI.conclusion: 参数空间中的对称性运动在局部可通过本文提出的方向实现，但全局跟踪需要持续重计算参数方向。即使网络架构未显式编码对称性，经过对称数据训练的网络仍展现出可通过参数扰动实现的局部对称运动，揭示了对称性在参数化中的隐式体现及其局限性。

title: ReproAgent: Contract-Guided Paper-to-Code Reproduction
summary: Paper-to-code reproduction asks scientific AI agents to turn research papers into executable repositories that preserve the paper's method, protocol and artifacts. This is difficult because the specification is split: explicit paper content such as algorithms, metrics and artifacts is often lost across long agent trajectories, while implicit details such as framework defaults and conventions inherited from related work are absent from the paper. We introduce ReproAgent, a four-stage Prepare--Plan--Generate--Repair pipeline built around a persistent implementation contract with two channels: an implementation-requirement channel that turns paper snippets into code obligations, and a reference-evidence channel that retrieves content and structure evidence from related repositories. Both are bound to work packages, projected into file-level contracts, and consumed across generation and repair. On PaperBench Code-Dev, ReproAgent reaches the highest mean score among same-backbone scaffolds under both Claude-Sonnet-4.5 and Gemini-3-Flash. End-to-end channel ablations and per-paper cases support the contribution of both channels. Code and experimental artifacts are publicly available.

AI.tldr: ReproAgent是一个四阶段（Prepare-Plan-Generate-Repair）的论文到代码复现管线，围绕一个持久的实现契约构建，通过双通道（实现需求通道和参考证据通道）将论文中的显式与隐式规范转化为代码义务，在PaperBench Code-Dev上达到同骨干框架下的最高平均分。
AI.motivation: 论文到代码复现的难点在于规范是分散的：显式内容（算法、指标、工件）在长agent轨迹中容易丢失，而隐式细节（框架默认值、从相关工作继承的惯例）在论文中不存在，导致现有agent难以完整复现论文。
AI.method: 提出ReproAgent，一个四阶段Prepare-Plan-Generate-Repair管线。核心是一个持久的实现契约，包含两个通道：实现需求通道将论文片段转化为代码义务，参考证据通道从相关仓库检索内容和结构证据。两者绑定到工作包，投影到文件级契约，并在生成和修复阶段被消费。
AI.result: 在PaperBench Code-Dev基准上，ReproAgent在Claude-Sonnet-4.5和Gemini-3-Flash两种同骨干框架下均达到最高平均分；端到端通道消融实验和逐论文案例分析都支持两个通道的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 双通道实现契约机制能有效缓解长轨迹中显式规范丢失和隐式规范缺失的问题，提升论文到代码复现的成功率；代码和实验工件已公开。

title: Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation of SAM for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
summary: Surgical instrument segmentation (SIS) is fundamental for computer-assisted surgery, where reliable instrument masks enable precise scene understanding and clinical assistance.
